Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, bagachaaka orogendo koirana gochia ase ense y'Abayuda,

English: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hawatavuka pamoja nanyi wakiwa wamevaa silaha za vita, lazima wakubali kupokea milki yao pamoja nanyi katika nchi ya Kanaani.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi'eseegi bamboke gochia ng'umbu ya Yorodani, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.”

English: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakamkamata, wakamngʼoa macho yake, wakamchukua wakamteremsha mpaka Gaza. Wakiwa wamemfunga kwa pingu za shaba, wakamweka ili asage ngano huko gerezani.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakamobwata, bakamokonora amaiso, naende bakamoira gochia Gasa, bakamosiba ne chingataare chie chitaai. Bakamobeeka gosia obosie agwo ase enyomba y'obosibwa.

English: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.
Kiswahili: Msile kiumbe chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, kiwe kitambaacho kwa tumbo lake, au kitambaacho kwa miguu minne au kwa miguu mingi; ni chukizo.
Ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.

English: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mnyama akakamatwa pamoja na huyo nabii wa uongo ambaye alikuwa amefanya ishara kwa niaba ya huyo mnyama, ambaye kwa ishara hizi aliwadanganya wale waliopokea chapa ya huyo mnyama na kuiabudu sanamu yake. Hawa wawili wakatupwa wakiwa hai ndani ya ziwa la moto liwakalo kwa kiberiti.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekabwatwa amo nomobani oria bw’oborimo, ere oyokorete ebikone ase obosio bwaye. Ase ebikone ebio nigo are kong’aina abanto baria baetwe ekemanyererio ki’engiti eria na gosasiima omogwekano oye. Abwo babere bakarutwa bare moyo ase enyancha y’omorero egwoka ekebiriti.

English: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
Kiswahili: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,
Ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

English: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
Kiswahili: Kisha Maria akachukua chupa ya painti moja yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa, akayamimina miguuni mwa Yesu na kuifuta kwa nywele zake. Nyumba nzima ikajaa harufu nzuri ya manukato.
Ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.

English: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
Kiswahili: Wakatoa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Hekalu la Mungu talanta 5,000 na darkoni 10,000 za dhahabu, talanta 10,000 za fedha, talanta 18,000 za shaba na talanta 100,000 za chuma.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae chitaabu chitalanta chilifu isano ne chidarikoni chilifu ikomi, ne chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi, ne chitaai chitalanta chilifu ikomi na isano na isato, na ebioma chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo.

English: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. The Friends Eat, O friends, and drink; drink freely, O beloved. The Bride
Kiswahili: Nimekuja kwenye bustani yangu, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; nimekusanya manemane yangu pamoja na kikolezo changu. Nimekula sega langu la asali na asali yangu; nimekunywa divai yangu na maziwa yangu. Marafiki Kuleni, enyi marafiki, mnywe; kunyweni ya kutosha, ee wapenzi. Shairi La Nne Mpendwa
Ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu) Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono goika moichorwe nobwanchani! Ogoteera Gwa Kane (Omoriakari)

English: Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
Kiswahili: Tiro amejijengea ngome imara, amelundika fedha kama mavumbi na dhahabu kama taka za mitaani.
Ekegusii: Turo bweagacheire chiburi chinkong’u, naende osangereirie chindwenyi chi’echifeta chinyinge buna orotu, ne chitaabu chinyinge buna eubi ere ase chinchera.

English: Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother, and buried him in the tomb of his ancestors at Modin.
Kiswahili: Yonathani na Simoni walimchukua Yuda ndugu yao, wakamzika katika kaburi la mababu zake huko Modin.
Ekegusii: Yonathani na Simioni bakabogoria omobere oye na koyotindeka ase chimbeera chi'echisokoro chiabo agwo Modeini.

English: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
Kiswahili: Ingawa yule mwanamke aliendelea kumshawishi Yosefu siku baada ya siku, Yosefu alikataa kukutana naye kimwili wala kukaa karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Akaba okonagokwana na Yusufu rituko ase rituko, korende Yusufu tamwanchera baraare komo, gose koba amo.

English: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I am honored through Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen.”
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri watajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana nitakapojipatia utukufu kupitia Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.”
Ekegusii: Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”

English: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hakika adui zetu wameangamizwa, nao moto umeteketeza mali zao.’
Ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.

English: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Farao akawauliza, “Je tunaweza kumpata yeyote kama mtu huyu, ambaye Roho wa Mungu yumo ndani yake?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria abasomba baye: “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”

English: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
Kiswahili: Lakini upinde wake ulibaki imara, mikono yake ikatiwa nguvu, na mkono wa Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo, kwa sababu ya Mchungaji, Mwamba wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko 'Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.

English: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.

English: After Joshua had spoken to the people, seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yoshua kuzungumza na watu, wale makuhani saba wenye kuzibeba zile baragumu saba mbele za Bwana, wakatangulia mbele, wakipiga baragumu zao na Sanduku la Agano la Bwana likawafuata.
Ekegusii: Erio, buna Yoshua abachigete, abakuani batano na babere bakagenda bosio bw’Esanduki y’Omonene bakobugia ebitureeri biria bi’omochengo, na Esanduki y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene ebogoirie korwa magega.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Nitakomesha makundi ya wajeuri ya Misri kwa mkono wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ninsirie obotenenku bwa Misiri goetera ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni.

English: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness, but who can survive a broken spirit?
Kiswahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning’o orayoremererie omoika ore n’omoichano?

English: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b'omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang'ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.

English: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness and recovery.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Merodaki-Baladani, mwana wa Baladani mfalme wa Babeli, akamtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi, kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia habari za kuugua na kupona kwake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omorwoti o Babiloni Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira riruube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabeete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.

English: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
Kiswahili: bali watasema, ‘Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, aliyewatoa wana wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na nchi zote alizokuwa amewafukuzia.’ Maana nitawarudisha katika nchi niliyowapa baba zao.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio nigo barakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na korwa ase chinse chionsi, agwo ase abaseretie gochia”. Ayio nakoreke, ekiagera inche nimbairanie, mbarente ase ense yabo abanyene, eyio naete chisokoro chiabo. Ebisusuro bikorentwa

English: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Washiloni waliorudi ni: Asaya mzaliwa wa kwanza na wanawe.
Ekegusii: na korwa Silo Asaia, omwana omotangi amo nabana baye abamura.

English: A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
Kiswahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Omoika bw'oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning'o orayoremererie omoika ore n'omoichano?

English: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kusema, “Rabi.” Akambusu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi aigete akagenda bwango, goika ase Yeso, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.

English: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.” The Parable of the Wicked Tenants (Matthew 21:33–46; Mark 12:1–12)
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.” Mfano Wa Wapangaji Waovu (Mathayo 21:33-46; Marko 12:1-12)
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.” Omoreng’anio bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu (Mat 21:33-46; Mar 12:1-12)

English: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakati njaa ilipokuwa imeenea katika nchi yote, Yosefu akafungua ghala za vyakula na kuwauzia Wamisri nafaka, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabeete endito ase ense ya Misiri.

English: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
Kiswahili: Bali kwenu ninyi mnaoliheshimu Jina langu, jua la haki litawazukia, lenye kuponya katika mabawa yake. Nanyi mtatoka nje na kurukaruka kama ndama aliyeachiwa kutoka zizini.
Ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ’ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaaba chiaye. Inwe inamosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.

English: Anyone who was found with any a book of the covenant, and if any consented to the law, the king's sentence delivered him to death.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aliyepatikana na kitabu cha agano, na yeyote aliyekubali sheria, hukumu ya mfalme ilimhukumu kifo.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kwomorwoti, onde bwensi orenge konyoorwa negetabu giokobwatana gose gotunyana amachiiko agaitwa.

English: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
Kiswahili: Viumbe wale waliposogea nilisikia sauti ya mabawa yao, kama ngurumo ya maji yaendayo kasi, kama sauti ya Mwenyezi, kama makelele ya jeshi. Waliposimama kimya walishusha mabawa yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa ebio biarenge kogenda, okoeera gwe chimbaaba chiabo nigo kwarenge ase amato ane buna okw'amaache amaange, buna eriogi ri'Omonguru, ee, nigo kwarenge buna okwoga kw'emeganda y'eseegi. Ekero biarenge gotenena, nigo biarenge kwororobia chimbaaba chiabo gochia inse.

English: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
Kiswahili: Lakini watamwitaje yeye ambaye hawajamwamini? Nao watawezaje kumwamini yeye ambaye hawajamsikia? Tena watamsikiaje bila mtu kuwahubiria?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inaki baramorangerie ere bataramwegena? Naende inaki baramwegene oyo batana koigwa amang'ana igoro yaye? Naende inaki baraigwe batari nomorandia?

English: So Moses declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: ‘Panapo usiku wa manane Mimi nitapita katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Farao, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Botuko gati ninche ng’ete egati y’Abamisiri.

English: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
Kiswahili: Mtu atamkamata mmoja wa ndugu zake katika nyumba ya baba yake na kusema, “Unalo joho, sasa uwe kiongozi wetu, tawala lundo hili la magofu!”
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio omonto nabwate oyomwabo baiboire komo amoteebie, “Aye nobwate chianga okobeeka, ase ayio kabe omogambi oito, otenenere obogaambi obo bwanyegerigwe.”

English: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo mnapowapa wahitaji, msipige panda mbele yenu kama wafanyavyo wanafiki katika masinagogi na mitaani, ili wasifiwe na watu. Amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupokea thawabu yao.
Ekegusii: Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang'ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi'emechie, erinde batogigwe n'abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng'a barabwo banyorire eng'eria yabo.

English: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
Kiswahili: “Sasa nitakufanya uwe mdogo miongoni mwa mataifa, aliyedharauliwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Naki ningokore obe omoke ase egati y'ebisaku. Abanto bonsi nabagochaye.

English: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sijanyamazishwa na giza, wala kwa giza nene linalofunika uso wangu.
Ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.

English: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ukawatia mikononi mwa adui zao, ambao waliwatesa. Lakini walipoteswa, wakakulilia wewe. Kutoka mbinguni uliwasikia, nawe kwa huruma zako kuu ukawapa waokozi, waliowaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio okababeka ase amaboko 'ababisa babo, na barabwo bakabachanda. Ekero barenge ase emechando yabo, bakarera asore; aye okabaigwa agwo igoro; na ase engencho y'amaabera ao amange, okabaa abatooria abwo bakabatooria korwa ase amaboko 'ababisa babo.

English: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
Kiswahili: Kukazuka mabishano miongoni mwa wanafunzi kuhusu ni nani miongoni mwao atakayekuwa mkuu kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o ase bare ore omonene kobua abande.

English: I will lay waste Pathros, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgment on Thebes.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya Pathrosi kuwa ukiwa na kuitia moto Soani, nami nitaipiga kwa adhabu Thebesi
Ekegusii: Ninsarie ense ya Patirosi esire ebe bosa, ninsambe Soani nomorero, na inachere omochie okorokwa No ekiina.

English: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na tatu Delaya, ya ishirini na nne Maazia.
Ekegusii: obwa emerongo ebere na gatato bokagwera Delaya, na obwa emerongo ebere na kane Maasia.

English: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku zinakuja,’ asema Bwana, ‘wakati nitakapotimiza ahadi yangu ya rehema niliyoifanya kwa nyumba ya Israeli na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Naama! Amatuko ngocha are ndaikeranie eira narierete chiamate chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abayuda.

English: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe. Msikilizeni yeye.
Ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abamino, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche. Oyio nere moraigwere.

English: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Zabuloni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
Kiswahili: Walipomwomba akae nao kwa muda mrefu zaidi hakukubali.
Ekegusii: Ekero bamoboretie amente amatuko ande komenya amo nabarabwo, akaanga.

English: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
Kiswahili: Lakini saa yaja, tena ipo, ambapo wale waabuduo halisi, watamwabudu Baba katika roho na kweli. Watu wanaoabudu namna hii, ndio Baba anawatafuta.
Ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasiimi b'ekeene barasasiime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.

English: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
Kiswahili: basi na usikie kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako, ukafanye lolote ambalo mgeni huyo anakuomba, ili mataifa yote ya dunia wapate kujua jina lako na wakuogope kama wafanyavyo watu wako Israeli nao wapate pia kujua kwamba nyumba hii niliyoijenga imeitwa kwa Jina lako.
Ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.

English: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
Kiswahili: Zebuli aliyekuwa mtawala wa mji aliposikia aliyosema Gaali mwana wa Ebedi, akakasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Sebuli, omogambi bw’omochie oria, aigwete amang’ana a Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, akaba n’endamwamu enene.

English: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies.'” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Mwambieni Daudi, ‘Mfalme hataki zawadi nyingine kuwa mahari isipokuwa magovi 100 ya Wafilisti, ili kulipiza kisasi juu ya adui zake.' ” Mawazo ya Sauli yalikuwa Daudi akaanguke mikononi mwa Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: na Saulo akabachika bateebie Daudi ng'a, “Omorwoti taganeti omoe enibo ende yonsi ase okomonyuomera omoiseke oye, otatiga aganetie omorentere amasankwa a isiko ay'ebiimo bi'obosaacha bi'Abafilisti rigana erimo bakwete, na igo omoruserie egesiomba ase ababisa baye.” Ase enchera eyio Saulo nigo areengereretie ng'a Daudi agwe ase amaboko y'Abafilisti.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hiyo pamoja na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi'egesaku kia Nafutali.

English: He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
Kiswahili: Yeye atailinda miguu ya watakatifu wake, lakini waovu watanyamazishwa kwenye giza. “Si kwa nguvu mtu hushinda;
Ekegusii: “Narende amagoro yabegenwa baye, korende abakori amabe nigo barasirigwe ase omosunte, onde tari orabue ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene.

English: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Ulamu alikuwa: Bedani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase.
Ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.

English: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akarudi mpaka Galilaya, akiwa amejaa nguvu za Roho Mtakatifu, nazo habari zake zikaenea katika sehemu zote za nchi za kandokando.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi'Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi'ense eria.

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ndipo Wamisri watasikia juu ya jambo hili! Kwa uweza wako uliwapandisha watu hawa kutoka miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,

English: And he added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
Kiswahili: Akaongeza kumwambia, “Taja ujira wako nami nitakulipa.”
Ekegusii: Bono nteebia eng’eria yao ey’oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”

English: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, unakwenda wapi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakokwenda huwezi kunifuata sasa, lakini utanifuata baadaye.”
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane magega.”

English: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall and twelve cubits in circumference; each was hollow, four fingers thick.
Kiswahili: Kila nguzo ilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na nane, kimo chake na mzunguko dhiraa kumi na mbili, na unene wa nyanda nne, na zote zilikuwa wazi ndani.
Ekegusii: Kera eyemo ye chisiiro chiria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere ekayeetanana. Nigo yaroisetigwe buna omobirangwa na obonetu bw’etai yaroisetie omobirangwa oria nigo bwarenge obogare bw’ebiara bine.

English: Does anyone harbor anger against another and expect healing from the Lord?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna mtu yeyote anayemkasirikia mwingine na kutarajia uponyaji kutoka kwa Bwana?
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okomenya nekeririanda ase oyomwabo, inaki ere araganie Omonene amwabere amororere amaabera?

English: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.'”
Kiswahili: na kusema, ‘Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye ameruhusu macho yangu kuona mrithi juu ya kiti changu cha ufalme leo hii.' ”
Ekegusii: agateeba: Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyo oeire oyomo ase oroiboro rwane ribaga goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane ki'oborwoti rituko ria reero, nainche neroreire ayio namaiso aane.”

English: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
Kiswahili: Hakika umesikia yale ambayo wafalme wa Ashuru wametenda kwa nchi zote, wakiwaangamiza kabisa. Je, wewe utaokolewa?
Ekegusii: Aye kwaigure aya abarwoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?

English: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
Kiswahili: Mara mfalme akatuma askari mmojawapo wa walinzi wake kukileta kichwa cha Yohana. Akaenda na kumkata Yohana kichwa humo gerezani,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omorwoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachiika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,

English: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: na jinsi ambavyo tangu utoto umeyajua Maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukuhekimisha upate wokovu kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inaki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariiko amaachenu, ayaraanyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, sikia maombi yangu, usikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang'ana aane ngokwana.

English: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, “Nitaingia vitani nikiwa nimejibadilisha, lakini wewe uvae majoho yako ya kifalme.” Kwa hiyo mfalme wa Israeli akajibadilisha na kwenda vitani.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agateebia Yehosafati, “Inche nigo ngwekona ase ogwetuba timanyekana, erio ngende ase esegi, korende aye obeke chianga chiao chi’oborwoti.” Na omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agekona ase ogwetuba tamanyekana, akagenda ase esegi.

English: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya amri aliyotoa Mfalme Dario, Tatenai mtawala wa Ngʼambo ya Mto Frati na Shethar-Bozenai na wenzao wakaitekeleza kwa bidii na kwa makini.
Ekegusii: Bono Tatenai, omogabana bw'orogongo rore bosongo y'orooche roria, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abarenge kogamba komo, bagakora ase okwerwa amang'ana ayio onsi Dario omorwoti konya achiikire.

English: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Huko Yerusalemu Daudi akaoa wake wengine zaidi na akawa baba wa wana na mabinti wengi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.

English: They spoke against the God of Jerusalem as they had spoken against the gods of the peoples of the earth—the work of human hands. Jerusalem Delivered from the Assyrians (2 Kings 19:35–37; Isaiah 37:36–38)
Kiswahili: Wakanena juu ya Mungu wa Yerusalemu kama vile walivyonena juu ya miungu ya mataifa mengine ya dunia ambayo ni kazi ya mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Bagakwana igoro ya Nyasae o Yerusalemu, buna bakwanete igoro ye chinyasae chi’abaanto b’ebisaku b’ense eye, chiria chiaroisetigwe namaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
Kiswahili: Yuda na Sila, ambao wenyewe walikuwa manabii, wakanena maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo na kuwajenga katika imani wale ndugu walioamini.
Ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y'abaminto ase amang'ana amange, bakababeeka chinguru.

English: Or don't you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu (sasa ninasema na wale wanaoijua sheria), je, hamjui ya kwamba sheria ina mamlaka tu juu ya mtu wakati akiwa hai?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiiko) ng'a amachiiko nigo akogaambera omonto ekero are moyo?

English: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.
Kiswahili: Nimesikia kwamba roho ya miungu iko ndani yako, na kwamba una ufahamu, akili na hekima ya pekee.
Ekegusii: Naigure igoro yao ng'a omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao, naende ng'a oborabu, na okomanya, na obong'aini obuya mono, nigo bikonyorekana ime yao

English: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Unashamed of the Gospel
Kiswahili: Kwa wote walioko Rumi wapendwao na Mungu na kuitwa kuwa watakatifu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Maombi Na Shukrani
Ekegusii: Nabariikeire inwe mwensi abamomenyete Rumi, abanchwa ba Nyasae, abamwarangeretigwe koba abachenu. Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosaba kw’ogoaka mbuya mono

English: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli wote wakasikia habari kwamba: “Sauli ameshambulia ngome ya Wafilisti, nao sasa Israeli wamekuwa harufu mbaya kwa Wafilisti.” Basi watu waliitwa kuungana na Sauli huko Gilgali.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakaigwa amang'ana agokwanwa ng'a Saulo oitire omotang'ani bw'abarwani b'Abafilisti, naende ng'a Abaisraeli babeire okogechia ase Abafirisiti. Abanto bakarangerigwa babwatane na Saulo bagende Giligali.

English: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
Kiswahili: Chagueni watu watatu kutoka kwenye kila kabila. Nitawatuma hao watu kukagua hiyo nchi na kuniandikia mapendekezo ya mgawanyo wa urithi wa kila kabila. Nao watanirudia.
Ekegusii: Nchorere abanto batato korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbatome bataare ase ense engima, bayiate na kworokia ase okorika chinsemo chigwenerete koba omwando bwa kera egesaku. Erio bandetere amang'ana.

English: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Ee Bwana nihurumie, niponye, maana nimekutenda dhambi wewe.”
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nateebete: “Omonene, indorera amaabera, ingwenie omoyo one, ekiagera nakorire ebibe asore.”

English: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, heri ni mtu yule anayekutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw'Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.

English: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
Kiswahili: Mmejengwa juu ya msingi wa mitume na manabii, naye Kristo Yesu mwenyewe ndiye jiwe kuu la pembeni.
Ekegusii: mwagaachirwe igoro y’oboroso bw’abatomwa na ababani, na Kristo Yeso omonyene nere rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. “Go, worship the LORD your God,” he said. “But who exactly will be going?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaletwa kwa Farao. Farao akawaambia, “Nendeni, mkamwabudu Bwana Mungu wenu. Lakini ni nani hasa watakaokwenda?”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakarentwa ase Farao, Ere akabateebia, “Genda, mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino. Korende ning’o nang’o moganetie mogende komo?”

English: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don't have.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama nia ya kutoa ipo, kitolewacho kinakubalika kulingana na kile mtu alicho nacho, wala si kwa kile ambacho hana.
Ekegusii: Naki aase ogwancha kore, iga bigwancherwa koreng'ana nebi omonto are nabio, tari ase ebi atabwati.

English: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Lebanoni hautoshi kwa moto wa madhabahuni, wala wanyama wake hawatoshi kwa sadaka za kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero, ne ching'iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa.

English: Cherubim and palm trees like those on the walls were carved on the doors of the outer sanctuary, and there was a wooden canopy outside, on the front of the portico.
Kiswahili: Juu ya hiyo milango ya Patakatifu palinakshiwa makerubi na miti ya mitende kama yale yaliyonakshiwa kwenye kuta, na kulikuwa na ubao ulioningʼinia mbele ya baraza kwa nje.
Ekegusii: Ase omorangwa bw’Aase Aachenu emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba na ey’emekendo nigo yachabeire aroro yagwekaine eria yarenge ase chinyasi. Ekerama gie chibao nigo kiarenge bosio bw’egesona isiko.

English: And when the priests of Nanaea's temple had set the treasures out, and he had come there with a small company within the wall of the sacred precinct, they locked the temple when Antiochus had come in.
Kiswahili: Na makuhani wa hekalu la Nanaea walipokwisha kuweka hazina nje, naye akaja huko na kundi dogo ndani ya ukuta wa eneo takatifu, walifunga hekalu Antiochus alipoingia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakuhani baigorete ebigachero, Antioko n'abanto baye bake igo bagasoa ime ase Hekalu gosakora enibo, ekero basoa abakuani bagasieka emerangwa rimo rioka,

English: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona Simoni na Andrea nduguye wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini, kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simioni na Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.

English: So you are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread, for on this very day I brought your divisions out of the land of Egypt. You must keep this day as a permanent statute for the generations to come.
Kiswahili: “Mtaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo siku ile niliyovitoa vikosi vyenu kutoka Misri. Mtaiadhimisha siku hii kwa vizazi vyenu vyote kuwa amri ya kudumu.
Ekegusii: Goika mobe mokorenda rituko eri rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekiagera ase rituko eri nario emeganda yaino yarusetigwe ase ense ya Misiri. Morende rituko erio ebiaare ase ebiaare. Oko nakwo korabe ogochika ase more kogenderera botambe.

English: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo mzigo wao utainuliwa kutoka mabegani mwenu, na nira yao kutoka shingoni mwenu; nira itavunjwa kwa sababu ya kutiwa mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio chigurube Abaasuri babeegete ase amareko aino nchirusigweo, na amakorogoto babeegete ase amagoti aino nabunwe ase obonetu bwaino.”

English: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won't enter into my rest.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng'a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.

English: For who knows what is good for a man during the few days in which he passes through his fleeting life like a shadow? Who can tell a man what will come after him under the sun?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni nani anayejua lililo jema kwa ajili ya maisha ya mwanadamu, katika siku chache na za ubatili anazopita kama kivuli? Ni nani awezaye kumwambia yatakayotokea chini ya jua baada ya yeye kuondoka?
Ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete egento kere ekiya ase omonto, ekero amenyete amatuko amake ase obogima bore bosa, agoeta buna omorengari? Ning’o oranyare goteebia omonto amang’ana arabe korwa magega yaye aiga inse y’erioba?

English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'”
Kiswahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa. Ninawaambia, hamtaniona tena mpaka wakati ule mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.' ”
Ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ere ritombe; na inche nabateebirie ng'a timokondora nonya ng'ake, goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri 'Omonene.”

English: But as for you and your officials, I know that you still do not fear the LORD our God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninajua kuwa wewe na maafisa wako bado hammwogopi Bwana Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Korende nimanyete ng’a, aye na abasomba bao, timomoirogeti Omonene Nyasae nonya mbono.”

English: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
Kiswahili: Utalisubu kwa pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera ensemo.

English: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
Kiswahili: Katika Kristo sisi nasi tumepata urithi, tukisha kuchaguliwa sawasawa na kusudi la Mungu, yeye ambaye hufanya mambo yote kulingana na kusudi la mapenzi yake,
Ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng'ana buna twachooretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oy'okorete onsi koreng'ana nogwancha kwaye,

English: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
Kiswahili: Nguvu zenu zitatumika bila ya mafanikio, kwa sababu ardhi yenu haitawazalia mazao yake, wala miti ya nchi yenu haitazaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yaino emekong’u moraabe mogokora, nigo eraabe bosa, ekiagera ense yaino tekwama endagera, na emete tekwama amatunda.

English: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi maneno yako yalivyo matamu kwangu, matamu kuliko asali katika kinywa changu!
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ao naki are amansu ase ’nde! Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.

English: They all, looking up to heaven, blessed the Lord who had manifested himself, saying, “Blessed is he who has preserved his own place undefiled!”
Kiswahili: Wote, wakitazama juu mbinguni, wakamsifu Bwana aliyejidhihirisha, wakisema, "Heri yeye aliyelinda mahali pake pasipo najisi!"
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo akarigereria igoro na gotogia Omonene ase obobui bwaye bw'ogotanga Hekalu yaye tesarigwa.

English: They came to Ecbatana, and arrived at the house of Raguel. But Sarah met them; and she greeted them, and they her. Then she brought them into the house.
Kiswahili: Wakafika Ekbatana, wakafika nyumbani kwa Ragueli. Sara akawakuta, akawasalimu, nao wakawakaribisha. Kisha akawaingiza ndani ya nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ekero Tobia n'momalaika Rafaeli basoete ase omochie bw'Ekbatana, Tobia agateebia Rafaeli, “Oyominto Asaria, ng'ire riimo rioka goika ase oyominto Ragueli.” Omomalaika oria akamoira rimo rioka goika ase enyomba ya Ragueli, bakanyora Ragueli oikaransete ange n'egesieri kegochia mwaye. Barabwo bakamokwania, nere agaitaba erio akabaarigania bagasoa nyomba mwaye.

English: and he returned to Jerusalem. They built strong cities in Judea, the stronghold that was in Jericho, and Emmaus, Bethhoron, Bethel, Timnath, Pharathon, and Tephon, with high walls and gates and bars.
Kiswahili: kisha akarudi Yerusalemu. Wakajenga miji yenye ngome katika Yudea, ngome iliyokuwa Yeriko, na Emau, Beth-horoni, Betheli, Timna, Faraothoni, na Tefoni, yenye kuta ndefu, malango na makomeo.
Ekegusii: Magega yokoirana goika Yerusalemu, Bakide akaagacha chinyasi chintambe na ebisieri ebikong'u ase chinyomba chiaye ase omochie o Yudea: Emau, Beth-horoni, Betheli, Timunati, Farathoni, Tefoni; na ase orwaki rwa Yeriko.

English: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
Kiswahili: Lakini Barzilai akamjibu mfalme, “Je, nitaishi miaka mingine mingapi, hata nipande kwenda Yerusalemu pamoja na mfalme?
Ekegusii: Korende Barisilai akamoiraneria, “Emiaka y'ane nerenga etigarete ngochia koba moyo, ing'a ngende amo naye Yerusalemu komenyao?

English: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
Kiswahili: Umewafanya watu kama samaki baharini, kama viumbe wa bahari wasio na mtawala.
Ekegusii: Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi'enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.

English: Saul said to the troops who were with him, “Call the roll and see who has left us.” And when they had called the roll, they saw that Jonathan and his armor-bearer were not there.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akawaambia watu wale waliokuwa pamoja naye, “Kagueni jeshi mkaone ni nani ameondoka katikati yetu.” Walipokagua, akawa ni Yonathani na mbeba silaha wake ambao hawakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia Abanto abwo baarenge nere, “Bara Abanto morore gose ning’o otari aa ase tore.” Na ekero baababarete bakarora ng’a Yonathani na omomura oyorenge komobogoreria ebirwanero tibaiyo.

English: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.
Kiswahili: nayo mataifa mageni yaliyo makatili sana yaliukata huo mti na kuuacha. Matawi yake yalianguka juu ya milima na kwenye mabonde yote, vitawi vyake vikavunjika na kusambaa katika makorongo yote ya nchi. Mataifa yote ya duniani yakaondoka kutoka kwenye kivuli chake na kuuacha.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebisaku ebigeni, abare abatindi mono goetania ab'ebisaku binde, mbayogeche bayotige inse. Chinsagia chiaye nchigwe, chibeere igoro ase ebitunwa na inse ase amagoko onsi. Ebisagia biaye mbibuneke bibeere ase chindooche chionsi chi'ense eria. Abanto bonsi bare ase ense eria mbatame, barue ase ekiriri kiaye bayotige.

English: “It is for money which Jonathan your brother owed to the king's treasury, by reason of the offices which he had, that we are detaining him.
Kiswahili: "Ni kwa ajili ya fedha ambazo Yonathani ndugu yako alikuwa anadaiwa hazina ya mfalme, kwa sababu ya nyadhifa alizokuwa nazo, tunamzuia."
Ekegusii: Nigo imobeegete momura omino inse yoborendi ekiagera ere taakanete amadeni ase ekegancha kiomorwoti ase chingaki chioborai bwaye.

English: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.
Kiswahili: Hakuacha ukahaba wake aliouanza huko Misri, wakati ambapo tangu ujana wake wanaume walilala naye, wakikumbatia kifua cha ubikira wake na kumwaga tamaa zao juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ohola tatigete obonyaka bwaye, boria anarete gokora korwa ekero arenge Misiri, ekiagera ase oboiseke bwaye abasacha nigo barenge gokora obonyaka nere, bagasiria obwekungi bwaye, bakaumora okogania kwabo okobe igoro ase are.

English: So the king ordered Doeg, “You turn and strike down the priests!” And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests himself. On that day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akamwagiza Doegi, “Wewe geuka ukawaue makuhani.” Hivyo basi Doegi Mwedomu, akageuka na kuwaua. Siku ile aliwaua watu themanini na watano wavaao visibau vya kitani.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia Doegi: “Aye imoka oite abakuani abwo,” na Doegi, Omoedomu, akaimoka, akabaita. Ase rituko erio agaita Abanto emerongo etano etato, na batano (85), abwo babeegete ebisibao bi’egatani.

English: because I, the LORD, will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak a message and bring it to pass, declares the Lord GOD.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mimi Bwana nitasema neno nitakalo, nalo litatimizwa bila kuchelewa. Kwa maana katika siku zako, wewe nyumba ya kuasi, nitatimiza kila nisemalo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkwane ring’ana nganetie gokwana, na rirorio goika riikerane, tirigoteebana nonya ng’ake. Inwe egesaku getari koigwera, ase amatuko aino ninkwane ring’ana ndiikeranie. Nabo inche Omonene nateebire.”

English: All the saints greet you.
Kiswahili: Watakatifu wote wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw'Omonene Yeso Kristo, na obwanchani bwa Nyasae na okobwatana kw'Omoika Omochenu bibe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka Ramesesi katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa kwanza, siku iliyofuata Pasaka. Walitembea kwa ujasiri wazi mbele ya Wamisri wote,
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, rituko ria ikomi na gatano, rituko riarenge kobwatia eri’Epasaka, Abaisraeli bakang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bakaimoka korwa Ramesesi, bare noboremu. Bakarua ase amasio y’Abamisiri,

English: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
Kiswahili: Kuota ndoto kwingi na maneno mengi ni ubatili. Kwa hiyo simama katika kicho cha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero amang'ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae.

English: He sent to him golden vessels and furniture for the table, and gave him permission to drink in golden vessels, and to be clothed in purple, and to have a golden buckle.
Kiswahili: Alimtumia vyombo vya dhahabu na samani za mezani, na akampa ruhusa ya kunywa katika vyombo vya dhahabu, na kuvikwa zambarau, na kuvaa kifungo cha dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Akamotomera ebibekerero bitaabu biogokorera emeremo ase emesa, akamoa ribaga riokonywera ebikobe bi'etaabu, kweboyia chianga chi'oborwoti na kobeeka omootoro bw'etaabu.

English: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
Kiswahili: Isaki alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini alipomwoa Rebeka binti Bethueli Mwaramu kutoka Padan-Aramu, nduguye Labani Mwaramu.
Ekegusii: Isaka nigo areenge nemiaka emerongo ene ekero anyuomete Rebeka, omoiseke o Betueli, Omoaramu o Padan‐Aramu, omoiseke omwabo Labani, Omoaramu.

English: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life. The Glory of the New Covenant (Exodus 34:10–35)
Kiswahili: Ndiye alituwezesha sisi kuwa wahudumu wa Agano Jipya: si wa andiko, bali wa Roho; kwa kuwa andiko huua bali Roho hutia uzima. Utukufu Wa Agano Jipya
Ekegusii: oyotoisaneirie koba abasomba b’okobwatana okoyia; tari ase ririiko, korende ase Omoika. Naki ririiko nigo rigoita, korende Omoika orua obogima.

English: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwisho wa mwaka wa nne, Absalomu akamwambia mfalme, “Naomba unipe ruhusa niende Hebroni nikatimize nadhiri niliyomwekea Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y'emiaka ene koyaerire, Abisalomu agateebia omorwoti, “Koranche ong'e ribaga 'ngeende Heburoni goikerania eira y'ane narierete Omonene.

English: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
Kiswahili: pamoja na eneo lote la Araba mashariki ya Yordani, na kuenea mpaka Bahari ya Araba kwenye miteremko ya Pisga.
Ekegusii: Bakaira orogongo gochakera rikura moocha ya Yorodani goikera ase Enyancha y’omonyoo inse y’ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.

English: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Ruthu akasema, “Naomba niendelee kupata kibali machoni pako, bwana wangu. Kwa maana umenifariji na umezungumza kwa ukarimu na mjakazi wako, hata ingawa mimi si bora kama mmoja wa watumishi wako wa kike.”
Ekegusii: Rutu akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, kwabeire omuya mono ase ’nde, kwandemirie ase ogokwana nobwororo nainche, omosomba oo, nonya tindenga’aini oyomo bw’abasomba bao abaiseke.”

English: For blessed is wood through which comes righteousness;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana heri mti ambao kupitia huo uadilifu huja;
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kogacha ase obwato boria bwa Nuhu obwo bwaretete ogotoreka.

English: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli sheria hudai kwamba, karibu kila kitu kitakaswe kwa damu, wala pasipo kumwaga damu, hakuna msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are goteeba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao. Ebibe mbiarusetigwe ase okong’wanswa gwa Kristo.

English: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayewashtaki wale ambao Mungu amewateua? Ni Mungu mwenyewe ndiye mwenye kuwahesabia haki.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gosoera abachoore ba Nyasae? Nyasae nere okobaa oboronge.

English: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Mimi mwenyewe nimekuweka kuwa mwangalizi wa sadaka zote zitakazotolewa kwangu; matoleo yote matakatifu Waisraeli wanayonipa ninakupa wewe na wanao kama sehemu yenu na fungu lenu la kawaida.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Rora, nakoeire okoruegwa konde gwonsi gokoruegwa ase ’nde, obe gokorenda. Ebinto bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli bakorua, ebio nakobieire bibe egetari kiao amo neki’ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.

English: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
Kiswahili: Wakawaona baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakila chakula kwa mikono iliyo najisi, yaani, bila kunawa kama ilivyotakiwa na sheria ya dini ya Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bakarora abande baborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.

English: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images surpassed those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
Kiswahili: Kama vile mkono wangu ulivyotwaa falme za sanamu, falme ambazo vinyago vyao vilizidi vile vya Yerusalemu na Samaria:
Ekegusii: Onye okoboko kwane kwaigete ase amarwoti arenge gosasiima emegwekano, emegwekano eyio yabombire yarenge emenene kobua eya Yerusalemu na Samaria.

English: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, “Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abimeleki alikuwa bado hajamsogelea, kwa hiyo akasema, “Je, Bwana utaliharibu taifa lisilo na hatia?
Ekegusii: Abimeleki konya ataraba nere, akabora: “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo oraite nonya nabanyaboronge?

English: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Kiswahili: niliendelea kuomboleza kama vile wao ni rafiki au ndugu. Niliinamisha kichwa chini kwa huzuni kama ninayemwombolezea mama yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y'okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng'ina akuure.

English: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
Kiswahili: Yehoshafati mwana wa Parua: katika Isakari;
Ekegusii: Yehosafati, mosinto o Parua, agatenenera orogongo rwa Isakaru.

English: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
Kiswahili: Makabila ya jangwani watamsujudia, na adui zake wataramba mavumbi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase erooro mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, n'ababisa baye bamene orotu.

English: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Atawafanya imara mpaka mwisho, ili msiwe na hatia siku ile ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nere orabakong'ie goika omoerio, erinde timocha koba nokomocha ase rituko riria ri'Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikatazama, nami nikaona mkono ulionyooshwa kunielekea. Nao ulikuwa na ukurasa wa kitabu,
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie, nkarora okoboko koramboire gocha asende, na ase okoboko okwo egetabu yaringire yarengeo.

English: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
Kiswahili: Karibishaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kama Kristo alivyowakaribisha ninyi ili kumletea Mungu utukufu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo moroisanie buna Kristo nere abaroisetie inwe, erinde Nyasae abaakwe.

English: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, kulitokea vita dhidi ya Wafilisti, huko Gezeri. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Sipai, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai, nao Wafilisti wakashindwa.
Ekegusii: Magega y'ayio esegi ekaba ase egati y'Abaisraeli na Abafirisiti agwo Geseri. Sibekai Omohusa agaita Sipai, omonto bw'ororeria rw'amamonto; na igo Abafirisiti bakabugwa na kogamberwa.

English: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
Kiswahili: Sitaweka mbele ya macho yangu kitu kiovu. Ninayachukia matendo ya watu wasio na imani; hawatashikamana nami.
Ekegusii: Tinkobeeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abaanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.

English: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, na mkaabudu katika mahali pa kuwekea miguu yake; yeye ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.

English: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him; for God's temple is holy, which you are.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiliharibu hekalu la Mungu, Mungu atamwangamiza; kwa maana hekalu la Mungu ni takatifu, na ninyi ndiyo hilo hekalu.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ogosaria Hekalu ya Nyasae, Nyasae nasarie omonto oyio; naki Hekalu ya Nyasae nenchenu, nero ninwe.

English: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other's flesh.”
Kiswahili: nikasema, “Sitakuwa mchungaji wenu. Waache wanaokufa wafe na wanaoangamia waangamie. Wale waliobakia kila mmoja na ale nyama ya mwenzake.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateba: “Inche tinkobarisia inwe rinde. Oyo ogokwa, tiga akwe, na oyo ogosirigwa, tiga asirigwe, na abatigari babe bakorianana.”

English: At that time I also said to the people, “Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they can stand guard by night and work by day.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo pia niliwaambia watu, “Kila mtu na msaidizi wake wakae ndani ya Yerusalemu wakati wa usiku, ili waweze kutumika kama walinzi wakati wa usiku, na kufanya kazi wakati wa mchana.”
Ekegusii: Boigo ngateebia abanto ng’a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y’okoagacha.

English: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa katika mji fulani, mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma mwili mzima akamjia. Alipomwona Yesu, alianguka chini mpaka uso wake ukagusa ardhi, akamsihi akisema, “Bwana, ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomoteebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

English: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn't pay attention to any of his ways,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wameacha kumfuata Mungu, nao hawakuiheshimu njia yake hata moja.
Ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng'ake.

English: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Filipo akaanza kutumia fungu lile la Maandiko, akamweleza habari njema za Yesu.
Ekegusii: Filipo agachaaka gokwana; agachakera korwa ase ririiko eri, akamoranderia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso.

English: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,
Kiswahili: Upendo huvumilia, upendo hufadhili, upendo hauoni wivu, hauna majivuno, hauna kiburi.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria, naende nigo bokoba nobwororo. Obwanchani tibori koba ne ribero, tibori koenena, tibori gwetogia,

English: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn't make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?
Kiswahili: Mnapindua mambo juu chini, kana kwamba mfinyanzi aweza kufikiriwa kuwa kama udongo wa mfinyanzi! Je, kile kilichofinyangwa chaweza kumwambia yule aliyekifinyanga, “Wewe hukunifinyanga mimi?” Je, chungu kinaweza kumwambia mfinyanzi, “Wewe hujui chochote?”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang'ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng'anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemoteebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?

English: Take heed lest you slip with it, lest you fall before one who lies in wait.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari usije ukateleza nayo, usije ukaanguka mbele ya mtu anayekuvizia.
Ekegusii: Renda tobaisa kogochwa oromeme, onye taibo nigo oragochwe bosio bw'abaanto n'amang'ana ao ayeye omonye.

English: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa kwamba Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili, mmoja wa mwanamke mtumwa na wa pili wa mwanamke huru.
Ekegusii: Naki neriikire, ng’a Aburaamu nigo arenge nabana babere abamura, oyomo bw’omokuungu omosomba, na oyomo bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.

English: Since we are now about to celebrate the purification of the temple in the month Chislev, on the twenty-fifth day, we thought it necessary to notify you, so that you may also keep a feast of tabernacles, and remember the fire which was given when Nehemiah offered sacrifices, after he had built both the temple and the altar.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sasa tunakaribia kusherehekea utakaso wa hekalu katika mwezi wa Kislev, siku ya ishirini na tano, tuliona ni muhimu kuwajulisha, ili pia mpate kusherehekea sikukuu ya vibanda, na kukumbuka moto uliotolewa Nehemia alipotoa dhabihu, baada ya kujenga hekalu na madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri'emerongo ebere n'atano ase omotienyi o Kisilevu nigo togocha gochengera rituko rinene r'ogochenwa gwe Hekalu, buna togochengera rituko rinene ri'echiema. Nigo twaroche nga mbuya tobainyorie ayio, erio nainwe mochengere rituko erio rinene. Moinyore buna omorero ochete engaki Nehemia arwete ekengwanso magega y'ogokora kwagacha oboyia Hekalu n'egesasiimero.

English: The angel of the LORD proceeded: “Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.
Kiswahili: Pia malaika wa Bwana akamwambia: “Wewe sasa una mimba nawe utamzaa mwana. Utamwita jina lake Ishmaeli, kwa sababu Bwana amesikia juu ya huzuni yako.
Ekegusii: Naende Omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia, “Rora, morito ore, noibore omwana omoisia; nomooroke Isumaeli, ekiagera Omonene oigure ekerero ki’emechando yao.

English: He said, “Hagar, Sarai's servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
Kiswahili: Malaika akamwambia, “Hagari, mtumishi wa Sarai, umetokea wapi, na unakwenda wapi?” Akamjibu, “Ninamkimbia bibi yangu Sarai.”
Ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Aye omosomba o Sarai, ng'ai okorwa, naende ng'ai okogenda?” Akamoiraneria: “Nigo ngotama korwa ase moibori ominto Sarai.”

English: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
Kiswahili: Nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi yenu ili mshindwe na adui zenu; wale wanaowachukia watawatawala, nanyi mtakimbia ingawa hakuna mtu anayewafukuza.
Ekegusii: Nimbe mamincha yaino, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Abanto baabageechete nabwo barabagambere, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Mobe mogotama nonya monto onde tari okobabwatia.

English: Then Jonathan said to David, “Tomorrow is the New Moon, and you will be missed if your seat is empty.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Kesho ni sikukuu ya Mwezi Mwandamo. Itajulikana kwamba haupo kwa kuwa kiti chako kitakuwa hakina mtu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yonathani agateebia Daudi, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekiagera togochi‐gocha koba ase omoyega, ekerogo kiao nigo keratigare bosa.

English: (The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.)
Kiswahili: (Chini ya mabawa ya makerubi paliweza kuonekana kitu kilichofanana na mikono ya mwanadamu.)
Ekegusii: Nkarora inse ye chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria egento gekororekana buna okoboko kw’omonto.

English: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off. Saying 27
Kiswahili: Ujue pia kwamba hekima ni tamu kwa nafsi yako, kama ukiipata, kuna matumaini kwako ya siku zijazo, nalo tumaini lako halitakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Manya ng’a obong’aini buna obwo ’mboganeirie ase omoyo oo, korabonyore, rirorio ’nonyore amaya ase amatuko agochi‐goocha, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa. 27.

English: And all the Gentiles who were around them sought to destroy them utterly; for they said, “They have no ruler nor anyone to help them. Now therefore let's fight against them, and take away their memory from among men.”
Kiswahili: Na mataifa yote yaliyowazunguka yakajaribu kuwaangamiza kabisa; maana walisema, "Hawana mtawala wala mtu wa kuwasaidia. Basi sasa tupigane nao, na tuondoe kumbukumbu lao miongoni mwa wanadamu."
Ekegusii: Naboigo ebesaku biabebekaine bono bigachaaka goteema kobasiria Abayahudi. Barabwo nigo bakagete buna Abayahudi tibari na morai onde gose omokoonyi oye naende. Bagateeba: “Bono tiga inwe tobaite na gosiria okoinyorwa kwabo korwa ase oboiko bw'ense.”

English: Those who trust him will understand truth. The faithful will live with him in love, because grace and mercy are with his chosen ones.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaomwamini wataelewa ukweli. Waaminifu wataishi naye katika upendo, kwa sababu neema na rehema ziko pamoja na wateule wake.
Ekegusii: Bonsi baria bamwegenete Nyasae mbamanye ekeene kiaye; bonsi baria bare abegeeni ase are mbamenye ase are n'obwanchani, ekiagera ere nigo akobaa obuya na kobarorera amaabera abachoore baye, na nigo akobarigereria buya abwo achorire.

English: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, akamoteebia,

English: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
Kiswahili: akiisha kuifuta ile hati yenye mashtaka yaliyokuwa yanatukabili, pamoja na maagizo yake. Aliiondoa isiwepo tena, akiigongomea kwenye msalaba wake.
Ekegusii: Ere agatinyia ririiko riria riarigetwe ase amachiiko, riare gotosoera, eriarenge nobobisa ase tore; akaritigeria ensemo, akariakerania ase omosalaba.

English: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.
Kiswahili: Mfalme aliarifiwa siku iyo hiyo hesabu ya waliouawa katika ngome ya Shushani.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio omorwoti akarenterwa omobaro bw'abaitetwe aria Susa, omochie omonene,

English: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana panapokuwa na wivu na ubinafsi, ndipo penye machafuko na uovu wa kila namna.
Ekegusii: ekiagera agwo ase ribero rire, na okweancha, agwo moroberio toiyo, korende kera ogokora okobe.

English: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
Kiswahili: Enyi milima yenye vilele vilivyochongoka, kwa nini mnakazia macho kwa wivu, katika mlima Mungu anaochagua kutawala, ambako Bwana mwenyewe ataishi milele?
Ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ki'ebichuria ebinge, nase ki okorigereria ne ribero ase egetunwa ekio Nyasae achorire koba obomenyo bwaye? Ee, Omonene ochorire komenya aroro kogenderera botambe.

English: So having appointed a day, he entered in to direct the inquiry concerning these matters; and there was no small distress throughout the whole city.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, baada ya kupanga siku, aliingia ili kuuliza maswali kuhusu mambo haya; na hapakuwa na msukosuko mdogo katika mji wote.
Ekegusii: Ase igo agachiika rituko arenge gocha ase Hekalu gotenenera okobarwa kw'eniibo eria. Egekorwa ekio gekarenta obotantanu ase omochie oria bwonsi.

English: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wote waume kwa wake na kila mtu aliyemfahamu mwanzoni, wakaja wakala pamoja naye katika nyumba yake. Wakamfariji na kumtuliza moyo juu ya taabu yote Bwana aliyoileta juu yake, nao kila mmoja akampa kipande cha fedha na pete ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang'ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabebe na komoremia ase engencho y'amabe aria onsi Omonene amorenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chitaabu na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu.

English: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi nilivyoenenda mbele zako kwa uaminifu na kujitoa kwa moyo wangu wote, na kufanya yaliyo mema machoni pako.” Naye Hezekia akalia kwa uchungu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa, na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio. Hezekia akarera nobororo.

English: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, hamtaniona tena tangu sasa mpaka mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana.' ”
Ekegusii: Na inche nabateebirie, timokondora naende nonya ng'ake goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri'Omonene.”

English: One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them.
Kiswahili: kila moja iko karibu sana na mwenzake, wala hakuna hewa iwezayo kupita kati yake.
Ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.

English: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
Kiswahili: Pia tafuteni amani na mafanikio ya mji ambamo nimewapeleka uhamishoni. Mwombeni Bwana kwa ajili ya mji huo, kwa sababu ukistawi, ninyi pia mtastawi.”
Ekegusii: Morigerie omochie oyio ase nabatomire gochia amaya; sabera omochie oyio ase Omonene, ekiagera obuya bwaye nabwo bore obwaino.

English: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army; but he won't stand, for they will devise plans against him.
Kiswahili: "Atachochea nguvu zake na ushujaa wake juu ya mfalme wa kusini kwa jeshi kubwa; na mfalme wa kusini atapigana vitani na jeshi kubwa sana na lenye nguvu; lakini hatasimama, kwa maana watamfanyia mipango."
Ekegusii: “Ere nabe noboremu, asangererie abarwani esegi abange mono gochia korwania omorwoti o Irianyi, na omorwoti o Irianyi nere nebeke ang'e korwana esegi nomoganda omonene mono ore ne chinguru, korende takobua, ekiagera nakorerwe emeroberio y'obong'ainereria.

English: But these things don't count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini siyahesabu maisha yangu kuwa ya thamani kwangu, kama kuyamaliza mashindano na kukamilisha ile kazi Bwana Yesu aliyonipa, yaani, kazi ya kuishuhudia Injili ya neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende obogima bwane timbobareti ng'a negento kie rigori rinene ase 'nde, erinde nkoore orogendo rwane, na obosomba boria nanyorete ase Omonene Yeso koorokia enchiri y'amaabera a Nyasae.

English: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuchukua kidari cha huyo kondoo dume wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa Aroni, kiinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, nayo itakuwa fungu lako.
Ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Aroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.

English: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yenu kidogo kidogo. Hamtaruhusiwa kuwaondoa wote kwa mara moja, la sivyo wanyama mwitu wataongezeka na kuwa karibu nanyi.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, naseerie ebisaku ebio ng'orang'ora, birue ase more. Timobaisa kobiseeria biere kegima ase ekero ekemo gioka. Moise gokora bo, ching'iti chi'orosana nigo chiramentekane chibachaande.

English: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
Kiswahili: Kisha mtaniita, na mtakuja na kuniomba, nami nitawasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Erio namondangerie mochiche ase 'nde mosabe, nainche nimbaigwe.

English: Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.
Kiswahili: Usimtumaini jirani; usiweke matumaini kwa rafiki. Hata kwa yule alalaye kifuani mwako uwe mwangalifu kwa maneno yako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.

English: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter). Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael
Kiswahili: Naye akamleta kwa Yesu. Yesu akamwangalia na kusema, “Wewe ni Simoni mwana wa Yohana. Utaitwa Kefa” (ambalo limetafsiriwa Petro ). Yesu Awaita Filipo Na Nathanaeli
Ekegusii: Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simioni, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose rigena). Yeso Okorangeria Filipo na Natanaeli

English: And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
Kiswahili: Malango ya Sayuni yataomboleza na kulia, ataketi mavumbini akiwa fukara.
Ekegusii: Ebiita bi’omochie oyio mbirere na kobokia amagombo; n’omochie oyio nobe buna omokungu ourirwe kera egento oinkaransete amaroba igoro.

English: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
Kiswahili: Utanunua ardhi kwa mzawa wa nchi yako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka baada ya Yubile. Naye ataiuza kwako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka iliyobaki kwa kuvuna mavuno.
Ekegusii: Koragore omogondo korwa ase omonto onde oakane omonto oria koreng'ana n'emiaka eyio etigarete aragese ekero Omwaka bw'Omochengo otaraika.

English: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh's sight.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya maovu mbele za Bwana tena, kwa kuwa walifanya maovu hayo Bwana akamtia nguvu Egloni mfalme wa Moabu dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, na ase engencho yayio Omonene akabarentera Egiloni, omorwoti bw'ense ya Moabu, nere akabarwania, akababua.

English: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.

English: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.
Kiswahili: Utakaliwa na watu, kamwe hautaharibiwa tena, Yerusalemu utakaa salama.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbamenye Yerusalemu, okoragererigwa tigokobao, ekiagera omochie oyio nigo orabe n'obotoereru.

English: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
Kiswahili: Yule Farisayo akashangaa kwamba Yesu hakunawa kwanza kabla ya kula.
Ekegusii: Omofarisai oria agachia korora, agakumia ekiagera ataisabete ritang'ani atararagera.

English: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”
Kiswahili: Mwombeni Bwana, kwa kuwa tumepata ngurumo na mvua za mawe za kututosha. Nitawaachia mwondoke; hamtahitaji kungoja zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y'amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”

English: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.
Kiswahili: Wakampa shekeli sabini za fedha kutoka hekalu la Baal-Berithi, naye Abimeleki akaitumia kuajiri watu ovyo wasiojali, wakawa ndio wafuasi wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakamoa chisekeli chi'echifeta emerongo etano n'ebere korwa ase enyomba ya Baali‐Beriti, na ase chitaabu echio akabagora abanto abatantanu bateechigeti: nabarabwo bakamotunyana.

English: they advanced in array, having him who is in heaven to fight on their side, for the Lord had mercy on them.
Kiswahili: Walisonga mbele kwa safu, wakiwa na yeye aliye mbinguni kupigana upande wao, kwa maana Bwana alikuwa na huruma juu yao.
Ekegusii: Bono bagasuka bosio bare ange ase esegi, bare amo n'omokonyi oria korwa igoro, ekiagera Omonene konya obaroreire amaabera.

English: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitamwangamiza mfalme wa Ashdodi na yeye aishikaye fimbo ya utawala katika Ashkeloni. Nitaugeuza mkono wangu dhidi ya Ekroni, hadi Mfilisti wa mwisho atakapokufa,” asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie abanto bamenyete Asidodi, na oyo obwate enyimbo y'obogambi agwo Asikeloni. Ning'onchore okoboko kwane kobe mamincha ya Ekironi, na abatigari b'Abafilisti mbasirigwe.”

English: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu anaudhihirisha upendo wake kwetu kwamba: Tulipokuwa tungali wenye dhambi, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oorokirie obwanchani bwaye ase tore ase ogotoma Kristo gokwa ase engencho yaito, ekero twarenge abanyene ebibe.

English: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
Kiswahili: Ninatamani sana kuwaona ili nipate kuweka juu yenu karama za rohoni ili mwe imara,
Ekegusii: Nigo inde n'amaiga kororana nainwe na kobaa ekeegwa ase enchera y'Omoika Omochenu, erio mobekwe chinguru,

English: In a very short time, will not Lebanon become an orchard, and the orchard seem like a forest?
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mfupi sana, je, Lebanoni haitageuzwa kuwa shamba lenye rutuba, na shamba lenye rutuba liwe kama msitu?
Ekegusii: Engaki netigarete enke, erio rinani ria Lebanoni riraonchorwe ribe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge; na omogondo oria orenge kwama chindagera chinyinge oonchorwe obe rinani.

English: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
Kiswahili: Akatoka ili kumlaki Asa na kumwambia, “Nisikilizeni, Asa na Yuda wote na Benyamini. Bwana yu pamoja nanyi mkiwa pamoja naye. Kama mkimtafuta, ataonekana kwenu, lakini kama mkimwacha yeye, naye atawaacha ninyi.
