Kiswahili: Kisha akanionyesha Yoshua, kuhani mkuu, akiwa amesimama mbele ya malaika wa Bwana, naye Shetani amesimama upande wake wa kuume ili amshtaki.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, Omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.

English: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu ukaanza kukata tamaa juu ya kazi yangu yote niliyoifanya kwa taabu chini ya jua.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngachaka goichana na gokwa omoyo ase engencho y'emeremo yonsi nechanderete inse y'erioba.

English: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
Kiswahili: Hawatajenga nyumba, nao watu wengine waishi ndani yake, au kupanda mazao na wengine wale. Kwa kuwa kama zilivyo siku za mti, ndivyo zitakavyokuwa siku za watu wangu, wateule wangu watafurahia kwa siku nyingi kazi za mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Tibakoba bakoagacha chinyomba, na abanto abaao bachimenye; tibakoba bagosimeka endagera na abanto abaao bayerie. Buna koreng’ana obogima bw’omote bore, naboigo nobogima bw’abaanto baane borabe, na abachore baane mbabe bakogokera emeremo y’amaboko abo ase engaki entambe.

English: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
Kiswahili: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,
Ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw'eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);

English: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
Kiswahili: lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nimewaonyesha miujiza mingi mikubwa kutoka kwa Baba yangu. Ni ipi katika hiyo mnataka kunipiga mawe?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”

English: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Mungu awezaje kujua? Je, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana anayo maarifa?”
Ekegusii: Erio bateeba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”

English: All things were known to him before they were created, and also after they were completed.
Kiswahili: Vitu vyote vilijulikana kwake kabla havijaumbwa, na pia baada ya kukamilika.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyete aye konye otaraiborwa goika omoerio ekero ere akoorete gotonga ense.

English: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
Kiswahili: Mlisema, ‘Hapana, tutakimbia kwa farasi.' Kwa hiyo mtakimbia! Mlisema, ‘Tutakimbia kwa farasi waendao kasi.' Kwa hiyo wanaowafukuza watakwenda kasi!
Ekegusii: Nigo mogoteeba ng'a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.

English: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nimewaambia mambo haya, mioyo yenu imejawa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabateebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.

English: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliishusha Yuda kwa sababu ya Ahazi mfalme wa Israeli, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameongeza uovu katika Yuda na kumkosea Bwana mno.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aganetie kwororoberia Abayuda ase engencho y'Ahasi, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere arenterete Abayuda obosooku na tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene.

English: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
Kiswahili: Kuwaogopa watu huwa ni mtego, bali yeyote amtumainiaye Bwana atakuwa salama.
Ekegusii: Okobairoka Mwanyabaanto nigo gokoba omotego, korende omonto omosemeretie Omonene nigo arendire buya.

English: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wangu kuhusu lile lililo bora kwenu juu ya jambo hili ni huu: Mwaka uliopita ninyi mlikuwa wa kwanza si tu kutoa lakini pia mlikuwa na shauku ya kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Na inche ase ring’ana eri nabaeire ay’ogosemia kwane, mbuya ase more mokoore emeremo eyio eyio mwarenge abachaki koyekora omwaka oeta. Timware koyekora rioka, korende boigo mware nokogania gw’okoyekora.

English: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
Kiswahili: Dharau zimenivunja moyo na nimekata tamaa, nimetafuta wa kunihurumia, lakini sikumpata, wa kunituliza, lakini sikumpata.
Ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.

English: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani, mtu mmoja alikutwa akikusanya kuni siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh's temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
Kiswahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote; utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na watu wa mataifa watamiminika humo.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko 'omoerio ng'a egetunwa ki'enyomba y'Omonene ngekong'igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.

English: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
Kiswahili: Wakamkazia macho, kisha Petro akamwambia, “Tutazame sisi.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora: “Torigererie intwe!”

English: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ororeria rwa Benjamini bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
Kiswahili: “Lakini uwaonyeshe wema wana wa Barzilai wa Gileadi na uwaruhusu wawe miongoni mwa wale walao mezani pako. Walisimama nami nilipomkimbia ndugu yako Absalomu.
Ekegusii: “Korende okorere abana ba Barisilai, Omogileadi, amaya, babe ase egati ya baria bakoragera amo naye, ekiagera ase obosani obo obuya, barabwo nabo bankorerete, ekero nareenge gotama korwa ase Abisalomu, momura omino.

English: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
Kiswahili: Lakini Manase hawakuwafukuza watu wa Beth-Shani na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Taanaki na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Dori na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Ibleamu na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Megido na vijiji vyake, lakini Wakanaani waliazimu kuishi katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Manase tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete Beti‐Sehani, na Taanaki, na Dori, na Ibileamu, na Megido, amo n’ebichie biabo. Korende Abakaanani baria ’mbagendererete komenya ase ense eria.

English: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Kiswahili: Mnajisumbua bure kuamka mapema na kuchelewa kulala, mkitaabikia chakula: kwa maana yeye huwapa usingizi wapenzi wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa ase more kobooka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong'u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechaandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.

English: He said, “This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them to his own chariots and horses, to run in front of his chariots.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Hivi ndivyo atakavyowatendea mfalme atakayewatawala. Atawachukua wana wenu na kuwafanya watumike kwa magari yake ya vita na farasi, nao watakimbia mbele ya magari yake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Aya naro omorwoti oyio orabagambere arabakorere: Naire abana baino abamura, ababeeke ase chigari chiaye, na abande ababeeke babe abariini be chibarasi chiaye bamokorere. Abande babetererigwe baminyoke bosio bwe chigari chiaye.

English: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: kama vile mafuta yanayoondolewa kutoka kwenye maksai aliyetolewa sadaka ya amani. Kisha kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana buna akobirusia korwa ase eng’ombe eria ekonyeenywa ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Erio abisaambere ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso.

English: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Kiswahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

English: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won't prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won't delay.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ufunuo huu unasubiri wakati uliokubalika; unazungumzia mambo ya mwisho, na kamwe hautakosea. Iwapo utakawia, wewe usubiri; kwa hakika utakuja na hautachelewa.
Ekegusii: Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng'a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogoteebana.

English: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo la hekima na ufahamu kuhusu kile mfalme alichowauliza, aliwaona bora mara kumi zaidi kuliko waganga na wasihiri wote katika ufalme wake wote.
Ekegusii: Ase amang'ana ande onsi omorwoti ababoretie igoro y'obong'aini na obomanyi, akabanyora ng'a nigo bamanyete ara ikomi goetania abaringoria na abaragori barenge ase oborwoti bwaye bwonsi.

English: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, ndugu wapendwa, simameni imara na myashike sana yale mafundisho tuliyowapa ikiwa ni kwa maneno ya kinywa au kwa barua.
Ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana y’emenwa yaito, gose nase riruube riaito.

English: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
Kiswahili: Kama amejitia unajisi na kukosa uaminifu kwa mumewe, wakati anapotakiwa anywe maji yale yaletayo laana, yatamwingia na kusababisha maumivu makali; tumbo lake litavimba na paja lake litapooza, naye atakuwa amelaaniwa miongoni mwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria tabeete omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende bwekorire omosaria, amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa akore enda yaye ebimbe, naende egombae. Ase enchera eyio omokungu oyio abe ekiorokererio gi’okoragererigwa kegwatorwa ase egati y’ abanto baye.

English: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted, and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kukutanika huko Mispa, walichota maji na kuyamimina mbele za Bwana. Siku hiyo walifunga na wakaungama, wakisema, “Tumetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.” Naye Samweli alikuwa kiongozi wa Israeli huko Mispa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasangererekana agwo Misipa, bakabuucha amaache, bakayaumora agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata ase rituko erio, bagakwana aroro agwo, “Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene.” Erio Samweli akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli agwo Misipa.

English: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God.”
Kiswahili: Yeye atokaye kwa Mungu husikia kile Mungu asemacho. Sababu ya ninyi kutosikia ni kwa kuwa hamtokani na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang'ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”

English: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wazao wa Shuthela: kutoka kwa Erani, ukoo wa Waerani.
Ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa ase are nao Abaerani barwete.

English: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu, mtumainini yeye wakati wote, miminieni mioyo yenu kwake, kwa kuwa Mungu ni kimbilio letu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.

English: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn't sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
Kiswahili: Wote wanayo hatima inayofanana, mwadilifu na mwovu, mwema na mbaya, aliye safi na aliye najisi, wale wanaotoa dhabihu na wale wasiotoa. Kama ilivyo kwa mtu mwema, ndivyo ilivyo kwa mtu mwenye dhambi; kama ilivyo kwa wale wanaoapa, ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wasioapa.
Ekegusii: Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing'wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y'ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y'ogotiana.

English: These were read before the congregation at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hizi zilisomwa mbele ya kutaniko huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Amariiko ayio akaba kagosomwa ase emesangererekano agwo Yerusalemu.

English: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Buna eriikire ase egetabu y'amang'ana 'omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri'oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y'Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.

English: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyefungua chemchemi na vijito, ulikausha mito ambayo ilikuwa ikitiririka daima.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amaache ye chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.

English: The Jews put all their enemies to the sword, killing and destroying them, and they did as they pleased to those who hated them.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi waliwaangusha adui zao wote kwa upanga wakiwaua na kuwaangamiza, nao walifanya kile walichotaka kwa wale waliowachukia.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi bakabua ababisa babo bonsi, bakabaita na kobasiria nemioro; bagakora buna banchete ase abwo baabagechete.

English: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, “Nina nini mimi nawe? Nenda kwa manabii wa baba yako na manabii wa mama yako.” Mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, “La hasha, kwa sababu ni Bwana ambaye ametuita pamoja sisi wafalme watatu ili atutie mikononi mwa Moabu.”
Ekegusii: Elisha agateebia omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, “Inki inde naye? Genda aye ase ababani ba iso na abanyoko!” Korende omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akamoteebia. “Tinkogendao. Omonene nere otobekire intwe abarwoti batato ase amaboko Abamoabu.”

English: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.
Kiswahili: Jua lako halitazama tena, nao mwezi wako hautafifia tena; Bwana atakuwa nuru yako milele, nazo siku zako za huzuni zitakoma.
Ekegusii: Erioba riao tirikorimera nonya ng'ake, gose omotienyi oo togosira, ekiagera Omonene nere orabe omobaso oo o kare na kare, na amatuko ao ay'omoichano naere.

English: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Hamkula mkate na hamkunywa divai wala kileo chochote. Nilifanya hivi ili mpate kujua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Timwabeete mokoria omogati, gose konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kende gionsi kegotindia, erio nario moranyaare komanya ng’a ere nere Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana, gotugutera chisese.”

English: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
Kiswahili: Kuhani ataagiza vitu vyote vitolewe ndani ya nyumba, kabla hajaenda kuchunguza kama ina ugonjwa huo, ili kitu chochote ndani ya nyumba kisitangazwe kuwa najisi. Baada ya hili, kuhani ataingia ndani na kuikagua hiyo nyumba.
Ekegusii: Omokuani achike ng'a ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba eyio birusigweo ritang'ani atarasoao koborenga. Onye tibagokora bo rirorio ebinto bionsi bire nyomba ime nabibe bitachenegeti. Magega y'ayio Omokuani asoe ase enyomba eyio koyerenga.

English: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa habari zenu ninyi, ee nyumba ya Israeli, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nendeni mkatumikie sanamu zenu, kila mmoja wenu! Lakini baadaye hakika mtanisikiliza mimi nanyi hamtalinajisi tena Jina langu takatifu, kwa matoleo yenu na sanamu zenu.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene akobateebia inwe Abaisraeli: Kera oyomo oino agenderere gosasiima omogwekano oye! Korende ase engaki eraache ekero morabe mokonyigwera timokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti ase okorua ebiegwa biaino na gosasiima emegwekano yaino.

English: Nevertheless you even spared these as men, and you sent hornets as forerunners of your army, to cause them to perish little by little.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo uliwaacha hawa kama wanaume, nawe ukatuma nyigu kama watangulizi wa jeshi lako, ili kuwaangamiza kidogo kidogo.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naba aye nigo kwabarorerete amaabera ase engencho barabwo n'abanto bao. Nigo gwatomete chinchoke chigatangana omoganda bw'abarwani esegi erio chibasirie ngora ngora.

English: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

English: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my bags for exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall by hand. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulder as they watched.
Kiswahili: Basi nikafanya kama nilivyoamriwa. Wakati wa mchana nilitoa vitu vyangu nje vilivyofungwa tayari kwa uhamishoni. Kisha wakati wa jioni nikatoboa ukuta kwa mikono yangu. Nikachukua mizigo yangu nje wakati wa giza la jioni, nikiwa nimeibeba mabegani mwangu huku wakinitazama.
Ekegusii: Inche ngakora buna nachigetwe; mobaso gati ngasokia ebinto biane isiko, nkaba buna nkong’anya inde, na riachia koba mogoroba, nkabochora enyasi namaboko ane. Ekero omosunte ochire, nkabeka ebinto biane ireko, nkagenda ekero abanto barigereretie.

English: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote ilivyovunjika na kuharibika! Tazama jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa ukiwa miongoni mwa mataifa!
Ekegusii: Naki enturago eria yaagete ense engima yaakirwe na gwateka! Naki Babiloni osirigwe, na abanto baichanigwe ase okoyorora igo!

English: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu akamwondolea uchungu wa mauti, kwa sababu haikuwezekana yeye kushikiliwa na nguvu za mauti.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamobokia ekero ororobirie obororo bw’amakweri, ekiagera tare konyarekana abwatwe naro.

English: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the gifts from the servants and stored them in the house. Then he dismissed the men, and they departed.
Kiswahili: Gehazi alipofika kwenye kilima, akavichukua vile vitu kutoka kwa wale watumishi na kuvificha ndani ya nyumba. Akawaaga wale watu, nao wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete agwo ase ekegoro, Gehasi akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabibeeka nyomba ime. Erio agatiga abanto baria bakagenda.

English: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uliye tumaini la Israeli, wote wakuachao wataaibika. Wale wanaogeukia mbali nawe wataandikwa mavumbini kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana, chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogosemeria kw'Abaisraeli, abanto abwo bagotigire nigo banyorire obosooku; ee, abwo baonchokire na kogotiga nigo barasire buna ririiko ririikire ase riroba, ekiagera bagotigire aye Omonene ore ensoko y'amaache are moyo.

English: And the time that David lived in Philistine territory amounted to a year and four months.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaishi katika nchi ya Wafilisti muda wa mwaka mmoja na miezi minne.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagenderera komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo na emetienyi ene.

English: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
Kiswahili: Akauliza, “Je, tutashambulia kupitia njia gani?” Akajibu, “Kupitia Jangwa la Edomu.”
Ekegusii: Naende akabooria: “Inee! Insemo ki toraetere kogenda?” Yoramu akairaneria: “Igo toraetere enchera y'erooro y'Edomu.”

English: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: amariiko nigo agoteeba, mobe abachenu ekiagera inche nomochenu.

English: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wosia, ni muhimu kuthibitisha kifo cha yule aliyeutoa,
Ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw'omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.

English: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’” So they listened to the word of the LORD and turned back according to the word of the LORD. Jeroboam’s Idolatry
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Msipande kupigana dhidi ya ndugu zenu, Waisraeli. Nendeni nyumbani, kila mmoja wenu, kwa kuwa hili nimelitenda mimi.’ ” Kwa hiyo wakalitii neno la Bwana na kurudi nyumbani, kama Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Ndama Wa Dhahabu Huko Betheli Na Dani
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene atebiire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abateebeetie. Yeroboamu ogotiga Omonene

English: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
Kiswahili: Wakati Mungu alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, akamkataa Israeli kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.

English: So they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the families of Israel. And when they came to Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Wakazunguka katika Yuda yote na kukusanya Walawi na viongozi wa jamaa za Israeli kutoka miji yote. Walipofika Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, bagasangereria Abalawi korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,
Ekegusii: Ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang'e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
Kiswahili: Adoramu alikuwa kiongozi wa wale waliofanya kazi ya kulazimishwa; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;
Ekegusii: Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw'emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw'Ahiludi, nigo areenge omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka.

English: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
Kiswahili: kwa muda wote nitakaokuwa na uhai ndani yangu, nayo pumzi ya Mungu ikiwa puani mwangu,
Ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,

English: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Noa akafanya kila kitu kama vile Mungu alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Nuhu nabo akorete igo; agakora ayio onsi koreng’ana buna Nyasae amochigeete.

English: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants; I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both slave and free.
Kiswahili: ‘Nitaleta maafa juu yako. Nitaangamiza uzao wako na kukatilia mbali kutoka kwa Ahabu kila mzaliwa wa mwisho wa kiume katika Israeli, wa mtumwa au wa mtu huru.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nindete amabe igoro yao; ningosirie kegima orueo, ninsirie korwa asore Ahabu kera omonto omosacha, omosomba na oyotari omosomba.

English: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
Kiswahili: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.

English: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tayarisheni nia zenu kwa kazi; mwe na kiasi, mkitumainia kikamilifu ile neema mtakayopewa Yesu Kristo atakapodhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong'u ebinema bi'ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria moraarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

English: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akawaita pamoja wazee wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma abanto barangerie abagaaka bonsi b'Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.

English: Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations, what will happen to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikilizeni, enyi mataifa, angalieni, enyi mashahidi, lile litakalowatokea.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abanto b’ebisaku, na inwe omoganda bwonsi, tegerera moigwe amang’ana agochia kobanyora abwo bangire.

English: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye kama Bwana Mungu wetu, Yeye ambaye ameketi juu kwenye kiti cha enzi,
Ekegusii: Ning'o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,

English: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
Kiswahili: Kizazi kimoja kitasifia kazi zako kwa kizazi kingine, watasimulia matendo yako makuu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.

English: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi sitafuti utukufu wangu mwenyewe, bali yuko anayetaka kunitukuza, naye ndiye mwamuzi.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru akavunja kambi na kuondoka. Akarudi Ninawi na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Senakeribu, omorwoti bw'Abaasuri, akarua agwo, akagenda nka bwoye, akamenya Ninawi.

English: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
Kiswahili: “Sema kwa ajili ya wale wasioweza kujisemea, kwa ajili ya haki za wote walioachwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachaandegete.

English: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
Kiswahili: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

English: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
Kiswahili: Jitahidi kujionyesha kwa Mungu kuwa umekubaliwa naye, mtendakazi asiye na sababu ya kuona aibu, ukilitumia kwa usahihi neno la kweli.
Ekegusii: Kora buna oranyaare kweorokia ase obosio bwa Nyasae buna oyobwancheirwe nere, buna omokori emeremo oyotagwenereti gosookigwa, ogwatanana boronge ring’ana ri’ekeene.

English: the signet rings, the nose rings,
Kiswahili: pete zenye muhuri, pete za puani,
Ekegusii: ne chibonyi chire nebimanyererio, na ebigera bie chimioro,

English: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
Kiswahili: Vyema basi, ingekupasa kuweka fedha yangu kwa watoa riba, ili nirudipo, nichukue ile iliyo yangu na faida yake.
Ekegusii: Gaki nkwagwenerete kobeeka chitaabu chiane ase abakorua efaida, na inche ngocha, anga nanyora echiane amo nefaida y’ane.

English: Who is the man wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may explain it? Why is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert, so no one can pass through it?
Kiswahili: Ni mtu yupi aliye na hekima ya kutosha ayaelewe haya? Ni nani aliyefundishwa na Bwana awezaye kuyaeleza haya? Kwa nini nchi imeharibiwa na kufanywa ukiwa kama jangwa ambapo hakuna awezaye kupita?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ng’ai omonto omong’aini are oyoranyare komanya engencho y’amang’ana aya? Ning’o aye Omonene gwakwanire nere, oyio oranyare goteeba egekogera ense yabeire ritongo, na yasarekire buna erooro omonto atanyare goeta ase egati yaye?

English: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, “Kila mtu atakayeliitia Jina la Bwana, ataokolewa.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera, “Onde bwensi orarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe.”

English: His father dies, and is as though he had not died; for he has left one behind him like himself.
Kiswahili: Baba yake anakufa, na ni kama hakufa; kwani amemwacha mmoja nyuma yake kama yeye.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoibori oyio are moyo nigo akwegokeria omwana oye, nonya n'ekero ise akuure nigo arabe buna oyotakweti; ekiagera otigire omomura omobwekaine.

English: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
Kiswahili: Wakati mmoja mama yake Yesu na ndugu zake walikuja kumwona, lakini hawakuweza kumfikia kwa sababu ya msongamano wa watu.
Ekegusii: Ng'ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang'e ase engencho y'omoganda.

English: For Yahweh says, “Don't enter into the house of mourning. Don't go to lament. Don't bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says Yahweh, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Usiingie katika nyumba ambayo kuna chakula cha matanga, usiende kuwaombolezea wala kuwahurumia, kwa sababu nimeziondoa baraka zangu, upendo wangu na huruma zangu kutoka kwa watu hawa,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba ase abanto bakorera gose kobokia amagombo, na tobaisa koreera onde bwensi, gose kobaichanera. Inche narusirie omorembe one na obwanchani bwane bwa botambe, na amaabera aane korwa ase abanto aba.

English: He who has ears, let him hear.” The Purpose of Jesus’ Parables (Isaiah 6:1–13; Mark 4:10–12; Luke 8:9–10)
Kiswahili: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.” Sababu Ya Kufundisha Kwa Mifano (Marko 4:10-12; Luka 8:9-10)
Ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe!” Ekerenga ki’ogokwana ase emebayeeno (Mar 4:10-12; Luk 8:9-10)

English: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king's table. He was lame in both his feet.
Kiswahili: Naye Mefiboshethi akaishi huko Yerusalemu, kwa sababu daima alikula mezani pa mfalme, naye alikuwa kiwete miguu yote.
Ekegusii: Mefiboseti akaba okomenya Yerusalemu, ekiagera nigo arenge koragera ase emesa y'omorwoti. Ere nigo aremarete amagoro aye onsi abere.

English: The sons of Zilpah (Leah's servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
Kiswahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Zilpa mtumishi wa kike wa Lea walikuwa: Gadi na Asheri. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yakobo, waliozaliwa kwake akiwa Padan-Aramu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Silpa, omoiseke omosomba o Lea, nabwo Gadi na Aseri. Aba nabwo abana abamura Yakobo aiboreretwe agwo Padan‐Aramu.

English: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndugu zake Yesu wakamwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende Uyahudi ili wanafunzi Wako wapate kuona miujiza unayofanya.
Ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.

English: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, Mwana hawezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yake, yeye aweza tu kufanya lile analomwona Baba yake akifanya, kwa maana lolote afanyalo Baba, Mwana pia hufanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.

English: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.
Kiswahili: Ameupinda upinde wake kama adui, mkono wake wa kuume uko tayari. Kama vile adui amewachinja wote waliokuwa wanapendeza jicho, amemwaga ghadhabu yake kama moto juu ya hema la Binti Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Ere otingire obota bwaye buna omobisa agotinga, otenenire na kobong'usa nokoboko kwaye gw'okorio buna omochandi; agaita bonsi aba twetogeretie. Igoro y'obomenyo bw'abaanto ba Sayoni, oumoire ekeririanda kiaye kere buna omorero.

English: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
Kiswahili: Katika pendo hakuna hofu. Lakini pendo lililo kamili huitupa nje hofu, kwa sababu hofu inahusika na adhabu. Kila mwenye hofu hakukamilika katika pendo.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nobwoba, korende obwanchani oboikeranu nigo bogoseria obwoba gochia isiko. Naki obwoba mbore negesusuro, na oyore nobwoba taikeraniri ase obwanchani.

English: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
Kiswahili: ambaye Mungu atamleta kwa wakati wake mwenyewe: yeye ahimidiwaye, aliye peke yake Mtawala, Mfalme wa wafalme, na Bwana wa mabwana,
Ekegusii: Oyosesenirie, oyore nokobua ere bweka, Omorwoti bw’abarwoti, Omonene bw’abanene, oraache gotworokia okoorokigwa okwo ase ekero kiaye.

English: Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
Kiswahili: Taabu na maumivu makuu vinamtia hofu; humshinda kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa vita,
Ekegusii: Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omorwoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.

English: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Midiani ukawa na nguvu dhidi ya Israeli na kwa ajili ya Wamidiani, Waisraeli wakajitengenezea mahali pa kujificha milimani, kwenye mapango na ngome.
Ekegusii: Abamidiani nigo baabaengerete Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y'Abamidiani Abaisraeli bakabetererigwa korigia obotamero ase amakuruma na emetaro, na ase chingoro chiakuunyire ase ebitunwa.

English: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;
Kiswahili: Mioyo yao ilipokuwa imefurahishwa wakasema, “Mleteni Samsoni aje acheze ili tufurahi.” Basi wakamleta Samsoni kutoka mle gerezani naye akacheza mbele yao. Wakamweka kati ya nguzo mbili.
Ekegusii: Na ekero chinkoro chiabo chiabeete n'omochengo, bagateeba, “Torentere Samusoni atokorere chigosori!” Ase ayio bakarenta Samusoni korwa enyomba y'obosibwa, ere akabakorera chigosori. Bakamobeeka agatenena gati‐gati ye chisiiro.

English: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
Kiswahili: Naam, nakusihi wewe pia, mwenzangu mwaminifu, uwasaidie hawa wanawake, kwa sababu walijitaabisha katika kazi ya Injili pamoja nami bega kwa bega, wakiwa pamoja na Klementi na watendakazi wenzangu ambao majina yao yameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima.
Ekegusii: Ee, naye bo, omosaiga bw'ekeene, nakoboririe okonye abakungu abwo bakorete emeremo y'enchiri amo nainche, na Klementi nere, na baria bande bakorete emeremo amo nainche, abwo amarieta abo are ime ase egetabu y'obogima.

English: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa hivi kwa miaka ile ishirini niliyokuwa nyumbani kwako. Nilikutumikia miaka ile kumi na minne kwa ajili ya binti zako wawili, miaka sita kwa ajili ya makundi yako, nawe ulibadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi.
Ekegusii: Emiaka eye emerongo ebere imenyete bwoo, nabeire nkogokorera emiaka ikomi na ene ase okonyora abaiseke bao babere, na emiaka etano nomo ase okonyora amaicho ao, na aye kwabeire gokoonchora eng'eria yane ara ikomi.

English: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
Kiswahili: Harifu, Anathothi, Nebai,
Ekegusii: Harifu, na Anatoti, na Nebai;

English: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi mnyangʼanyeni hiyo talanta, mkampe yule mwenye talanta kumi.
Ekegusii: Bono moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.

English: Yahweh called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuita mti wa mzeituni uliostawi ulio na matunda mazuri kwa sura. Lakini kwa ngurumo ya mawimbi makuu atautia moto, nayo matawi yake yatavunjika.
Ekegusii: Agwo kare inche Omonene nigo nabaarogete “Omozeituni omobese obwate amazeituni amaya”, korende bono narentire okogukura okonene na koyotongia omorero, ne chinsagia chiaye chiyie chisareke.

English: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.
Kiswahili: Akajenga miji yenye ngome katika Yuda, wakati nchi ikiwa na amani. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyepigana vita naye katika miaka hiyo, kwa kuwa Bwana alimstarehesha.
Ekegusii: Akaagacha emechie yagiteire chindwaki agwo ase ense ya Yuda, ekiagera ense eria nigo yarenge n'obotoereru; tabwate chiseegi ase amatuko aria, ekiagera Omonene amoete omorembe.

English: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
Kiswahili: Lile jicho linaloniona sasa halitaniona tena; utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng'ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.

English: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
Kiswahili: Vitu utakavyoviona kwa macho yako vitakufanya wazimu.
Ekegusii: Komorarore aya onsi, nigo morasareke ase ebirengererio biaino, mobe buna chiosi.

English: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wa dhehebu lao wakawalalamikia wanafunzi wa Yesu, wakisema, “Mbona mnakula na kunywa pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi'?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b'amariiko babo bakemurunganeria aborokigwa baye, bakaboora, “Nase ki mokoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”

English: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu asiyeamini au asiyeelewa akiingia wakati kila mtu anatoa unabii, ataaminishwa na watu wote kuwa yeye ni mwenye dhambi na kuhukumiwa na wote,
Ekegusii: Korende onye bonsi bakobana, omonto otegeneti ogocha, gose omonto o isiko, orokigwe na bonsi ng’a nomomochi are, agambigwe na bonsi;

English: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
Kiswahili: Kisha watakisokotea pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote katika ngozi za pomboo na kukiweka kwenye jukwaa lake.
Ekegusii: Nababeeke ekebeekerero ekio amo nebikorero biaye ase omobuko bwe risankwa ri'eng'iti ya rooche, na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.

English: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read,
Kiswahili: ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: Nitaleta maafa juu ya mahali hapa na watu wake, kulingana na kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika kitabu hicho mfalme wa Yuda alichosoma.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Rora inche Omonene nindete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga, amabe aya onsi ariikire ase egetabu eke omorwoti bw’Abayuda asomire.

English: The nations will escort Israel and bring it to its homeland. Then the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors. The Fall of the King of Babylon
Kiswahili: Mataifa watawachukua na kuwaleta mahali pao wenyewe. Nayo nyumba ya Israeli itamiliki mataifa kama watumishi na wajakazi katika nchi ya Bwana. Watawafanya watekaji wao kuwa mateka, na kutawala juu ya wale waliowaonea.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku binde mbikonye Abaisraeli koirana ase ense yabo, na Abaisraeli mbaabakore babe abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, mbabe bakobakorera agwo ase ense y’Omonene. Abaisraeli mboose abwo baboosete kare, na bagambere abwo baarenge kobakorera bobe. Omorwoti o Babiloni ore aase abakuure

English: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mfalme Rehoboamu akatengeneza ngao za shaba badala ya zile za dhahabu na kuzikabidhi kwa majemadari wa ulinzi wa zamu kwenye ingilio la jumba la mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio Rehoboamu omorwoti akagoncha chinguba chi’etai ribaga rie chinguba chiria chi’etaabu, agachibeeka ase amaboko ’abanene b’oborendi, baria baarenge korenda egesieri ki’enyomba y’omorwoti.

English: Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
Kiswahili: (Farao mfalme wa Misri alikuwa ameushambulia na kuuteka mji wa Gezeri. Alikuwa ameuchoma moto. Akawaua Wakanaani waliokuwa wakikaa humo na kisha kuutoa kwa binti yake, yaani mkewe Solomoni, kama zawadi ya arusi.
Ekegusii: (Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, konya ochire korwania Geseri na koyosakora, naende akayosamba nomorero. Agaita abanto ba Kaanani baria bamenyete aroro, na koyorua buna ekeegwa ki’ogosokia omoiseke oye abe moga Sulemani.

English: For to be acquainted with you is perfect righteousness, and to know your dominion is the root of immortality.
Kiswahili: Kwani kukufahamu ni haki kamilifu, na kujua utawala wako ndio mzizi wa kutokufa.
Ekegusii: Gokomanya aye n'obochenu oboikeranu, komanya chinguru chiao n'omochakano bw'okomenya kare na kare.

English: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Wataadhimisha wema wako mwingi, na wataimba kwa shangwe juu ya haki yako.
Ekegusii: Mbararie chinkuma chi'obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.

English: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu tuliopanda nao waliifanya mioyo ya watu iyeyuke kwa hofu. Bali mimi, nilimfuata Bwana Mungu wangu kwa moyo wote.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria twagendete komo bakagera abanto bakerusia moyo, korende inche nkaba omwegenwa ase okoigwera Omonene, Nyasae one.

English: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Mara wakaenda Elimu, mahali ambapo palikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili na mitende sabini, huko wakapiga kambi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Mara, bakageenda bagaika Elimu, aase chinsoko chi’amaache ikomi na ibere chiarenge amo nemekendo emerongo etano na ebere, bagatoora aroro.

English: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
Kiswahili: Sasa ninasema nanyi watu wa Mataifa. Maadamu mimi ni mtume kwa watu wa Mataifa, naitukuza huduma yangu
Ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde nainwe abanto b’Ebisaku. Koreng’ana buna inde omotomwa bw’ abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarire ng’a obosomba bwane n’egento ekenene,

English: “The sentence is fair,” Shimei replied. “Your servant will do as my lord the king has spoken.” And Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.
Kiswahili: Shimei akamjibu mfalme, “Ulilolisema ni jema. Mtumishi wako atatenda kama bwana wangu mfalme alivyosema.” Naye Shimei akakaa Yerusalemu kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Simei agateebia omorwoti: “Egento gwateebire nekiya; buna aye omonene one omorwoti gwateebire, naboigo inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Ase ayio, Simei akamenya ase Yerusalemu amatuko amange.

English: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
Kiswahili: Nitajisifu kwa ajili ya mtu kama huyo, lakini sitajisifu kuhusu mimi mwenyewe ila mimi nitajisifia udhaifu wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omonto oyio ninyetogie; korende ase engencho yane tingwetogia, otatiga ase oboreu bwane.

English: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Lakini mbuzi aliyechaguliwa kwa kura kuwa wa kubebeshwa dhambi atatolewa akiwa hai mbele za Bwana, atumike kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa kumwacha aende jangwani akiwa amebebeshwa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Na egoree eria eraabe yagwereirwe nobomera ase Asaseli ayerente ere moyo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, erinde akore okobwatanigwa asero, na koyetiga esiboire egende ase erooro ase Asaseli.

English: While all this was happening, I was not in Jerusalem, because I had returned to Artaxerxes king of Babylon in the thirty-second year of his reign. Some time later I obtained leave from the king
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati haya yote yalipokuwa yakitendeka, sikuwa Yerusalemu, kwa kuwa katika mwaka wa thelathini na mbili wa utawala wa Artashasta mfalme wa Babeli nilikuwa nimerudi kwa mfalme. Baadaye nilimwomba ruhusa,
Ekegusii: Inche tinarenge Yerusalemu ekero amang’ana ayio abeete iga, ekiagera ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na ebere, bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omorwoti o Babiloni, nario nagendete ase omorwoti oyio. Magega y’engaki ende nkaegwa ribaga,

English: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
Kiswahili: Katika taabu yangu nilisema, “Wanadamu wote ni waongo.”
Ekegusii: na ase okwegosa kwane ’ngateeba, “Kere omonto nomonyaborimo.”

English: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
Kiswahili: Tupatieni nafasi mioyoni mwenu. Hatujamkosea mtu yeyote, hatujampotosha mtu yeyote, wala hatujamdhulumu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Toigorere chinkoro chiaino; titokorereti monto onde bobe, titosareti monto, titorieti monto kiaboama.

English: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
Kiswahili: Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini, Benaya Mpirathoni,
Ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamini, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;

English: There was no one to deliver them, because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone; it was in a valley near Beth-rehob. And the Danites rebuilt the city and lived there.
Kiswahili: Hapakuwa na yeyote wa kuwaokoa, kwa kuwa kulikuwa mbali sana na Sidoni na hawakuwa na ushirikiano na mtu mwingine yeyote. Mji ulikuwa kwenye bonde karibu na Beth-Rehobu. Wadani wakaujenga upya huo mji na kuishi humo.
Ekegusii: Onde tachete kobatooria, ekiagera Laisi orenge aare korwa Sidoni, naende abanto ba Laisi tibarenge gosanga n’abanto bande. Omochie oria nigo orenge ase rikura riare ang’e na Beti‐Rehobu. Abanto ba Dani bakaagaacha omochie o Laisi naende, bakamenyao.

English: Nevertheless, I have reserved seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.” The Call of Elisha
Kiswahili: Hata sasa nimeweka akiba watu elfu saba katika Israeli, wote ambao hawajampigia Baali magoti, na wote ambao midomo yao haijambusu.” Wito Wa Elisha
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, nintigare nabaanto chilifu isano na ibere b’Abaisraeli bonsi, baria batabegete amaru abo inse ase ogosasiima Baali, gose koyenyunyunta.” Elisha okorangerigwa

English: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amwaminiye hahukumiwi, lakini asiyeamini amekwisha kuhukumiwa, kwa sababu hakuliamini jina la Mwana pekee wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri'Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.

English: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can't hold water.
Kiswahili: “Watu wangu wametenda dhambi mbili: Wameniacha mimi, niliye chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai, nao wamejichimbia visima vyao wenyewe, visima vilivyobomoka, visivyoweza kuhifadhi maji.
Ekegusii: Abanto baane bakorire amabe abere: bantigire inche inde ensoko y'amaache amaya ay'obogima; bakunyire ebisima biabo bi'amaache, ebisima biremogete, bitanyare kogaacha amaache nonya ng'ake.

English: They have hired Arabians to help them, and are encamped beyond the brook, ready to come against you to battle.” So Judas went to meet them.
Kiswahili: Wamewaajiri Waarabu kuwasaidia, nao wamepiga kambi ng'ambo ya kijito, tayari kuja dhidi yenu kupigana. Basi Yuda akaenda kukutana nao.
Ekegusii: Timotheo boigo konye ogorire abarwani esegi ba Abaarabu abwo boigo bebegete ang'e ase ekeng'umbu kiengegu ende yorooche erio bamogwere Yuda. Yuda agasooka kogenda korwana na barabwo.

English: Don't be furious, Yahweh. Don't remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usikasirike kupita kiasi, usizikumbuke dhambi zetu milele. Ee Bwana, utuangalie, twakuomba, kwa kuwa sisi sote tu watu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toba nendamwamu enene mono, togenderera koinyora ebibe biaito botambe. Torigererie, otoinyore, twensi nigo tore abanto bao.

English: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yenu kidogo kidogo. Hamtaruhusiwa kuwaondoa wote kwa mara moja, la sivyo wanyama mwitu wataongezeka na kuwa karibu nanyi.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, naseerie ebisaku ebio ng’orang’ora, birue ase more. Timobaisa kobiseeria biere kegima ase ekero ekemo gioka. Moise gokora bo, ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chiramentekane chibachaande.

English: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
Kiswahili: Sikiliza, mwanangu na uwe na hekima, weka moyo wako kwenye njia iliyo sawa.
Ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa na obe n'obong'aini, naende orende enkoro y'ao ebwatie enchera endonge.

English: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
Kiswahili: Nami nitamwomba Baba, naye atawapa Msaidizi mwingine akae nanyi milele.
Ekegusii: Naende inche ninsambe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,

English: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
Kiswahili: akamtuma mwanawe, Hadoramu kwa Mfalme Daudi ili kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa ushindi wake katika vita dhidi ya Mfalme Hadadezeri, kwa kuwa alikuwa amepigana vita mara nyingi na Tou. Hadoramu akamletea Daudi vifaa mbalimbali vya dhahabu, fedha na shaba.
Ekegusii: agatoma Hadoramu, omomura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi komokwania na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri na omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okonakorwania Tou. Boigo Tou agatoma ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, na ebie chitaai.

English: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama nikiwahuzunisha ninyi, ni nani aliyebaki wa kunifurahisha isipokuwa ninyi ambao nimewahuzunisha?
Ekegusii: Naki onye inche nkobaichania, gaki ning’o orangokie, otatiga oria naichanirie?

English: For seven days there must be no leaven found in your houses. If anyone eats something leavened, that person, whether a foreigner or native of the land, must be cut off from the congregation of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba isionekane chachu yoyote katika nyumba zenu. Yeyote alaye chochote chenye chachu ndani yake, lazima akatiliwe mbali kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, akiwa ni mgeni au mzawa.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ememera terorekana ase chinyomba chiaino nonya ng’ake; naki onde bwensi orarie egento kebekire ememera naatananwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, onye ore omomenyi gose omobiare.

English: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.
Kiswahili: Ndani yako wako watu wasingiziaji, watu walio tayari kumwaga damu, ndani yako wako wale wanaokula vyakula vilivyotolewa mahali pa ibada za miungu kwenye milima, na kutenda matendo ya uasherati.
Ekegusii: Abang’achi bande bamenyete ime yao bakogera amanyinga aiteka. Abanto bao bande nigo bakoriera ebing’wanso igoro ase ebitunwa; na abande nigo bare abatomani,

English: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

English: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako akuletapo katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki, na awafukuzapo mbele yako mataifa mengi, yaani Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, mataifa saba makubwa tena yenye nguvu kuliko wewe,
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaikie ase ense eria, mogochia koira ebe eyaino, na aseerie ebisaku ebinge birue ase amasio aino, ebisaku bitano bibere bire ebinene, naende bire nechinguru kobabua. Ebisaku ebio nabio ebi: Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.

English: Araunah said to David, “My lord the king may take whatever seems good and offer it up. Here are the oxen for a burnt offering and the threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.
Kiswahili: Arauna akamwambia Daudi, “Bwana wangu mfalme na achukue chochote kinachompendeza na akitoe sadaka. Hapa kuna maksai kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pia kuna miti ya kupuria na nira za ngʼombe kwa ajili ya kuni.
Ekegusii: Erio Arauna akairaneria Daudi, “omonene one omorwoti, rora kende gionsi keramogwenere ase ekeng’wanso. Ira chintang’ana echi ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebikorero ebi bi’okoora amo namakorogoto bibe chiinko chi’okogesambera.”

English: At the end of Josiah’s reign, Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt marched up to help the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River. King Josiah went out to confront him, but Neco faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
Kiswahili: Yosia alipokuwa mfalme, Farao Neko mfalme wa Misri akapanda mpaka Mto Frati kumsaidia mfalme wa Ashuru. Mfalme Yosia akatoka kwenda kupigana naye, lakini Neko akamkabili na kumuua huko Megido.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko y’okogaamba kwa Yosia, Farao Neko, omorwoti o Misiri, akagenda korwana nomorwoti bw’Abaasuri agwo ase orooche rw’Eufarati. Yosia omorwoti akagenda agwo korwana nere, na ekero Farao Neko amorooche, akamoitera agwo Megido.

English: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kwa kuwa Herode hakumpa Mungu utukufu, malaika wa Bwana akampiga, naye akaliwa na chango, akafa.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango omomalaika bw'Omonene akamoaka ekiagera atasigete Nyasae; akariegwa namakonde, agatweka mo.

English: Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David's throne and ruling in Judah.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “Mwandike huyu mtu kama asiye na mtoto, mtu ambaye hatafanikiwa maisha yake yote, kwa maana hakuna mtoto wake atakayefanikiwa, wala kukaa kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Daudi wala kuendelea kutawala katika Yuda.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: “Riika igoro y'omonto oyio ng'a tari nabana, obeire omonto otasesenetigwe ase obogima bwaye. Ororeria rwaye tirogotoka roraikaranse ase ekerogo ki'oborwoti gia Daudi agambere Abayuda.”

English: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
Kiswahili: “Kisha atawaambia wale walio upande wake wa kushoto, ‘Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mliolaaniwa, nendeni kwenye moto wa milele ulioandaliwa kwa ajili ya ibilisi na malaika zake.
Ekegusii: Erio nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue ase ’nde inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,

English: Some time later, Nahash king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Nahashi mfalme wa Waamoni akafa, mwanawe akaingia mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Nahasi, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, agakwa, na omomura oye akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
Kiswahili: Kama mngelimwamini Mose, mngeliniamini na mimi kwa maana aliandika habari zangu.
Ekegusii: Naki onye mwamwegenete Musa anga mwanyegena nainche, ekiagera nere origete amang’ana igoro yane.

English: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.
Kiswahili: Bwana akafunua shimo huko Lehi, pakatoka maji. Samsoni alipoyanywa, nguvu zikamrudia na kuhuika. Hivyo chemchemi ile ikaitwa En-Hakore, nayo iko mpaka leo huko Lehi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akabochora engoro yarenge agwo Lei, na amaache agasoka korwa agwo. Samusoni akanywa amaache ayio, na akaigwa obeire buna omonto omoyia, akanyora chinguru. Eke nakio gekogera ensoko eria ya Lei ekorokwa Eni‐Hakore; nabo ekorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Tazama, nimeanza kuwapa Mfalme Sihoni na nchi yake kwako. Sasa anzeni kuishinda na kuimiliki nchi yake.”
Ekegusii: “Omonene aganteebia: Rora, nachaakire kobeeka Sihoni amo n'ense yaye ase amaboko aino. Ase ayio, chaaka koira ense yaye ebe eyaino.

English: They saw the sanctuary laid desolate, the altar profaned, the gates burned up, shrubs growing in the courts as in a forest or as on one of the mountains, and the priests' chambers pulled down;
Kiswahili: Waliona patakatifu pakiwa ukiwa, madhabahu ikiwa imetiwa unajisi, malango yameteketezwa, vichaka vikimea katika nyua kama msituni au kama kwenye mojawapo ya milima, na vyumba vya makuhani vikibomolewa;
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo abanto bakayenyora Hekalu nigo etigire birati, egesasiimero kiaye kiabekirwe ogotacheneka, ebisieri biaye nigo biasaambire nomorero, chinyasi chiaye chiamerire abonyansi n'ebisarara biamerire buna biria bire orosana nase ebitunwa, nechinyomba chia abakuani chiatagoirwe.

English: But when the young man would in no way listen, the king called to him his mother, and urged her to advise the youth to save himself.
Kiswahili: Lakini kijana huyo alipokataa kusikiliza, mfalme alimwita mama yake, na kumsihi amshauri kijana huyo ajiokoe.
Ekegusii: Korende omomura oria taigwete mangana aria. Erio Antioko agatema gokwana na ng'ina erio akwane n'omwana oye erio gotoria obogima bwaye.

English: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye nguvu za hasira yako? Kwa maana ghadhabu yako ni kubwa kama hofu tunayopaswa kuwa nayo kwako.
Ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?

English: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote, ila ni Mungu Mwana pekee, aliye kifuani mwa Baba ndiye ambaye amemdhihirisha.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie.

English: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon in the Arabah south of Jeshimon,
Kiswahili: Basi wakaondoka na kwenda mpaka Zifu wakimtangulia Sauli. Naye Daudi na watu wake walikuwa katika Jangwa la Maoni, katika Araba kusini mwa Yeshimoni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bagatang’anera Saulo, bakagenda Sifu, korende Daudi amo n’baanto baye nao baarenge ase erooro ya Maoni, agwo ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, Irianyi ya Yesimona.

English: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
Kiswahili: Mzee: Kwa Gayo rafiki yangu, nimpendaye katika kweli. Gayo Anasifiwa Kwa Ajili Ya Ukarimu Wake
Ekegusii: Korwa ase omogaka ngokorikera nde aye Gayo, omwanchani, oyonyanchete ase ekeene.

English: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.
Ekegusii: Nainwe boigo komorarore ayio agokoreka, momanye ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae ng’ang’e bore.

English: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn't go out by night.
Kiswahili: Huona kwamba biashara yake ina faida, wala taa yake haizimiki usiku.
Ekegusii: Nigo akorora ng'a emeremo yaye nigo ekorenta ebitoki, na etaaya yaye teri korima nyomba mwaye botuko.

English: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd's tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
Kiswahili: Kama hema la mchunga mifugo, nyumba yangu imebomolewa na kutwaliwa kutoka kwangu. Kama mfumaji nimevingirisha maisha yangu, naye amenikatilia mbali kutoka kitanda cha mfumi. Mchana na usiku uliyakomesha maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwane bwatagoirwe na korusigwa ase 'nde buna eema y'omorisia, naringire obogima bwane buna omooroisia ebitambaa akobiringa; nabutoirwe korwa ase egekorero; ekero botaraira, aye nigo okoeria obogima bwane.

English: We have disobeyed him and have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in the commandments of the Lord that he has set before us.
Kiswahili: Hatukumtii wala hatukutii sauti ya Bwana, Mungu wetu, ili kuenenda katika amri za Bwana alizoweka mbele yetu.
Ekegusii: Korwa chingaki chiria Omonene arusetie chisokoro chiaito aria Misiri goika rero iga, intwe twagendereire gotaba abegenwa ase are, na twabeire aboro komoigwera.

English: When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not put any in your basket.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiingia katika shamba la mizabibu la jirani yako, unaweza kula zabibu kadiri utakavyo, lakini usiweke chochote kwenye kikapu chako.
Ekegusii: “Ekero ogoeta ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omogisangio oo norie amatunda y’emesabibu goika oigote, korende totwa nonya n’erimo obeeke ase esaaro yao na koriira.

English: Neither did I liken to her any priceless gem, because all gold in her presence is a little sand, and silver will be considered as clay before her.
Kiswahili: Wala sikumfananisha naye kito chochote kisicho na thamani, kwa sababu dhahabu yote mbele yake ni mchanga mdogo, na fedha itahesabiwa kama udongo mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Tinabwekanetie obongaini gento kende gionsi ki'erigori rinene, ekiagera etaabu yonsi ere ase ense nigo enga buna amaroba, ne chifeta mbosa ase obongaini.

English: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
Kiswahili: Yeyote kati yenu anayependa uzima na kutamani kuziona siku nyingi njema,
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?

English: My delicate ones have traveled rough roads. They were taken away like a flock carried off by enemies.
Kiswahili: Wapenzi wangu wamesafiri katika barabara mbaya. Walichukuliwa kama kundi linalochukuliwa na maadui.
Ekegusii: Abana baane nigo nababegete ase obwanchani, korende mogachora kogenda ase chinchera chimbe erio mokaimokigwa buna ching'ondi chiabwatirwe na koirwa n'ababisa.

English: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.
Kiswahili: Nenda kwa Farao asubuhi wakati anapokwenda mtoni. Ngoja ukingoni mwa Naili ili uonane naye, na uchukue mkononi mwako fimbo ile iliyobadilishwa kuwa nyoka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, genda oumerane na Farao ekero aragende rooche mambia, ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.

English: The vile man vowed to the sovereign Lord, who now no more would have pity upon him, saying
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu aliapa kwa Bwana Mwenye Enzi Kuu, ambaye sasa hangemhurumia tena, akisema
Ekegusii: Nyasae konya osiekire amaabera aye ase omonto oyo, korende omonto oyo akaria eira ase Nyasae agateeba,

English: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn't call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
Kiswahili: Basi Waefraimu wakamuuliza Gideoni, “Mbona mmetutenda hivi? Kwa nini hukutuita ulipokwenda kupigana na Wamidiani?” Wakawalaumu kwa ukali sana.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu bakabooria Gidioni, “Nase ki otatorangeretie ekero kwagendete korwania Abamidiani? Inki eke gwatokoreire?” Naende bakamwomania, bare n'obotindi obonge mono.

English: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
Kiswahili: Mafanikio ya nchi ni kwa ajili ya wote, hata mfalme mwenyewe hufaidi kutoka mashambani.
Ekegusii: Mbuya ase ense ere nomorwoti okogamba buya na korigereria ng'a abanto nkorema bare emegondo yabo.

English: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
Kiswahili: Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza: kama mkimpata mpenzi wangu, mtamwambia nini? Mwambieni ninazimia kwa mapenzi.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora ng'a mokonyora omwanchi one, momoteebie ng'a amaiga 'obwanchani anyaarire.

English: therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh's word!”
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo enyi wachungaji, sikieni neno la Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring'ana ri'Omonene:

English: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
Kiswahili: wakitusihi kwa bidii wapewe fursa ya kushiriki katika huduma hii ya kuwasaidia watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatosaba na gotosorora mono tobae ribaga babwatane naintwe ase ogokorera abachenu.

English: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?
Ekegusii: Ning'o ore ase more oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi'okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?

English: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.
Kiswahili: “Nisikilizeni, watu wangu; nisikieni, taifa langu: Sheria itatoka kwangu; haki yangu itakuwa nuru kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inyigwere; inwe abanto b'egesaku kiane, tegerera monyigwe! Nindue ogochika kwane, na oboronge bwane mbobe omobaso ase abanto bonsi.

English: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
Kiswahili: Samaria na mfalme wake wataelea kama kijiti juu ya uso wa maji.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amaache igoro.

English: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
Kiswahili: “Pia kwa habari ya Yezebeli Bwana anasema, ‘Mbwa watamla Yezebeli karibu na ukuta wa Yezreeli.'
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire boigo igoro ya Yesebeli; Chisese inachiriere Yesebeli agwo ase oboremo bwa Yesireeli.

English: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
Kiswahili: alikimbia uchi, akaliacha vazi lake.
Ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki'egatani, agatama ore getirianda.

English: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
Kiswahili: Nifundishe kufanya mapenzi yako, kwa maana wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu, Roho wako mwema na aniongoze katika nchi tambarare.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.

English: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
Kiswahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi ya nchi; niliwaponda na kuwakanyaga kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ye riroba, nkabamionogora na kobatiringa buna esike egotachwa ase chinchera.

English: So now I will consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat:
Kiswahili: Basi nitamwangamiza Baasha pamoja na nyumba yake, nami nitaifanya nyumba yako kama ile ya Yeroboamu mwanawe Nebati.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ningosirie kegima, aye Baasa amo nabaanto b’enyomba yao ebe buna enyomba ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati.

English: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
Kiswahili: Maji yenye kina yamewafunika, wamezama mpaka vilindini kama jiwe.
Ekegusii: Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
Kiswahili: Nitafurahi na kushangilia ndani yako. Nitaliimbia sifa jina lako, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga mono kegima ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono Kegima.

English: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
Kiswahili: Lakini akili zao zilipumbazwa, kwa maana mpaka leo utaji ule ule hufunika wakati Agano la Kale linasomwa. Huo utaji haujaondolewa, kwa maana ni katika Kristo peke yake unaondolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende ebirengererio biabo bigakong'igwa. Naki nonya ngoika rituko ria reero, ekero amariiko y'okobwatana ogokoro agosomwa, egietubo ekio ekio keba tigekorusigwa, ekiagera ase Kristo bweka kiarusigwe.

English: Then the angel who was speaking with me went out, and another angel came out to meet him
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami akaondoka, malaika mwingine akaja kukutana naye
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche ogocha, na omomalaika onde agacha koumerana nere,

English: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wale kumi na wawili aliowachagua: Simoni (ambaye alimwita Petro);
Ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere achoorete nabwo aba: Simioni nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,

English: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
Kiswahili: akusamehe dhambi zako zote, akuponya magonjwa yako yote,
Ekegusii: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.

English: Then they will look to the earth and see only distress and darkness and the gloom of anguish. And they will be driven into utter darkness.
Kiswahili: Kisha wataangalia duniani na kuona tu dhiki na giza, hofu na huzuni tupu, nao watasukumiwa kwenye giza nene kabisa.
Ekegusii: naende baonchoke barigererie ense inse, korende nigo bararore obororo, na omosunte, na ogoichanigwa okonene, erio basoigwe ase omosunte ekerima.

English: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
Kiswahili: Kusanyeni mbele yangu wazee wote wa makabila yenu na maafisa wenu wote, ili nipate kusema maneno haya masikioni mwao na kuziita mbingu na nchi ili kushuhudia dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Sangereria abagaaka bonsi b’ebisaku biaino, na abanene bonsi, obarente ase ’nde, erinde imbateebie amang’ana aya; inche nindangerie igoro na ense chibe birori ase bare.

English: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Gederothi, Beth-Dagoni, Naama na Makeda; yote ni miji kumi na sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Gederoti, na Beti‐Dagoni, na Naama, na Makeda, emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: That very night Belshazzar king of the Chaldeans was slain,
Kiswahili: Usiku ule ule, Belshaza mfalme wa Wakaldayo akauawa,
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obwo Belisasari, omorwoti bw’Abakalidayo, agaitwa agakwa,

English: Therefore let Moab wail; let them wail together for Moab. Moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth, you who are utterly stricken.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wamoabu wanaomboleza, wanaiombolezea Moabu kwa pamoja. Wanaomboleza na kuhuzunika kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-Haresethi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamoabu mbarere; kera omonto tiga areere ense ya Moabu. Eng’ererie moichane, ekiagera mwaborirwe amabomba ’amasabibu amomo akwama Kiri‐Hareseti.

English: No foot of man or beast will pass through, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.
Kiswahili: Hakuna unyayo wa mtu au mnyama utakaopita ndani yake, wala hakuna yeyote atakayeishi humo kwa muda wa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tagotaara ase ense eyio, gose eng’iti tegotaara goeterao. Ense eyio nebe etamenyiri nabaanto ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
Kiswahili: Mtu huyu aliishi makaburini, wala hakuna aliyeweza kumzuia hata kwa kumfunga minyororo.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,

English: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Mvi ni taji ya utukufu; hupatikana kwa maisha ya uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Chimbuche chire ase omotwe neguutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorwa n’abanyaboronge.

English: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
Kiswahili: miungu wale waliokula mafuta ya dhabihu zao na kunywa mvinyo wa sadaka zao za vinywaji? Wainuke basi, wawasaidie! Wawapeni basi ulinzi!
Ekegusii: Chinyasae echio chiariete ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biabo, na konywa okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa bi’edivai, ng’ai chire? Tiga chichiche erio chibakonye na kobarenda.

English: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,
Kiswahili: “Sasa, mwanadamu, kaza uso wako dhidi ya binti za watu wako wanaotabiri mambo kutoka mawazo yao wenyewe. Tabiri dhidi yao
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, barigererie abakungu b' abanto bao, abwo bakobana amang'ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obaane amang'ana are mamincha yabo.

English: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
Kiswahili: Tou mfalme wa Hamathi aliposikia kwamba Daudi amelishinda jeshi lote la Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba,
