Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ebing'wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue n'okoruegwa kw'endagera, na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Mambo haya yanaweza kuonekana ya ajabu kwa mabaki ya watu wakati huo, lakini yaweza kuwa ya ajabu kwangu?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Onye amang’ana ayio are ay’ogokumia ase abatigari b’egesaku eke, Inee, nabe ay’ogokumia ase ’nde boigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda?

English: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn't provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu wangu, mtu akiwalisha, wanatangaza ‘amani'; kama hakufanya hivyo, wanaandaa kupigana vita dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bane nigo bakong'ainwa n'ababani abwo bakobariera chiira chi'omorembe baria bakobaakana, korende bagosereria baria batari kobaakana egesi. Ase ababani abwo Omonene nigo agoteeba,

English: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa maana ya lile alilowaambia.
Ekegusii: Tibamanya ring'ana riria abateebia.

English: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.

English: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
Kiswahili: Mlinijibu, “Shauri ulilolitoa ni zuri.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwancheranete buna ayio namaya na buna moyakore.

English: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
Kiswahili: Dunia itaharibiwa kabisa na kutekwa nyara kabisa. Bwana amesema neno hili.
Ekegusii: Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene oteebire ring’ana erio.

English: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
Kiswahili: Basi nyumba ya Yosefu wakashambulia Betheli, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n’abanto b’eamate ya Yusufu. Barabwo bakageenda kobarwania abanto b’omochie o Beteli.

English: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
Kiswahili: Wameitupa miungu yao kwenye moto na kuiangamiza, kwa kuwa haikuwa miungu, bali miti na mawe tu iliyotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: batugutire chinyasae chi’abaanto abwo ase omorero, ekiagera chirochio tichiri Nyasae, korende nemeremo y’amaboko ’abaanto, chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena; ase ayio chigasirigwa.

English: The king’s servants replied, “Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.”
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa mfalme wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako tu tayari kufanya lolote mfalme bwana wetu analochagua.”
Ekegusii: Abasomba b’omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao nigo twebegete ang’e gokora rinde rionsi oratoteebie.”

English: The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
Kiswahili: Tangu mwanzo, manabii waliokutangulia wewe na mimi walitabiri vita, maafa na tauni dhidi ya nchi nyingi na falme kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abaabani abwo bagotang’anerete aye na inche ase chingaki chia kare nigo baabaanete igoro y’esegi, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita, ng’a mbichiche ase chinse chinyinge na ase amarwoti are ne chinguru.

English: He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
Kiswahili: Anapopita nyuma yake huacha mkondo unaometameta; mtu angedhani vilindi vilikuwa na mvi.
Ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.

English: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sema nao uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Wakati Mwisraeli yeyote anapoweka sanamu moyoni mwake na kuweka kitu kiovu cha kukwaza mbele ya macho yake na kisha akaenda kwa nabii, Mimi Bwana nitamjibu peke yangu sawasawa na ukubwa wa ibada yake ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo, kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli orae emegwekano yaye agosasiima ribaga ase enkoro yaye, na emegwekano eyio ebe ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie buna agwenerete ase engencho y’emegwekano yaye emenge agosasiima.

English: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
Kiswahili: Goliathi alisimama na kuwapigia kelele majeshi ya Israeli, akisema, “Kwa nini mmetoka kupanga vita? Je, mimi si Mfilisti, na ninyi ni watumishi wa Sauli? Chagueni mtu na anishukie mimi.
Ekegusii: Goliato agacha bosio, agaaka eriogi ase abarwani b'Abaisraeli, akabora: “Nase ki mwachire na korobera ase okorwana esegi? Inee! Inche tindi Omofilisti, nainwe nabasomba ba Saulo? Chora omonto oyomo oino ache aa ase 'nde.

English: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila kitu kilichowekwa nuruni, huonekana,
Ekegusii: Korende onsi ayaorokigwe nomobaso nigo are maiso marore, ekiagera kera egento ekere maiso marore nigo kere omobaso.

English: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaondoa wanawe magotini mwa Israeli naye akasujudu hadi nchi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatugama inse.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Nyoosha mkono wako umkamate mkiani.” Basi Mose akanyoosha mkono akamkamata yule nyoka, naye akabadilika tena kuwa fimbo mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Erio ere akarambora okoboko kwaye, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.

English: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
Kiswahili: hakikisheni kwamba mnatii amri na sheria zote ninazoziweka mbele yenu leo.
Ekegusii: mwerende na mobwate amachiiko na emeroberio yonsi echiikire, aya nayabeekire ase amasio aino rituko ria reero.

English: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
Kiswahili: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,

English: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
Kiswahili: Hekalu ndani ilikuwa ya mierezi iliyonakshiwa mifano ya maboga na maua yaliyochanua. Kila kitu kilikuwa cha mwerezi, hakuna jiwe ambalo lilionekana.
Ekegusii: Chibao chi'emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiareenge nemegwekano y'ebirandi, na ey'ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.

English: Then Daniel replied, “O king, may you live forever!
Kiswahili: Danieli akajibu, “Ee mfalme, uishi milele!
Ekegusii: Erio Danieli akairaneria omorwoti, “Aye omorwoti, ochie kare!

English: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal glory that is far beyond comparison.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana dhiki yetu nyepesi iliyo ya kitambo inatutayarisha kwa ajili ya utukufu wa milele unaozidi kuwa mwingi kupita kiasi,
Ekegusii: Naki emechando yaito eyere y’ekero egeke gioka nemegusu, egotoroiseria obonene bwa kare na kare obore obonge mono kobua.

English: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama wao, kwa sababu Baba yenu anajua kile mnachohitaji kabla hamjamwomba.
Ekegusii: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba. Ogosaba kw’Omonene (Luk 11:2-4)

English: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijenga juu ya msingi huu kwa kutumia dhahabu, fedha, vito vya thamani, miti, majani au nyasi,
Ekegusii: Korende omonto karaagache igoro ase oboroso obwo netaabu, gose efeta, gose amagena e rigori rinene, gose emete, gose obonyansi, gose chinsiaga,

English: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
Kiswahili: Lakini mkiingia katika mji, nao hawakuwakaribisha, tokeni mwende katika barabara zake mkaseme:
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaariganeti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:

English: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini, mwezi wa nne, siku ya tano ya mwezi, wakati nilipokuwa miongoni mwa hao waliokuwa uhamishoni kando ya Mto Kebari, mbingu zilifunguka nami nikaona maono ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw'emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang'e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.

English: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
Kiswahili: Sitasahau mausia yako kamwe, kwa maana kwayo umehifadhi maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche tinkonyaara kweba amachiiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang'eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.

English: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And his son Amon reigned in his place. Amon Reigns in Judah (2 Chronicles 33:21–25)
Kiswahili: Manase akalala pamoja na baba zake na akazikwa katika bustani ya jumba lake la kifalme, katika bustani ya Uza. Naye Amoni mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake. Amoni Mfalme Wa Yuda (2 Nyakati 33:21-25)
Ekegusii: Manase akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase omogondo bw’enyomba yaye oria orenge o Usa; na Amoni, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye. Amoni omorwoti bw’Abayuda (2 Amg 33:21-25)

English: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Naye kila atakayenena neno baya dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.

English: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
Kiswahili: Wazike wote mavumbini pamoja; wafunge nyuso zao kaburini.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong'u amasio abo ime y'ense inse.

English: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone's heart will melt.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya hili, mikono yote italegea, moyo wa kila mtu utayeyuka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, amaboko 'abaanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.

English: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions, as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officers.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Uzia alikuwa na jeshi lililofunzwa vizuri, lililokuwa tayari kwenda vitani kwa vikosi kufuatana na idadi yao kama walivyokusanywa na Yeieli mwandishi na Maaseya msimamizi chini ya maelekezo ya Hanania, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Naende Usia nabwate omoganda bw’abasikari bamanyete korwana. Barabwo bakagenda korwana esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe, koreng’ana buna baabaretwe na korikwa na Yeieli omoriki, na Maaseya omoteneneri, inse y’obochiki bwa Hanania, omochiki bw’abarwani b’omorwoti.

English: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng'ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

English: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
Kiswahili: Nitapaza sauti yangu nikisema, “Ni nani aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Wewe huwaokoa maskini kutokana na wale walio na nguvu kuliko wao, maskini na mhitaji kutokana na wanaowanyangʼanya!”
Ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay'omobere one nateebe, “Aye Omonene, ning'o onga buna aye? Aye Omonene, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”

English: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them
Kiswahili: Uwasamehe watu wako, waliotenda dhambi dhidi yako; uwasamehe makosa yote waliyoyatenda dhidi yako, ukawafanye wale waliowashinda kuwaonea huruma;
Ekegusii: Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire baabarorere amabeebe.

English: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?'”
Kiswahili: Wewe unasema moyoni mwako kwamba umemshinda Edomu, nawe sasa unajigamba na kujivuna. Lakini kaa nyumbani kwako! Kwa nini utafute matatizo na kujiletea anguko lako mwenyewe na la Yuda pia?”
Ekegusii: Na bono aye nigo ogokwana iga: Rora, inche naitire Abaedomu; ase igo kweimokereirie igoro ase enkoro yao ime na kweenenia. Korende aye, beera agwo nka bwoo! Nase ki okorangeria emechando, erinde ogwe, aye amo n'Abayuda?”

English: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
Kiswahili: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y'ayio noche kong'ira onsoyie ase obonene.

English: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
Kiswahili: Kando ya mito ya Babeli tuliketi, tukaomboleza tulipokumbuka Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babiloni, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.

English: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme wa Israeli akaagiza, “Mchukueni na mkamrudishe kwa Amoni mtawala wa mji na kwa Yoashi mwana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli agateeba, “Bwata Mikaya momoiranie ase Amoni, omogabana bw'omochie, na ase Yoashi, omomura bw'omorwoti,

English: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na ndugu saba miongoni mwetu. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa, na kwa kuwa hakuwa na watoto, akamwachia nduguye yule mjane.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise oyomo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bw'eritang'ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mok'aye.

English: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng’a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteeba ng’a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteeba, “Yeso n’Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.
Kiswahili: Sasa nitaondoka na kuzunguka mjini, katika barabara zake na viwanja; nitamtafuta yule moyo wangu umpendaye. Kwa hiyo nilimtafuta lakini sikumpata.
Ekegusii: “Erio nkaimoka nkagenda ase omochie, ng’aeta ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, nkarigia omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.

English: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mashemasi nao wawe watu wanaostahili heshima, wasiwe wenye kauli mbili au wenye kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo, wala wanaotamani faida isiyo halali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakoonyi b'ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw'oborianania.

English: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Matthew 22:23–33; Luke 20:27–40)
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.” Nao wakamstaajabia sana. Ndoa Wakati Wa Ufufuo (Mathayo 22:23-33; Luka 20:27-40)
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Luk 20:27-40)

English: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa ni sauti ya mabawa ya wale viumbe hai yakisuguana moja kwa jingine, sauti kama ya ngurumo.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa na eriogi rie chimbaaba chi'ebitongwa biria bire moyo chigokunana, na eriogi ri'amagoro aria arenge mbarabare yabo riarenge buna eri'ogoaka gw'enkoba.

English: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
Kiswahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.
Ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oo, n’enkoro yao yonsi, n’omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.

English: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
Kiswahili: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bi'omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.

English: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao aliyeitwa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, akasema, “Ninyi hamjui kitu chochote!
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase bare, Kayafa, oyorenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabateebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.

English: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale maserafi akaruka kunijia akiwa na kaa la moto linalowaka mkononi mwake, ambalo alikuwa amelichukua kwa koleo kutoka madhabahuni.
Ekegusii: Erio omoserafi oyomo akairuruka gocha ase ’nde, obogoretie ase okoboko kwaye rikara rire nomorero, erio arusetie ne rigami korwa ase egesasiimero.

English: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoweka wakfu Maskani ya Mungu, aliweka vitako mahali pake, akasimamisha mihimili, akatia mataruma na kusimamisha nguzo.
Ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.

English: And every man of Israel cried to God with great earnestness, and with great earnestness they humbled their souls.
Kiswahili: Na kila mtu wa Israeli alimlilia Mungu kwa bidii kubwa, na kwa bidii kubwa walinyenyekeza roho zao.
Ekegusii: Abasacha bonsi ba Israeli bakamoreera Omonene Nyasae obo ase ogwekeia nokweng'ata.

English: “The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.”
Kiswahili: “ ‘ Bwana amethibitisha haki yetu; njooni, tutangaze katika Sayuni kitu ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu amefanya.’
Ekegusii: “Omonene otorenteire oboronge bwaito. Inchuo torarie ase Sayoni emeremo y’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: For she is a reflection of everlasting light, an unspotted mirror of the working of God, and an image of his goodness.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye ni mng'ao wa nuru ya milele, kioo kisicho na doa cha utendaji wa Mungu, na taswira ya wema wake.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini n'oborabu bwa Nyasae bwa kare na kare, ekerore ekerabu ki'ogokora kwa Nyasae na omobwekano bw'obuya bwaye.

English: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
Kiswahili: Unasema, “Ninachagua wakati maalum; ni mimi nihukumuye kwa haki.
Ekegusii: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekiina kia boronge.

English: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”
Kiswahili: Akaangalia, na tazama alikuwako mfalme, akiwa amesimama karibu na nguzo, kama ilivyokuwa desturi. Maafisa na wapiga tarumbeta walikuwa pembeni mwa mfalme, nao watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakifurahi na kupiga tarumbeta. Ndipo Athalia akararua mavazi yake na kulia, “Uhaini! Uhaini!”
Ekegusii: Atalia akarora omorwoti oteneine ang'e nesiiro buna engencho yarenge. Abatang'ani na abanto abaarenge kobugia ebitureeri bateneine mbarabare y'omorwoti, na abanto bonsi b'ense eria nigo baarenge nomochengo, bakobugia ebitureeri. Atalia agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Oko nokoregwa! Nokoregwa!”

English: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher. “Everything is futile!” The Whole Duty of Man
Kiswahili: Mhubiri asema, “Ubatili! Ubatili! Kila kitu ni ubatili!” Hitimisho La Mambo
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteeba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima. Okobeekwa amo kw’amang’ana

English: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
Kiswahili: Baadaye wakawatuma baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Maherode ili kwenda kumtega Yesu katika yale anayosema.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma asare abande b'Abafarisai na Abaherodia, erinde bamotege ase amang'ana.

English: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn't drink the river water.
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri wote wakachimba kandokando ya Mto Naili kupata maji ya kunywa, kwa sababu hawakuweza kunywa maji ya mto.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y'orooche ase okorigia amaache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amaache a rooche.

English: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
Kiswahili: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng’ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

English: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatuma vijana wanaume wa Kiisraeli, nao wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za mafahali wachanga kuwa sadaka za amani kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, bakanyenyera Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

English: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Kiswahili: “Wale niwapendao, ninawakemea na kuwaadibisha. Hivyo uwe na bidii ukatubu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaa egesusuro bonsi abanyanchete, na kobagambera; gaki kabe nomokia na koonchoka.

English: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,
Kiswahili: Naye bwana wangu ameniapisha na akasema, ‘Kamwe usimtwalie mwanangu mke katika binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi katika nchi yao,
Ekegusii: Omonene one akamboria ntiane, aganteabia: “Torigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase ense yabo;

English: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”
Kiswahili: Mlinzi akasema, “Ninaona kuwa yule wa kwanza anakimbia kama Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki.” Mfalme akasema, “Yeye ni mtu mwema. Analeta habari njema.”
Ekegusii: Omorendi agateeba, “Nigo 'ndoche ng'a omominyoki oria bw'eritang'ani nigo anga buna Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki.” Erio omorwoti agateeba, “Ere nomonto omuya, nigo akorenta amang'ana amaya.”

English: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.
Kiswahili: ambaye ataamua ubora wa mnyama huyo, kama ni mzuri au mbaya. Thamani yoyote atakayoweka kuhani, hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa.
Ekegusii: na ere akore rigori ri’eng’iti eria koreng’ana buna ere engiya gose embe. Rigori Omokuani arakore, nario erio riraabe.

English: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan.
Kiswahili: Hilkia akamwambia Shafani mwandishi, “Nimekipata Kitabu cha Sheria ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.” Akampa Shafani kile Kitabu.
Ekegusii: Erio Hilikia agateebia Safani omoriki, “Nanyorire Egetabu y’Amachiko ime ase enyomba y’Omonene,” akaa Safani egetabu eria.

English: Yet none of this satisfies me as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”
Kiswahili: Lakini haya yote hayanipi kuridhika iwapo ninaendelea kumwona yule Myahudi Mordekai akiketi kwenye lango la mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ayio onsi tabwati engencho ase inde ekero nkorora Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, oikaransete ase egeita ki’omorwoti.”

English: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msiishi kwa kufuata desturi za mataifa nitakayoyafukuza mbele yenu. Kwa sababu walifanya mambo haya yote, nami nikachukizwa sana nao.
Ekegusii: Timochia kobwatia chingencho chi’abaanto b’egesaku keria ngochia goseria kerue ase amasio aino; barabwo nigo bakorete amang’ana ayio onsi, na ase engencho y’ayio nkagechigwa nabarabwo.

English: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.'
Kiswahili: Majembe yenu yafueni yawe panga na miundu yenu ya kukatia iwe mikuki. Aliye dhaifu na aseme, “Mimi nina nguvu!”
Ekegusii: Tura amakombe aino abe emioro, na emeyio yaino chinkuro ebe amatimo! Tiga oyore omworo atebe, “Nainche nigo inde etuoni.”

English: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo na kesho yanatupwa motoni, je, hatawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba?
Ekegusii: Korende onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe, abamore nokwegena ogoke?

English: Heliodorus went on to execute that which had been decreed.
Kiswahili: Heliodorus aliendelea kutekeleza kile kilichokuwa kimeamriwa.
Ekegusii: Heliodoro ere akagenderera n'omoroberio oye.

English: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni Alfa na Omega,” asema Bwana Mungu, “aliyeko, aliyekuwako na atakayekuja, Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: “Inche n'Alifa na Omega,” Omonene oteebire, oyoreo, na oyorengeo, na oyorache kobao.

English: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
Kiswahili: na useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ee Gogu, mimi ni kinyume nawe, mtawala mkuu wa Roshi, Mesheki na Tubali.
Ekegusii: omoteebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Aye Gogi, omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, inche nigo inde mamincha yao.

English: It came to pass, when King Alexander heard these things, he honored Jonathan even more.
Kiswahili: Ikawa, Mfalme Aleksanda aliposikia mambo haya, alimheshimu Yonathani zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Alekisanda anyoorete amang'ana ayio, akamoa Yonathani esiko enene kobua.

English: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Kiswahili: Hukunikabidhi kwa adui yangu bali umeiweka miguu yangu mahali penye nafasi.
Ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko 'omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.

English: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
Kiswahili: “Kisha tengeneza taa zake saba na uziweke juu ya kinara hicho ili ziangaze mbele yake.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.

English: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme alipokuwa mezani pake, manukato yangu yalisambaza harufu yake nzuri.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.

English: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
Kiswahili: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukatili. Akikataa shauri alilopewa na wazee,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akairaneria abanto baria amang'ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw'abagaaka baria.

English: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not bow down or pay him homage, he was filled with rage.
Kiswahili: Wakati Hamani alipoona kuwa Mordekai hampigii magoti wala kumpa heshima alighadhibika.
Ekegusii: Hamani akaba nendamwamu enene mono ekero aroche ng’a Moredekai tarenge gotung’ama ase okomosasiima,

English: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
Kiswahili: mama yako ataaibika mno, yeye aliyekuzaa atatahayari. Atakuwa mdogo kuliko mataifa mengine yote, atakuwa nyika, nchi kame na jangwa.
Ekegusii: nyoko nabe nobosooku obonene, ee, omochie oyo okoiborete noichanigwe. Rora, ase egati ye chinse chi'ense oyio obe omoke mono kobua, nobe erooro enyomo ere bosa.

English: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umetupwa nje ya kaburi lako kama tawi lililokataliwa, umefunikwa na waliouawa pamoja na wale waliochomwa kwa upanga, wale washukao mpaka kwenye mawe ya shimo. Kama mzoga uliokanyagwa chini ya nyayo,
Ekegusii: korende aye totindekiri; nigo otugutire buna orosagia rotanchiri. Nigo oraire ase egati y'abanto baitetwe nemioro, bagatugutwa ase chingoro chi'amagena buna ebitondo bigotachwa namagoro.

English: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.” The Covenant of Circumcision
Kiswahili: Nchi yote ya Kanaani, unakoishi sasa kama mgeni, nitakupa kuwa milki yako milele, na uzao wako, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninkoe aye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ense eye omenyete bono buna omomenyi, ense yonsi ya Kaanani, ebe eyaino kare na kare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.” Okobwatana gw’okwarokigwa, na eira y’okoiborwa gwa Isaka

English: And those He predestined, He also called; those He called, He also justified; those He justified, He also glorified.
Kiswahili: Nao wale Mungu aliotangulia kuwachagua, akawaita, wale aliowaita pia akawahesabia haki, nao wale aliowahesabia haki, pia akawatukuza. Upendo Wa Mungu
Ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo. Obwanchani bwa Nyasae

English: Again Elijah replied, “If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.” And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.
Kiswahili: Eliya akajibu, “Ikiwa mimi ni mtu wa Mungu, moto na ushuke kutoka mbinguni ukuteketeze wewe na watu wako hamsini!” Ndipo moto wa Mungu ukashuka kutoka mbinguni, ukamteketeza yeye na watu wake hamsini.
Ekegusii: Korende Elija akabairaneria: “Onye inche inde omonto o Nyasae, tiga omorero orwe igoro ogosambe na kogosiria, aye amo nabarwani bao emerongo etano.” Erio omorero okarwa igoro, ogasamba omotang’ani oria amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano, okabasiria.

English: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
Kiswahili: Nitakushukuru, kwa kuwa ulinijibu, umekuwa wokovu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyiguure, naende kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.

English: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu mfalme wa Ashuru: “Hataingia katika mji huu wala hatapiga mshale hapa. Hatakuja mbele yake akiwa na ngao, wala kupanga majeshi kuuzingira.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba igoro y'omorwoti bw'Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takorasa omogwe agwo; tagocha ase omochie oyo obogoretie chinguba, gose takoagacha orwaki bosio bwaye.

English: and should forbid whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and drink offerings in the sanctuary; and should profane the Sabbaths and feasts,
Kiswahili: na kukataza sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa na dhabihu na sadaka za kinywaji katika patakatifu; na kuchafua Sabato na sikukuu,
Ekegusii: Akabakania tibabaisa korwa ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, chinyeke gose ebiebinyuugwa ime ye Hekalu. Agachiika esabato na'matuko yomochengo agwekane amatuko ande a botaambe.

English: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.
Kiswahili: Anapokuwa kazini pande za kaskazini, simwoni; akigeukia kusini, nako simwoni hata kidogo.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende ere nigo akwebisa; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komoorora.

English: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
Kiswahili: Yuda alikuwa mmoja wetu, kwa maana na yeye alichaguliwa ashiriki katika huduma hii.”
Ekegusii: Naki Yudasi konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y'obokoreri amo naitwe.

English: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli: “Kwa sababu mmekataa ujumbe huu, mkategemea uonevu na kutumainia udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli oteebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.

English: For as the masterbuilder of a new house must care for the whole structure, and again he who undertakes to decorate and paint it must seek out the things fit for its adorning; even so I think it is also with us.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile mjenzi mkuu wa nyumba mpya anavyopaswa kutunza muundo mzima, na tena yule anayejitolea kupamba na kupaka rangi lazima atafute vitu vinavyofaa kwa mapambo yake; hata hivyo nadhani iko nasi pia.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi omoroisia bw'enyomba engeni eyio ogokora kera egento, korende inche n'omwaki chirangi na emeremo yane n'okoroisia enyomba erorekane buya.

English: Say to the king and to the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.”
Kiswahili: Mwambie mfalme na mamaye, “Shukeni kutoka kwenye viti vyenu vya enzi, kwa kuwa taji zenu za utukufu zitaanguka kutoka vichwani mwenu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Teebia omorwoti na ng’ina bekeyie babe abaitongo ekiagera chigutwa chiabo chingiya chiarusigwe ase emetwe yabo.”

English: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
Kiswahili: “Kuko wapi, ee mauti, kushinda kwako? Uko wapi, ee mauti, uchungu wako?”
Ekegusii: “Amakweri, ng'ai okobua kwao kore? Amakweri, ng'ai obororo bwao bore?”

English: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Ambaye aliumba mianga mikubwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere okorete emebaso eria emenene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king's commandment.
Kiswahili: Huduma ilipomalizika kuandaliwa makuhani wakasimama mahali pao na Walawi katika migawanyo yao kama mfalme alivyokuwa ameamuru.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya okwebeka ang'e gwakorirwe, abakuani bagatenena aase abo, na Abalawi ase ebiombe biabo, koreng'ana buna omorwoti achigete.

English: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
Kiswahili: Adhabu ya watu wangu ni kubwa kuliko ile ya Sodoma, ambayo ilipinduliwa ghafula bila kuwepo mkono wa msaada.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abanyorete, ekiagera ebibe biakorire ase omochie bw'abaanto bane nigo biarenge ebinene kobua ebi'abaanto ba Sodomu, omochie oyio nigo oonchoranetwe ase etagika eyemo, na okoboko kw'onde tikwayokunete.

English: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
Kiswahili: (Meli za Hiramu zilileta dhahabu kutoka Ofiri; tena kutoka huko zilileta shehena kubwa ya miti ya msandali na vito vya thamani.
Ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Hiramu, chiria chiarentete chitaabu korwa Ofiri, chikarenta naende korwa aroro chibao chi'emete ekorokwa alumugu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene.

English: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kambi katika mashamba yao na kuharibu mazao ya nchi yote hadi kufikia Gaza, wala hawakuacha kiumbe chochote kilicho hai kwa Waisraeli, iwe kondoo au ngʼombe au punda.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bagotoora ase ense y'Abaisraeli, erio basaria chindagera chiabo goika chimbebe chia Gasa. Tibaare gotigareria Abaisraeli ching'ondi, gose chiombe, gose chitigere, nonya ngento kende gionsi Abaisraeli baare koria.

English: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of David's city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
Kiswahili: Baada ya binti Farao kuja kutoka Mji wa Daudi na kuingia jumba la kifalme ambalo Solomoni alikuwa amemjengea, akajenga Milo.
Ekegusii: Korende mosubati o Farao akarua ase Omochie o Daudi, agatiira gochia komenya ase enyomba yaye eria Sulemani konya amoagacheire; magega y'ayio Sulemani akaagacha Milo.

English: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Dumisha upendo wako kwa wale wanaokujua wewe, haki yako kwa wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Usinishike, kwa maana sijapaa kwenda kwa Baba. Lakini nenda kwa ndugu zangu ukawaambie, ‘Ninapaa kwenda kwa Baba yangu ambaye ni Baba yenu, kwa Mungu wangu ambaye ni Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tonkuna, ekiagera tindagenda ase Tata one, korende genda ase abaminto, obateebie, ng’a nkogenda nde ase Tata one oyore Iso oino, ase Nyasae one oyore Nyasae oino.”

English: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don't walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Wewe umekuwa mzee, nao wanao hawaenendi katika njia zako, sasa tuteulie mfalme wa kutuongoza, kama ilivyo kwa mataifa mengine yote.”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia: “Rora bono aye kwagotire, na abamura bao tibari kobwatia chinchera chiao. Ase ayio tochorere omorwoti oranyare gotogaambera buna ebisaku binde bionsi bibwate abarwoti.”

English: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro alipoona haya yaliyotukia, alianguka miguuni mwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Bwana, ondoka kwangu. Mimi ni mtu mwenye dhambi!”
Ekegusii: Korende Simioni Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”

English: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana ataadhibu kwa upanga wake, upanga wake mkali, mkubwa na wenye nguvu, ataadhibu Lewiathani yule nyoka apitaye kwa mwendo laini, Lewiathani yule nyoka mwenye kujipinda; atamuua joka huyo mkubwa sana wa baharini.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene nae Leviatani, eng'iti eria y'okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite n'omoro oye ore omokong'u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.

English: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilimwamuru Yoshua, “Umejionea kwa macho yako mwenyewe yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewafanyia wafalme hawa wawili. Bwana atazifanyia falme zote huko mnakokwenda vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria ’ngachiika Yoshua, ’nkamoteebia: ’Nkwarooche amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete abarwoti baria babere Sihoni na Ogi; Naboigo arakorere kera oyomo ase ense oraabe kogosoa.

English: As a bird which you have released out of your hand, so you have let your neighbor go, and you will not catch him again.
Kiswahili: Kama ndege uliyemwachilia mkononi mwako, ndivyo ulivyomwachilia jirani yako aende, wala hutamkaba tena.
Ekegusii: Buna ere enyoni etairane gocha koboko kwao ekero yaminchoirie, naboigo tokomonyoora omosaani oo naende.

English: But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply. The Crowd Chooses Barabbas (Matthew 27:15–23; Luke 23:13–25)
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu hakujibu lolote, hivyo Pilato akashangaa. Pilato Amtoa Yesu Asulubiwe (Mathayo 27:15-26; Luka 23:13-25; Yohana 18:39–19:16)
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.

English: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayegusa kitanda chake ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna ebiraarero bi’omonto oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule wa pili akamwoa huyo mjane, naye akafa bila mtoto,
Ekegusii: na oyio o kabere akamotwara, na ere agakwa, tatiga bana;

English: My belly also was troubled to seek her. Therefore I have gained a good possession.
Kiswahili: Na tumbo langu lilisumbuka kumtafuta, kwa hiyo nimepata mali nzuri.
Ekegusii: Nabeire n'eng'eria enene ekiagera nigo nasugetigwe n'okogania gw'okonyora chisemi, ekio nakio kiagerire nanyoorire obotenenku bwaye obonene.

English: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
Kiswahili: Mlinde mtumishi wako na dhambi za makusudi, nazo zisinitawale. Ndipo nitakapokuwa sina lawama, wala sitakuwa na hatia ya kosa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi'obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.

English: It's like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
Kiswahili: Ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo ni mbegu ndogo sana kuliko mbegu zote zinazopandwa ardhini.
Ekegusii: Nigo bonga entetere y'omoaruni, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,

English: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
Kiswahili: Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye (ambao aliwaita Boanerge, maana yake Wana wa Ngurumo);
Ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;

English: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
Kiswahili: Mshtakiwa lazima akae katika mji wake wa makimbilio mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu; atarudi tu kwenye mali yake baada ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria oitete oyonde moeneno goika agenderere kobeera ase omochie oria bw’obotamero goika Omokuani bw’engaki eyio akwe. Korende Omokuani oria omonene gakuure, omonto oria nairane gochia ase ense yaye, na ase omwando oye.

English: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.' All the people shall say, ‘Amen.'
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu amuuaye jirani yake kwa siri.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraite omonto onde bobisi. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.
Kiswahili: uliyoyatoa kupitia watumishi wako manabii uliposema: ‘Nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki ni nchi iliyochafuliwa na uovu wa watu wake. Kwa matendo yao ya machukizo wameijaza nchi kwa unajisi wao kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine.
Ekegusii: ayio gwachigeete goetera ase abasomba bao ababani ogateba: Ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino nigo ere eyetachenegeti, ekiagera abanto b'aroro bayekorire yabeire enyaka ase okoyeichoria nogokora kwabo gw'okogechia korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

English: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.
Kiswahili: Nami katika mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wa Dario Mmedi, nilisimama kumsaidia na kumlinda.)
Ekegusii: Na inche nigo natenenete komokonya na komobeka chinguru ase omwaka bw'eritang'ani bw'okogaamba kwa Dario Omomedi.

English: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa maumivu yangu makuu nilimlilia Bwana, naye akanijibu kwa kuniweka huru.
Ekegusii: Ekero nareenge n'emechando nkamorangeri'Omonene; nere akang'iraneria, akambeeka aase aagare.

English: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo Farao akatoa amri hii kwa viongozi wa watumwa na wasimamizi wa watu akawaambia:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachiika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabateebia,

English: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
Kiswahili: Kisha yule jemadari wa jeshi akasimama na kuita kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, akasema: “Sikieni maneno ya mfalme mkuu, mfalme wa Ashuru!
Ekegusii: Erio Rabi‐Sake agatenena, agaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda, agateeba: “Igwa ring’ana ri’omorwoti omonene, ore omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
Kiswahili: Farao akawakasirikia hawa maafisa wake wawili, mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu,
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Farao akabeigwa n’abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati.

English: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
Kiswahili: Hapo palikuwa na mwanamke aliyekuwa amesumbuliwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.

English: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks.
Kiswahili: Kisha Labani akamwacha Yakobo kwa mwendo wa safari ya siku tatu kati yake na Yakobo, wakati Yakobo akiendelea kuchunga lile kundi la Labani lililobaki.
Ekegusii: Erio ageatanana korwa ase Yakobo oboare bw’orogendo rw’amatuko atato; na Yakobo agatigara okorisia riicho ria Labani eriatigarete.

English: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”
Kiswahili: Basi msimamizi wa jumba la mfalme, mtawala wa mji, na wazee na walezi wakatuma ujumbe huu kwa Yehu: “Sisi tu watumishi wako, na tutafanya kila kitu utakachosema. Hatutamteuwa mtu yeyote kuwa mfalme. Wewe fanya uonalo kuwa ni bora.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oria otenenerete enyomba y'omorwoti, na oria otenenerete omochie, amo nabagaaka na abateneneri b'abana b'Ahabu, bagatoma amang'ana ase Yehu, bakaboora: “Intwe nabasomba bao, nabo torakore onsi aya ogotochika. Titobeeka onde bwensi koba omorwoti; aye kora kende gionsi oranche.”

English: When Hadadezer’s subjects saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were unwilling to help the Ammonites anymore.
Kiswahili: Raiya wa Hadadezeri walipoona kuwa wameshindwa na Israeli, wakafanya mapatano ya amani na Daudi, wakawa watumishi wake. Hivyo Waaramu hawakukubali kuwasaidia Waamoni tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe na Daudi, bakebeka inse yaye. Ase ayio Abasiiria tibanchete gokonya Abaamoni naende.

English: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold;
Kiswahili: maua ya dhahabu yaliyofanyizwa, taa na makoleo (vilikuwa vya dhahabu bora kabisa);
Ekegusii: emegwekano y’ebisicha, ne chitaaya, ne chigami biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaabu chioka;

English: I will yet bring instruction to light as the morning, and will make these things clear from far away.
Kiswahili: Nitaleta mafundisho kama asubuhi, nami nitayafanya mambo haya yawe wazi kutoka mbali.
Ekegusii: Bono ninyaare komesia amorokererio aane buna ogotonga kw'erioba, ninyamesie arabe goika aare.

English: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lotani walikuwa wawili: Hori na Homamu. Lotani alikuwa na dada yake aliyeitwa Timna.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Homamu; omosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.

English: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, watoto wadogo, kwa sababu dhambi zenu zimesamehewa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y'erieta riaye.

English: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitapigana dhidi yenu kwa mkono wangu ulionyooshwa na mkono wa nguvu, kwa hasira na ghadhabu kali na ukali mwingi.
Ekegusii: Inche omonyene mbarwanie inwe nokoboko kwane kore ne chinguru, imbe nendamwamu, na obotindi, na okogechigwa okonene.

English: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
Kiswahili: Wao wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Si huyu mtu, bali tufungulie Baraba!” Yule Baraba alikuwa mnyangʼanyi.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakaboora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.

English: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama hamtanisikiliza na kutimiza maagizo haya yote,
Ekegusii: “Korende onye timokonyigwera gose kobwata amachiiko aya onsi,

English: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na ushindi uliompa, utukufu wake ni mkubwa, umeweka juu yake fahari na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Amasikani 'omorwoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.

English: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.
Kiswahili: “Nimekufanya wewe kuwa kitu cha kujaribu chuma, nao watu wangu kama mawe yenye madini, ili upate kuzijua na kuzijaribu njia zao.
Ekegusii: “Nakobekire aye obe gokorenga abanto baane, naende obateeme buna omoturi ebioma agoteema ebioma biaye, erio obamanye na goteema chinchera chiabo.

English: He told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side, go back and forth through the camp from gate to gate, and slay his brother, his friend, and his neighbor.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipowaambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemalo: ‘Kila mmoja wenu ajifunge upanga wake kiunoni aende huku na huko kambi yote mwisho hadi mwisho mwingine, kila mmoja amuue ndugu yake, na rafiki yake na jirani yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga “Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa egeita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio”.

English: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
Kiswahili: “Uwalipize kisasi Wamidiani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Halafu baada ya hayo, utakufa.”
Ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo baabakorerete, erio magega yaye nokwe, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao.”

English: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akatawala katika falme zote kuanzia Mto Frati hadi nchi ya Wafilisti, hadi kwenye mpaka wa Misri. Nchi hizi zilileta ushuru na zilikuwa chini ya Solomoni, siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akaba okogaambera amarwoti onsi, gochakera orooche rw'Eufarati na goikera ense y'Abafilisti, na goikera orobebe rwa Misiri. Abanto bonsi b'oborwoti bwaye nigo baarenge komorentera ebango na bakaba bakomokorera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
Kiswahili: Aliwapelekea makundi ya mainzi yakawala, na vyura wakawaharibu.
Ekegusii: Nigo arentete chingi chinyinge chikabachanda, na akabarentera ebioto bigasaria ense yabo.

English: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep,
Kiswahili: ambaye wala moyo wake haukunibariki kwa kumpatia joto kwa mavazi ya manyoya ya kondoo zangu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.

English: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
Kiswahili: Lakini Samweli akajibu: “Je, Bwana anafurahia sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu kama vile kuitii sauti ya Bwana? Kutii ni bora zaidi kuliko dhabihu, nako kusikia ni bora kuliko mafuta ya kondoo dume.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamoteebia: “Inee! Igo okorengereria ng’a Omonene nagokerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde kobua okomoigwera? Naama! Okoigwera nokuya kobua ebing’wanso, na ogotegerera nokuya kobua ebitinya bie chimingichi.

English: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
Kiswahili: Wakati alikuwa angali anazungumza na makutano, mama yake na ndugu zake wakasimama nje wakitaka kuongea naye.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana n’abanto, rora, ng’ina na bamura bamwabo nigo bateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana nere.

English: and to those who are fighting with them, there shall not be given food, weapons, money, or ships, as it has seemed good to Rome. They shall keep these ordinances, and that without deceit.
Kiswahili: na wale wanaopigana nao, hawatapewa chakula, silaha, pesa, au meli, kama ilivyoonekana kuwa vyema kwa Roma. Watashika amri hizi, na hilo bila udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Na ababisa abwo barakore esegi, Abarumi tibabaa gose kobaereria endagera, ebirwanero gose chimeeri buna twancheranire na Rumi. Abayahudi mbaikeranie amachiiko ayio komocha gotaiyo.

English: Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaondoka sehemu za Tiro, akapita katikati ya Sidoni, hadi Bahari ya Galilaya na kuingia eneo la Dekapoli.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarua agwo ase ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.

English: Then King David said, “Call in for me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” So they came before the king.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akasema, “Mwite kuhani Sadoki ndani, nabii Nathani na Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada.” Walipofika mbele ya mfalme,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agateeba: “Indangererie Zadoki Omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada.” Erio abanto abwo bagacha ase obosio bw’omorwoti.

English: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
Kiswahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi yanayopeperushwa na upepo; niliwamwaga nje kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.

English: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—
Kiswahili: nanyi ikiwa hamtayasikiliza maneno ya watumishi wangu manabii, ambao nimewatuma kwenu tena na tena (ijapokuwa hamkuwasikiliza),
Ekegusii: na mwangire koigwera amang'ana 'abasomba baane ababani, abwo nabeete nkobatomera korende inwe timobaigwereti,

English: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Yahweh had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, wakiongozwa na Yehoshafati, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakiwa na furaha kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa amewasababisha wafurahi juu ya adui zao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakairana, kera oyomo bw'Abayuda na obw'abaanto ba Yerusalemu, na Yehosafati akabatang'ana. Bakairana Yerusalemu bare nomochengo, ekiagera Omonene abaete obobui igoro ase ababisa babo.

English: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa mkono wenye nguvu ulionyooshwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabarusia aroro n’okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said, “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo mfalme wa Yeriko akatuma huu ujumbe kwa Rahabu: “Watoe wale watu waliokujia na kuingia nyumbani mwako, kwa sababu wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yote.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omorwoti o Yeriko agatoma abanto ase Rahabu komoteebia, “Abanto abwo basoire mwao, nigo bachire koroota ense engima. Ase igo, basokie gocha ase tore.”

English: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Heri mtu yule ambaye Mungu humrudi; kwa hiyo usidharau adhabu yake Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaaya ogoaka, gw'okorongeyia kw'oyore Omonguru.

English: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
Kiswahili: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume katika Israeli, awe wa mwanadamu au mnyama, ni wangu. Wakati nilipowaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza huko Misri, niliwatenga kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Abana abatangi bonsi b'Abaisraeli n'abaane, ne ching'iti chintangi boigo. Rituko riria naitete abana abatangi bonsi amo ne ching'iti chintangi ase ense ya Misiri, nigo neatananerete abana abatangi b'Abaisraeli amo ne ching'iti chintangi.

English: He oppresses the poor and needy; he commits robbery and does not restore a pledge. He lifts his eyes to idols; he commits abominations.
Kiswahili: Huwaonea maskini na wahitaji. Hunyangʼanyana. Harudishi kile kilichowekwa rehani kwake. Huziinulia sanamu macho. Hufanya mambo ya machukizo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agokorera abataka na abaremerwa bobe, na kourereria abanto ebinto biabo, gose tari koirania egento aetwe koba intenenera, ere nigo akorigereria emegwekano egosasiimwa na gokora ay’okogechia.

English: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Muumba wako ndiye mume wako, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ni Mkombozi wako, yeye anaitwa Mungu wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Omotongi oo nere omosacha oo, Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere Omobooria oo; nigo akorokwa Nyasae bw’ense engima.”

English: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume asiyetahiriwa, ambaye hajapata tohara ya mwilini, atatengwa na watu wake, amelivunja Agano langu.”
Ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri'ekiimo kiaye ki'obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”

English: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan
Kiswahili: Eliaba, Mshaalboni; wana wa Yasheni; Yonathani
Ekegusii: Eliaba korwa Saalaboni, na basinto ba Yaseni, na Yonathani;

English: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says Yahweh, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”'?”
Kiswahili: Atamchukua Sedekia hadi Babeli, mahali atakapoishi mpaka nitakapomshughulikia, asema Bwana. Kama utapigana dhidi ya Wakaldayo, hutashinda.' ”
Ekegusii: Oyio naire Zedekia Babiloni, nere agenderere komenya aroro goika inche Omonene imochiere. Namoisa korwania Abakalidayo timokobabua. Nab'Omonene atebiire.”

English: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying: “Why are you prophesying like this? You claim that the LORD says, ‘Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
Kiswahili: Basi Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda alikuwa amemfunga huko akisema, “Kwa nini unatabiri hivyo? Wewe unasema, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Ninakaribia kuutia mji huu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauteka.
Ekegusii: Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, konya omosibire, ogoteeba, “Nase ki okobana kogoteeba ng’a aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nkobeeka nde omochie oyo ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, ayoire.

English: Take the ark of the LORD, set it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending Him as a guilt offering. Then send the ark on its way,
Kiswahili: Chukueni hilo Sanduku la Bwana na mliweke juu ya gari la kukokotwa, na ndani ya kasha kando yake wekeni hivyo vitu vya dhahabu mnavyompelekea Bwana kama sadaka ya hatia. Lipelekeni,
Ekegusii: Moimokie Esanduki eye y’Omonene ase egari igoro, na emegwekano eria y’etaabu, mokebeeke ase esanduki eng’ao ebeere ensemo y’Esanduki eria y’Omonene. Emegwekano eyio moyeirere Omonene, erio ebe okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha okwo. Magega y’ayio motige Esanduki egende aase aye.

English: The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” For the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wavutao pinde walionusurika, mashujaa wa Kedari, watakuwa wachache.” Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, amesema.
Ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’Abakedari, abamanyete koruta chinsara, nigo baratigare abake mono. Inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nateebire amang’ana ayio.”

English: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia watu, “Waandaeni baadhi ya wanaume wenu waende vitani kupigana na Wamidiani ili wawalipize kisasi cha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Babeeke ang’e abanto bare ase egati yaino, mobae ebirwanero bagende korwania Abamidiani, erinde bamoruserie Omonene egesiomba.

English: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
Kiswahili: na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha akawatokea wale kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: naende akaorokera Kefa; naende na baria ikomi na babere.

English: When David had gone a little beyond the summit, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth was there to meet him. He had a pair of saddled donkeys loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits, and a skin of wine.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipokuwa amekwenda umbali mfupi kupita kilele cha mlima, akamkuta huko Siba, msimamizi wa shughuli za Mefiboshethi, akingojea kumlaki Daudi. Alikuwa na punda wawili wakiwa wametandikwa na kupakiwa mikate mia mbili, maandazi mia ya zabibu kavu, maandazi mia ya tini na kiriba cha divai.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi ageendire ake goetania egetunwa igoro, akaumerana na Siba, omosomba o Mefiboseti, ore ne chitigere ibere chibogoretie emagaati amagana abere, na amabomba y’amasabibu amomo rigana erimo, na amabomba y’amako rigana erimo, amo nekerandi ekemo keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, kere nedivai.

English: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
Kiswahili: Huyu alimjia Yesu usiku akamwambia, “Rabi, tunajua kuwa wewe ni mwalimu uliyetumwa na Mungu, kwa maana hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya miujiza hii uifanyayo wewe, kama Mungu hayuko pamoja naye.”
Ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamoteebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”

English: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
Kiswahili: Wakajibu kwa mara nyingine, “Mfalme na awaambie watumishi wake ndoto yake, nasi tutaifasiri.”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria omorwoti eria kabere, “Aye omorwoti, toteebie intwe abasomba bao chindoto chiria, na intwe ntogoteebie engencho yaye.”

English: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Tarumbeta zote mbili zikipigwa, jumuiya yote itakusanyika mbele yako katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Ekero chitarumbeta chionsi ibere chirabugigwe, abanto bonsi ’nabache na gosangererekana agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
Kiswahili: Nchi kando ya bahari, mahali ambapo wanaishi Wakerethi, patakuwa mahali pa wachungaji na mazizi ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ense eyio ere mbarabare y'enyancha nebe amarisio aase abarisia barabe namakuruma abo na ameri 'amaicho abo.

English: Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja ambaye aliishi huko akajibu, “Je, naye baba yao ni nani?” Basi ikawa mithali, kusema, “Je, Sauli pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”
Ekegusii: Omonto omenyete aase aria akabooria: “Ise nere ng’o?” Ase engencho eyio amang’ana akaba agokwanwa iga: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”

English: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote likakubaliana kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu ilionekana vyema kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Omosangererekano oria bwonsi bw'abaanto ogancha gokora amang'ana ayio, ekiagera nigo abeete amaronge ase abanto bonsi.

English: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?
Kiswahili: wakati maji yawapo magumu kama jiwe, wakati uso wa vilindi vya maji unapoganda?
Ekegusii: Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.

English: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa huko kwa muda, akaondoka na kwenda sehemu moja hadi nyingine huko Galatia na Frigia, akiwaimarisha wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Magega kamenyire amatuko atai make akaimoka, agaeta egati y'ense ya Galatia na Furugia, agasoa omochie ase omochie, na gokong'ia aborokigwa bonsi.

English: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
Kiswahili: Nikachukia kila kitu nilichokuwa nimetaabikia chini ya jua, kwa sababu ni lazima nimwachie yule ajaye baada yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkagecha emeremo yonsi, eyio nabeete ngwechandera inse y'erioba, ekiagera goika ntigere omonto orambwatie ebinto ebio nakorire.

English: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn't worthy of me.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote ampendaye baba yake au mama yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu. Yeyote ampendaye mwanawe au binti yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu.
Ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete ise gose ng'ina kombua, oyio tangwenereti, na oyo bwanchete omwana oye omomura gose omoiseke kombua, oyio tangwenereti.

English: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mti mwema huzaa matunda mazuri, na mti mbaya huzaa matunda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Naboigo kera omote omuya nigo okwama amatunda amaya, na omote omobe nigo okwama amatunda amabe.

English: Moreover, Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
Kiswahili: Akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa katika Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, na kuwatoa wanawe kafara kwa kuwateketeza kwa moto, akifuata njia za machukizo za yale mataifa Bwana aliyoyafukuza humo mbele ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Agasamba ubani agwo ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu. Naende agasamba abana baye bakaba ekeng’wanso, koreng’ana nogokora gw’okogechia okwo abanto banarete gokora, bari’Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli.

English: and Moab was terrified of the people because they were numerous. Indeed, Moab dreaded the Israelites.
Kiswahili: Moabu aliogopa, kwa kuwa walikuwepo watu wengi sana. Hakika, Moabu alijawa na hofu kubwa kwa sababu ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Abamoabu bakoboa abanto abwo mono, ekiagera nigo barenge abange; ee Abamoabu bakabegosera Abaisraeli.

English: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Ashuru akaishambulia nchi yote, akapigana dhidi ya Samaria na kuizunguka kwa majeshi miaka mitatu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw'Abaasuri akagenda ase ense eria, akaboera Samaria ase engaki y'emiaka etato.

English: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of deceit and pull sin along with cart ropes,
Kiswahili: Ole wao wanaovuta dhambi kwa kamba za udanganyifu na uovu kama kwa kamba za mkokoteni,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakweng’usera obobe ne chingori chi’obong’ainereria, abwo bakweng’usera ebibe buna ne chingori chie chigari,

English: He won't break a bruised reed. He won't quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
Kiswahili: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima, mpaka atakapoifanya haki ishinde.
Ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw'etaya rokoimoka erioki, takororimia, goika arete oboronge ase okobua;

English: Grace be with all of you.
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

English: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
Kiswahili: Utakomboa mzaliwa wa kwanza wa punda kwa mwana-kondoo, lakini kama humkomboi, utavunja shingo yake. Utakomboa wazaliwa wako wa kwanza wote wa kiume. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele zangu mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Korende emori entangi y'etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua eng'ondi ebe ekeng'wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria, goika oyebune ebigoti. Abana bao abaisia abatangi goika obaboorie. Onde tari orabe ogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, namaboko amasa.

English: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
Kiswahili: Walimwaga damu isiyo na hatia, damu za wana wao na binti zao, ambao waliwatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani, nayo nchi ikanajisika kwa damu zao.
Ekegusii: Bagaitera amanyinga ya bana babo, abamura na abaiseke, abatari na komocha, abwo baruete bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano bagasasiima ase ense ya Kaanani; na ense eria ekaba eyetachenegeti ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ayio.

English: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
Kiswahili: Basi nilipofika Troa kuhubiri Injili ya Kristo na kukuta kwamba Bwana alikuwa amenifungulia mlango,
Ekegusii: Gaki ekero naigete Teroa ase engencho y'okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, nkaigorerwa egesieri n'Omonene,

English: She made herself a tent upon the roof of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins. The garments of her widowhood were upon her.
Kiswahili: Alijitengenezea hema juu ya paa la nyumba yake, na kuvaa gunia viunoni mwake. Mavazi ya ujane wake yalikuwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ya amagombo akeboyia eyanga ye chigunia neyoboboraka ase ekenama kiaye. Akariosia egetwori kiaye sang'ina na akaba oraire aroro Abag 3:20; 2 Abar 4:10

English: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: kwa maana Waisraeli ni mali yangu kama watumishi. Wao ni watumishi wangu, niliowatoa kutoka nchi ya Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nabasomba baane, ee, barabwo nabasomba baane aba narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapata na kubatiza wanafunzi wengi zaidi kuliko Yohana,
Ekegusii: Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng’a Abafarisai baigure ng’a Yeso okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, na kobatisa,

English: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard. Those things are not for you. Instead, you must live in tents all your lives, so that you may live a long time in the land where you wander.’
Kiswahili: Pia msijenge nyumba kamwe, wala kuotesha mbegu au kupanda mashamba ya mizabibu. Kamwe msiwe na kitu chochote katika hivi, lakini siku zote lazima muishi kwenye mahema. Ndipo mtakapoishi kwa muda mrefu katika nchi ambayo ninyi ni wahamiaji.’
Ekegusii: Boigo naende agatokania, agatoteebia ng’a titobaisa koagacha chinyomba gose kobusura chimbusuro, gose gosimeka, gose gotwara emegondo y’emesabibu, korende ng’a tomenye ase chiema ase amatuko aito onsi, erio nario toragenderere koba moyo ase ense eye intwe tore abamenyi.

English: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
Kiswahili: Wakajinajisi wenyewe kwa yale waliyotenda; kwa matendo yao wenyewe wakajifanyia ukahaba.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaaba abegenwa.

English: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Kaini, Gibea na Timna; miji kumi pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Kaini, na Gibea, na Timuna, emechie ikomi, amo nebichie biabo.

English: While they were yet talking with him, the king's eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa bado wakizungumza naye, matowashi wa mfalme wakaja na kumharakisha Hamani aende katika karamu aliyoiandaa Esta.
Ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete gokwana nere, abakoreri b'enyomba y'omorwoti bagacha kwoyia Hamani bakamoira bwango ase endagera eria Esiteri aroisetie.

English: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
Kiswahili: Vipofu na vilema wakamwendea kule Hekaluni, naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Emeuko na amagata bakamochiera aria ase Hekalu, na ere akabagwenia.

English: who carried off everything to Babylon—all the articles of the house of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king and his officials.
Kiswahili: Akavichukua kwenda Babeli vyombo vyote kutoka Hekalu la Mungu, vikubwa na vidogo, hazina za Hekalu la Bwana pamoja na hazina za mfalme na za maafisa wake.
Ekegusii: Ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, ebinene na ebike, ne chinibo chionsi chiarenge ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba y’omorwoti, na ase echi’abagaambi barenge amo nere, ebinto ebio bionsi akabiira Babiloni.

English: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
Kiswahili: Yeye alindaye kinywa chake na ulimi wake hujilinda na maafa.
Ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rw’aye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.

English: A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
Kiswahili: Sauti husema, “Piga kelele.” Nami nikasema, “Nipige kelele gani?” “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao wote ni kama maua ya kondeni.
Ekegusii: Eriogi rigoteeba, “Raria amang’ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang’ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng’a Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.
