Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya naro akoregete ase amatuko 'Ahaswero, oyio ogamberete chingongo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na isano na ibere (127), gochaakera India goikera Ethiopia.

English: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu mnavyosikia. Kwa maana yeyote aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile anachodhani anacho atanyangʼanywa.”
Ekegusii: Mwerende gaki inwe buna mokoigwa, ekiagera ere oyobwate naegwe, korende oyotabwati, naurwe nonya nkeria arengereretie abwate.”

English: So they decided that day, saying, “Whoever comes against us to battle on the Sabbath day, let's fight against him, and we will in no way all die, as our kindred died in the secret places.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaamua siku hiyo, wakisema, “Yeyote atakayekuja kupigana nasi siku ya Sabato, na tupigane naye, nasi hatutakufa sote, kama vile jamaa zetu walivyokufa mahali pa siri.”
Ekegusii: Gochaakera rituko erio bagaetia ase obomo buna goika berwanerere eisa koba buna onde bwensi obagwereire ase rituko ri'Esabato egere tibacha goitwa bonsi buna abamwabo baitetwe agwo ase bebisete.

English: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much,
Kiswahili: kama nimefurahia wingi wa utajiri wangu, ustawi ambao mikono yangu ilikuwa imepata,
Ekegusii: tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.

English: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden'?”
Kiswahili: Basi nyoka alikuwa mwerevu kuliko wanyama wote wa porini ambao Bwana Mungu aliwafanya. Nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Ati kweli Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile matunda ya mti wowote wa bustanini'?”
Ekegusii: Bono eng'iti engenda inse nigo yarenge eng'aini kobua ching'iti chinde chionsi, echi Omonene Nyasae akorete. Engiti ekaboria omokungu: “Inee! Namaene ng'a Nyasae nigo abakanetie ng'a timoria amatunda 'omote onde bwonsi ore mogondo?”

English: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
Kiswahili: Au waudharau wingi wa wema, ustahimili na uvumilivu wake, bila kujua kuwa wema wa Mungu wakuelekeza kwenye toba?
Ekegusii: Gose ngwachaayire obonge bw’obuya bwaye, na oboremereria bwaye, na okoganya kwaye, na tomanyeti ng’a obuya bwa Nyasae nigo borigetie gokoraa gochia ase okoonchoka?

English: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
Kiswahili: bali kwa matendo mazuri kama iwapasavyo wanawake wanaokiri kuwa wanamcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende bakore ogokora okuya, buna egwenerete abakungu abakoorokia ng'a mbare ne chingeencho chi'obonyasae.

English: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
Kiswahili: Ezri mwana wa Kelubu alikuwa msimamizi wa wafanyakazi waliolima katika mashamba.
Ekegusii: Esiri, mosinto o Kelubi, agatenenera abakori emeremo b’emegondo, abarenge koyerema.

English: Esther said to the king, “Let it be granted to the Jews to do the same to them tomorrow. Also, hang the bodies of the ten sons of Haman.”
Kiswahili: Esta akamwambia mfalme, “Wayahudi na waruhusiwe kuwafanyia vivyo hivyo kesho. Pia, watundike miili ya wana kumi wa Hamani.”
Ekegusii: na omorwoti agateebia Esiteri enting'ana: “Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, Abayahudi baitire abanto amagana atano, baabasiririe, boigo baitire abamura ikomi ba Hamani. Onye ere igo, Inee, ngento ki bakorire ase chinsemo chinde ase chingongo chi'oborwoti bwane? Bono ninki naende oganetie? Nokeegwe. Nteebia ngento ki naende otarakorerwa. Nakerokio nokorerwe.”

English: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
Kiswahili: Nami kama natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, watu wenu je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.
Ekegusii: Na inche, onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng'o bakobiseeria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo inababe abagaambi baino.

English: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hana binti, wape ndugu zake wa kiume urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati nonya nomwana omoiseke, omwando oye abamura bamwabo bayoire.

English: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Nimetumwa tu kwa ajili ya kondoo wa Israeli waliopotea.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”

English: By the seventh month, the Israelites had settled in their towns, and the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa saba ulipowadia baada ya Waisraeli kukaa katika miji yao, watu wote walikusanyika huko Yerusalemu kama mtu mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, na Abaisraeli bamenyete ase emechie yabo, bonsi bagasangererekana ase obomo agwo Yerusalemu.

English: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
Kiswahili: Lakini jeshi la Wakaldayo likawafuatia na kumpata Sedekia katika sehemu tambarare za Yeriko. Wakamkamata na kumpeleka kwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi, mahali ambapo alimtangazia hukumu.
Ekegusii: Korende abasikari b'Abakalidayo bakababwatia. Bagaikera Zedekia agwo ase ense eraire ya Yeriko. Ekero bamobwatete, bakamoira ase Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na Nebukadinesaro akamonachera ekiina.

English: They are like one of the beams of the temple. Men say their hearts are eaten out when things creeping out of the earth devour both them and their clothing. They don't feel it
Kiswahili: Wao ni kama moja ya mihimili ya hekalu. Watu husema mioyo yao huliwa wakati vitu vinavyotambaa kutoka ardhini vinawala wao na nguo zao. Hawahisi hivyo
Ekegusii: Amasio abo abaire amamwamu kobwatekana n'erioki rikorwa ase hekalu.

English: At the doors of the houses and in the streets they burned incense.
Kiswahili: Katika milango ya nyumba na barabarani walifukiza uvumba.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaba bagoutera ubani ase kera enchera ne egesieri kienyomba.

English: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,
Kiswahili: Kisha akapima urefu wa jengo linaloelekeana na ua upande wa nyuma wa Hekalu, pamoja na vyumba vyake kila upande, ilikuwa dhiraa mia moja. Sehemu takatifu ya nje, sehemu takatifu ya ndani, pamoja na baraza inayoelekeana na ukumbi,
Ekegusii: Akarenga obotambe bw'enyomba yaagachire gochia bosongo magega amo nebisona biaye biarochie ase chinsemo ibere, bokaba nekerengo ki'amaboko rigana erimo. Boigo akarengia Aase Aachenu Mono, ne chinyomba chinde chiare ime y'eraaro.

English: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000. The Redemption of the Firstborn
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya Walawi waliohesabiwa na Mose na Aroni kwa amri ya Bwana, kufuatana na koo, pamoja na kila mume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walikuwa 22,000.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha b’Abalawi, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, abwo Musa na Aroni bariigete, eamate ase eamate, buna Omonene abachiigete, nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000). Abalawi Bakobekwa Ribaga Ri’abamura Abatangi B’Abaisraeli

English: For this thing is from Israel— a craftsman made it, and it is not God. It will be broken to pieces, that calf of Samaria.
Kiswahili: Zimetoka katika Israeli! Ndama huyu: ametengenezwa na fundi, si Mungu. Atavunjwa vipande vipande, yule ndama wa Samaria.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio nigo oruete ase Abaisraeli. Nigo oroisetigwe nomooroisia bw’ebinto, oyio tari oro Nyasae. Omogwekano oria bw’emori ore Samaria nosenyentwe obe ebisamunye.

English: Happy is he who has found prudence, and he who speaks in the ears of those who listen.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule aliye na busara, na yeye asemaye masikioni mwa wale wanaosikiliza.
Ekegusii: omonto ore negesio giokonyoora omosani omwegenwa, boigo omonto oria abanto bakogooka komotegerera.

English: And all these officials of yours will come and bow before me, saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that, I will depart.” And hot with anger, Moses left Pharaoh’s presence.
Kiswahili: Maafisa hawa wako wote watanijia, wakisujudu mbele yangu, wakisema, ‘Ondoka, wewe pamoja na watu wako wote wanaokufuata!’ Baada ya haya nitaondoka.” Kisha Mose, huku akiwa amewaka hasira, akamwacha Farao.
Ekegusii: Na abasomba aba bao bonsi nabatirimboke gocha ase ’nde na batung’ameo, bakobora: Genda, karue aa, aye na abanto bao bonsi bakobwatie. Magega y’ayio nindue aa!” Erio agwo Musa akarua o Farao ore nekeririanda ekenene.

English: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Baba, wasamehe, kwa maana hawajui walitendalo!” Wakagawana nguo zake kwa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tata, baabere, ekiagera tibamanyeti eke bagokora.” Bakagabana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera.

English: Go at once to King David and say, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to your maidservant, “Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne”? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
Kiswahili: Ingia kwa Mfalme Daudi na umwambie, ‘Bwana wangu mfalme, je hukuniapia mimi mtumishi wako: “Hakika mwanao Solomoni atakuwa mfalme baada yangu na ndiye atakayeketi juu ya kiti changu cha ufalme”? Kwa nini basi Adoniya amekuwa mfalme?’
Ekegusii: Bono genda, osoe ara rimo ase omorwoti Daudi, omoboorie: Inee! Aye omonene one omorwoti, tikwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana, ogateeba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragaambe magega yane; ere naikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oborwoti? Nase ki rende Adonia abeire omorwoti?

English: Through him, then, let's offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa njia ya Yesu, tuzidi kumtolea Mungu dhabihu ya sifa, yaani matunda ya midomo inayolikiri Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng'wanso gi'okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw'emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.

English: “I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
Kiswahili: “Kwa muda mrefu nimenyamaza kimya, nimekaa kimya na kujizuia. Lakini sasa, kama mwanamke wakati wa kujifungua, ninapiga kelele, ninatweta na kushusha pumzi.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkirete‐kiri ase engaki entambe, nabeire ngendererete gwetanga na gokira; korende bono ning’ake eriogi buna eri’omokuungu okobina aibore; ning’use omoika na goita egekoe.

English: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
Kiswahili: Waimbaji Hemani, Asafu na Ethani walichaguliwa kupiga matoazi ya shaba;
Ekegusii: Abateri baria Hemani na Asafu, na Etani babe bakobugia chisani chi'etai chikobugigwa na kwoga.

English: At that time Solomon assembled in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
Kiswahili: Kisha Solomoni akawaita huko Yerusalemu wazee wa Israeli, viongozi wote wa makabila na wakuu wa jamaa za Waisraeli, ili walilete Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani bonsi b’ebisaku biabo, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende korenta Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, korwa ase Omochie o Daudi, noro Sayoni.

English: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
Kiswahili: Kila kuhani mkuu huwekwa ili atoe sadaka na dhabihu. Vivyo hivyo, ilikuwa jambo muhimu kwa huyu Kuhani naye awe na kitu cha kutoa.
Ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani omonene nigo are kobekwa ase okorua ebiegwa na ebing’wanso. Ase ayio yamogwenerete Omokuani oyo boigo abe negento akorua.

English: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
Kiswahili: nanyi kama mkimkunjulia mtu mwenye njaa nafsi zenu na kutosheleza mahitaji ya walioonewa, ndipo nuru yenu itakapongʼaa gizani, nao usiku wenu utakuwa kama adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: korakonye abare nenchara na oe oyochandegete eki'aremeire, rirorio omobaso oo nobare ase omosunte, na obotuko bwao mbobe buna mobaso gati.

English: the LORD had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.” And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.
Kiswahili: wakati ule Bwana alisema kwa kinywa cha Isaya mwana wa Amozi. Akamwambia, “Vua nguo ya gunia kutoka mwilini mwako na viatu kutoka miguuni mwako.” Naye akafanya hivyo, akatembea huku na huko uchi, bila viatu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, akamoteebia: “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.

English: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Kiswahili: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,
Ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.

English: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Toeni pamoja na hiyo mikate wana-kondoo saba, kila mmoja wa mwaka mmoja asiye na dosari, na fahali mchanga, na kondoo dume wawili. Watakuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amo nokoruegwa okwo morente ching’ondi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, na eeri ensae, ne chimingichi ibere, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyuugwa okwo gochiikire amo. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

English: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his Israelite brothers, whether he treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. So you must purge the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikamatwa akiiba yeyote miongoni mwa ndugu zake wa Waisraeli na kumtenda kama mtumwa au akimuuza, mwizi huyo ni lazima auawe. Nawe utaondoa uovu kutoka miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oibire Omoisraeli omwabo amokore buna omosomba, gose amoonie, omoibi oria goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe korwa ase more.

English: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana y’oborimo, na okorama.

English: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
Kiswahili: Simoni alipoona kuwa watu wanapokea Roho Mtakatifu mitume walipoweka mikono juu yao, akataka kuwapa fedha
Ekegusii: Ekero Simioni achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobeekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chitaabu,

English: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
Kiswahili: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.

English: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Ishmaeli, yaliyoorodheshwa kulingana na jinsi walivyozaliwa: Mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Ishmaeli ni Nebayothi, akafuatia Kedari, Adbeeli, Mibsamu,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana ba Isumaeli, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo: Nebayoti, nere omwana oye omotangi, na Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu,

English: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mwamba wao si kama Mwamba wetu, sawasawa na vile adui zetu wanavyokiri.
Ekegusii: Egetare kiabo tikeri buna Egetare giaito, nonya n’ababisa baito ’mbamanyete amang’ana ayio.

English: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akashuka ili auone mji na mnara ambao wanadamu waliokuwa wanaujenga.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agaika goocha inse, erinde arore omochie na omoorobiri oyio abana ba Mwanyabaanto konya baagachire.

English: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu ameruhusu watawaliwe na nguvu ya udanganyifu, ili waendelee kuamini uongo,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw'echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay'oborimo,

English: His brother's name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
Kiswahili: Kaka yake aliitwa Yubali, aliyekuwa baba wa wote wapigao zeze na filimbi.
Ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro y'abanto baria baare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.

English: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
Kiswahili: Huko Hekaluni aliwakuta watu wakiuza ngʼombe, kondoo na njiwa, nao wengine walikuwa wameketi mezani wakibadili fedha.
Ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.

English: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hakika umenichakaza; umewaangamiza kabisa watu wa nyumbani mwangu wote.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.

English: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi na Misiri, Putu na Kaanani.

English: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama, hapo mbele yangu palikuwa na wingu jeupe, na aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya hilo wingu alikuwa “kama Mwana wa Adamu” mwenye taji ya dhahabu kichwani mwake na mundu mkali mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkarora riire rirabu, na igoro ase riire riria naikaranseteo oyomo ogwekaine omwana o Mwanyabaanto, orenge negutwa y’etaabu ase omotwe oye, na omoyio okogesa ase okoboko kwaye.

English: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau mafundisho anajiletea maangamizi, bali yeye anayeheshimu agizo hupewa tuzo.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya Ring'ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng'eria y'obuya.

English: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao, mtaalamu wa sheria, akamuuliza swali ili kumjaribu, akisema,
Ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw'amachiiko, akamobooria ase okomoteema,

English: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu, naye akastawi, Yosefu akaishi nyumbani kwa bwana wake Mmisri.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, na ere akanyora ogosesenigwa. Yusufu akamenya ase enka y'omonene oye, oria Omomisiri.

English: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
Kiswahili: Mtaila kama kitu kilicho kitakatifu sana; kila mwanaume ataila. Ni lazima mtaiheshimu kama takatifu.
Ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore ase more nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio n’ebinto ebichenu ase ore.

English: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wawe machukizo kwa falme zote za dunia kwa sababu ya kile alichofanya Manase mwana wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ninkore amagambi onsi are ase ense aichanigwe na koondoka ase amang’ana arabanyore ase engencho y’obobe obwo Manase, mosinto bwa Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akorete agwo Yerusalemu.

English: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
Kiswahili: Wekeni tumaini lenu katika nuru hiyo ili mpate kuwa wana wa nuru.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu aliondoka, akajificha wasimwone.
Ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b'omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa ase bare.

English: Then the king's servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.
Kiswahili: Kisha watumishi waliomhudumia mfalme walipendekeza, “Na ufanyike utafiti kwa ajili ya wanawali mabikira wazuri wa sura kwa ajili ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio abasomba abarenge gokorera omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Tiga abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni barigigwe barentwe asore, aye omorwoti.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Gadi walikuwa watu 45,650.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n'amagana atano nomo, namerongo etano (45,650).

English: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa na mikia yenye miiba ya kuumia kama nge. Nguvu yao ya kutesa watu kwa huo muda wa miezi mitano ilikuwa katika hiyo mikia yao.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo chiarenge nebimincha bire nemeburera buna ebi’ebiuge, na okobua kwabo kw’ogochanda Mwanyabaanto ase emetienyi etano nigo kwarenge ase ebimincha biabo.

English: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.

English: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farmlands around each of their cities or in any other city, men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu makuhani, wazao wa Aroni walioishi kwenye mashamba yaliyozunguka miji yao au katika miji mingine yoyote, watu walitajwa majina ili kumgawia kila mwanaume miongoni mwao na kwa wote waliokuwa katika orodha ya vizazi vya Walawi.
Ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abakuani b’ororeria rwa Aroni, abamenyete ase amaremo aetanaine emechie yabo, ase kera omochie, abanto gete bagachorwa na korikwa amarieta abo. Barabwo bakaba bagwatanana ebiegwa biria ase kera omonto omosacha, ase egati y’abakuani, na ase kera Omolawi origetwe ase omooroberio.

English: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini basi hukumkemea Yeremia Mwanathothi, aliyejifanya kama nabii miongoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Bono naki rende otaratogonyera Yeremia oyio okorwa Anatoti ogendererete kobaabaanera inwe?

English: He who had thrown out a multitude unburied had none to mourn for him. He didn't have any funeral at all and no place in the tomb of his ancestors.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyewafukuza watu wengi ambao hawakuzikwa hakuwa na mtu wa kuomboleza kwa ajili yake. Hakuwa na mazishi yoyote kabisa na hakuwa na nafasi katika kaburi la mababu zake.
Ekegusii: Yasoni konya oitire abanto abange na gotiga emebere yabo etatindekiri, bono ere agakwa atari na monto onde okomorera; na tatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye.

English: I will observe your statutes. Don't utterly forsake me. BETH
Kiswahili: Nitayatii maagizo yako; usiniache kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiiko ao; tobaisa gontiga.

English: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa mmefufuliwa pamoja na Kristo, yatafuteni yaliyo juu, Kristo alikoketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mwabokigwe ase obogima amo na Kristo, ase igo beka chinkoro chiaino ase ebinto bire igoro, aase Kristo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: in her virginity, lest she should be defiled and be with child in her father's house; when she has a husband, lest she should transgress; and when she is married, lest she should be barren.
Kiswahili: katika ubikira wake, asije akatiwa unajisi na kupata mimba katika nyumba ya baba yake; akiwa na mume, asije akafanya dhambi; na akiwa ameolewa, asije akawa tasa.
Ekegusii: Ekero are omoiseke, ise nigo akwoboa buna nigo ere arasarigwe, gose nabaisa konyora oborito ekero ere are ase enyomba yaye; naende ekero asookire ise nigo akwoboa buna nigo arabaisa koba omogomba.

English: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father's household.
Kiswahili: isipokuwa, hapo tutakapoingia katika nchi hii, utakuwa umefunga hii kamba nyekundu dirishani pale ulipotuteremshia na kama utakuwa umewaleta baba yako na mama yako, ndugu zako na jamaa yako yote ndani ya nyumba yako.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio togokoboria okore: Ekero torasoe ase ense eye, osibe engori eye embariri ase ekebao eke gwatoikeria. Osangererie gocha nyomba mwao iso, na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amo nabaanto bonsi b'enyomba ya iso.

English: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
Kiswahili: Kundi kubwa zaidi lipe urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kundi dogo zaidi lipewe urithi mdogo zaidi; kila kundi litapokea urithi wake kulingana na hesabu ya wale walioorodheshwa.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng'ana nomobaro obo.

English: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
Kiswahili: Mwangwi wa kilio chao umefika hadi mpakani mwa Moabu, kilio chao cha huzuni kimefika hadi Eglaimu, maombolezo yao hadi Beer-Elimu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri'okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.

English: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
Kiswahili: Sungura ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

English: Who will listen to your proposal? The share of the one who went to battle will match the share of the one who stayed with the supplies. They will share alike.”
Kiswahili: Ni nani atasikiliza yale mnayosema? Fungu la mtu aliyekaa na vyombo litakuwa sawa na la yule aliyekwenda vitani. Wote watashiriki sawa.”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobaigwera ase amang’ana buna ayio? Yaya, buna abanto abwo bagendete korwana esegi bakoegwa ebisakorwa, naboigo nabwo batigarete magega korenda ebinto baraegwe. Nigo baragaberwe bareng’anie.”

English: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?
Kiswahili: Nimevua joho langu: je, ni lazima nivae tena? Nimenawa miguu yangu: je, ni lazima niichafue tena?
Ekegusii: Narusirie eanga, inee, inyebeeke naende? Nesibirie amagoro, inee, inyabeeke eubi naende?

English: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
Kiswahili: “Yuda atakuwa na sehemu moja, itapakana na nchi ya Reubeni kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yuda keegwe orogongo rw'aye robebekane norwa Rubeni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
Kiswahili: Huvisukasuka vilindi kama sufuria kubwa ichemkayo, na kukoroga bahari kama chungu cha marhamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amaache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amaache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.

English: Later, King Belshazzar held a great feast for a thousand of his nobles, and he drank wine with them.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Belshaza alifanya karamu kubwa kwa ajili ya maelfu ya wakuu wake na akanywa mvinyo pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Belisasari agakora omoyega omonene, akarangeria abanto abanene koreng’ana elifu eyemo b’oborwoti bwaye, akaba okonywa edivai amo n’abanto abwo elifu.

English: May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you all not be put to shame in praising him.
Kiswahili: Nafsi zenu zifurahi katika rehema zake, nanyi nyote msione haya katika kumsifu.
Ekegusii: Tiga emioyo yaino egokere amaabera a Nyasae, gose tari timwenyoorera obosooku, na mono ekero mokomotogia Omonene Nyasae.

English: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwasimamisha Petro na Yohana katikati yao, wakawauliza, “Ni kwa uwezo gani au kwa jina la nani mmefanya jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Bakababeka abatomwa batenene ase obosio bwabo, erio bakababoria “’ngaki mwanyara gokora aya? Ase kobua ki gose nase erieta riango mwarangeria?”

English: He added to them knowledge, and gave them a law of life for a heritage.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongezea maarifa, na akawapa sheria ya uzima kwa ajili ya urithi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akabaa bosio bwabo chisemi, na kobaa ebirage bi'obogima.

English: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y'omochie, bagakaga ng'a okuure,

English: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Makelothi na kupiga kambi huko Tahathi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Makeloti bakageenda bagaika Tahati, bagatoora aroro.

English: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msile mkate wowote, au nafaka iliyokaangwa au nafaka mpya, mpaka siku ile mtakayomletea Mungu wenu sadaka hii. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koria okwama okwo okoyia: Ebigara ebibese, gose ebikarangire, gose ebiaroisigwe emegati, ekero motaraarentera Nyasae oino okoruegwa kwaino kw'ogotongora. Ogochika okwo nigo koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
Kiswahili: “Akasema na pawepo mkataba kati yangu na wewe, kama ulivyokuwepo kati ya baba yangu na baba yako. Tazama, nimekuletea zawadi ya fedha na dhahabu. Sasa vunja mkataba wako na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli ili aniondokee mimi.”
Ekegusii: “Tiga okobwatana kw'ogotianania kobe ase egati yane naye, buna kwarenge ase egati ya tata na iso. Rora nagotomeire ekeegwa gie chifeta ne chitaabu. Genda osarie okobwatana okwo kwao gwakorete na Baasa, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, erinde arue ase ense yane antigane.”

English: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa nimetaabika, nimeadhibiwa kila asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

English: Later, as Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces besieged Lachish, he sent his servants to Jerusalem with a message for King Hezekiah of Judah and all the people of Judah who were in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Hatimaye Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru na majeshi yake yote walipokuwa wameuzunguka Lakishi, akawatuma maafisa wake kwenda Yerusalemu wakiwa na ujumbe huu kwa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, na kwa watu wote wa Yuda waliokuwako humo, kusema:
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio, Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, oria onaaretie Lakisi amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, agatoma abasomba baye Yerusalemu ase Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na ase Abayuda bonsi abwo barenge Yerusalemu, agateeba,

English: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah. David Serves Saul
Kiswahili: Basi Samweli akachukua ile pembe ya mafuta na kumtia mafuta mbele ya ndugu zake, kuanzia siku ile na kuendelea Roho wa Bwana akaja juu ya Daudi kwa nguvu. Kisha Samweli akaenda zake Rama. Daudi Katika Utumishi Kwa Sauli
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Samweli akaimokia orogunchara rore namaguta, na agwo ase amasio y’abamura bamwabo agaaka Daudi amaguta. Omoika bw’Omonene ogaacha igoro ase Daudi, na korwa rituko riria okabeera asare kogenderera. Erio Samweli akarua agwo, akairana Rama. Daudi ase enyomba ya Saulo

English: Amaziah asked the man of God, “What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the army of Israel?” And the man of God replied, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
Kiswahili: Amazia akamuuliza yule mtu wa Mungu, “Lakini itakuwaje kwa zile talanta 100 za fedha nilizolipa kwa ajili ya haya majeshi ya Israeli?” Yule mtu wa Mungu akajibu, “ Bwana aweza kukupa zaidi sana ya hizo.”
Ekegusii: Amasia akaboria omonto oria o Nyasae, “Ngento ki togokora ase chitalanta chiria rigana erimo naakanire abasikari b’Abaisraeli?” Omonto oria o Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Omonene nabwate okobua gokoa chinyinge mono goetania echio.”

English: And Baasha did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
Kiswahili: Akatenda maovu machoni pa Bwana, akienenda katika njia za Yeroboamu na dhambi yake, ambayo alikuwa amesababisha Israeli kuitenda.
Ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.

English: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya jambo hili, Wamoabu na Waamoni, pamoja na baadhi ya Wameuni wakaja ili wapigane vita na Yehoshafati.
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y'ayio, Abamoabu na Abaamoni, na abanto bande bamenyete amo n'Abaamoni bagacha korwania Yehosafati esegi.

English: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatumo miongoni mwa hao wanaositasita na kuangamia, bali tuko miongoni mwa hao wenye imani na hivyo tunaokolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.

English: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
Kiswahili: Wawili ni afadhali kuliko mmoja, kwa sababu wana malipo mazuri kwa kazi yao:
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.

English: Then Yahweh's angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akamwamuru Gadi amwambie Daudi apande na kumjengea Bwana madhabahu kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw'Omonene agachiika Gadi ateebie Daudi ng'a agende atenenie egesasiimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki'Orinani, Omoyebusi.

English: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
Kiswahili: ili tuweze kuhubiri Injili sehemu zilizo mbali na maeneo yenu. Kwa maana hatutaki kujisifu kwa ajili ya kazi ambayo imekwisha kufanyika tayari katika eneo la mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio tonyare korandia enchiri ase chinse chire ng’umbu yaino, titwetogia ase emeremo yakorirwe ase ensemo y’omonto onde.

English: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Ethani Mwezrahi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw'Etani Omoezara) Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day, but have kept the charge given you by the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu sasa, hadi siku hii ya leo, hamkuwaacha ndugu zenu, bali ninyi mmetimiza ile kazi Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika reero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.

English: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
Kiswahili: "Lakini enenda zako hata mwisho; maana utapumzika na kusimama katika urithi wako mwisho wa siku."
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Danieli, genda goika engaki eyio y'omoerio eike, ekero orabe gotimogete, noche koboka onyore egetari kiao ase engaki y'omoerio bw'amatuko ayio.”

English: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
Kiswahili: Uniponye na watu watendao mabaya, uniokoe kutokana na wamwagao damu.
Ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.

English: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Manase; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 52,700.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi'egesaku kia Manase. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano abere (52,700).

English: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akamwambia Kora, “Enyi Walawi! Sasa nisikilizeni.
Ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateeba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!

English: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Watu wote hutoa kwanza divai nzuri, kisha huleta ile divai hafifu wageni wakisha kunywa vya kutosha, lakini wewe umeiweka ile nzuri kupita zote mpaka sasa.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyuure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”

English: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Alipigana vita dhidi ya Wafilisti na kubomoa kuta za Gathi, Yabne na Ashdodi. Kisha akajenga upya miji karibu na Ashdodi na mahali pengine katikati ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Usia akagenda akarwania Abafirisiti esegi; agatagora orwaki rwa Gati, na orwa Yabune, na orw'Asidodi. Akaagacha naende emechie ase orogongo rw'Asidodi na aande onsi ase egati y'Abafilisti.

English: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.'
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nimeuchagua Yerusalemu ili Jina langu lipate kuwamo humo, na nimemchagua Daudi kuwatawala watu wangu Israeli.'
Ekegusii: korende bono nachorire Yerusalemu, erinde erieta riane ribeere aroro, naende nachorire Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.

English: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi Abramu akaondoa mahema yake, akaenda kuishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre huko Hebroni, huko akamjengea Bwana madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang'anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya ebitutu bw'emete ekorokwa emialoni agwo Mamure, ang'e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro.

English: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, mjalie mfalme aamue kwa haki yako, mwana wa mfalme kwa haki yako.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, kae omorwoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omorwoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.

English: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
Kiswahili: Mikononi mwao watakuinua, ili usijikwae mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakamlilia tena Bwana, naye akawapa mwokozi: Ehudi, mtu wa shoto, mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini. Waisraeli wakatuma kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu ushuru kwa mkono wa Ehudi.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng'a ababoorie, nere akabaa omonto okobabooria. Omonto oria nere Ehudi, mosinto o Gera, bw'egesaku gia Benjamini. Ehudi nigo arenge omonyakebee. Abaisraeli bagatoma Ehudi koirera Egiloni, omorwoti bw'ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa bi'amasikani.

English: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanashangaa juu ya jambo hili, ghafula watu wawili waliokuwa wamevaa mavazi yanayongʼaa kama umeme wakasimama karibu nao.
Ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e ase bare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.

English: be careful not to be ensnared by their ways after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, asking, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
Kiswahili: na baada ya kuangamizwa mbele yenu, mwe waangalifu msijiingize katika tanzi kwa kuuliza habari za miungu yao, mkisema, “Je, mataifa haya hutumikiaje miungu yao? Nasi tutafanya vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: mwerende timobaisa gotegwa n’emeeto na kobwatia chingeencho chiabo banarete gokora. Timorigia komanya igoro ye’chinyasae chiabo na koboria: Naki ebisaku ebi biarenge gosasiima chinyasae chiabo? Naboigo naintwe tochisasiime.

English: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza Akishi, “Lakini mimi nimefanya nini? Je, umeona nini kibaya juu ya mtumishi wako tangu siku ile niliyokuja kwako hadi leo? Kwa nini nisirudi na kupigana na adui za bwana wangu mfalme?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akabooria Akisi: “Ngento ki nakorire? Korwa ekero inche, omosomba oo, nachete aa kogokorera, goika rituko ria reero, mbobe ki kwarorire ase 'nde bokogera tingenda korwania ababisa bao, aye omorwoti, omonene one?”

English: Fear the Lord with all your soul; and revere his priests.
Kiswahili: Mche Bwana kwa roho yako yote; na waheshimu makuhani wake.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Nyasae Omobui n'omoyo oo bwonsi; na kae abakuani bao amasikani.

English: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
Kiswahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wafungwa kifike mbele zako; kwa nguvu za mkono wako hifadhi wale waliohukumiwa kufa.
Ekegusii: Tiga ekerero ki'abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekiina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.

English: Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake toka miisho ya dunia, ninyi mshukao chini baharini, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, enyi visiwa na wote wakaao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo n’ebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!

English: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
Kiswahili: Amri hizi ninazokupa leo zitakuwa katika moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya 'nkobachiika rituko ria reero timobaisa koyeeba nonya ng'ake.

English: You are my brothers, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to restore the king?’
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni ndugu zangu, nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe. Kwa hiyo kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme?’
Ekegusii: Inwe n’abanto baminto b’amanyinga ane ne chinyama chiane. Inaki rende morigetie koba ab’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omorwoti inka?

English: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
Kiswahili: Je, mfinyanzi hana haki ya kufinyanga kutoka bonge moja vyombo vya udongo, vingine kwa matumizi ya heshima na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida?
Ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari n’okobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?

English: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
Kiswahili: Ahazia akaenda vitani na Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu kupigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu huko Ramoth-Gileadi. Waaramu wakamjeruhi Yoramu.
Ekegusii: Ahasia akagenda amo na Yoramu, mosinto bw'Ahabu, korwania Hasaeli, omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, agwo Ramoti o Gileadi. Abasiiria bagaaka Yoramu chingoma.

English: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
Kiswahili: Kwenye chumba cha ghorofani walimokuwa wamekutania kulikuwa na taa nyingi.
Ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.

English: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,

English: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume asiyetahiriwa, ambaye hajapata tohara ya mwilini, atatengwa na watu wake, amelivunja Agano langu.”
Ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”

English: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Hashumu: Matenai, Matata, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremai, Manase na Shimei.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Hasumu; Matenai na Matata, Sabadi na Elifeleti, Yeremia na Manase, na Simei;

English: They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus. Preparing the Passover (Matthew 26:17–19; Luke 22:7–13)
Kiswahili: Walifurahi sana kusikia jambo hili na wakaahidi kumpa fedha. Hivyo yeye akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti. Yesu Ala Pasaka Na Wanafunzi Wake (Mathayo 26:17-25; Luka 22:7-14, 21-23; Yohana 13:21-30)
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chitaabu. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya. Yeso okoria Epasaka y’omoerio n’aborokigwa baye (Mat 26:17-30; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)

English: As a door turns on its hinges, so the slacker turns on his bed.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mlango ugeukavyo kwenye bawaba zake, ndivyo mvivu ajigeuzavyo kitandani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.

English: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.
Ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi'egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.

English: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.
Kiswahili: watu wa Anathothi 128
Ekegusii: abanto b'Anatoti: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128);

English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng'ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

English: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akamchagua Sila na akaondoka baada ya ndugu kuwatakia neema ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila, na ekero abegeni bamobekeire amaboko, akaimoka akagenda.

English: In the very time of his deliverance, he awakens, and marvels that the fear is nothing.
Kiswahili: Wakati uleule wa ukombozi wake, anaamka, na kushangaa kwamba hofu si kitu.
Ekegusii: Ekero agotorigwa, obooka, oichana buna obwoba bwaye tibobwati ekeene.

English: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Amoni wakafanya fitina juu yake, nao wakamuulia kwake nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Abasomba b'Amoni bagakora omooroberio bw'okomoita, bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.

English: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitakufanya ukiwa milele, watu hawataishi katika miji yako. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninkoonchore ogenderere koba bosa botambe, na emechie yao tekomenywa naende. Erio nario moramanye ng'a ninche Omonene.

English: They had entered the house while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed, and having stabbed and killed him, they beheaded him, took his head, and traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wameingia ndani ya nyumba wakati alipokuwa amelala kitandani chumbani kwake. Baada ya kumchoma mkuki na kumuua, walikata kichwa chake. Wakiwa wamekichukua, walitembea usiku kucha kwa njia ya Araba.
Ekegusii: Naboigo banyorete Isi‐Boseti oraire borere bwaye agwo ase akanyomba g’okorara bakamoika ang’e bakamoita, bakamobutora omotwe bakayoira; erio bakageenda ase obotuko bwonsi goetera ase enchera y’Ekerubo Ekiomo.

English: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
Kiswahili: Remethi, En-Ganimu, En-Hada na Beth-Pasesi.
Ekegusii: na Remeti, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Eni‐Hada, na Beti‐Pasesi.

English: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God's house.
Kiswahili: Afisa mkuu wa Walawi huko Yerusalemu alikuwa Uzi mwana wa Bani, mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Matania, mwana wa Mika. Uzi alikuwa mmoja wa wazao wa Asafu, waliokuwa waimbaji wenye kuwajibika kwa ajili ya huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyorenge omoteneneri bw'Abalawi abamenyete Yerusalemu, nere Usi, mosinto o Bani, o Hasabia, o Matania, o Mika. Usi nigo arenge oyomo bw'ororeria rw'Asafu, abanto abarenge abateneneri b'amatera ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was removed, but they were granted an extension of life for a season and a time. Daniel’s Vision of the Son of Man
Kiswahili: (Wanyama wengine walikuwa wamevuliwa mamlaka yao, lakini waliruhusiwa kuishi kwa muda fulani.)
Ekegusii: Ching’iti chiria chinde chiatigarete chikaurwa chinguru chiabo chi’okogaamba, korende chigatigwa chigendendererete koba moyo goika ase ebiro ne chingaki chiachikeretwe.

English: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
Kiswahili: Baadaye, Daudi aliposikia kuhusu jambo hili, akasema, “Mimi na ufalme wangu kamwe hatuna hatia mbele za Bwana kuhusu damu ya Abneri mwana wa Neri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete amang'ana ayio, akabora, “Omonene namanyete ng'a inche na abanto bane titori na komocha ase obosio bwaye ase ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga y'Abineri, mosinto o Neri.

English: Now in the street, now in the squares, she lurks at every corner.
Kiswahili: mara kwenye barabara za mji, mara kwenye viwanja vikubwa, kwenye kila pembe huvizia.)
Ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chiinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.

English: When Judah turned and discovered that the battle was both before and behind them, they cried out to the LORD. Then the priests blew the trumpets,
Kiswahili: Basi Yuda wakageuka na kuona kwamba wanashambuliwa mbele na nyuma. Ndipo wakamlilia Bwana. Makuhani wakapiga tarumbeta zao,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abayuda barigereretie bakarora ng’a esegi nigo yarenge bosio bwabo na magega abo, na igo bakarera ase Omonene, na abakuani bakabugia ebitureeri biria.

English: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken. For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg.
Kiswahili: Msifurahi, enyi Wafilisti wote, kwamba fimbo iliyowapiga imevunjika; kutoka mzizi wa huyo nyoka atachipuka nyoka mwenye sumu kali, uzao wake utakuwa joka lirukalo, lenye sumu kali.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abafirisiti mwensi, timobaisa kogoka ng’a enyimbo eria yabaagete yabunirwe; korwa ase ritina ri’eng’iti eria ende ere nobosongo obotindi nesoke, na korwa ase eyio enchoka ekoiruruka netuboke.

English: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
Kiswahili: Msilipe ovu kwa ovu, au jeuri kwa jeuri, bali barikini, kwa maana hili ndilo mliloitiwa ili mpate kurithi baraka.
Ekegusii: Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng’a monyore omwando bw’ogosesenigwa.

English: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.
Kiswahili: Ingilio la ghorofa ya chini kabisa lilikuwa upande wa kusini wa Hekalu, ngazi ilielekea ghorofa ya kati na kutokea hapo ilielekea hadi ghorofa ya tatu.
Ekegusii: Egesoero kegosoera ebinyomba bia inse nigo kiareenge ensemo ya Irianyi ye Hekalu na goetera ase ebiriinero abanto nigo baarenge koriina gochia ase rirongo ria kabere, na korwa aroro bariina gochia ase rirongo ria gatato.

English: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nimeanza kukuharibu, kuwaangamiza kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.

English: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wawili wabaya kabisa wakaja wakaketi mkabala naye, nao wakaleta mashtaka dhidi ya Nabothi mbele ya watu, wakisema, “Nabothi amemlaani Mungu na mfalme.” Kwa hiyo wakamtoa nje na kumpiga kwa mawe hadi akafa.
Ekegusii: Abanto babere abatagwenereti bagacha, bagaikaransa kororia asare, bakamosoera ase amasio y'abanto, bagateeba: “Naboti oragereirie Nyasae na omorwoti.” Ase igo abanto bakamosokia isiko y'omochie, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa.

English: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
Kiswahili: Bwana kumbuka jinsi mtumishi wako amesimangwa, jinsi ninavyovumilia moyoni mwangu dhihaka za mataifa yote,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.

English: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,
Kiswahili: lakini watakapofika umri wa miaka hamsini, ni lazima waache kazi zao za kawaida wala wasiendelee.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire emiaka emerongo etano batige batimoke korwa ase emeremo eria.

English: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab's anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”
Kiswahili: Eliabu nduguye mkubwa Daudi alipomsikia akizungumza na watu hasira ikawaka juu yake akamuuliza, “Kwa nini umeteremka kuja hapa? Nao wale kondoo wachache kule nyikani umewaacha na nani? Ninajua jinsi ulivyo na kiburi na jinsi moyo wako ulivyo mwovu; umekuja hapa kutazama vita tu.”
Ekegusii: Eliabu, omomura omonene omwabo Daudi, akaigwa buna agokwana na'baanto. Akaba nendamwamu enene ase Daudi, agateeba: “Ninki kiagera gwachicha aa? Ning'o gwatigera riicho riria rike rie ching'ondi chikare nka aaria ase erooro? Nimanyete oboenenu bwao na obobe bore ase enkoro yao. Nigo gwacha aa korora esegi rioka.”

English: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.
Kiswahili: anaweza akahudumu katika jina la Bwana Mungu wake kama Walawi wenzake wote wanaohudumu hapo mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere na’be ogokora emeremo ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Abalawi bande bamwabo bagotenena gokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
Kiswahili: Eshtoni akawazaa Beth-Rafa, Pasea na Tehina. Tehina alikuwa baba wa Iri-Nahashi. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Reka.
Ekegusii: Esitoni akaibora Beti‐Rafa na Pasea, na Tehina, ise abanto b'omochie o Nahasi. Aba nabaanto bamenyete Reka.

English: Indeed, their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with everything you hear.”
Kiswahili: Wana wao wawili, Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki na Yonathani mwana wa Abiathari, wako pamoja nao huko. Watume kwangu na lolote utakalosikia.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbakabwate abana babo babere, Ahimasi, omwana o Zadoki, na Yonathani, omwana bw’Abiatari. Mobe mokobatoma bandetere kera ring’ana moraigwe.”

English: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit. Jesus’ Side Is Pierced (Zechariah 12:10–14)
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuionja hiyo siki, Yesu akasema, “Imekwisha.” Akainamisha kichwa chake, akaitoa roho yake. Yesu Achomwa Mkuki Ubavuni
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo. Yeso okobetwa ritimo na koirwa gotindekwa

English: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
Kiswahili: Kisha utatangaza mbele za Bwana Mungu wako: “Baba yangu alikuwa Mwaramu aliyekuwa anatangatanga, akaenda Misri pamoja na watu wachache, akaishi huko hadi akawa taifa kubwa, lenye nguvu na watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Oiranerie amang'ana aya okwane ase obosio bw'Omonene, Nyasae oo: Sokorooria yane nigo arenge Omoaramu, orenge okona‐koong'anyang'anya. Agatirimboka gochia Misiri, akaba omomenyi aroro amo n'abanto baye. Ekero ageendete ase ense eria nigo abwate abanto abake, na aroro agwo bakabucha, bakaba egesaku ekenene, kiarenge n'echinguru, naende kiarenge n'abanto abange.

English: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa watakatifu kwangu, kwa sababu Mimi, Bwana, ni mtakatifu, nami nimewatenga kutoka mataifa kuwa wangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Inwe mobe abachenu baane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde omochenu, nabaatananire korwa ase ebisaku binde, erinde mobe abaane.

English: But Saul replied, “You cannot go out against this Philistine to fight him. You are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.”
Kiswahili: Sauli akamjibu Daudi, “Wewe hutaweza kwenda kupigana dhidi ya huyu Mfilisti; wewe ni kijana tu, naye amekuwa mtu wa vita tangu ujana wake.”
Ekegusii: Saulo agakania Daudi, akamoteebia: “Tokonyara korwania Omofilisti oyio. Aye nomoke; ere nigo enaretie korwana esegi korwa obosae bwaye.”

English: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
Kiswahili: Nakuomba, uniokoe na mkono wa ndugu yangu Esau, kwa maana ninaogopa kuwa atakuja kunishambulia, pia mama pamoja na watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.

English: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo Israeli itakuwa ya tatu, pamoja na Misri na Ashuru, nao watakuwa baraka kwa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli mbabwatane n'Abamisiri na Abaasuri, na ebisaku ebio bitato mbibe ogosesenigwa ase ense engima,

English: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mzidi kupigwa? Kwa nini kudumu katika uasi? Kichwa chako chote kimejeruhiwa, moyo wako wote ni mgonjwa.
Ekegusii: Nase ki mogendererete gosaria? Nigo moganetie konyora egesusuro goetania? Omotwe bwonsi orwarire, na enkoro yanyarekire.

English: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana humchukia mtu mpotovu, lakini siri yake iko kwa mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
Kiswahili: akamtuma mwanawe Yoramu kwa Mfalme Daudi kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa ushindi wake katika vita dhidi ya Hadadezeri, kwa kuwa Hadadezeri alikuwa amepigana vita na Tou. Yoramu akamletea Daudi vyombo vya fedha, dhahabu na shaba.
Ekegusii: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi'etaabu, na ebi'efeta, na ebi'etai.

English: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Kiswahili: Hazina zilizopatikana kwa njia mbaya hazifai, lakini uadilifu huokoa kutoka mautini.
Ekegusii: Chinibo chi'ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.

English: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven. The Lesson of the Fig Tree (Matthew 24:32–35; Luke 21:29–33)
Kiswahili: Naye atawatuma malaika wake wawakusanye wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka miisho ya dunia hadi miisho ya mbingu. Somo Kuhusu Mtini (Mathayo 24:32-35; Luka 21:29-33)
Ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mat 24:32-36,42; Luk 21:29-33)

English: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
Kiswahili: Watazame! Wakiwa wameketi au wamesimama, wananidhihaki katika nyimbo zao.
Ekegusii: Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka, ninche engeero yabo bagochaaya.

English: and the idols will vanish completely.
Kiswahili: nazo sanamu zitatoweka kabisa.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.

English: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asiwaondolee thawabu yenu kwa kusisitiza kunyenyekea kwake na kuabudu malaika. Mtu kama huyo hudumu katika maono yake, akijivuna bila sababu katika mawazo ya kibinadamu.
Ekegusii: Timoa monto onde ribaga ri'okobaura inwe ekeegwa kiaino ase okorigia kwaye ase okweororobia na ase ogosasiima abamalaika, na kwebeka ase amaroro aya arorire, na koenena bosa ase ebirengererio biaye bi'obobe,

English: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati utafika mtakaposema, ‘Wamebarikiwa wanawake tasa, ambao matumbo yao hayakuzaa, wala matiti yao hayakunyonyesha!'
Ekegusii: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!

English: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
Kiswahili: Mose akajenga madhabahu na kuiita Yehova Nisi.
Ekegusii: Musa akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,

English: “Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.”
Kiswahili: Sema na Yerusalemu kwa upole, umtangazie kwamba kazi yake ngumu imekamilika, kwamba dhambi yake imefanyiwa fidia, kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana maradufu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.

English: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
Kiswahili: Nataka mjue jinsi ninavyojitaabisha kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya wale walioko Laodikia, na pia kwa ajili ya wote ambao hawajapata kuniona mimi binafsi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkobamanyia igoro y’omokia inde noro ase engencho yaino, boigo na ase abanto bare Laodikia na baria bonsi batarandora obosio bwane,

English: The women, girded with sackcloth under their breasts, thronged the streets. The virgins who were kept indoors ran together, some to the gates, others to the walls, and some looked out through the windows.
Kiswahili: Wanawake, wakiwa wamevaa magunia chini ya vifua vyao, walijaa mitaani. Mabikira waliokuwa wamefungiwa ndani walikimbia pamoja, wengine hadi malangoni, wengine hadi ukutani, na wengine walichungulia madirishani.
Ekegusii: Abakungu nabarabwo bakebisia chigunia ase ebikuba biabo bagaichora ase chinchera. Abasubati abekungi abwo konya batarancherwa gosoka isiko korwa ase chinyomba chiabo bakamonyoka bagaeta ase ebiita n'echinyasi chi'omochie, nabande bagatigara barigereretie korwa chitirisa.

English: Then the elders of the congregation said, “What should we do about wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kusanyiko wakasema, “Kwa kuwa wanawake wa Wabenyamini wameangamizwa, tufanyeje ili kuwapatia wake wale wanaume waliosalia?
Ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omosangererekano oria bakaboorania, “Naki torakore tonyorere abasacha baria batigarete abakungu, ekiagera abakungu bonsi baitirwe korwa ase Ababenjamini?”

English: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumfukuzia mbali Adamu, Mungu akaweka makerubi mashariki ya Bustani ya Edeni, pamoja na upanga wa moto ukimulika huku na huko kulinda njia ya kuuendea mti wa uzima.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya moocha y'omogondo o Edeni akabeeka ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, n'omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi. Erio korenda onde bwensi tacha ase omote bw'obogima.

English: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.
Kiswahili: mpaka mshale umchome ini lake, kama ndege anayenaswa kwenye mtego, bila kujua itamgharimu maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abeete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.

English: The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya wenye hekima ni kama mchokoro, mithali zao zilizokusanywa pamoja ni kama misumari iliyogongomewa ikawa imara, yaliyotolewa na Mchungaji mmoja.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana nigo anga buna chimbambo chinyoge, na aya basangereirie anga buna emesumari eakeire bokong’u. Ayio onsi nebiegwa korwa ase Omorisia oyomo.

English: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked. “There, in the tent,” he replied.
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Yuko wapi Sara mkeo?” Akasema, “Yuko huko, ndani ya hema.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria: “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria: “Neema ime are.”

English: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
Kiswahili: Taji itatolewa kwa Heldai, Tobia, Yedaya na Heni mwana wa Sefania kama kumbukumbu ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Egutwa eyio negenderere kobeera ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene koba ekeinyorio kia Helidai, na Tobia, na Yedaya, na Heni, mosinto o Sefania.

English: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him, they placed him in custody.
Kiswahili: nao wakamweka kifungoni, kwa sababu haikufahamika kwa wazi kwamba afanyiwe nini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.

English: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
Kiswahili: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”
Ekegusii: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw'ogotianania nainwe, ng'a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n'amaache y'etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y'ayio.”

English: Depart from wrong, and it will turn away from you.
Kiswahili: Jiepushe na uovu, nao utakugeukia mbali.
Ekegusii: Korebachere amabe, amabe natame korwa asore.

English: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya hao mitume kumi na wawili: wa kwanza, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea nduguye; Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye;
Ekegusii: Na amarieta abotomwa baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bw'eritang'ani, Simioni, oyio ore korokwa naende Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;

English: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
Kiswahili: Mmeyainua madhabahu ya mfalme wenu, Sikuthi mungu wenu mtawala, na Kiuni mungu wenu wa nyota, ambao mliwatengeneza wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Inwe mobogorie Sikuti, omogwekano oyio mogosasiima buna omorwoti oino, na Kiyuni, enyasae yaino ye ching'enang'eni mweroiseretie.

English: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
Kiswahili: Kwa namna hii twaweza kulijua pendo la Mungu: Kwa sababu Yesu Kristo aliutoa uhai wake kwa ajili yetu. Nasi imetupasa kuutoa uhai kwa ajili ya hao ndugu.
Ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y'abaminto.

English: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.'”
Kiswahili: Huniabudu bure; nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.' ”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

English: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, viongozi wa Kiyahudi, wazee na walimu wa sheria wakakusanyika Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia rituko riare kobwatia, abarai ba Abayahudi, abanene, amo n'Aborokia b'amachiiko bagasangererekana ime ya Yerusalemu.

English: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father's brothers' sons.
Kiswahili: Binti za Selofehadi, ambao ni Mahla, Tirsa, Hogla, Milka na Noa, wakaolewa na waume, wana wa ndugu za baba yao.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke obwo ba Selofehadi; Maala, Teresa, Ogila, Milika, amo na Nuhu bakanywomwa n'abamwabo korwa are ororeeria rwa ise.

English: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
Kiswahili: Barabarani upanga utawakosesha watoto; nyumbani mwao hofu itatawala. Vijana wao wa kiume na wa kike wataangamia, pia watoto wachanga na wazee wenye mvi.
Ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bare isiko mbaitwe n'emioro, ekero bare ime ase chinyomba obwoba mbobaite; ebio mbiite abamura, na abaiseke, na abana bakogonka, amo n'abanto abagotu.

English: For he called upon the Most High Lord, and he gave him strength in his right hand to kill a man mighty in war, to exalt the horn of his people.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alimwomba Bwana Aliye Juu Zaidi, naye akampa nguvu katika mkono wake wa kuume ili amuue mtu hodari vitani, ili kuinua pembe ya watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ere amosororete Omonene Nyasae nere agatenenia okoboko kwaye gwokorio, erio ere anyare komobua omobisa omonyanguru ase esegi na kobasegeta abanto baye.

English: “Go and look toward the sea,” he said to his servant. So the servant went and looked, and he said, “There is nothing there.” Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Nenda ukatazame kuelekea bahari.” Akaenda na kutazama. Akasema, “Hakuna kitu chochote huko.” Mara saba Eliya akasema, “Nenda tena.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Elija agateebia omosomba oye: “Tiira gochia igoro, origererie gochia ase enyancha.” Omosomba oye agatiira, akarigereria, akamoteebia: “Tindochi gento kende.” Ase chintunda isano na ibere Elija akamoteebia: “Genda origererie!”

English: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
Kiswahili: Naam, hili litanigeukia kuwa wokovu wangu, kwa maana hakuna mtu asiyemcha Mungu atakayethubutu kuja mbele yake!
Ekegusii: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng'a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.

English: Saul's uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
Kiswahili: Basi babaye mdogo akamuuliza Sauli na mtumishi wake, “Je, mlikuwa wapi?” Akajibu, “Tulikuwa tukiwatafuta punda. Lakini tulipoona hawapatikani, tulikwenda kwa Samweli.”
Ekegusii: Ise moke Saulo akabooria Saulo na omosomba oye: “Ng'ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria: “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”

English: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
Kiswahili: “Reubeni atakuwa na sehemu moja, itapakana na nchi ya Efraimu kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Rubeni keegwe orogongo rw'aye robebekane norwa Efraimu korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
Kiswahili: Ataichuna hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuikata vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,

English: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret; it leads only to evildoing.
Kiswahili: Epuka hasira na uache ghadhabu, usihangaike: itakuongoza tu kutenda uovu.
Ekegusii: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.

English: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
Kiswahili: Mungu alipompa Abrahamu ahadi yake, kwa kuwa hakuwepo mwingine aliyekuwa mkuu kuliko yeye ambaye angeweza kuapa kwa jina lake, aliapa kwa nafsi yake,
Ekegusii: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Aburaamu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,

English: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
Kiswahili: Aliwafanya washuke ndani ya kambi yao, kuzunguka mahema yao yote.
Ekegusii: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y'egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.

English: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
Kiswahili: Nafurahia ahadi zako kama mtu aliyepata mateka mengi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.

English: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
Kiswahili: Bwana apitapo katika nchi yote kuwapiga Wamisri, ataiona damu juu ya vizingiti na kwenye miimo ya milango, naye atapita juu, wala hatamruhusu mwangamizi kuingia katika nyumba zenu na kuwapiga ninyi.
Ekegusii: Inaki Omonene nache aete ense ya Misiri aite Abamisiri, korende ekero ararore amanyinga agindirie omoriibo bw'emetobwa ya gesieri igoro na emetobwa eria ebere, nigo araete egesieri ekio, gose tagotiga oria omosiria asoe chinyomba chiaino abaite.

English: “To the worthy Jewish citizens, Antiochus, king and general, wishes much joy and health and prosperity.
