Kiswahili: "Kwa raia wa Kiyahudi wanaostahili, Antiochus, mfalme na jenerali, anawatakia furaha nyingi, afya na ustawi."
Ekegusii: “Korwa ase omorwoti Antioko, gochia ase Abayahudi, abanto baane abanchwa. Kobatomera inde amaiga y'obwanchani, na kobaganeria obogima obuya, n'okogenderera kwaino.

English: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Waiteni wapiga mishale dhidi ya Babeli, wote wale wavutao upinde. Pigeni kambi kumzunguka kabisa, asitoroke mtu yeyote. Mlipizeni kwa matendo yake; mtendeeni kama alivyotenda. Kwa kuwa alimdharau Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Rangeria abanto bamanyete korwanera amata bachiche korwania Babiloni. Moyoboere ase chinsemo chionsi, timotiga nonya nomonto oyomo atame atooreke. Yoakane koreng'ana nogokora kwaye. Buna koreng'ana oro okorete tiga okorerwe boigo, ekiagera omochie oyio oenenire ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Shuka, kwa sababu watu wako, uliowatoa Misri, wamepotoka.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,

English: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja anaitukuza siku fulani kuwa ni bora kuliko nyingine, na mwingine anaona kuwa siku zote ni sawa. Basi kila mmoja awe na hakika na yale anayoamini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng'a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng'a amatuko onsi nigo areng'aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.

English: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
Kiswahili: Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode, “Si halali kwako kuwa na mke wa ndugu yako.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge ase ore komenyana na moka momura omino.”

English: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akawakusanya Waisraeli wote, kuanzia Mto Shihori ulioko Misri hadi Lebo-Hamathi, ili kulileta Sanduku la Mungu kutoka Kiriath-Yearimu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Sihori ya Misiri goika egesoero kia Hamati, erinde barente Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa Kiriati‐Yearimu.

English: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alifanya Agano nasi katika mlima wa Horebu.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

English: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
Kiswahili: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko ane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko ane anyare gokumba obota bw’etai.

English: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja wa Sora, aliyeitwa Manoa, wa kabila la Wadani, naye alikuwa na mke ambaye alikuwa tasa na hakuwa na mtoto.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nareengeo omonto ore korokwa Manoa. Nigo arenge korwa omochie ore korokwa Sora, omonto bw’egesaku gia Dani. Omokungu oye nigo arenge omogomba, taiborete bana.

English: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.”
Kiswahili: Nyumba yako na ufalme wako utadumu milele mbele zangu, kiti chako cha enzi kitafanywa imara milele.’ ”
Ekegusii: Enyomba yao na oborwoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”

English: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
Kiswahili: Wakati jua lilipochomoza, Mungu akautuma upepo wa hari wa mashariki, nalo jua likawaka juu ya kichwa cha Yona mpaka akazimia. Akatamani kufa, naye akasema, “Ni afadhali mimi nife kuliko kuishi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omoororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateeba, “Nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”

English: Gain trust with your neighbor in his poverty, that in his prosperity you may have gladness. Stay steadfast to him in the time of his affliction, that you may be heir with him in his inheritance.
Kiswahili: Jiaminishe na jirani yako katika umaskini wake, ili katika mafanikio yake upate furaha. Mtegemee wakati wa mateso yake, ili upate kuwa mrithi pamoja naye katika urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Nonya gwaikigwe gotwara enkwano enkong'u n'omosani oo, tokwa omoyo; ekiagera naende nabo obosani bokogorororwa naende bobeo

English: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
Kiswahili: Nchi yote kuanzia Geba, kaskazini mwa Yuda, hadi Rimoni, kusini mwa Yerusalemu, itakuwa kama Araba. Lakini Yerusalemu utainuliwa juu na kubaki mahali pake, toka Lango la Benyamini hadi mahali pa Lango la Kwanza, mpaka kwenye Lango la Pembeni na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli hadi kwenye mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio ense eye yonsi neonchorwe ebe ense omweya korwa Geba goika Rimoni, Irianyi ya Yerusalemu. Korende Yerusalemu oro nogenderere kobeera igoro agwo aase aye, korwa ase Egeita kia Benjamini goika ase Egeita kie Ritang’ani, na goika ase Egeita gi’Ekoona, na korwa ase Omorobiri bwa Hananeli goika ase ebimitero bi’edivai bi’omorwoti.

English: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina. Ndipo gharika ikaja na kuwaangamiza wote.
Ekegusii: Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egaacha, egasiria bonsi.

English: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
Kiswahili: Maneno yenu ni mithali za majivu; utetezi wenu ni ngome za udongo wa mfinyanzi.
Ekegusii: Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.

English: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let's walk by the same rule. Let's be of the same mind.
Kiswahili: Lakini na tushike sana lile ambalo tumekwisha kulifikia.
Ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.

English: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
Kiswahili: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu, pamoja na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;
Ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;

English: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
Kiswahili: Akawatuma watumishi wake kuwaita wale waliokuwa wamealikwa karamuni, lakini wakakataa kuja.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abasomba baye batuunye baria konya barangerigwe ase enyangi, korende barabwo bakaanga gocha.

English: When they came to Chidon's threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Kidoni, Uza akaunyoosha mkono wake ili kulizuia Sanduku, kwa sababu maksai walijikwaa.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gia Kidoni, Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduki eria, ekiagera chiombe chiare kong'usa egari chiagochetwe.

English: The calm words of the wise are heeded over the shouts of a ruler among fools.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya utulivu ya mwenye hekima husikiwa kuliko makelele ya mtawala wa wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gotegerera amang’ana omonto omong’aini agokwana ase obotoereru kobua gotegerera amang’ana ’omogambi ogoaka eriogi ase egati y’abanto abariri.

English: An abundance of food is in poor people's fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
Kiswahili: Shamba la mtu maskini laweza kuzalisha chakula kingi, bali dhuluma hukifutilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Oboremo oboyia bw'omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende ase engencho y'obobe, enyinge yasiara‐siarerwa yasira.

English: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
Kiswahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa katika miiba ni yule mtu alisikiaye neno, lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya na udanganyifu wa mali hulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae matunda.
Ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amagwa, oyo nere okoigwa ring’ana; okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo biaba nkomiga bire ring’ana, riaba tirikwama.

English: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
Kiswahili: Walivunjavunja milango yote iliyonakshiwa kwa mashoka na vishoka vyao.
Ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.

English: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
Kiswahili: Atakula jibini na asali atakapokuwa ameweza kukataa mabaya na kuchagua mema.
Ekegusii: Ekero omwana oyio arabe omanyire kwanga amabe na gochora amaya, nabe okoria amaguta 'amabeere na obooke.

English: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
Kiswahili: Upo udanganyifu katika mioyo ya wale ambao hupanga mabaya, bali kuna furaha kwa wale wanaoleta amani.
Ekegusii: Obong'ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi'abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay'omorembe nigo bakogera omogooko oba.

English: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Kishi: mwana wa Kishi: alikuwa Yerameeli.
Ekegusii: Yerameeli nomwana omomura o Kisi.

English: So he called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
Kiswahili: Akapaza sauti, akasema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
Ekegusii: Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

English: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He tore down the high places of the gates at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which was to the left of the city gate.
Kiswahili: Yosia akawaleta makuhani wote wa Bwana kutoka miji yote ya Yuda, na kunajisi mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, kuanzia Geba hadi Beer-Sheba, mahali pote ambapo hao makuhani wa miungu walifukiza uvumba. Akabomoa mahali pa kuwekea vitu vya ibada za miungu palipokuwa katika malango, kwenye ingilio la Lango la Yoshua, mtawala wa mji, lililoko upande wa kushoto wa lango la mji.
Ekegusii: Akarenta abakuani bonsi korwa ase emechie y’Abayuda, na ase ense yonsi korwa Geba goika Beeri‐Seba agakora aase onsi aimokererete igoro agwo ase abakuani baarenge gosambera ubani akaba aatachenegeti. Na ebisasimero bi’aase aimokererete igoro arenge agwo ase ebiita bi’omochie, keria kiarenge ase egesoero ki’Egeita kia Yoshua, omogabana bw’omochie, na keria kiarenge ensemo y’okobee y’oyo ogosoera omochie, omorwoti akabitagora akabiyeria inse.

English: He has walled up my way so that I can't pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
Kiswahili: Yeye ameizuia njia yangu hivyo siwezi kupita; ameyafunika mapito yangu na giza.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obeekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.

English: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
Kiswahili: aliyegeuza mwamba kuwa dimbwi la maji, mwamba mgumu kuwa chemchemi za maji.
Ekegusii: Oyio oonchorete egetare gekaba ritibo ri'amaache, ne rigena riikong'u rikaba ensoko y'amaache.

English: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor’s property.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwizi asipopatikana, mwenye nyumba atafika mbele ya waamuzi ili kuthibitisha kuwa hakuchukua mali ya mwenzake.
Ekegusii: Korende atanyorekaneti, oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bw’ekegambero, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.

English: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
Kiswahili: Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki na makuhani wenzake, Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli pamoja na wenzake walianza kujenga madhabahu ya Mungu wa Israeli ili kumtolea dhabihu za sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto juu yake, kulingana na ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria ya Mose mtu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, amo nabakuani bamwabo, na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na abanto bamwabo, bakaimoka koagacha oboyia egesasiimero kia Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, bamoruere ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa ase kerokio, buna ariikire ase amachiiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae.

English: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn't spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa ile alama haijabadilika wala kuenea, ni kovu tu kutokana na jipu, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti na gwesiarera, eyio engoro ase rigumba riariete, na Omokuani ateebe ng'a omonto oria ochenekire.

English: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
Kiswahili: Basi tamanini sana karama zilizo kuu. Nami nitawaonyesha njia iliyo bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Rigia mono ebiegwa ebiya kobua. Naende nimborokie enchera ere engiya mono.

English: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
Kiswahili: Tunapapasa ukuta kama kipofu, tunapapasa katika njia zetu kama watu wasio na macho. Adhuhuri tunajikwaa kama wakati wa gizagiza; katikati ya wenye nguvu, tuko kama wafu.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokona‐gotaba‐taba ase enyasi y’enyomba buna abanto emeuko, nigo tokona‐kouna‐una buna abatabwati amaiso; intwe nigo tokogochwa mobaso gati buna mbwamura‐murire. Ase egati y’abare ne chinguru nigo tonga buna abakwete.

English: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Yoshua, “Hakika Bwana ametupa nchi yote mikononi mwetu; watu wote wanayeyuka kwa hofu kwa sababu yetu.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Ntwaenegetie ng'a Omonene otoeire ense eria yonsi, na bono abanto bonsi b'ense eria baondokire ase engencho yaito.”

English: “Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni hili, ee nyumba ya Yakobo, ninyi mnaoitwa kwa jina la Israeli, na mnaotoka katika ukoo wa Yuda, ninyi mnaoapa kwa jina la Bwana, mnaomwomba Mungu wa Israeli, lakini si katika kweli au kwa haki;
Ekegusii: Inwe ab’enyomba ya Yakobo, aba mokorokwa Abaisraeli, na more ab’ororeeria rwa Yuda, naende mogotiana ase erieta ri’Omonene na komoorokia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, korende tari ase ekeene na oboronge, igwa amang’ana aya!

English: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwepo pale walikuwa wakisemezana wao kwa wao, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?
Ekegusii: Abanto bake ase abwo barenge oo bakagechigwa ase emioyo yabo, bakaboora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?

English: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,
Kiswahili: Lakini mtavuka Yordani na kuishi katika nchi Bwana Mungu wenu anayowapa kama urithi, naye atawapa pumziko kutokana na adui zenu wote wanaowazunguka ili ninyi mpate kuishi kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero moramboke Yorodani na komenya ase ense eri'Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, naende ekero arabae obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baino bonsi baabaetanaine, erio 'namomenye ase omorembe ase motaabe n'obwoba.

English: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Jinsi gani alivyo wa kutisha, Bwana Aliye Juu Sana, Mfalme mkuu juu ya dunia yote!
Ekegusii: Omonene ore Igoro Mono nigo are oyo bw'okoirokia, ere nomorwoti omonene bw'ense yonsi.

English: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Matthew 8:14–17; Mark 1:29–34)
Kiswahili: Habari zake zikaanza kuenea kila mahali katika sehemu ile. Yesu Awaponya Wengi (Mathayo 8:14-17; Marko 1:29-34)
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria. Yeso okogwenia aaria mwa Simioni (Mat 8:14-17; Mar 1:29-39)

English: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake wakamwambia, “Wewe unakusudia kututawala? Hivi kweli wewe utatutawala sisi?” Wakaongeza kumchukia zaidi kwa sababu ya ndoto yake pamoja na yale aliyowaambia.
Ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobooria: “Inee! Aye nigo orengereretie ng'a nigo orabe omogambi oito, otogambere?” Ase igo, barabwo bakamenta komogecha mono ase engencho y'okoroota kwaye, na ase engencho y'amang'ana aye.

English: “You chose this house to be called by your name, to be a house of prayer and supplication for your people.
Kiswahili: "Ulichagua nyumba hii iitwe kwa jina lako, iwe nyumba ya sala na dua kwa ajili ya watu wako."
Ekegusii: “Omonene naye gwachoorete Hekalu eye erokwe ase erieta riao, boigo ebe enyomba yogosaba na ogosorora ase engencho ya abanto bao.

English: Also in those days, the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came back to them.
Kiswahili: Pia katika siku hizo wakuu wa Yuda walikuwa wakituma barua nyingi kwa Tobia, nayo majibu yaliyotoka kwa Tobia yaliendelea kuwajia.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio onsi abasike b’Abayuda nigo bagendererete konagotoma amarube amange ase Tobia, nere nabo agendererete kona-gotoma ayande ase okobairaneria.

English: But the angel of the Lord said to Habakkuk, “Go carry the dinner that you have into Babylon to Daniel, in the lions' den.”
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Habakuki, “Nenda ukampelekee Danieli chakula cha jioni ulicho nacho Babeli, katika tundu la simba.”
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika bw'omonene agateebia “Ira endagera eyio oimogetie oyee Daniel, oyio ore aria Babiloni ime y'engoro ye chisimba.”

English: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate ya kutosha. Walikuwa na mkate mmoja tu kwenye mashua.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.

English: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Kiswahili: Usishindwe na ubaya, bali uushinde ubaya kwa wema.
Ekegusii: Tobugwa n'obobe, korende obue obobe ase obuya.

English: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yatakapoanza kutendeka, simameni na mkaviinue vichwa vyenu, kwa sababu ukombozi wenu umekaribia.”
Ekegusii: Nabo karachake koba ayio, rigereria igoro, ekiagera okoboorigwa kwaino gwaikire ang'e.”

English: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati Sanbalati, Tobia, Waarabu, Waamoni na watu wa Ashdodi waliposikia kuwa ukarabati wa kuta za Yerusalemu ulikuwa umeendelea na mianya ilikuwa inazibwa, walikasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati, na Tobia, na Abaarabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaasidodi baigwete ng'a oboagacho bwe chindwaki chia Yerusalemu nigo bogendererete buya, naende ng'a aase abochogete nkoiranerigwa are, bakaba nendamwamu enene.

English: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David's city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yehoshafati akalala na baba zake, akazikwa pamoja nao katika mji wa Daudi baba yake. Mwanawe Yehoramu akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Yehosafati akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase chiatindegetwe ase Omochie o Daudi, sokororia yaye; na Yehoramu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
Kiswahili: Baba yangu aliyenipa hawa ni mkuu kuliko wote na hakuna awezaye kuwapokonya kutoka mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Tata one oching’eire nomonene kobua bonsi, na onde takonyara gochitaboria korwa ase okoboko gwa Tata.

English: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
Kiswahili: Huchunga kundi lake kama mchungaji wa mifugo: Hukusanya wana-kondoo katika mikono yake na kuwachukua karibu na moyo wake, huwaongoza taratibu wale wanyonyeshao.
Ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching'ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chi'eching'ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching'are nachiraae ng'ora ng'ora.

English: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn't uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hii ni kwa sababu ninyi wawili mlivunja uaminifu nami mbele ya Waisraeli kwenye maji ya Meriba-Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini, na kwa sababu hamkuuinua utakatifu wangu miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: ekiagera timwabeete abeegenwa ase 'nde ase egati y'Abaisraeli agwo ase amaache a Meriba‐Kadeshi, ase erooro ya Sini. Timwansigete na kworokia Abaisraeli ng'a inche nigo inde omochenu.

English: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives.”
Kiswahili: Wakunga wakamjibu Farao, “Wanawake wa Kiebrania ni tofauti na wanawake wa Kimisri; wao wana nguvu, nao hujifungua watoto kabla wakunga hawajafika.”
Ekegusii: Abaiboria baria bakairaneria Farao, “Abakungu b’Abaiberania tibari buna aba Abamisiri; barabwo nabaango ase okoibora, nigo bakoibora ritang’ani omoiboria ataraika.”

English: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.
Kiswahili: Ezra alianza safari yake kutoka Babeli tangu siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, naye akawasili Yerusalemu siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa tano, kwa maana mkono wa neema wa Mungu wake ulikuwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo achagete orogendo rwaye korwa Babiloni ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, na agaika Yerusalemu rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae oye kwarenge amo nere ase okomokonya.

English: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
Kiswahili: ambao aliukunjua mbele yangu. Pande zote mbili ulikuwa umeandikwa maneno ya maombolezo, vilio na ole.
Ekegusii: Egetabu keria gekaramborwa ase obosio bwane; nero nigo yariikire bosio na magega. Amang’ana ariikire aroro nigo arenge ay’amagombo, na okweumia, na okorera kw’obobe.

English: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.'”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Kwa maana mikono iliinuliwa mpaka kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Bwana. Bwana atakuwa na vita dhidi ya Waamaleki kutoka kizazi hata kizazi.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki'Omonene, na gotiana ng'a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
Kiswahili: Bwana na auongeze upendo wenu na kuuzidisha kati yenu na kwa wengine wote, kama vile tulivyo na upendo mwingi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.

English: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yosefu alisema, “Liwe mbali nami kufanya jambo kama hili! Mtu yule tu aliyekutwa na kikombe ndiye atakayekuwa mtumwa wangu. Ninyi wengine, rudini kwa baba yenu kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akabora: “Yaya, tari bo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.”

English: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kama mtu mwenye haki akiacha haki yake na kutenda dhambi na kufanya mambo ya machukizo ambayo mtu mwovu hufanya, Je, ataishi? Hakuna hata mojawapo ya matendo ya haki aliyotenda litakalokumbukwa. Kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwake anayo hatia na kwa sababu ya dhambi alizozitenda, atakufa.
Ekegusii: “Korende omonyaboronge karatige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, naende akore okogechia okwo omokori amabe agokora, Inee, oyio nabe moyo? Yaya, oboronge bwaye bwonsi obwo konya akorire tibokoinyorwa; goika akwe, ekiagera atabeete omwegenwa, korende agakora ebibe.

English: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten. When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
Kiswahili: Wakati mtu alipoendea lundo la nafaka la vipimo ishirini, kulikuwa na vipimo kumi tu. Wakati mtu alipoendea pipa la mvinyo ili kuchota vipimo hamsini, kulikuwa na vipimo ishirini tu.
Ekegusii: Ninki kiabeete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.

English: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo kuhusu manabii: “Nitawafanya wale chakula kichungu na kunywa maji yaliyotiwa sumu, kwa sababu kutokana na manabii wa Yerusalemu kutokumcha Mungu kumeenea katika nchi yote.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba igoro y'ababani abwo: “Naama! Nimbae ekemeri ekeroro barie, nimbae namaache are nobosongo banywe. Korwa ase ababani ba Yerusalemu, ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwesiareire ase ense yonsi.”

English: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mtu mwovu hufanya maovu mia moja na akaendelea kuishi maisha marefu, najua kwamba itakuwa bora zaidi kwa watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, wamchao Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng'a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.

English: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
Kiswahili: yapate kushika miisho ya dunia, na kuwakungʼuta waovu waliomo?
Ekegusii: erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?

English: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king's provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwambia Malkia Esta, “Wayahudi wamewaua wanaume 500 na wana kumi wa Hamani ndani ya ngome ya Shushani. Wamefanyaje katika majimbo mengine ya mfalme yaliyobaki? Je, sasa haja yako ni nini? Nayo pia utapewa. Nalo ombi lako ni nini? Nalo utafanyiwa.”
Ekegusii: na omorwoti agateebia Esiteri eting'ana, “Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, Abayahudi baitire abanto amagana atano, baabasiririe, boigo baitire abamura ikomi ba Hamani. Onye ere igo, Inee, ngento ki bakorire ase chinsemo chinde ase chingongo chi'oborwoti bwane? Bono ninki naende oganetie? Nokeegwe. Nteebia ngento ki naende otarakorerwa. Nakerokio nokorerwe.”

English: And Judah said to his father Israel, “Send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die—neither we, nor you, nor our children.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwambia baba yake Israeli, “Mtume kijana pamoja nami, nasi tutaondoka mara, ili sisi na wewe pamoja na watoto wetu tuweze kuishi, wala tusife.
Ekegusii: Yuda agateebia Israeli ise: “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.

English: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna adui atakayemtoza ushuru, hakuna mtu mwovu atakayemwonea.
Ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.

English: Abstain from strife, and you will diminish your sins, for a passionate man will kindle strife.
Kiswahili: Jiepushe na ugomvi, nawe utapunguza dhambi zako, maana mtu mwenye hasira kali atachochea ugomvi.
Ekegusii: Ebachere korwa ase eriomana, erio nario otakore ekebe. Ekiagera omonto ore n'obororo nigo akereta eriomana.

English: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
Kiswahili: Jambo hili ni jema, tena linapendeza machoni pa Mungu Mwokozi wetu,
Ekegusii: Eri nerigiya, naende ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito,

English: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
Kiswahili: Mataifa walikasirika nao wakati wa ghadhabu yako umewadia. Wakati umewadia wa kuwahukumu waliokufa na kuwapa thawabu watumishi wako manabii na watakatifu wako pamoja na wale wote wanaoliheshimu Jina lako, wakubwa kwa wadogo: na kuwaangamiza wale wanaoiangamiza dunia.”
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakabea, korende bono endamwamu yao yachire, na engaki y’okogambia abakuure, na engaki y’okoa abasomba bao ababani, na abachenu, na abwo bairogete erieta riao, abake na abanene, eng’eria yabo, na gosiria abwo bagosaria ense.”

English: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Ewe mwana wa ibilisi, wewe ni adui wa kila kilicho haki! Umejaa kila aina ya udanganyifu na ulaghai. Je, hutaacha kuzipotosha njia za Bwana zilizonyooka?
Ekegusii: “Aye omwana o Saitani omobisa bw'oboronge bwonsi, oichire nobong'ainereria n'obobe bwonsi, torigeti gotiga gokora bogeka chinchera chia Nyasae Omobui chire boronge?

English: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, sikia maombi yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki'ogosorora kwane.

English: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mkikataa kutahiriwa, tutamchukua ndugu yetu na kuondoka.”
Ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke oito aa, togende nere.”

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will dwell in their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakapoikusanya nyumba ya Israeli kutoka mataifa ambako wametawanyika, nitajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu miongoni mwao machoni pa mataifa. Ndipo watakapoishi katika nchi yao wenyewe, niliyompa mtumishi wangu Yakobo.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ninsangererie Abaisraeli, mbarusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku agwo ase basiareretwe gochia, na ning’orokie obochenu bwane ase bare ase amasio y abanto b’ebisaku; erio mbarente bamenye ase ense yabo eria naete Yakobo, omosomba one.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Make a fiery serpent and mount it on a pole. When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Tengeneza nyoka wa shaba na umweke juu ya mti; yeyote aliyeumwa na nyoka anaweza kumtazama na akaishi tena.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Roisia omogwekano bw’eng’iti korwa ase etai, erio oyebeke igoro ase omote, erinde kera omonto oromirwe neng’iti kararigererie eng’iti eria nabe moyo.”

English: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty men, he went with David to taunt the Philistines who had gathered for battle at Pas-dammim. The men of Israel retreated,
Kiswahili: Wa pili wake alikuwa Eleazari mwana wa Dodai, Mwahohi. Akiwa mmojawapo wa wale mashujaa watatu, alikuwa pamoja na Daudi wakati waliwadhihaki Wafilisti waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko Pas-Damimu kwa ajili ya vita. Kisha watu wa Israeli wakarudi nyuma,
Ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodai bw’eamate y’Ahohi. Ere nigo arenge na Daudi ekero baramete Abafirisiti aase basangererekanete amo barwane esegi, na Abaisraeli bakairana magega.

English: Now these are the priests and Levites who went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Kiswahili: Hawa wafuatao walikuwa makuhani na Walawi ambao walirudi na Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli pamoja na Yeshua: Seraya, Yeremia, Ezra,
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’abakuani na Abalawi abairanete korwa ase obosomba amo na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua. Abakuani nabwo aba: Seraya, na Yeremia na Ezra;

English: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mnapotoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana, toeni kwa namna ambayo itakubaliwa kwa niaba yenu.
Ekegusii: “Onye moganetie korua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase ’nde inche Omonene, mobwate emeroberio yachiikirwe, erio nario ekeng’wanso ekio kerancherwe.

English: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.
Kiswahili: Basi akatuma vijana kumi na kuwaambia, “Pandeni kwa Nabali huko Karmeli, mkamsalimie kwa jina langu.
Ekegusii: Erio agatoma abamura ikomi ase Nabali, akabateebia: “Genda ase Nabali agwo Karimeli, momoirere ogokwania kwane,

English: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”
Kiswahili: Basi mfalme akamwamuru Ebed-Meleki Mkushi, akisema, “Chukua watu thelathini kutoka hapa pamoja nawe, mkamtoe nabii Yeremia huko kwenye kisima kabla hajafa.”
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agachiika Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, akamoteebia, “Ira abanto emerongo etato korwa aiga, ogende amo nabarabwo, na morusie Yeremia omobani korwa ase engoro ime, atarakwa.”

English: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
Kiswahili: Akawanyooshea mkono wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Hawa hapa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu!
Ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!

English: “What is it?” I asked. And he replied, “A measuring basket is going forth.” Then he continued, “This is their iniquity in all the land.”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza, “Ni kitu gani?” Akanijibu, “Ni kikapu cha kupimia.” Kisha akaongeza kusema, “Huu ni uovu wa watu katika nchi nzima.”
Ekegusii: Nkamoboria, “Ngento ki keria?” Akang’iraneria aganteebia, “Keria negetonga gi’okorenga kegocha; kerokio nigo getenenerete obobe bw’abaanto b’ense yonsi.”

English: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
Kiswahili: Sisi si kama Mose, ambaye ilimpasa kuweka utaji ili kufunika uso wake ili Waisraeli wasiuone ule mngʼao uliokuwa juu yake hadi ulipofifia na hatimaye kutoweka.
Ekegusii: Titogokora buna Musa oyotubete obosio bwaye, erinde Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria mono omoerio bw’obonene boria bwarenge goeta.

English: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo baraka Mose mtu wa Mungu aliyotamka kwa Waisraeli kabla ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenia Musa, omonto o Nyasae, asesenetie Abaisraeli ekero konya atarakwa.

English: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Gaali akasema tena, “Tazama, watu wanashuka kutoka katikati ya nchi na kikosi kimoja kinakuja kutoka Tabur-Ezeri na kikosi kingine kutoka upande wa Elon-Meonenimu.”
Ekegusii: Gaali agakwana naende, agateeba, “Yaya, rigereria, abanto 'ngotirimboka bare korwa ase rigwamu ria gati‐gati, n'abanto b'ekeombe kende nigo bagoocha ase enchera ekorwa ase omote oria bw'abaringoria Omoaluni.”

English: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hata hivyo, nitauletea afya na uponyaji, nitawaponya watu wangu na kuwafanya wafurahie amani tele na salama.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo ningwenie abanto b'omochie oyo, babe nemebere emiya. Nimbagwenie mbae omorembe na obotoereru ase obonge.

English: How can I curse what God has not cursed? How can I denounce what the LORD has not denounced?
Kiswahili: Nitawezaje kuwalaani, hao ambao Mungu hajawalaani? Nitawezaje kuwashutumu hao ambao Bwana hakuwashutumu?
Ekegusii: Naki ’ndakore ndagererie oyo Nyasae ataragerereti? Naki ’ndakore ’ngambie oy’Omonene atagambeti?

English: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele, lakini yeye asiyemwamini Mwana hatauona uzima, bali ghadhabu ya Mungu itakuwa juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”

English: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
Kiswahili: Siku ya hukumu watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo n’abanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekiina, ekiagera barabwo nigo baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona, na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are.

English: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
Kiswahili: Nguvu za hao farasi zilikuwa katika vinywa vyao na kwenye mikia yao, kwa sababu mikia yao ilikuwa kama nyoka, yenye vichwa ambayo waliitumia kudhuru.
Ekegusii: Na okobua gwe chibarasi chiria nigo kware ase emenwa yabo, na ase ebimincha biabo. Ebimincha biabo nigo biagwekaine ching'iti chire nemetwe, na ase ebio nigo chiare koroma.

English: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
Kiswahili: katika utakatifu na haki mbele zake, siku zetu zote.
Ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.

English: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu utanena haki yako na sifa zako mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.

English: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
Kiswahili: pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka ya sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, na sadaka yake ya kinywaji ya robo ya hini ya divai.
Ekegusii: Amo n'ekengwanso ekio morue obosie ebimunu bine bwochoganirie namaguta, bibe okoruegwa kw'endagera kogosaambwa n'omorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Amo nokwo morue edivai egetuba ekemo ebe okoruegwa gw'ekenyugwa.

English: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo amepotoka na tena ni mwenye dhambi. Yeye amejihukumu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Nomanyete buna omonto onga buna oyio nomosareku, naende ebibe biaye biamwatananire, nere omonyene bwegaambirie.

English: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
Kiswahili: Utalewa ulevi na kujawa huzuni, kikombe cha maangamizo na ukiwa, kikombe cha dada yako Samaria.
Ekegusii: Nigo oratinde mono, naende obe nobororo obonge. Egekombe ekio gia Samaria, mosubati omino, negekombe ki'obwoba na ogosirigwa.

English: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule, Yuda akawaacha ndugu zake, akaenda kuishi na Hira Mwadulami.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase engaki eria Yuda agatigana n'abamwabo, agatirimboka, agaika ase omonto gete Omoadulamu ore korokwa Hira, bakabwatana nere.

English: Hezekiah appointed military commanders over the people and gathered the people in the square of the city gate. Then he encouraged them, saying,
Kiswahili: Akaweka maafisa wa jeshi juu ya watu, wakawakutanisha mbele yake katika uwanja kwenye lango la mji, naye akawatia moyo kwa maneno haya:
Ekegusii: Akabeka abatang’ani b’abasikari igoro ase abanto, akabasangereria amo agwo ase eraaro ase egeita ki’omochie, agakwana nabarabwo, akabaremia, ogoteeba,

English: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn't think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
Kiswahili: Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Kamwe sikutazamia kuuona uso wako tena, lakini sasa Mungu ameniruhusu kuwaona watoto wako pia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Tinasemeretie ng'a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”

English: Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akatuma ujumbe kwa Shimei na kumwambia, “Ujijengee nyumba huko Yerusalemu uishi huko, lakini usiende mahali pengine popote.
Ekegusii: Naende Omorwoti akarangeria Simei, akamoteebia: “Eagachere enyomba ime ya Yerusalemu omenyeo, tobaisa korua aroro ogende aande onsi nonya ng’ake.

English: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep. She laid him in her bosom and put her dead son at my bosom.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaondoka katikati ya usiku na kumchukua mwanangu kutoka ubavuni pangu wakati mimi mtumishi wako nilipokuwa nimelala. Akamweka kifuani mwake na kumweka mwanawe aliyekufa kifuani mwangu.
Ekegusii: Erio akaboka botuko gati, akabogoria omwana one omoisia korwa ase rikere riane ensemo, ekero inche, omosomba oo, naraire chitoro, erio akaareria omwana one ase rikere riaye, na akarenta omwana oria oye okwete, akamwareria ase rikere riane.

English: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”
Kiswahili: Wamoabu wakasema, “Ile ni damu! Lazima hao wafalme wamepigana na kuchinjana wao kwa wao. Sasa Moabu, twendeni tukateke nyara!”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateeba: “Aya namanyinga! Abarwoti baria barwanire barabwo ase barabwo na goitana. Ase ayio bono intwe Abamoabu, togende tosakore!”

English: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
Kiswahili: Shamai akamzaa Maoni na Maoni akamzaa Beth-Suri.
Ekegusii: Samai akaibora Maoni, na Maoni akaibora Beti‐Suri.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ninyi mmekuwa wakaidi kuliko mataifa yanayowazunguka na hamkufuata amri zangu wala kuzishika sheria zangu. Wala hamkuweza hata kuzifuata kawaida za mataifa yanayowazunguka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Inwe mwabeire abebura‐buria kobua ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine, gose timobwateti emeroberio y’ane echiikire, gose timorendeti amachiiko ane, na timobwateti nonya namachiiko y’ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”

English: He who considers her ways in his heart will also have knowledge of her secrets.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayezingatia njia zake moyoni mwake atajua pia siri zake.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogosoma ase enchera y'echisemi naende oyokorengereria igoro y'obobisi bwekerengerio kiaye.

English: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hana ndugu wa kiume toa urithi wake kwa ndugu za baba yake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo, omwando oye oirwe nabamura bamwabo ise.

English: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.
Kiswahili: Pumzi ya Mungu hutoa barafu, eneo kubwa la maji huganda.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akorua omoika bw’obokeng’entu obwatania amaache, na amaache oyarenta abwatana oma pa.

English: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Kiswahili: na pia aliwapa Wamerari magari manne ya kukokotwa na maksai wanane, kama kazi yao ilivyohitaji. Wote walikuwa chini ya maelekezo ya Ithamari mwana wa kuhani, Aroni.
Ekegusii: Naende akaa Abamerari chigaari inye, ne chiombe isanaisato, buna emeremo yabo yarenge inse y'oboraai bwa Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani.

English: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto huyu mdogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi, na yeyote atakayenikaribisha mimi, atakuwa amemkaribisha yeye aliyenituma. Kwa maana yeye aliye mdogo miongoni mwenu, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote.”
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyo ase erieta riane, onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete. Ekiagera ere oyore omoke ase egati yaino, oyio nere omonene.” Okworokereria igoro y’okobogorerania (Mar 9:38-40)

English: God does not restrain His anger; the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him.
Kiswahili: Mungu hataizuia hasira yake; hata jeshi kubwa la Rahabu lenye nguvu linajikunyata miguuni pake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.

English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Kiswahili: Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya milima ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
Ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso 'ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.

English: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
Kiswahili: Mvua ikanyesha juu ya nchi siku arobaini usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: na embura egatwa igoro ase ense, rioka rioka ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.

English: and all of them conspired to come and fight against Jerusalem and create a hindrance. Discouragement Overcome
Kiswahili: Wote walifanya shauri pamoja kuja kupigana dhidi ya Yerusalemu, na kuchochea machafuko dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Bakabwatana amo bakabeekana omokia, erinde bagende bonsi amo ase okorwania Yerusalemu na koburukania abakori emeremo.

English: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”
Kiswahili: Vyura wataondoka kwako na katika nyumba zako, kwa maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, ila watabakia katika Mto Naili tu.”
Ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

English: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unababaika, woga unanifanya nitetemeke, gizagiza la jioni nililolitamani sana, limekuwa hofu kuu kwangu.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, omoondoko ombwatire; engaki ya mogoroba eyio naganyete yang'onchokeire na kondetera obwoba.

English: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
Kiswahili: “Ni nani hawa warukao kama mawingu, kama hua kuelekea kwenye viota vyao?
Ekegusii: Mbarabi aba bagoeta buna amare agoeta igoro, aba banga buna amaruma akoiruruka gochia ase ebiswa biabo?

English: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
Kiswahili: Hata ninapoita au kulia ili kuomba msaada, anakataa kupokea maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nonya nkorera neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, ere bwangire koigwa ogosaba kwane.

English: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
Kiswahili: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.

English: “Since I have returned to my kingdom, and am seated on the throne of my fathers, and have established my dominion, and have overthrown Demetrius, and have taken possession of our country—
Kiswahili: "Kwa kuwa nimerudi kwenye ufalme wangu, na nimeketi katika kiti cha enzi cha baba zangu, na nimeimarisha utawala wangu, na nimempindua Demetrio, na nimechukua milki ya nchi yetu ..."
Ekegusii: “Inche nairanire ase borwoti bwane na goikaransera ekerogo kiobonene giechisokoro chiane. Namobuire Demeturio na goonchora eserekari na bono ense nigo ere ase amaboko ane.

English: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kisha nikawatuma Mose na Aroni, nami nikawapiga Wamisri kwa kile nilichokitenda huko, tena nikawatoa ninyi huko.
Ekegusii: Erio ngatoma Musa na Aroni, ngaaka Abamisiri namaakwa aya nabarenterete, na magega y'ayio nkabarusia inwe aroro.

English: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
Kiswahili: Wale waliouawa kwa upanga ni bora kuliko wale wanaokufa njaa; wanateseka kwa njaa, wanatokomea kwa kukosa chakula kutoka shambani.
Ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.

English: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him. Christian Households (Ephesians 6:1–4)
Kiswahili: Lolote mfanyalo, ikiwa ni kwa neno au kwa tendo, fanyeni yote katika jina la Bwana Yesu, mkimshukuru Mungu Baba katika yeye. Kanuni Katika Madaraka Ya Nyumbani
Ekegusii: Na kera eki mogokora, ase amang’ana gose ase ogokora, mokore kera egento ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono goetera asare. Obogima bw’oboamate bw’obokristo

English: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.
Kiswahili: Baada ya taifa lote kutahiriwa, waliendelea kukaa kambini mpaka walipokuwa wamepona.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bakoorire kwarokigwa, abanto bonsi bakabeera aase abo ase egetwori goika bakagwena.

English: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.' “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.'
Kiswahili: unasema, ‘Sina hatia; Mungu hajanikasirikia.' Lakini nitakuhukumu kwa sababu unasema, ‘Mimi sijatenda dhambi.'
Ekegusii: “Nigo mogendererete goteeba: Intwe titori nokomocha, na ase ayio Omonene tari nendamwamu ase tore. Ekiagera mwakanire ng'a timokoreti ebibe, nimbanachere ekiina.

English: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawaambia waziwazi, “Lazaro amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akabateebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okuure.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaziah, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
Kiswahili: Kwa matukio mengine ya utawala wa Ahazia na yale aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Ahasia, na aya akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli.

English: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitamgawia sehemu miongoni mwa wakuu, naye atagawana nyara pamoja na wenye nguvu, kwa sababu aliyamimina maisha yake hadi mauti, naye alihesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji. Kwa kuwa alichukua dhambi za wengi, na kuwaombea wakosaji.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimwatananere abange babe egetari kiaye; ere naatanerwe ebisakorwa amo nabare ne chinguru, ekiagera aruete obogima bwaye agakwa, akabarwa buna noyomo bw’abasaria. Nigo abogoretie ebibe bi’abaanto abange, agasabera abasaria.

English: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Lile gari la kukokotwa lilikuja mpaka kwenye shamba la Yoshua wa Beth-Shemeshi, nalo likasimama kando ya mwamba mkubwa. Watu wakapasua mbao za lile gari la kukokotwa na kutoa dhabihu wale ngʼombe kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero egari eria yaigete ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi egatenenao, ase rigena rinene riarenge. Abanto bagaatia chibao chi’egari eria, erio bakarua chiombe chiria chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene.

English: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”
Kiswahili: Watumishi wake wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini unafanya hivi? Mtoto alipokuwa angali hai, ulifunga na kulia; lakini sasa mtoto amekufa, umeinuka na kula.”
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamoteebia, “Ing'ana ki eri gwakora? Ekero omwana arenge moyo okeng'ata na korera korende bono omwana gakuure, kwaimokire kwarageire.”

English: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yohana akajitahidi kumzuia, akimwambia, “Mimi ninahitaji kubatizwa na wewe, nawe waja kwangu nikubatize?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateeba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha ase 'nde?”

English: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
Kiswahili: Umewatelekeza watu wako, nyumba ya Yakobo. Wamejaa ushirikina utokao Mashariki, wanapiga ramli kama Wafilisti na wanashikana mikono na wapagani.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abaanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabaanto b’echinse chingeni.

English: This is what the LORD says: “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama vile mchungaji aokoavyo kinywani mwa simba vipande viwili tu vya mfupa wa mguu au kipande cha sikio, hivyo ndivyo Waisraeli watakavyookolewa, wale wakaao Samaria kwenye kingo za vitanda vyao, na katika Dameski kwenye viti vyao vya fahari.”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Buna koreng’ana omorisia agotoria korwa ase omonwa bw’endo amagoro abere, gose egetabo ki’ogoto kw’eng’ondi eyio konya endo yarire, naboigo bake barataborigwe, abwo bamenyete Samaria baikaransete ase ebirogo ebiororo na ase emeito etubire nebitambaa bi’ariri.”

English: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, because you will become desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jiwe litakalochukuliwa kutoka kwako kwa ajili ya kufanywa jiwe la pembeni, wala jiwe lolote kwa ajili ya msingi, kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri’ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
Kiswahili: ili kwamba utafute makosa yangu na kuichunguza dhambi yangu;
Ekegusii: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?

English: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa nini wewe wamhukumu ndugu yako? Au kwa nini wewe unamdharau ndugu yako? Kwa kuwa sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha Mungu cha hukumu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, nase ki okogaambia oy’omino? Gose aye, nase ki ogochaaya oy’omino? Inaki intwe twensi inatoche gotenena bosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina kia Nyasae.

English: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
Kiswahili: na kama joto la jangwani. Wewe wanyamazisha makelele ya wageni; kama vile hari ipunguzwavyo na kivuli cha wingu, ndivyo wimbo wa wakatili unyamazishwavyo.
Ekegusii: na buna omobaso bw'eguru‐gura. Aye gwakiririe amariogi 'ababisa; buna omobaso omoororo ogokendigwa ne riire, naboigo namatera 'abaanto abwo abatindi arakendigwe.

English: come death, bloodshed, strife, sword, calamities, famine, suffering, and plague.
Kiswahili: kifo, umwagaji damu, ugomvi, upanga, misiba, njaa, mateso, na tauni.
Ekegusii: Amakweri kera engaki, ogoitera amanyinga, ogoitana neseegi, amakweri, enchara, emechaando na amarwaire.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilimngoja Bwana kwa saburi, naye akaniinamia, akasikia kilio changu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.

English: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo, Kitabu cha Mose kilisomwa kwa sauti kuu, na watu wote wakasikia. Humo ilionekana imeandikwa kwamba hakuna Mwamoni wala Mmoabu atakayeruhusiwa katika kusanyiko la watu wa Mungu,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria abanto bagasomerwa amang'ana Korea ase Egetabu kia Musa, na ekanyorekana eriikire ng'a Abaamoni na Abamoabu tibakobarwa ase omosangererekano bw'abaanto ba Nyasae nonya ng'ake,

English: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo enyi wachungaji, sikieni neno la Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene:

English: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
Kiswahili: Wakati wakitoa maono ya uongo kwa ajili yako, wanapobashiri uongo kwa ajili yako, wanakuweka wewe kwenye shingo za watu wapotovu, wale walio waovu, wale ambao siku yao imewadia, wakati wa adhabu yao ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: “Nigo bakobarorera inwe amaroro y'oborimo, na kobaringoreria oborimo, bateeba ng'a monyare koba abamogotacha ebigoti bi'abakori amabe abwo batachenegeti, ekiagera rituko riabo riachire baraegwe egesusuro ki'omoerio ki'ebibe biabo.

English: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don't bring us over the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Kama tumepata kibali mbele ya macho yako, nchi hii na ipewe watumishi wako kama milki yetu. Usitufanye tuvuke Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Naende bagateeba, “Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa korwa ase ore, tiga intwe, abasomba bao, toegwe ense eye ebe eyaito, korende tobaisa gotwambokia gochia ng'umbu ya Yorodani komenyao.”

English: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: “Farao, yeye pamoja na jeshi lake lote, atakapowaona atafarijiwa kwa ajili ya makundi yake yote ya wajeuri, wale waliouawa kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ekero Farao ararore abwo baitetwe, nigo areremie ase engencho y’emeganda yaye yonsi eyio yaitetwe nemioro.

English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
Kiswahili: Ninyi vipofu wapumbavu! Ni kipi kilicho kikuu zaidi: ni ile dhahabu, au ni lile Hekalu linaloifanya hiyo dhahabu kuwa takatifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?

English: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
Kiswahili: Efraimu ameonewa, amekanyagwa katika hukumu kwa kuwa amekusudia kufuatia sanamu.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu baregirwe na gotiringerwa inse ase ekiina, ekiagera beruete ase okobwatia emeroberio ya bosa.

English: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
Kiswahili: Aliagiza amri kwa Yakobo na akaweka sheria katika Israeli, ambazo aliwaamuru baba zetu wawafundishe watoto wao,
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b'ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.

English: Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.”
Kiswahili: Warudishieni mara moja mashamba yao, mashamba yao ya mizabibu, mashamba yao ya mizeituni, na nyumba zao, pia riba yao mnayowatoza na sehemu ya fungu la mia la fedha, nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta.”
Ekegusii: Bono rituko ria reero bairanerie ebio bionsi baboreretigwe baakane: amaremo abo, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, edivai, ne chinyomba amo nebitoki bie chitaabu mwabeire mokoboria.”

English: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo hutakula tena watu wala kulifanya tena taifa lako lisiwe na watoto, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono tokogenderera koria abanto, gose goita abana b'egesaku kiao. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
Kiswahili: wakasema, “Enyi watu wa Galilaya, mbona mnasimama mkitazama juu angani? Huyu Yesu aliyechukuliwa kutoka kwenu kwenda Mbinguni, atarudi tena jinsi iyo hiyo mlivyomwona akienda zake Mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora: “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie gochia igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa as more kogenda igoro, naboigo naende arairane koreng'ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.”

English: Because of her, I will have immortality, and leave behind an eternal memory to those who come after me.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu yake, nitakuwa na kutokufa, na nitawaachia kumbukumbu ya milele wale wanaokuja baada yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'obong'aini nigo ndaegwe ogotakwa, na baria barache magega yane mbanginyore botambe.

English: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikiire ng'a baria bakorandia enchiri banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchiri.

English: From Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their associates—the judges and officials over Tripolis, Persia, Erech and Babylon, the Elamites of Susa,
Kiswahili: Rehumu afisa msimamizi na mwandishi Shimshai, pamoja na wenzao, yaani mahakimu na maafisa walio juu ya watu kuanzia Tripoli, Uajemi, Ereki na Babeli, Waelami wa Shushani,
Ekegusii: Erio Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na abande babwataine nabarabwo: abagaambi ebiina, na abagabana, na abanene b’oborwoti, na Abaayemi, na Abaereki, na Abaababeli, na Abasusa korwa ase ense y’Abaelamu,

English: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umependezwa nami, nifundishe njia zako ili nipate kukujua, nami nizidi kupata kibali mbele zako. Kumbuka kuwa taifa hili ni watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabaanto bao bare.”

English: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu anayevumilia wakati wa majaribu, kwa sababu akiisha kushinda hilo jaribio atapewa taji la uzima Mungu alilowaahidia wale wampendao.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y'obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Yahweh commanded.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Njoo madhabahuni ili utoe dhabihu yako ya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, ufanye upatanisho kwa ajili yako mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya watu. Kisha utoe sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Suka gochia ang'e ase egesasiimero, na orue ekeng'wanso kiao ki'ebibe na eki'ogosaambwa, okore okobwatanigwa ase ore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng'wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, buna Omonene achiigete.”

English: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kutambua makosa yake? Nisamehe makosa yangu nisiyoyajua.
Ekegusii: Ning'o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.

English: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja wakati wa jioni Daudi aliinuka kitandani mwake na kutembeatembea juu ya paa la jumba lake la kifalme. Kutokea kule kwenye paa, akamwona mwanamke akioga. Mwanamke huyo alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura,
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko erimo chinsa chia mogoroba, Daudi akaimoka korwa borere bwaye, akariina kerama igoro, ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti. Ekero areenge gotaarao, akarora omokungu ogwesibia, na omokungu oyio nigo arenge omonyakieni mono.

English: If he is presenting a lamb for his offering, he must present it before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kama akimtoa mwana-kondoo, atamleta mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onye okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye, erio ayerue ase obosio bwane.

English: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
Kiswahili: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.

English: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe napondaponda mwanaume na mwanamke, kwa wewe napondaponda mzee na kijana, kwa wewe napondaponda kijana wa kiume na mwanamwali,
Ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore abasacha na abakungu, ninsamunyore abanto abagotu na abake, ninsamunyore abamura na abaiseke;

English: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Korende magega y'okobooka kw'ane, nimbatang'anere kogenda Galili.”

English: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ueni kabisa chochote kilicho ndani yenu cha asili ya kidunia: yaani uasherati, uchafu, tamaa mbaya, mawazo mabaya na ulafi, ambayo ndiyo ibada ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo moite kende gionsi ekio kere ime yaino ekio kere egi’ense: obotomani, eubi, okorengereria okobe, okogania okobe, na obwegimeria, engencho yaye ogosasiima emegwekano.

English: Then He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones come to life?” “O Lord GOD,” I replied, “only You know.”
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Mwanadamu, mifupa hii yaweza kuishi?” Nikajibu, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe peke yako wajua.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, amauga aya nanyare koba moyo?” Nkairaneria, nkamoteebia: “Aye Omonene, naye omanyete.”

English: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuja na ngurumo, tetemeko la ardhi, na kwa sauti kuu, atakuja na dhoruba, tufani na miali ya moto iteketezayo.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.

English: The brothers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy remained in Berea.
Kiswahili: Mara hiyo, wale ndugu wakamsafirisha Paulo hadi pwani, lakini Sila na Timotheo wakabaki Beroya.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima abaminto baria bagatoma Paulo agende goika nyancha, korende Sila na Timotheo bagatigara aroro.

English: Raise a banner on a barren hilltop; call aloud to them. Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.
Kiswahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya mlima usio na kitu, wapazieni sauti, wapungieni mkono waingie katika malango ya wenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abasikari, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi’abaanto abasike.

English: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiutupe ujasiri wenu, kwa maana una thawabu kubwa mno.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.

English: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.

English: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

English: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana alipoanza kuzungumza kupitia Hosea, Bwana alimwambia, “Nenda ukajitwalie mwanamke wa uzinzi na watoto wa uzinzi, kwa sababu nchi ina hatia ya uzinzi wa kupindukia kwa kumwacha Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamoteebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”

English: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
Kiswahili: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.

English: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
Kiswahili: na yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa mtumwa wa wote.
Ekegusii: Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, nabe omosomba o bonsi.

English: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.
Kiswahili: Nahuzunika kwa ajili yako, Yonathani ndugu yangu, kwangu ulikuwa mpendwa sana. Upendo wako kwangu ulikuwa wa ajabu, wa ajabu zaidi kuliko ule wa wanawake.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yonathani ominto, nigo inde nomoichano omonene ase engencho yao, aye nigo konya ongogetie mono. Ase inde obwanchani bwao nigo bwarenge obonene kobua obwanchani bw'abakuungu.

English: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD, and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa jumuiya wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali aliye mbele za Bwana, naye fahali atachinjwa mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase obosio bwane abagaaka b’omoganda oria goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio, na ero enyenyerwe agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi mtesi alivyokudhihaki, jinsi watu wapumbavu walivyolitukana jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.

English: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, yeyote miongoni mwenu akipotoka na kuicha kweli, naye akarejezwa na mtu mwingine,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,

English: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
Kiswahili: “Basi, baada ya kutokuwepo kwa miaka mingi nilikuja Yerusalemu ili kuwaletea watu wangu msaada kwa ajili ya maskini na kutoa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Bono yaetire emiaka etai meke ngacha ndetere abanto b’egesaku kiane ebiegwa, naende indue chisadaka.

English: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya watu wako Israeli kuwa watu wako wewe mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana Mungu, umekuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.

English: Behold, the Gentiles are assembled together against us to destroy us. You know what things they imagine against us.
Kiswahili: Tazama, mataifa wamekusanyika pamoja dhidi yetu ili kutuangamiza. Unajua wanachopanga dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: Rora bono, abanto b'ebisaku basangererekanire batosirie; naye nomanyete emeroberio eyio emebe bakorire mamincha yaito.

English: They will speak among themselves repenting, and for distress of spirit they will groan, “This was he whom we used to hold in derision, as a parable of reproach.
Kiswahili: Watasema wao kwa wao wakitubu, na kwa huzuni ya roho wataugua, "Huyu ndiye tuliyemdhihaki, kama mfano wa lawama."
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbaangame nagweitia ase emioyo yabo bagoteeba,

English: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
Kiswahili: “Tazama, naja upesi! Amebarikiwa yeye ayashikaye maneno ya unabii wa kitabu hiki.”
Ekegusii: Rigereria, ninchiche bwango.” Nasesenirie ere oyorendete amang'ana 'obobani, ayarikire ase egetabu eke.

English: If you don't quickly prevent them, they will do greater things than these, and you won't be able to control them.
Kiswahili: Usipowazuia haraka, watafanya mambo makubwa kuliko haya, na hutaweza kuwadhibiti.
Ekegusii: Aye otakoreti bwango ase okobatanga rirorio barabwo inabakore amange naye tokonyara kobatanga.”

English: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninajisifu katika Kristo Yesu, kwenye utumishi wangu kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Bono ninde n'engencho y'okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo y'ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia yoyote ya kuokoa uhai wa muuaji ambaye anastahili kufa. Mtu huyo hakika lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire n'okomocha kw'ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Utumishi wao wote ukiwa ni kuchukua au wa kufanya kazi nyingine, utafanyika chini ya maelekezo ya Aroni na wanawe. Mtawapangia kama wajibu wao yote watakayoyafanya.
