Ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.

English: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unisikie na kunihurumia, Ee Bwana, uwe msaada wangu.”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amaabera! Omonene, inkonye!

English: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
Kiswahili: “Adui zetu wote wamefumbua vinywa vyao wazi dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.

English: All this I tested by wisdom, saying, “I resolve to be wise.” But it was beyond me.
Kiswahili: Yote haya niliyajaribu kwa hekima, nikasema, “Nimeamua kuwa na hekima”: lakini hii ilikuwa nje ya uwezo wangu.
Ekegusii: Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateeba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa ase ’nde.

English: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
Kiswahili: Mtu maskini huomba kuhurumiwa bali tajiri hujibu kwa ukali.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.

English: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
Kiswahili: ya tatu Harimu, ya nne Seorimu,
Ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;

English: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, wala si kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu tu, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhambi za ulimwengu wote.
Ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.

English: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
Kiswahili: Sethi aliishi jumla ya miaka 912, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.

English: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Nipeni na mimi uwezo huu ili kila mtu nitakayeweka mikono yangu juu yake apate kupokea Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: agateeba: “Ing'a nainche okobua oko, ng'a kera omonto ndabeekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”

English: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sikiliza dua ya mtumishi wako na maombi yake kwa huruma, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Sikia kilio na dua ambayo mtumishi wako anaomba mbele zako siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo; oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, nkogosaba.

English: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
Kiswahili: Gaagaa kwa utungu, ee Binti Sayuni, kama mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa, kwa kuwa sasa ni lazima uuache mji ukapige kambi uwanjani. Utakwenda Babeli; huko utaokolewa. Huko Bwana atakukomboa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw'omokuungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babiloni, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko 'ababisa baino.

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: ‘Kwa kuwa wote mmekuwa takataka ya chuma, nitawakusanya Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya n'aro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera inwe mwensi mwabeire buna amabiria, rora nimbasangererie, 'mbarente ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu,

English: so that he detests his bread, and his soul loathes his favorite food.
Kiswahili: kiasi kwamba maisha yake yenyewe yanakataa chakula nayo nafsi yake ikakichukia kabisa hata chakula kizuri.
Ekegusii: Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.

English: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
Kiswahili: Paulo akashuka chini, akajitupa juu yake na kumkumbatia, akasema, “Msishtuke, uzima wake bado umo ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”

English: On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo, Shina la Yese atasimama kama bendera kwa ajili ya mataifa. Mataifa yatakusanyika kwake, na mahali pake pa kupumzikia patakuwa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Oyore Egesebo kie ritina ria Yese natenene abe ekemanyererio ase abanto; abanto b’ebisaku mbamorigie, na obomenyo bwaye mbobe nobonene obonge.

English: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
Kiswahili: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,
Ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori ase 'nde. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora

English: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kuhusu kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu: Tunajua kwamba “Sanamu si kitu chochote kabisa duniani,” na kwamba “Kuna Mungu mmoja tu.”
Ekegusii: Gaki ase amang'ana ay'okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing'wanso ase emegwekano y'ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng'a “omogwekano bw'ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng'a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”

English: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
Kiswahili: “Aroni atamtoa huyo fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka yake ya dhambi ili afanye upatanisho kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani arue eeri ebe ekeng'wanso ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b'enka yaye, erinde baaberwe.

English: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini mmegeuka mkaiacha njia, na kwa mafundisho yenu mmesababisha wengi kujikwaa. Mmevunja agano na Lawi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y'amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw'ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba.

English: This is what the LORD says: “What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me, and followed worthless idols, and became worthless themselves?
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “Je, baba zenu waliona kosa gani kwangu, hata wakatangatanga mbali nami hivyo? Walifuata sanamu zisizofaa, nao wenyewe wakawa hawafai.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Mbobe ki chisokoro chiaino chiaroche ase ’nde, erinde chigantiga, chikagenda gosasiima emegwekano ere bosa nabarabwo bakaba bosa?

English: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God's dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
Kiswahili: Nami nikasikia sauti kubwa kutoka kile kiti cha enzi ikisema, “Sasa makao ya Mungu ni pamoja na wanadamu, naye atakaa pamoja nao. Yeye atakuwa Mungu wao nao watakuwa watu wake, naye Mungu mwenyewe atakuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene rikorwa ase ekerogo keria ki'obonene rigoteeba, “Rora obomenyo bwa Nyasae nigo bore amo na Mwanyabaanto. Ere namenye amo nabarabwo, na barabwo nababe abanto baye, na Nyasae omonyene nabe amo nabarabwo.

English: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
Kiswahili: Chini ya mabawa yao katika pande zao nne walikuwa na mikono ya mwanadamu. Wote wanne walikuwa na nyuso na mabawa,
Ekegusii: Inse ye chimbaaba chiabo, ase chinsemo chiabo inye, nigo biabwate amaboko buna aya Mwanyabaanto. Amasio abo ne chimbaaba chiabo nigo biarenge iga:

English: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kumbukeni kwamba ninyi ambao hapo awali mlikuwa watu wa Mataifa kwa kuzaliwa na kuitwa “wasiotahiriwa” na wale wanaojiita “waliotahiriwa” (yaani tohara ifanyikayo katika mwili kwa mikono ya wanadamu),
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwareenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingeencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa n’amaboko.

English: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
Kiswahili: “Tumelichunguza hili, nalo ni kweli. Hivyo lisikie na ulitendee kazi.”
Ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang'ana ayio; naro nay'ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang'ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”

English: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.

English: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Sabato ilipomalizika, Maria Magdalene, Maria mama yake Yakobo, na Salome walinunua manukato ili wakaupake mwili wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta yamanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.

English: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
Kiswahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa amekuwa mwema kwangu.
Ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.

English: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, conquering Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and the whole land of Naphtali, including the region of Chinnereth.
Kiswahili: Ben-Hadadi akakubaliana na Mfalme Asa na kutuma majemadari wa majeshi yake dhidi ya miji ya Israeli. Akaishinda miji ya Iyoni, Dani, Abel-Beth-Maaka na Kinerethi yote, pamoja na Naftali.
Ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akaigwera Asa omorwoti, agatoma abatang’ani b’abarwani baye, bakagenda bakarwania emechie y’Abaisraeli, bakabua Iyoni na Dani, na Abeli‐Beti‐Maaka, na Galili, yonsi, amo nense yonsi ya Nafutali.

English: Yahweh says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama jinsi maji yanavyoinuka huko kaskazini, yatakuwa mafuriko yenye nguvu sana. Yataifurikia nchi na vitu vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, miji na wale waishio ndani yake. Watu watapiga kelele; wote waishio katika nchi wataomboleza
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Naama! Amache naimokerere igoro korwa sugusu, naichore aminyoke buna emegoko emenene, naichore na gotuba ense na bionsi ebire aroro; namere emechie na bonsi abamenyeteo. Erio abanto mbarere, na abamenyi bonsi b'ense eyio mbarere na kweng'ereria.

English: Judas returned to plunder the camp, and they took much gold, silver, blue, sea purple, and great riches.
Kiswahili: Yuda alirudi kupora kambi, nao wakachukua dhahabu nyingi, fedha, bluu, zambarau ya bahari, na utajiri mwingi.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akairana akaira ekambi eyio ya ababisa; bakanyoora etaabu ne chifeta chinyinge, chianga chia buluu na echia monyiinga ne chinibo chinyinge.

English: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alipofika katika eneo la Kaisaria-Filipi, akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Watu husema kwamba mimi Mwana wa Adamu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso acha ensemo ya Kaisaria Filipi, akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Inee! Abanto nigo bakobora ng'a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere ng'o?”

English: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuzama jua Yoshua akaamuru, nao wakawashusha kutoka kwenye ile miti na kuwatupa kwenye lile pango ambalo walikuwa wamejificha. Kwenye mdomo wa lile pango wakaweka mawe makubwa, ambayo yapo hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachiika ng'a ebitondo bi'abaanto baria bisungorwe, bitugutwe ase rikuruma riria bebisete, na abanto bagakora bo. Naende bakabeeka amagena amanene ase egesoero kie rikuruma, nao are goika reero iga.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, mfalme huzifurahia nguvu zako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo kuu furaha yake kwa ushindi unaompa!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, omorwoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.

English: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw'Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.

English: On the following day, when it had become necessary, Judas and his company came to take up the bodies of those who had fallen, and in company with their kinsmen to bring them back to the sepulchres of their ancestors.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, ilipobidi, Yuda na kundi lake walikuja kuchukua miili ya wale waliouawa, na pamoja na ndugu zao ili kuirudisha kwenye makaburi ya mababu zao.
Ekegusii: Rituko riare kobwatia magega y'Esabato bakarora nga mbuya, erio ase obwango bagasangereria emebere y'abamwabo abwo bakwete ase esegi bakayetindeka ase chimbera chi'echisokoro chiabo.

English: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said, “Get up, leave my people, both you and the Israelites! Go, worship the LORD as you have requested.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Farao akawaita Mose na Aroni na kuwaambia, “Ondokeni! Tokeni kwa watu wangu, ninyi pamoja na Waisraeli! Nendeni mkamwabudu Bwana kama mlivyoomba.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni obotuko boria, akabateebia, “Imoka, morue aa ase abanto baane, inwe na Abaisraeli bonsi! Genda mokorere Omonene buna mwabeire mokoboria!

English: At that moment the sentence against Nebuchadnezzar was fulfilled. He was driven away from mankind. He ate grass like an ox, and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven, until his hair grew like the feathers of an eagle and his nails like the claws of a bird. Nebuchadnezzar Restored
Kiswahili: Papo hapo yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kuhusu Nebukadneza yakatimia. Alifukuzwa mbali na wanadamu, akala majani kama ngʼombe. Mwili wake uliloweshwa kwa umande wa mbinguni mpaka nywele zake zikakua kama manyoya ya tai na kucha zake kama makucha ya ndege.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ring’ana riria rigaikeranigwa igoro ya Nebukadinesaro. Agaserigwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto, akaba okorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe; omobere oye okaba okonyirirerwa ne riime rikorwa igoro, goika etukia yaye egakina ekaba entambe buna amarionya y’ebiongo, ne chinchara chiaye chigakina chikaba buna echie chinyoni. Nebukadinesaro okomotogia Nyasae

English: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
Kiswahili: Okoa maisha yangu na upanga, uhai wangu wa thamani kutoka nguvu za mbwa.
Ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase omoro bw’amakweri, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!

English: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
Kiswahili: Israeli na washangilie katika Muumba wao, watu wa Sayuni na wafurahi katika Mfalme wao.
Ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omorwoti obo!

English: In a man's prosperity, his enemies are grieved. In his adversity, even his friend leaves.
Kiswahili: Katika ustawi wa mtu, maadui zake huhuzunika. Katika shida yake, hata rafiki yake huondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto asesenigwe, abasani baye nigo bakoba n'obororo mono kegima. Nonya nabo, ekero ki'obokong'u nonya n'abasani baye abanyene nigo bakomotama.

English: In the second month, a very great assembly gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
Kiswahili: Basi umati mkubwa wa watu ukakusanyika huko Yerusalemu kuadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu katika mwezi wa pili.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o kabere, abanto abange mono bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu korenda Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera.

English: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Kiswahili: Utasema kila kitu nitakachokuagiza, naye Aroni ndugu yako atamwambia Farao awaachie Waisraeli watoke katika nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Aye oteebie oyomino Aroni ayio onsi nagochikiire, na ere akwane na Farao, amoteebie ng'a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.

English: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”
Kiswahili: Wakaniambia, “Wale walionusurika kwenda uhamishoni, wale ambao wamerudi kwenye lile jimbo, wako katika taabu kubwa na aibu. Ukuta wa Yerusalemu umebomoka, na malango yake yamechomwa moto.”
Ekegusii: Bakang'iraneria, baganteebia, “Abatigari baria batooretigwe korwa ase obosomba bare ase orogongo rwabo, nigo bare ase emechando emenene na ogochaywa okonene Orwaki rwa Yerusalemu rwatagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe nomorero.”

English: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni rafiki zangu mkifanya ninayowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachiikire.

English: I loved her more than health and beauty, and I chose to have her rather than light, because her bright shining is never laid to sleep.
Kiswahili: Nilimpenda zaidi kuliko afya na uzuri, na nilichagua kuwa naye badala ya mwanga, kwa sababu mwangaza wake mkali haulazimishwi kamwe.
Ekegusii: Nigo nanchete chisemi kobua ekieni na okoba buya, nigo nanchete obongaini obo kobua oborabu bw'erisase, ase engencho oborabu bwaye tibori korima nonya ngake.

English: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
Kiswahili: Yoela na Zebadia, wana wa Yerohamu, kutoka Gedori.
Ekegusii: Yoela na Sebadia, basinto ba Yerohamu, korwa Gedori. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi

English: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
Kiswahili: Majivuno yako yote yameshushwa mpaka kuzimu, pamoja na kelele ya vinubi vyako, mafunza yametanda chini yako, na minyoo imekufunika.
Ekegusii: Obonene bwao amo namariogi 'amakano ao biarentirwe aiga aase abakuure; ebinyegera nabio ekeraarero kiao na amakonde naro ekiebisio kiao.

English: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
Kiswahili: Watu 1,000 watakimbia kwa ajili ya kitisho cha mtu mmoja, kwa vitishio vya watu watano wote mtakimbia, hadi mtakapoachwa kama mlingoti wa bendera juu ya kilele cha mlima, kama bendera juu ya kilima.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baino elifu eyemo mbaserigwe ase okogoswa nomonto oyomo, gose nabaanto batano, goika abatigari baino babe buna omoenga oyomo ore ase egetunwa igoro, na buna ekemanyererio keimokereirie ase ekerogo igoro.

English: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
Kiswahili: siku hiyo atakayetoroka atakuja kuwapasha habari.
Ekegusii: ase rituko erio omonto oratooreke natame gochia ase ore, akorentere amang'ana.

English: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.
Kiswahili: Basi Rekabu na Baana, wana wa Rimoni Mbeerothi wakaenda nyumbani kwa Ish-Boshethi, nao walifika huko wakati alipokuwa kwenye mapumziko yake ya mchana.
Ekegusii: Rekabu na Baana, basinto ba Rimoni Omobeeroti, bagachaaka orogendo rw'abo, na ekero kia mobaso gati bagaika ase enyomba ya Isi‐Boseti, bakamonyora otimogete nyomba mwaye okendererete.

English: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
Kiswahili: Lakini watakuwepo wenye kuokoka, wana na binti wataletwa kutoka nje ya nchi hiyo. Watawajia ninyi, nanyi mtakapoona mwenendo wao na matendo yao, mtafarijika kuhusu maafa niliyoleta juu ya Yerusalemu, kwa ajili ya yale yote niliyoleta juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo 'mbatigare abanto bande bare moyo, amo nabana baabo, abamura na abaiseke. Abwo mbasoke korwao bache ase more. Ekero baraache, morigererie orogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo. Erio nario moraisaneke ng'a egesusuro ekio naruete igoro ya Yerusalemu, na aya onsi nayokorerete ase engencho y'ebibe biaye nay'oboronge.

English: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
Kiswahili: “Mikono yako ndiyo iliyoniumba na kunifanya. Je, sasa utageuka na kuniangamiza?
Ekegusii: “Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang'onchokeire na gonsiria.

English: The second thanksgiving choir proceeded to the left, and I followed it with half the people along the top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
Kiswahili: Kundi la pili la waimbaji lilielekea upande wa kushoto. Niliwafuata juu ya ukuta, pamoja na nusu ya watu kupitia Mnara wa Tanuru mpaka kwenye Ukuta Mpana,
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kende ki’abateri baria barenge goteera amatera ay’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bakagenda gochia ensemo y’okobee igoro ase orwaki roria, na inche amo nekeng’ese ki’abaanto tokababwatia, tokagenda goetera ase Omorobiri bw’eriko, gochia ase Orwaki Orogare.

English: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
Kiswahili: Utayacheka maangamizo na njaa, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuwaogopa wanyama wakali wa mwituni.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching'iti chintindi chire ase ense.

English: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
Kiswahili: Bwana na akulipe kwa yale uliyoyatenda. Ubarikiwe kwa wingi na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye umekimbilia mabawani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”

English: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo yeye pia ana hekima na anaweza kuleta maafa, wala hayatangui maneno yake. Yeye atainuka dhidi ya nyumba ya mwovu, dhidi ya wale ambao huwasaidia watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo are omong'aini na nigo akorenta obobe gose tari koonchora amang'ana aye. Nae eamate y'abakori amabe egesusuro, boigo nae abakoonyi b'abagokora amabe egesusuro.

English: then You would plunge me into the pit, and even my own clothes would despise me.
Kiswahili: wewe ungenitupa kwenye shimo la utelezi kiasi kwamba hata nguo zangu zingenichukia sana.
Ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.

English: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
Kiswahili: Wanawaambia mama zao, “Wapi mkate na divai?” wazimiapo kama watu waliojeruhiwa katika barabara za mji, maisha yao yadhoofikavyo mikononi mwa mama zao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoboria abang’ina: “Ng’ai endagera ere, na edivai?” Nigo bakona‐kogireka na korara ase chinchera chi’omochie buna abaakirwe chingoma, batweka mo ase amaboko ’abang’ina.

English: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
Kiswahili: Mungu huwaweka wapweke katika jamaa, huwaongoza wafungwa wakiimba, bali waasi huishi katika nchi kame.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo kegima.

English: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu wa baba zao, nao wakafanya ukahaba kwa miungu ya mataifa, ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameyaangamiza mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto b'ebisaku bia moocha bagakora ogosaria ase Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakora obotayayi, bakabwatia chinyasae chi'abaanto b'ense eria, abwo Nyasae asiretie korwa ase bare.

English: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya shaba juu ya ile nguzo moja ilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa tano, na ilikuwa imepambwa kwa wavu na makomamanga ya shaba kuizunguka kote. Ile nguzo nyingine pamoja na makomamanga yake ilifanana na hiyo ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Na igoro ase kera esiiro, egesure nkiarengeo kiaroiseirie etai, na obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw'amaboko atano. Egechanga na emegwekano y'amatunda amakomomanga biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai, nigo biaetanaine egesure keria.

English: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
Kiswahili: “Yale yaliyotupata ni matokeo ya matendo yetu mabaya, pia hatia yetu kubwa. Hata hivyo, wewe Mungu wetu, umetuadhibu kidogo kuliko dhambi zetu zilivyostahili na umetupa mabaki kama haya.
Ekegusii: Na bono nonya amang’ana aya onsi aikire gotonyora ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito okobe, na okomocha gwaito okonene, twarorire ng’a aye, Nyasae oito, totoeti egesusuro buna ebibe biaito bigwenerete, korende gwatotigeire abatigari buna aba iga.

English: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimestahimili dharau kwa ajili yako, aibu imefunika uso wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.

English: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa Wahori: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,
Ekegusii: Na abagaambi barwete ase Abahori nabwo aba: Omogambi Lotani, na omogambi Sobali, na omogambi Sibeoni, na omogambi Ana,

English: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
Kiswahili: Kama akija peke yake, atakwenda huru peke yake, lakini kama akija na mke, ataondoka pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokuungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.

English: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjibu, “Wewe una pepo mchafu! Ni nani anayetaka kukuua?”
Ekegusii: Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”

English: But above all things, my brothers, don't swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don't fall into hypocrisy.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, ndugu zangu, msiape, iwe kwa mbingu au kwa dunia, au kwa kitu kingine chochote. “Ndiyo” yenu na iwe ndiyo, na “Hapana” yenu iwe hapana, la sivyo mtahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende abaminto, kobua ase onsi timotiana, ase igoro, gose ase ense, gose koria muma ende yonsi, korende “ee” yaino ebe “ee”, na “yaya” yaino ebe “yaya”, timocha kobekwa inse y'okogambigwa.

English: Then the cloud that overshadowed the camp was seen, and dry land rising up out of what had been water, out of the Red sea an unhindered highway, and a grassy plain out of the violent surge,
Kiswahili: Kisha wingu lililofunika kambi likaonekana, na nchi kavu ikainuka kutoka katika kile kilichokuwa maji, kutoka Bahari ya Shamu njia kuu isiyozuiliwa, na uwanda wenye nyasi kutoka kwenye mawimbi makali,
Ekegusii: Igoro nigo yabakengete n'ekiiriri, na amaache agakama korwa roche erio bagatara ense enyomo, y'obonyansi bokaama gati y'emerindo y'enyancha, bakanyora enchera ase bagoeta.

English: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakakusanya kusanyiko pamoja mbele ya huo mwamba, naye Mose akawaambia, “Sikilizeni, enyi waasi. Je, ni lazima tuwatoleeni maji kutoka mwamba huu?”
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bosio bw'egetare keria, akabateebia, “Igwa inwe abasaria aba! Inee! 'Nkobasokeria tore amaache korwa ase egetare eke?”

English: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni hili, enyi wazee; sikilizeni, ninyi nyote mnaoishi katika nchi. Je, jambo kama hili lilishawahi kutokea katika siku zenu au katika siku za babu zenu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang'ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ya Yuda, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang'ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?

English: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Wabenyamini kutoka Geba waliishi Mikmashi, Aiya, Betheli na makazi yake,
Ekegusii: Abanto b'egesaku kia Benjamini bakaba bakomenya gochakera Geba na kogenderera goikera Mikimasi, na Aiya, na Beteli na ase ebichie biaye;

English: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote yatauliza: “Kwa nini Bwana amefanya hivi juu ya nchi hii? Kwa nini hasira hii kali ikawaka?”
Ekegusii: Ee, ebisaku bionsi ’mbiboorie: Ninki kiagerete Omonene akorete ense eye ekaba iga? ’Naki endamwamu yaye yokire iga?

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
Kiswahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya nafaka pamoja na sadaka ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ebing'wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw'endagera na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: The Lord removed sleep from the king that night; so he told his servant to bring in the books, the registers of daily events, to read to him.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaondoa usingizi kutoka kwa mfalme usiku huo; kwa hivyo akamwambia mtumishi wake alete vitabu, orodha ya matukio ya kila siku, ili asome mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria omorwoti taraarete chitoro; agachiika arenterwe egetabu kerikire amang'ana y'ebiro ayio arenge gokoreka agwenerete koinyorwa, n'amang'ana ayio agasomwa asare.

English: For the Lord repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana hulipa, naye atakulipa mara saba.
Ekegusii: Orwe ebiegwa biao bionsi ase omoyo omorabu, ochirwe chisadaka chiao chionsi ase omogooko.

English: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.
Kiswahili: Usiongeze wala usipunguze chochote ninachowaamuru ninyi, ila myashike maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu ambayo nawapa.
Ekegusii: Timomenta ring'ana rinde rionsi ase aria nabachiikire, gose timorusia gento aroro. Mobwate amachiiko y'Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio inche nabaeire.

English: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
Kiswahili: “Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya mbingu ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
Ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n’endamwamu.

English: So all the service of Yahweh was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on Yahweh's altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakati ule huduma yote ya Bwana ilifanyika katika kuadhimisha Pasaka, kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya Bwana kama alivyoamuru Mfalme Yosia.
Ekegusii: Igo aya onsi ay'okomokorera Omonene nigo akoretwe ase rituko riria; nigo barendete Epasaka bakarua okoruegwa kw'ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa ase egesasiimero ki'Omonene, buna Yosia omorwoti achigete.

English: because they have abandoned Me and made this a foreign place. They have burned incense in this place to other gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have ever known. They have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wameniacha na kupafanya mahali hapa kuwa pa miungu ya kigeni. Wameiteketezea sadaka miungu ambayo wao wala baba zao wala wafalme wa Yuda kamwe hawakuijua, nao wamelijaza eneo hili kwa damu isiyo na hatia.
Ekegusii: Ninkore ayio, ekiagera abanto bantigire na bakorire aase aiga abeire aya atachenegeti ase ogosamba ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, chiria barabwo, gose chisokoro chiabo, gose abarwoti b’Abayuda, batamanyete, Naende baichoirie aase aiga namanyinga ’abaanto batari na komocha.

English: You are also to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel and Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.
Kiswahili: Pia mtie mafuta Yehu mwana wa Nimshi awe mfalme wa Israeli, na umtie Elisha mwana wa Shafati kutoka Abel-Mehola mafuta awe nabii badala yako.
Ekegusii: Naende Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, omoake amaguta, omobeke abe omorwoti igoro y’Abaisraeli; na Elisha, mosinto o Safati, korwa Abeli‐Mehola omoake amaguta, abe omobani ase ribaga riao.

English: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.
Kiswahili: Nitageuza uso wangu mbali nao, nao waovu wa dunia watapanajisi mahali pangu pa thamani, wanyangʼanyi watapaingia na kupanajisi.
Ekegusii: Ning’onchore obosio bwane korwa ase bare, erinde bakore ekungo y’ane ebe eyetachenegeti; abauri mbasoe aroro na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti.

English: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
Kiswahili: Nitakufanya uwe na uzao mwingi sana, kwako yatatoka mataifa nao wafalme watatoka kwako.
Ekegusii: Ninkomente obe na ororeeria oronge mono, ninkore ebisaku ebinge birue asore, na abarwoti nabarue asore boigo.

English: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.” Moses Appoints Leaders (Exodus 18:13–27)
Kiswahili: Tazama, nimewapa ninyi nchi hii. Ingieni mkaimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana aliapa kuwa angaliwapa baba zenu, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, pamoja na vizazi vyao baada yao.” Uteuzi Wa Viongozi (Kutoka 18:13-27)
Ekegusii: Eyio yonsi n’ense inche Omonene nariete eira koa chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, chisokoro chiaino, amo n’abanto b’ororeeria rwabo. Genda moyeire.” Musa ogochoora abagaambi (Okong’ 18:13-27)

English: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
Kiswahili: Alipomwambia baba yake pamoja na ndugu zake, baba yake akamkemea akisema, “Ni ndoto gani hii uliyoota? Hivi kweli mama yako na mimi na ndugu zako tutakuja kukusujudia wewe hadi nchi?”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero ateebetie ise na bamura bamwabo amang'ana ayio, ise akamotogonyera, akamobooria: “nkoroota ki okwo okoroota? Inee! Inche na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amaene, nigo torache togotugamere togosasime aye?”

English: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
Kiswahili: Samweli alipoyasogeza makabila yote ya Israeli, kabila la Benyamini likachaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli akarenta ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli ang’e, na egesaku gia Benjamini kegachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera.

English: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Kiswahili: Basi Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase hakuwa na wana waume ila mabinti tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.
Ekegusii: Korende Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase, taiborete abana abamura, otatiga abaiseke boka. Amarieta 'abaiseke aba naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

English: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mnyama aliibwa kwa jirani, itampasa amlipe mwenye mnyama.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.

English: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba Kristo, kwa sababu alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, hawezi kufa tena; mauti haina tena mamlaka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakuure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogaambera naende.

English: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.
Kiswahili: Kama mawingu yamejaa maji, hunyesha mvua juu ya nchi. Kama mti ukianguka kuelekea kusini au kuelekea kaskazini, mahali ulipoangukia, hapo ndipo utakapolala.
Ekegusii: Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya Irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.

English: Mercy is as welcome in the time of his affliction, as clouds of rain in the time of drought.
Kiswahili: Rehema inakaribishwa wakati wa mateso yake, kama mawingu ya mvua wakati wa ukame.
Ekegusii: Ere oria okomokorera Omonene ase okomogookia nigo agwancherwa nere, ogosaba kwaye inagoike igoro.

English: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
Kiswahili: Ijapo watu elfu wataangukia kando yako, kumi elfu mkono wako wa kuume, lakini haitakukaribia wewe.
Ekegusii: Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.

English: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign over Babylon, Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mnamo siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa tano, katika mwaka wa kumi na tisa wa utawala wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, Nebuzaradani jemadari wa askari walinzi wa mfalme, aliyemtumikia mfalme wa Babeli, alikuja Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano, ase omwaka o ikomi na kianda bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, Nebusaradani, oyorenge omoteneneri bw’abarendi na omosomba bw’omorwoti o Babiloni, agacha Yerusalemu.

English: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built,
Kiswahili: Malkia wa Sheba alipoona hekima yote ya Solomoni na jumba la kifalme alilokuwa amejenga,
Ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana ya Seba yaroche obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,

English: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice to the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote aletaye sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana ataleta sehemu ya sadaka hiyo kama dhabihu yake kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a omonto onde bwensi orarue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, arue korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio gentungetie inche Omonene.

English: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
Kiswahili: Rudi, rudi, ee Mshulami; rudi, rudi ili tupate kukutazama! Mpenzi Kwa nini kumtazama Mshulami, kama kutazama ngoma ya Mahanaimu?
Ekegusii: Irana! Irana, aye Omosulamiti! Irana! Irana, erinde tokorigererie! (Omoriakari) Nase ki mokondigereria inche Omosulamiti, buna mokorigereria ogotenga kw'ebiombe bibere bi'abasikari?

English: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: When David came to Mahanaim, he was met by Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipofika Mahanaimu, Shobi mwana wa Nahashi kutoka Raba ya Waamoni, Makiri mwana wa Amieli kutoka Lo-Debari, na Barzilai Mgileadi kutoka Rogelimu
Ekegusii: Ekaba Daudi gaikire Mahanaimu, akanyorana na Sobi, mosinto o Nahasi, korwa Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni, na Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, korwa Lo‐Debari, na Barisilai Omogileadi korwa Rogelimu.

English: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
Kiswahili: Kisha atamchukua yule fahali nje ya kambi na kumteketeza kama alivyomteketeza yule wa kwanza. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya jumuiya.
Ekegusii: Erio aire eeri eyio isiko y'egetwori, ayesaambere aroro, buna asaambete eeri eria ye ritang'ani. Ekio n'ekengwanso ki'ebibe ase engencho y'omoganda bwonsi.

English: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
Kiswahili: Nikiziangalia mbingu zako, kazi ya vidole vyako, mwezi na nyota, ulizoziratibisha,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching'enang'eni, ebi kwabegete kera ekemo ase aaye;

English: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
Kiswahili: Lakini wafuatao msiwale: tai, furukombe, kipungu,
Ekegusii: Timoria chinyoni echi: ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;

English: Now speak a parable to this rebellious house and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Put the pot on the fire; put it on and pour in the water.
Kiswahili: Iambie nyumba hii ya kuasi fumbo, na uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Teleka sufuria jikoni; iteleke na umimine maji ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Kwana n’abanto aba batari koigwera, obateebie omoreng’anio. Otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Tereka enyongo riko, ee, oyetereke, oumore amaache ime yaye.

English: For God loves nothing as much as one who dwells with wisdom.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hapendi chochote kama vile mtu anayeishi na hekima.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho Nyasae nigo anchete omonto ore n'obongaini.

English: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket, or grasshopper.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa hawa, mtakula nzige wa aina zote, senene, parare au panzi.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio moraarie.

English: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt; He will punish their sins.
Kiswahili: Wamezama sana katika rushwa, kama katika siku za Gibea. Mungu atakumbuka uovu wao na kuwaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: Besaririe kegima buna yabeete ase amatuko aria a kare agwo Gibea. Omonene nainyorete ebibe biabo, abae egesusuro. Ebibe bi’Abaisraeli na aya abanyorete

English: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”
Kiswahili: Utakapokuwa ukizungumza na mfalme, nitaingia na kuthibitisha hayo uliyoyasema.”
Ekegusii: Bono nebe ekero aye ogendererete gokwana nomorwoti, nainche boigo ninsoe mbeeke amang'ana ao chinguru ase okoenekia ng'a nekeene.”

English: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Huuachilia umeme wake wa radi chini ya mbingu yote na kuupeleka hata miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi'ense.

English: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don't come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtakapotambua njia mtakayoiendea, kwa kuwa hamjawahi kuipita kabla. Lakini msisogee karibu, bali kuwe na umbali wa dhiraa 2,000 kati yenu na Sanduku.”
Ekegusii: Timoyeika ang'e; mobeere magega ase oboare bw'ekiromita eyemo. Erio namomanye ase mogoeta, naki timwana goeta enchera eyio rinde.”

English: Its windows, portico, and palm trees had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.
Kiswahili: Madirisha yake, baraza yake na nakshi yake ya miti ya mitende vilikuwa na vipimo sawasawa na vile vya lango linaloelekea mashariki. Kulikuwa na ngazi saba za kupandia huko, pamoja na baraza yake mkabala nazo.
Ekegusii: Ebibao biaye, na egesoero kiaye, na emegwekano eria y’emekendo, bionsi ebio nigo biareng’aine na biria bi’oboagacho bware geita kiarochie moocha. Ekeriinero kiare n’ebitambokero bitano na bibere nkiarengeo kiare koriinerwa gochiao, na egesona kiaye nigo kiarenge ime y’oboagacho obwo.

English: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.
Kiswahili: Walipoamka mapema alfajiri, Samweli akamwita Sauli darini, akamwambia, “Jiandae, nami nitakuaga uende zako.” Sauli alipokuwa tayari yeye na Samweli wakatoka nje pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokiamoka, Samweli akarangeria Saulo oyoreenge ase ekerama igoro, akabora: “Imoka ngokoobe, ogende ase orogendo rwao.” Saulo akaimoka, na barabwo babere bakagenda bare amo.

English: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.
Kiswahili: Atachoma moto mahekalu yao ya miungu ya Misri, atachoma mahekalu yao na kuteka miungu yao. Kama vile mchungaji ajizungushiavyo vazi lake ndivyo atakavyojizungushia Misri na kuondoka mahali hapo bila kudhurika.
Ekegusii: Ere natongie chie Hekalu chi'echinyasae chiria. Ase enchera eyio nachene ense ya Misiri buna omorisia akorusia chinda chire ase eanga yaye akwambara. Nebukadinesaro gakoorire gokora ayio, nairane ase ense yaye nomorembe.

English: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakaita mkutano wa baraza. Wakaulizana, “Tufanyeje? Huyu mtu anafanya ishara nyingi.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakaboora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.

English: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
Kiswahili: Zerubabeli akamzaa Abiudi, Abiudi akamzaa Eliakimu, Eliakimu akamzaa Azori,
Ekegusii: na Serubabeli akaibora Abihudi, na Abihudi akaibora Eliakimu, na Eliakimu akaibora Azoro,

English: She arose, then bowed facedown and said, “Here is your maidservant, ready to serve and to wash the feet of my lord’s servants.”
Kiswahili: Akainama chini uso wake mpaka ardhini, akasema, “Mjakazi wako yuko hapa, tayari kuwatumikia na kuwanawisha miguu watumishi wa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Abigaeli akaimoka, agatugama inse, akabora, “Rora, inche omosomba oye omokungu nigo inde ang’e gosibia amagoro y’abasomba b’omonene one.”

English: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
Kiswahili: Alimtumikia na kumwabudu Baali na kumghadhibisha Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kama vile baba yake alivyokuwa amefanya.
Ekegusii: Agakorera Baali, akayesasiima, na buna ise akorete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, goika ere akaba nendamwamu.

English: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune. Yeye ataiona, nami nitampa yeye na wazao wake nchi aliyoikanyaga kwa miguu, kwa sababu alimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.”
Ekegusii: otatiga Kalebu mosinto o Yefune. Ere nasoe ense eria. Ere obeire omwegenwa ase inde nimoyee ere na ororeeria rw'aye, ense eyio arotire.

English: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
Kiswahili: Amenizungushia ukuta ili nisiweze kutoroka, amenifunga kwa minyororo mizito.
Ekegusii: Onsiekeire ase chinsemo chionsi, tinkonyara gosoka; onsibeire ebinyuri ebirito.

English: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
Kiswahili: Alipofanyiza nguvu za upepo na kuyapima maji,
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amaache,

English: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;' and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
Kiswahili: Nimwambiapo mtu mwovu, ‘Hakika utakufa,' na wewe usipomwonya mtu huyo au kumshauri aache njia zake mbaya ili kuokoa maisha yake, huyo mtu mwovu atakufa katika dhambi yake na damu yake nitaidai mkononi mwako.
Ekegusii: Kondateebe ase omokori amabe: Ekeene aye goika okwe, na aye koratige tomokuurera, gose tokwana nomokori amabe oyio ase okomokuurera, erinde atige chinchera chiaye chi'obobe atoorie obogima bwaye, rirorio omokori amabe oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende amanyinga aye nin'yaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mimi Danieli nikaangalia, nako mbele yangu walisimama wengine wawili, mmoja katika ukingo huu wa mto, na mwingine ukingo wa pili wa mto.
Ekegusii: Erio inche Danieli nkarigereria nkarora abanto babere bateneine ase engegu y'orooche, oyomo ase engegu eyemo, na oyonde ase engegu ende.

English: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng’a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

English: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kama kioja kwa wengi, lakini wewe ni kimbilio langu imara.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna egento ki'ogoichanerwa ase abanto abange, korende aye naye obotamero bwane obokong'u.

English: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu humcha Bwana, bali yeye ambaye njia zake zimepotoka humdharau Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y'oboronge, korende oyo omochaayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye.

English: For we are members of His body.
Kiswahili: Sisi tu viungo vya mwili wake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo tore ebiimo bi’omobere oye.

English: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza ya mwaka 601, wa kuishi kwake Noa, maji yalikuwa yamekauka duniani. Kisha Noa akafungua mlango wa safina akaona ya kuwa uso wa ardhi ulikuwa umekauka.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw'amagana atano na rimo, na oyomo (601), rituko rie ritangani ri'omotienyi bw'eritang'ani, amaache agakama kegima korwa ase ense. Nuhu akarusia ekerama ki'obwato, akarigereria, akarora ng'a ense yakamokire.

English: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong'u ase Omonene, abanchi baane.

English: The fear of the Lord is the crown of wisdom, making peace and perfect health to flourish.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni taji la hekima, na kufanya amani na afya kamili kustawi.
Ekegusii: Chisemi nigo agoichoria chinyomba chiabo n'ebinto bionsi abanyene enyomba baganetie ase ebiage n'amarongo abo ase rigesa riaye.

English: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Waisraeli kukusanywa na kupewa mahitaji, walikwenda kukabiliana nao. Waisraeli wakapiga kambi mkabala nao kama makundi mawili madogo ya mbuzi, wakati Waaramu walienea katika nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaroberigwa na koariganerigwa chindagera, bakagenda korwania Abasiiria. Abaisraeli bagatoora korigererania n'Abasiiria, bakarorekana buna amaicho abere amake e chimbori, korende Abasiiria bagaichora aase aria.

English: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.
Kiswahili: Mchuzi ukagawiwa watu, lakini walipoanza kula, wakalia, “Ee mtu wa Mungu, kuna mauti ndani ya chungu.” Nao hawakuweza kula.
Ekegusii: Bono endagera eria egaterekerwa abanto baria barie, korende ekero baarenge koyeria, bakarera neriogi: “Aye omonto o Nyasae, obee! Endagera eye yatorenteire amakweri!” Barabwo tibanyara koyeria.

English: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.
Kiswahili: Hezekia pamoja na watu wote wakafurahi kwa sababu ya lile Mungu alilolifanya kwa ajili ya watu wake, kwa kuwa lilitendeka papo hapo.
Ekegusii: Hezekia amo nabaanto bonsi bakaba nomogooko ase ayio Nyasae akorerete abanto, ekiagera nigo abairanerete ase obwango.

English: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
Kiswahili: Utumishi wao wote ukiwa ni kuchukua au wa kufanya kazi nyingine, utafanyika chini ya maelekezo ya Aroni na wanawe. Mtawapangia kama wajibu wao yote watakayoyafanya.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye nabwo barachike Abagerisoni ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria, na onsi aya barakore; inwe mobatige batenenere ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria.

English: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mzao wa kuhani Aroni mwenye kilema chochote atakayekaribia kutoa sadaka kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kama ana kilema, kamwe asikaribie kutoa chakula cha Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeeria rwa Aroni Omokuani ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e kondeetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero, ekiagera oyio ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tagoika ang’e andeetere inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero.

English: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
Kiswahili: Basi hata yule askari hodari kuliko wengine wote, ambaye moyo wake ni kama wa simba, atayeyuka kwa hofu, kwa maana Israeli yote wanajua kwamba baba yako ni mpiganaji na kwamba wale walio pamoja naye ni watu hodari.
Ekegusii: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi 'mbamanyete ng'a iso nigo are etuoni y'eseegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.

English: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
Kiswahili: Naye akapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu kama simba anayenguruma. Alipopiga kelele, zile radi saba zikatoa ngurumo zake.
Ekegusii: na akarera neriogi rinene ringa buna eri’endo ekoruma. Ekero achia korera chinkoba isano na ibere chigakwana neriogi riabo.

English: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
Kiswahili: Tena nimemteua Oholiabu mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, ili kumsaidia. Pia mafundi wote nimewapa ustadi wa kutengeneza kila kitu nilichokuamuru wewe:
Ekegusii: Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikiire.

English: So the king of Israel assembled the prophets, about four hundred men, and asked them, “Should I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?” “Go up,” they replied, “and the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mfalme wa Israeli akawaleta pamoja manabii wanaume wapatao mia nne, akawauliza, “Je, niende vitani dhidi ya Ramoth-Gileadi, au niache?” Wakajibu, “Naam, nenda, kwa kuwa Bwana ataiweka Ramoth-Gileadi mkononi mwa mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agasangerereria ababani ang’e amagana ane amo, akababoria, “Nkogenda nde korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose yaya?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria “Genda, ekiagera Omonene nabeeke omochie oyio ase okoboko kwao aye omorwoti.”

English: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walikuwa wamefanya kazi yote sawasawa na vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini ashukuriwe Mungu, yeye atupaye ushindi kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Lameki aliishi jumla ya miaka 777, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano na ebere (777), erio agakwa.

English: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.
Kiswahili: Kwa kushika maagizo ya Daudi baba yake, aliweka migawanyo ya makuhani kwa ajili ya kazi zao, nao Walawi kuongoza kusifu na kusaidia makuhani kufuatana na mahitaji ya kila siku. Pia akaweka mabawabu katika migawanyo kwa ajili ya malango mbalimbali, kwa sababu hili ndilo Daudi mtu wa Mungu alilokuwa ameagiza.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana onsi omorwoti achigete abakuani na Abalawi nigo aikeranetigwe kegima ase kera ring'ana rinde rionsi amo nerie chimonga.

English: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, usiwe mbali. Ee Nguvu yangu, uje haraka unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, koranche, ayerera onkonye!

English: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.
Kiswahili: Mtagawa kwa usawa miongoni mwao. Kwa sababu niliapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kuwapa baba zenu, nchi hii itakuwa urithi wenu.
Ekegusii: Mobaatere mobareng'anerie kera omonto ensemo yaye. Nigo netianetie koa chisokoro chiaino ense eye; ase ayio ense eyio n'ebe omwando oino.

English: So Arkesaeus, Sarsathaeus, and Malisear, the princes of the Persians and Medes, who were near the king, who sat chief in rank by the king, drew near to him,
Kiswahili: Basi Arkesayo, Sarsayo, na Malisea, wakuu wa Waajemi na Wamedi, waliokuwa karibu na mfalme, waliokuwa wakuu wa cheo karibu na mfalme, wakamkaribia,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akarwa ogochika abwo babere bakabwatwa nagochandwa goika bagaitaba ng'a mbaroberetie egokoro ekio, erio barobwo bakang'etwa.

English: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mfalme anamtumaini Bwana; kwa upendo usiokoma wa Aliye Juu Sana hatatikiswa.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.

English: Now King David was old and well along in years, and though they covered him with blankets, he could not keep warm.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi alipokuwa mzee umri ukiwa umesogea, hakuweza kupata joto hata walipomfunika kwa nguo.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Daudi konya ogotire mono, nonya abakori emeremo baye bare komobisia amarangeti amange, tareenge koigwa riberera.

English: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur,
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa kusini kutakuwa kambi ya makundi ya Reubeni chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Reubeni ni Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya Irianyi n’Abareubeni, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: Although he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come— a wind from the LORD rising up from the desert. His fountain will fail, and his spring will run dry. The wind will plunder his treasury of every precious article.
Kiswahili: hata ingawa Efraimu atastawi miongoni mwa ndugu zake. Upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwa Bwana utakuja, ukivuma kutoka jangwani, chemchemi yake haitatoa maji na kisima chake kitakauka. Ghala lake litatekwa hazina zake zote.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nabaisa koibora babuche ase egati y’abamwabo, omwaga korwa moocha noche, ee, omwaga o Omonene noche korwa ase erooro. Erio ebisima biabo bi’amaache biome, ne chinsoko chiabo chikame. Omwaga oyio nosirie kegima chinibo chiabo banchete.

English: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakawachukua mateka kutoka ndugu zao, watu wapatao 200,000 hawa wakiwa ni wanawake, watoto wa kiume na wa kike. Wakachukua pia kiasi kikubwa cha nyara, ambazo walirudi nazo Samaria.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwata abanto bamwabo chilifu amagana abere (200,000): abakungu, na abana, abamura na abaiseke, bakabaira ase obosomba. Boigo bagasakora ebinto ebinge korwa ase abanto baria, bakabiira Samaria.

English: When daylight came, the magistrates sent their officers with the order: “Release those men.”
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka wale mahakimu wakawatuma maafisa wao kwa mkuu wa gereza wakiwa na agizo linalosema, “Wafungue wale watu, waache waende zao.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaambi bagatoma abanyanyimbo, bagoteeba: “Tiga abanto abwo bagende!”

English: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
Kiswahili: Si vizuri kumwadhibu mtu asiye na hatia, au kuwapiga sana maafisa kwa ajili ya uadilifu wao.
Ekegusii: Tari buya komoa egesusuro omonto omooronge, boigo tari buya kwaguria abanto abasike ase engencho y'oboronge bwabo.

English: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Yeye ni nani, Bwana? Niambie ili nipate kumwamini.”
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, inyare komwegena?”

English: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.
Kiswahili: Atanena maneno kinyume cha Yeye Aliye Juu Sana na kuwaonea watakatifu wake, huku akijaribu kubadili majira na sheria. Watakatifu watatiwa chini ya mamlaka yake kwa wakati, nyakati mbili, na nusu wakati.
Ekegusii: Ere nakwane amang’ana are mamincha y’Oyore Igoro Mono, naende narosie abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono na kobachanda; narengererie koonchora ebiro, na amachiiko. Abachenu mbabekwe ase okoboko kwaye ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng’ese gi’ekero.

English: If the mildew reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house has been scraped and replastered,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa upele huo utatokea tena ndani ya ile nyumba baada ya mawe kuondolewa na nyumba kukwanguliwa na kuwekwa lipu mpya,
Ekegusii: “Ukoma boria koboratuboke naende ase enyomba eria magega amagena aria karusigweo, ne rioomo riria koriaoomoirwe, na enyomba eria yaoomirwe naende,

English: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu wa kizazi hiki kiovu atakayeona nchi nzuri niliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu,
Ekegusii: Ekeene, onde tari ase abanto b'ekegori eke ekebe oraike ase ense eria entobu narierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng'a nimbayee,

English: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mmenunuliwa kwa gharama. Kwa hiyo mtukuzeni Mungu katika miili yenu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera mwagoretwe ase rigori rinene. Ase ayio, motogie Nyasae ase emebere yaino.

English: Then Samson’s wife came to him, weeping, and said, “You hate me! You do not really love me! You have posed to my people a riddle, but have not explained it to me.” “Look,” he said, “I have not even explained it to my father or mother, so why should I explain it to you?”
Kiswahili: Basi mke wa Samsoni akalia mbele yake na kumwambia, “Unanichukia! Hunipendi kabisa. Umewategea watu wangu kitendawili, lakini mimi hujaniambia jibu.” Samsoni akamwambia, “Wala sijamweleza baba yangu wala mama yangu, kwa nini nikufumbulie?”
Ekegusii: Moga Samusoni akageenda ase are, akarera akamoteebia, “Aye nigo ongeechete, tonyancheti, ogateebia abanto baminto omobayeeno, korende tonteebeti inche engencho y’omobayeno oria.” Samusoni akamoteebia, “Rora, tindateebia tata, gose baba, engencho y’omobayeno oria, naki ndakore ngoteebie aye?”

English: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
Kiswahili: Basi Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilipokuwa imekaribia, watu wengi walitoka vijijini wakaenda Yerusalemu kabla ya Pasaka ili wakajitakase.
Ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y'Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang'e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang'anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.

English: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Sayuni itasemwa hivi, “Huyu na yule walizaliwa humo, naye Aliye Juu Sana mwenyewe atamwimarisha.”
Ekegusii: Igoro ya Sayoni amang'ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” n'Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong'ia.

English: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
Kiswahili: na pia wakati wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, mpaka mwezi wa tano wa mwaka wa kumi na moja wa utawala wa Sedekia mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, wakati watu wa Yerusalemu walipopelekwa uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Naende rikamocheera ekero Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, arenge omorwoti bw'Abayuda. Magega y'ayio Omonene akaba ogokwana nere ase chingaki chinyinge goika omoerio bw'omwaka o ikomi na rimo bw'okogamba gwa Zedekia mosinto o Yosia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, na omoerio bw'omotienyi o gatano bw'omwaka oria, ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu boosetwe bakairwa ase obosomba.

English: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Kiswahili: Kama watu wasiomcha Mungu, wamenidhihaki, wamenisagia meno.
Ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.

English: From there David went to Mizpeh of Moab, where he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and mother stay with you until I learn what God will do for me.”
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko Daudi akaenda Mispa huko Moabu na kumwambia mfalme wa Moabu, “Naomba uwaruhusu baba yangu na mama yangu waje kukaa nawe mpaka nijue nini Mungu atakachonifanyia.”
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarua agwo, akagenda Misipa ya Moabu; agateebia omorwoti o Moabu: “Koranche oe tata na baba ribaga bache kobeera aa, goika imanye aya Nyasae arankorere.”

English: Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in Yahweh's eyes, and my God has become my strength.
Kiswahili: Sasa Bwana asema: yeye aliyeniumba tumboni kuwa mtumishi wake, kumrudisha tena Yakobo kwake na kumkusanyia Israeli, kwa maana nimepata heshima machoni pa Bwana, naye Mungu wangu amekuwa nguvu yangu;
Ekegusii: Nateebigwe ring'ana n'Omonene, oria ontongete ase enda ya baba ng'a nimbe omosomba oye, erinde ng'iranie ororeeria rwa Yakobo gochia asare, na nsangererie Abaisraeli gochia asare. Inche nanyorire amasikani ase obosio bw'Omonene, Nyasae one obeire chinguru chiane.

English: When a man's ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Kiswahili: Njia za mtu zinapompendeza Bwana, huwafanya hata adui zake waishi naye kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Ekero chiinchera chi'omonto chiamogokirie Omonene Nyasae nigo agokora nonya nababisa b'omonto oyio babwatana nere.

English: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima mwangamize watu wote ambao Bwana Mungu wenu atawatia mikononi mwenu. Msiwatazame kwa kuwahurumia na msiitumikie miungu yao, kwa kuwa itakuwa mtego kwenu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke ase amaboko aino, mobasirie, timobarorera amaabera. Timobaisa gokorera chinyasae chiabo, ekiagera ase ogokora igo, chirochio 'nachinyaare kobatiga.

English: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable; it must not be eaten.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi ni chukizo; kisiliwe.
Ekegusii: “Ebitongwa ebike bionsi bigoetanana ase ense nigo bire okogechia, tibiriegwa.

English: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: huku tukilitazamia tumaini lenye baraka na ufunuo wa utukufu wa Mungu wetu Mkuu, aliye Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: gatoganyete ogoikeranigwa ogosemeria kwe Rituko Risesenirie, na okooroka kw'obonene bwa Nyasae omonene, na Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso,

English: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe ndiwe Mungu! Maneno yako ndiyo kweli, nawe umemwahidi mtumishi wako mambo haya mazuri.
Ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, na amang’ana ao naro ekeene, na kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira ng’a onkorere ring’ana eri rigiya.

English: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
Kiswahili: figo mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayatoa pamoja na figo.
Ekegusii: “Onye ekeng'wanso kiaye nembori, ayerue ase obosio bwane,

English: But the righteous live forever. Their reward is in the Lord, and the care for them with the Most High.
Kiswahili: Lakini wenye haki huishi milele. Thawabu yao iko katika Bwana, na utunzaji wao uko kwa Aliye Juu Zaidi.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abaya nigo bakomenya kare na kare nengeria yabo nigo ere ase Omonene; ee Nyasae Omonene nere okobaakana.

English: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Hutakuwa na urithi wowote katika nchi yao, wala hutakuwa na sehemu miongoni mwao; Mimi ni fungu lako na urithi wako miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye tokonyora omwando bw'orogongo ase egati y'Abaisraeli bande. Tokoegwa ensemo ende yonsi ase egati yabo. Inche ninche ensemo yao, naende omwando oo, ase egati y'Abaisraeli.

English: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
Kiswahili: “Nikusanyieni watu wangu waliowekwa wakfu, waliofanya agano nami kwa dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: “Sangereria abanto baane abegenwa bache asende, abwo bakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainche ase okorua ebing’wanso.”

English: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh's name I indeed cut them off.
Kiswahili: Walinizunguka pande zote, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Nigo bamboerete korwa chinsinyo chionsi, korende ase erieta ri'Omonene nkabasiria.

English: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: Atamchinja huyo kondoo katika mahali patakatifu ambapo sadaka ya dhambi na ile ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa. Kama ilivyo sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya hatia ni ya kuhani; nayo ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Anyeenyere emaanwa eria agwo aase achenire, ase ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe na eki'ogosaambwa bikonyeenyerwa, ekiagera ekeng'wanso gi'okomocha neki'Omokuani; ekio negechenu mono.

English: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
Kiswahili: Huyu Maria, ambaye Lazaro kaka yake alikuwa mgonjwa, ndiye yule ambaye alimpaka Bwana mafuta na kuifuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake.
Ekegusii: Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.

English: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa nuru ndiyo hufanya kila kitu kionekane. Hii ndiyo sababu imesemekana: “Amka, wewe uliyelala, ufufuke kutoka kwa wafu, naye Kristo atakuangazia.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio oteebire, “Booka aye osundogete, booka korwa ase abakuure, na Kristo nakobarerie.”

English: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
Kiswahili: Niambieni, je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
Ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete igoro, gose nase Mwanyabaanto? Ng’iranerie.”

English: Let's fill ourselves with costly wine and perfumes, and let no spring flower pass us by.
Kiswahili: Tujishibishe kwa divai na manukato ya thamani, na ua lolote la masika lisitupite.
Ekegusii: Tiga tweigoti ase okonywa edivai y'erigori na manukato boigo twerigerie amaua.

English: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu yenu na fedha yenu vimeliwa na kutu. Kutu yake itashuhudia dhidi yenu nayo itaila miili yenu kama vile moto. Mmejiwekea hazina kwa ajili ya siku za mwisho.
Ekegusii: Chitaabu ne chifeta chiaino chiasoirwe noboboosu, na oboboosu obwo bwabeire kirori igoro yaino, na borobwo naborie emebere yaino buna omorero okoria. Mwegacheire emonga amatuko aya ay’omoerio.

English: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati uliopita, aliinuka mtu mmoja jina lake Theuda, alijidai kuwa yeye ni mtu maarufu, akapata wafuasi wapatao 400 walioambatana naye. Lakini aliuawa, na wafuasi wake wote wakatawanyika, wakawa si kitu.
Ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko aetire Theuda naimoka, agetogia ng'a ere nomonto omonene; abanto koreng'ana amagana ane bakabwatana nere, korende ere agaitwa, na abatunyani baye bonsi bagaserebekana, n'ekeombe kiaye kegasira.

English: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
Kiswahili: Msikiapo habari za vita na uvumi wa vita, msiwe na hofu. Mambo haya hayana budi kutukia, lakini ule mwisho bado.
Ekegusii: Naende komoraigwe esegi, na ebirage bi'esegi, timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe, ko moerio toracha.

English: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
Kiswahili: Yeremia alipomaliza kuwaambia watu maneno yote ya Bwana Mungu wao, yaani kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amemtuma kuwaambia,
