Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa Fomu ya Nne lazima kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura kabla ya kuondoka shule kwa muongozo wa IEBC.
Ekegusii: Abana besekondari bekerasi kia inye goika babe berikire koba abbaki chikura batrarua esukuru

English: Council of Governors launches an app for devolution awareness.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti .

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Makueni County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Makueni Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonyene: KEMSA egakora ogosima oborwa bwa sukari ase obosa ase Makueni County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Meru County on agroforestry this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kilimo cha misitu Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyerero: KALRO egokorera abaremi amachiko ase Meru County igoro yoboremi bwechimiti (agroforestry) ase omotienyi 5.

English: KALRO urges rice growers in Bomet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawasihi wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Bomet kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO ogotebererigwa nereikari buna buna okorenda ebichuni biria bigosaria endagera, erio gotanga amokonde echingeti gindigwa amariogo ao ao okoyera amagoro hii.

English: New policy on standardized school infrastructure development to ensure quality learning environments.
Ekegusii: Richiko riyia igoro yamaagacho esukuru abwekaine goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera.

English: Seek help! Access counselors after protest disruptions.
Kiswahili: Tafuta msaada! Wasiliana na washauri baada ya vurugu za maandamano.
Ekegusii: Rigia ogokonywa! Kabe neribaga rigiya nomwarimu oo bwebirengererio kogokonya nyuma yeburaburu yokoandamana.

English: Notice: DPP launches a fraud prevention campaign in Nairobi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP azindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekenyori: DPP giaansire ekampeini ya kusia kumwona Nairobi County eng'atiato hii.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.
Ekegusii: Abana b'omwaka 1 goika 5 mbagwenerete gosibigwa ebianda ase kera emetienyi etano n'omo, erio gotanga okoambokeria kw'ebianda ebio biranyare korenta enchara na ogotakina buya.

English: DPP urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP anawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Taita-Taveta kojikia buna abanyene ekombo ekijikia chinchogu chinye, gochona gochiokorwa gochiokorwa gochikia chinchogu chinye chinye.

English: KEMSA launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokonya omokono ase ogoteba abanto igoro yoborwaire bwa sukari ase omotienyi 5 goika ogoteba abanto ase ogosomwa ase Makueni County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Kiambu County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usafirishaji wa mifugo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi nembego yetugo egokweibokia abamenyi bwa Kiambu Kaunti buna ogotara amaterasi nkogesa oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani yasemirie abamenyi a Tharaka-Nithi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro, yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Judiciary budget upgrades will automate courts and speed up corruption case handling.
Kiswahili: Maboresho ya bajeti ya mahakama yataendesha mahakama kiotomatiki na kuharakisha ushughulikiaji wa kesi za ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Okogeswa chibesa ase obokoreri bwa koti mboikerania chikoti gokora emeremo yaye goetera etekinorochi ase obokoreri obuya Jkwangoi kogaba ebina biobokorekanu.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii ya Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development egokora abanto ba Narok County goika bagende gochora ase ogosoma kwabakuru erio babone gochera ebitambokero biogochera abana chindagera ase amasomo.

English: NCPB announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB nigo erangerete ogotera esindani yoboreme bwe amagoro na amakanwa ase chimburi ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Samburu County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bia Obobwenia - Ekeombe gia Obobwenia bwa Abanto obasabire abareeri abana ase Samburu County goeta abana babo ase ogotarerwa ogokura ase egeku kia omotienyi 6 kia ogotebia obobwenia bwa abamama.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises milk producers in Lamu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kegosaba abaremi bamate ase Lamu County gochia goikora oboremi bwa rigori ria chibei chiri ase oboremu mbere yechingaki chiorigesa.

English: HELB encourages residents of Nyeri County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: HELB obabwateranirie abamenyi ba kaunti ya Nyeri kobasaba kwebaterania amakwania gokwerikia buna bera tebia kwebaterania ase amagenderero amo nebirenga biekaonti.

English: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.
Kiswahili: Utambulisho wa watoto unaweza kuibiwa kwa udanganyifu. Wazazi wanapaswa kulinda vyeti vya kuzaliwa na kufuatilia ripoti za mikopo.
Ekegusii: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Egesaku: Okoigora ogosaba kwao chibesa chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara bochaberi mwa Kajiado.

English: Promote youth inclusion in decision-making; get involved in local governance.
Kiswahili: Kukuza ushirikishwaji wa vijana katika kufanya maamuzi; kushiriki katika utawala wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Segeta okobwaterana nabasae ase okorosia amachiko; sanga ase obogambi bwekenyoro.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Mombasa County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokibukia abamama abanyabwate ase Mombasa County inga okwenera okwanchwa kwabana nigo kuri obwanto ase chifasiliti chiensi chia gavamenti.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Machakos County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (Kenya Dairy Board) nkorora kere nga abaremi bechinyama ase Machakos County bagwenerete gochia gochia amang'ana ase ofisi yobuveterinari eria eri hakuhi na abwo, nigo konyora oborendi bw'echinyama chiao.

English: OGP warns public officers in Nairobi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP ng'okorwa abarendi boborendi bwenyoro bagesete okomanyania ase ekaonti ya Nairobi ng'a igoro yokorwa amaaki.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased dengue fever risk in Meru County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Kwale County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.

English: KMTC urges parents and teachers in Mandera County to reach out to the child helpline 116.

Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.

English: OGP updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of county development projects this November.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Novemba.

Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Mombasa County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kitui County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Isiolo County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Murang'a County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. For storage, keep tomatoes at 12C and 86-90% relative humidity - they spoil if kept below 10C for over 2 weeks, or below 5C for more than 6-8 days, but can last 2-3 weeks at 10C or above.
Kiswahili: Vuna nyanya asubuhi na mapema au jioni wakati joto ni karibu 20C na hali ya hewa ni kavu. Kwa kuhifadhi, weka nyanya kwa 12C na unyevu wa jamaa wa 86-90% - huharibika ikiwa zimehifadhiwa chini ya 10C kwa zaidi ya wiki 2, au chini ya 5C kwa zaidi ya siku 6-8, lakini zinaweza kudumu wiki 2-3 kwa 10C au zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gesa tomatoo omogoroba kana omogoroba chungu wakati wetu wana 20C na chuma orwomo. Gacha tomatoo 12C na humidiati 86-90% - wana gachwa kama gacha chungu 10C matuko 2 echuma, kana chungu 5C matuko 6-8, lakini wana gachwa 2-3 echuma 10C kana wana.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Bomet County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.

English: DCI urges the public in Meru County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: DCI baboririe abamenyi echi kaunti ya Meru komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta SIM-swap ogotunya ng'a abanto bamomanyie ebikoru binde bionsi bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura.

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Ekegusii: EACC akiyera omoerio bw'ekero as'ID abamenyi gosanga ase amagenderero yorogongo Kericho.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces free medical camps for residents of West Pokot County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia Ogochera Oborwaire na Ogoitokera nigo konyorete buna eraba ne chinkambi chia oborwari chitaragwe ase abanto ba West Pokot County gosegerera ase omotienyi 1.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) as defined by FAO comprises of three main pillars: 1) sustainably increasing agricultural productivity and incomes, 2) adapting ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo kiakili kwa ajili ya hali ya hewa (CSA) kama ilivyoelezwa na FAO inajumuisha nguzo kuu tatu: 1) kuongeza endelevu ya uzalishaji wa kilimo na mapato, 2) kugeuza ...
Ekegusii: Oboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura  (CSA) buna ekeombe ekene kiendagera giense (FAO) nigo kerengete chisoro isato 1) oboremi bwokwegendereria obwo bokogesa rigesa na  2) ebitoki goetera goetera ogoonchoka gochia oboremi bwabono...

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Mandera County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Mandera kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: ODPP baboririe abamenyi abakwete ogotiotereria go'kwerikia buna abaaki chikura gwekeombe gietenenerete giechimbebe nobochori ekaonti ya Mandera.

English: AFA promotes organic farming among farmers in Isiolo County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia AFA nkogenderera gokora amabera okorora oborimi bwobwoni ase abarimi ba Isiolo County ase omotienyi o omotienyi 10 bwo ogokonya abanto goikara ase oborimi obo goetera egechera kia ogokonya ebi binto bitoe goikara ase amachiko amabe ya chimbura.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free food safety outreach in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ogochaka amang'ana: KEMSA egokora omoroberio obosa ogokonya abanto ase okomanya oborwa bwe chiri ase Kwale County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Notice: DCI okoigora omorobere ya gender ya nore nerekobwetana ase okoba asenogochengera kwa akaunti ya Bungoma.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Ekegusii: Nabwate: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ya chakiri omoroberio o cybersécurity orengete gokeani ogotakìa kwa SIM-swap fraud yasirete go abakuru ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen akiripotiri oyera oborokigwa koerikia ase amagenderero yorogongo na ID na Mombasa Ekaunti.

English: KRA reminds residents of Bomet County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Bomet kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria ababenzi achi kaunti ya Bomet nga gae guting’igua obogambi bwekenyoro kutegeia rikaro ryabeene ryo gusia gwe chi kaunti.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Kericho County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS ekobasoka abanyamwaka banchera ase Kericho County koripoti chinyamu chire oborwa ase ofisi yechivetinaryi eria eri hakoinya nigo konyora obochenu bwe chinyamu.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Lamu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egosaba abaremi ase Lamu County gochia ase ogoteka chingencho chiogotara amache ase amakonde ayo nigo bakonyeke na ogotindana na chimbura chire gochaka gose gosekerera.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for national ID applications in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Chinga: OGP okoigora ekeyia gia chingiru chiomobasekano chia ID aaria Vihiga County.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Mandera County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Medical Association egokang'a abamama ase Mandera County goikara ase erikodi yobochari bwa mama na omwana erio gokonyora obochari bwomwana obo.

English: KICD invites youth in Mombasa County to enroll for tailoring and design training this August.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: KICD eragete abasubati ase Ekaunti ya Mombasa gochora okwiyandika ase oboremi bwo gocheka chinguo na okobora chinguo ase omotienyi 8.

English: DPP reminds residents of Baringo County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Baringo koegerera chinchera chiegekoro gacha eamate yao.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Embu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Embu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS koseka abaibori nabarimu ba Embu gati ya sira amagancha a bionsi.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Wajir County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: DCI gikonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Wajir County enao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe na eki ore.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Nyeri County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: ODPP erio gokei oborwaire bwechimbere chieng'ombe ase ekaunti ya Nyeri eeio gokeiya choria bwechimbere chia' choria.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: Mandika wa Komunikesheni wa Kenya yasemirie abamenyi na Kisii ekunyara komenta oboasioku terio kurenda na korure na egonde ebirengererio kegima korora bwango.

English: OGP updates residents of Tharaka-Nithi County on progress of county development projects this January.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Januari.
Ekegusii: OGP ariogorwa abamenyi be Tharaka-Nithi goikaunti gosire gomogorwo chiira buna abanto bekaunti eyuo eng’atiato.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Nyesa: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu yaansire omoroberio  burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara kwomwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) ase omoroberio bwegeintaneti okorwa  bwokorwa amasomo make make ase abarimu erio gokonya gokongia ochusi gosomia Bungoma.

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yure okoboria ase abamenyi gwekaunti ya Nairobi gosegeta oboremi bwebiticha chinyeni ase chisukuru chioboroso erio goatanana chindagera na amaegerio esagati.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Makueni County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Komisheni y'abakora imirimo y'abasomi (TSC) nigo ekwibokia abasubati ase Makueni County ng'a obonyaganyi bwa HELB nigo buri ase okosomera imirimo y'okogabura ebirio na okorora abageni.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya conducts a community briefing on border security in Isiolo County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Wilaya ya Isiolo Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure okobwatanigwa egonde omosiongoroko ase ekaunti ya Isiolo gwe October.

English: KEPHIS informs milk farmers in Kwale County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo ekobamanyia abaremi bamate ase Kwale County igoro yechingira chipeya chokorandia amate ase omotienyi 5.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Kiambu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: KALRO ogotebererigwa abachune ba Kiambu korenda okorenda amokonde echingeti oginda oginda gindigwa amariogo agokwana agokwana amagoro a October ogokomera.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Migori County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KTDA egokaba chimbeyo chiomwere chio obori ase abanyamwaka ase ekaunti ya Migori ase omotienyi 10.

English: TVET encourages residents of Garissa County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: TVET orure abamenyi bensemo ya Garissa ekaunti goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo bera tebia kwa obokoreri bwechibese.

English: AFA urges farmers in Kericho County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egosaba abanyamwaka ase Kericho County gochia ase obotebia bwa chigari bwe oborimi bwa ogwate amagega ase ogotanga chimbura chitaragoka buya.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Nandi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba maombi ya bure ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie endorero egesa omwabo Nandi oko egera omwabo bwamasomo a digital ticha, korengana ticha.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejea kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: KRA yachakire oyera korwania okonyarekana okonene Kwa endwari eye okobaga ID ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: On September 1 2025 KUCCPS will open its portal for the September 2025 university and TVET intake targeting 2024 KCSE candidates.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Septemba 1, 2025, KUCCPS itafungua portal yake kwa chuo kikuu cha Septemba 2025 na kuingia kwa TVET ikilenga wagombea 2024 wa KCSE.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 9 omwaka 2025 ekeombe keria getenerete gochora abana bagosoa eyunifasiti (KUCCPS)   neigore eintaneti yaye ase abana beyunifasiti na chikorechi chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase abana baria bakorete esekenderi KCSE omwaka  2024.

English: TVET reminds youth in Kirinyaga County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET kigoibokia abasubati ase Kirinyaga County buna obokonyi bwa HELB bware ase abana baria barasome chinchera chia ogotengia chigari.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches the county integrated development plan in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) yachakirie omoroberio oboere okaunti Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: TSC reminds parents in Makueni County that school feeding programme registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: TSC egokibukia abamama na ababa ase Makueni County ng'a ogokwandika kwa abana ase chigira chiokoria chigenderete ase omotienyi 11.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises maize producers in Nakuru County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Serikari ya Ebikoni bya Egorora Riama ya Kenya ibwaga aboboremi bamaize eki Nakuru gukireta omwitagana oguagetaire ogwogochatokana ekiroga abatebereire mbere ya omwana w'ekiro.

English: Discover the benefits of farmers groupd or cloud fundraising, including wholesale trading, joint marketing and getting loans.
Kiswahili: Gundua manufaa ya wakulima waliopangwa kwa kikundi au kuchangisha pesa za wingu, ikiwa ni pamoja na biashara ya jumla, uuzaji wa pamoja na kupata mikopo.
Ekegusii: Rigia komanya obuya obonge boreo ase okobwatana gose korosia ebiombe bigokonya korwa ebioboremi, amo nobogori bwebinto bioboremi ase obonge, ogosanga echiro, na buna ogoikera amakobeso yoboremi.

English: NPS reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubaki macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Ekegusii: NPS niaborigwe abamenyi bonyokie Elgeyo-Marakwet koba maiso egonde omoroberio obokoreri obwasioku.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso KRA giachakirie amasomo igoro yogotanga obogaang a ba Baringo ekaonti mwa okotober.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Siaya County to have children under five screened for malaria during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo esabire abamama nabataata ase Siaya County gochia gosekeria abana baria bare ase emiaka erio ase oborwari bwa malaria ase omwaka omotienyi 12.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Meru County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Meru kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Division of Disease Surveillance and Response nkogasera ababokeri b'ebingwerere ase Meru County goeta n'ebingwerere biabo ase ogokorwa ogokorora ogokura kwabo ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 7 okw'eafya y'abamama.

English: Notice: TVET announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: TVET nkoraria chitariki chiogosaba chigokora omoroberio bwogotera abana chiri ase chisukuru chire Kericho County.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Nyeri County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: IPOA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri koegerera chinchogu chingaki omorero ogwateka amagoro.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Bomet County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nkoeboria abareeri abana ase Bomet County gochia na abana babo ase ogokorwa ogokwanirwa ogokura ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 1 kw'obogwenia bw'abang'ina.

English: Improved basic infrastructure, storage facilities and market access, reduces costs to be affordable food. Good roads accelerate farming always..
Kiswahili: Miundombinu ya msingi iliyoboreshwa, vifaa vya kuhifadhi na upatikanaji wa soko, hupunguza gharama za kuwa chakula cha bei nafuu. Barabara nzuri huharakisha kilimo kila wakati..
Ekegusii: Ogotaba nomoroberio omuya ase chinyomba chiokogacha rigesa nechipara gochiboria gochia echiro ngokonya ore ase goikera echiro na gokeania rigori riendagera. Chipara chingiya botambe nigo chigosegeta boremi…….

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chiairwe omoyo korigia enchera y'obosombi mapema, Obororo Bwa okoibora kiborache mobasokano. Okonyorwa goika nyagitari Nabo gokoreta emechando.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Kirinyaga County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IebC.
Ekegusii: IEBC yabororirie abamenyi entongori ekenene getenererete chikura Kirinyaga ngetarere chisekenderi IEBC yogoaka chikura.

English: DCI calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: DCI b erekera egonde ase West Pokot gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwo Ewizara yoborwaria, ekitengo kia okorora oborwaria na okogokia: okogokia obonyansi bwabana abato ase chikiriniki chigenderere gochakera omotienyi 4 ase chikiriniki chiokorwaria chieretigwe ase Nyandarua County.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of dairy cows in Homa Bay County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana: KTDA nigo etoretie ogotambuka kw'ebinyamcheke bia amabeere ase Homa Bay County nigo ekorua n'oborwa bwa anthrax.

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders The Multi Sectoral Food Security and Nutrition Project is launching awareness competitions in 1 500 schools to promote nutrition through arts Participate to enhance community awareness
Kiswahili: Wakulima makini na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo Mradi wa Sekta mbalimbali wa Usalama wa Chakula na Lishe unazindua mashindano ya uhamasishaji katika shule 1,500 ili kukuza lishe kupitia sanaa Shiriki ili kuongeza uelewa kwa jamii.
Ekegusii: Ogutuoro egosira na agribusiness abegworo, Mwami wa Ujenzi wa Usalama na Uhitaji wa Kilimo na Mlo kwa kila sectori kutoa mashindano ya kujulikisha katika 1 500 shulani kusongora usalama na uhitaji kwa kutumia ngoma. Shughuli kwenye mashindano hawa kusongora ujulikishaji wa egonde.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches ward-level service delivery in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Wajir.
Ekegusii: Ogochika: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yachakirie chisitesheni chia boborendi bwenyoro ase ekaonti ya Wajir.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria iria gusiira maragia ya Bungoma ya kwamba kurega nyiambo ya kusia ng'ombe kwa kumia kurega nyakubua ya mabinga na nyakubua ya maragia mema

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Uasin Gishu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Uasin Gishu gindigwa ntsa via e-Citizen portal nende osabire ID ogosaba.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Echibesa chieserikari ase obokoreri bwabanto ichorera emesangerekano yesukuru yechisemi chiobogesaku buna engencho yoborigereria igoro yechibesa chiekaonti ase Kitui amaumuntia.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Eriko: Eserikari ya TVET okoigora omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase abana bonsi cinse yomoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari ase Kajiado.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC yafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: IEBC okoigora ekeyia egetaseni gia oboronge bwobokorwa nobokorwa nobogosi aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges eligible citizens in Nyamira County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama bia siasa koborigwa abamenyi kwa Nyamira yekaunti kuegera okoreta abanto korwa ebirengererio.

English: In compliance with the directive issued by the National Emergency and Response Committee, we shall forthwith scale down court activities throughout the country over the next two weeks effective tomorrow, March 16, 2020 in order to allow further consultations and design appropriate measures to prevent the spread of the virus
Kiswahili: Kwa mujibu wa agizo lililotolewa na Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Dharura na Jibu, tutapunguza mara moja shughuli za mahakama nchini kote katika wiki mbili zijazo kuanzia kesho, Machi 16, 2020 ili kuwezesha mashauriano zaidi na kubuni hatua sahihi za kuzuia kuenea kwa virusi
Ekegusii: Kobwatekana nerichiko rirure n’Ekamiti Yense y’Omoaganano n’Amairanerio, ntokeanie emeroberio yebigambero, ense engima, emekubio ebere ekobwatia, gochakera mambia, March 16, 2020, erio koenana ribaga riogosemania mono na kobeka ebirengo biogotanga ogoichora kwebinyinyi.

English: Healthy mental life contributes to success in your daily work. Priritizing mental health contributes to fruiful work you do and increase yiour incomes
Ekegusii: Obongo bobwate afya engiya nigo bokorenta obobui as'emeremo ogokora. Gotang'ania afya y'obongo nigo gokomenta omokia as obogima, gwakeania ebirengererio, na komenta ebitoki/amagenderero.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Gazeti ya Kenya yoboriri oyera neri ya kuyereka kubororia ID ya Kenya ase akaunti ya Bungoma.

English: Uasin Gishu entrepreneurs can now engage with proposed policy reforms and financing opportunities Stay informed on the Draft MSME Policy 2025 and the MSE Amendment Bill 2025
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali wa Uasin Gishu sasa wanaweza kujihusisha na mapendekezo ya marekebisho ya sera na fursa za ufadhili Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu Rasimu ya Sera ya MSME 2025 na Mswada wa Marekebisho ya MSE 2025.
Ekegusii: Abiria wa Uasin Gishu bono bera na tebia kuhusu malengwa ya sasipati 2025 na madeni ya kutekeleza malengwa ya MSE 2025

English: NDMA alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi a Kirinyaga County koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) obokoreri bwa obokoreri bwa magenderero.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Garissa County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana kiaigoreire amabwana a Garissa County ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia buna chibesa chiechikanti chiabo chigokora emeremo, chibwana chikire chikire.

English: FAO advises farmers in Garissa County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: FAO yasemirie abaswani ba Garissa koerikia koerikia erio amorokererigua y'oboremi bwetugo, ayio are egekoro ekenene ase abaswani baobokoreri.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Migori County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna Universities Fund obasemirie endorero bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia buna egera nebigambero ao ao kore kere nga ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie gotoka ase.

English: TSC offers training programs for teachers on effective digital pedagogies for modern classrooms.
Kiswahili: TSC hutoa programu za mafunzo kwa walimu juu ya pedagogies digital ufanisi kwa darasa za kisasa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC)  nkorwa kere omoroberio bwogosomia abarimi igoro yogosomia ase enchera yegedichitri ase abana bebirasi bia bono.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Uasin Gishu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase entongori bwechikovota bwe Uasin Gishu bogoria amang'ana ID au pasipoto igoro yechikovota.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a cholera outbreak alert for Siaya County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kipindupindu kwa Kaunti ya Siaya. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Ewizara yoborwaria - Ekeombe kioborwaria bwabana na abakungu (Reproductive Health Unit) kiraririe ing'a kwaye oborwaro bwa cholela ase Siaya County. Abamenyi baragirwe gokorikia chichanjo chiabo chionsi cheria chiragirwe.

English: SHA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that input on the county budget process is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya yanakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: SHA baboririe abamenyi yechi Uasin Gishu etureti ya kebaki kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari yechikaonti.

English: Kevin Osido “ Exec. Dir., County Governance: There is a lot of fear, and a foundation must be created so that Kenyans can report corruption and see action taken. We must establish proper mechanisms for complaints, which are currently lacking
Kiswahili: Kevin Osido  Mkurugenzi Mtendaji, Utawala wa Wilaya: Kuna hofu nyingi, na msingi lazima uanzishwe ili Wakenya waweze kuripoti ufisadi na kuona hatua ikichukuliwa.

English: malaria vaccine that was tried in Kenya has beed confirmed by WHO
Kiswahili: chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa Kenya imethibitishwa na WHO
Ekegusii: Eriogo ri’esosera erio riatemetwe Kenya riancheranirwe na WHO

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises tea producers in Makueni County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Serivisi ya Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate yorora abarima bwa ciya mu Kaunti ya Makueni kugura ciya chebakiiremboka na abogora beya babirangamiye mbere ya igihe ekegeni.

English: WHO warns of virus outbreak; follow safety advisories.
Kiswahili: WHO yaonya kuhusu mlipuko wa virusi; fuata ushauri wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwense bwobochenu (WHO) bwarure ogokurera ogoro yomwateko bwenyinyi; bwatia amachiko obosemia.

English: The government put in place measures control measures when Covid Virus was detected and spreaded to 15 in the past time. New directives were imposed after eight people were diagnized and found to be infected with Covid 19
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabekire ebitambokero ekero ebinyinyi ebinyia bia Korona biamentekanete goika 15 ime ye'chinsa 72 chiaetire. Amachiko amayia nigo achete magega yabanto bande batano na batato gopimwa na konyorekana na COVID-19.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Abisi ya Aganisi yemenyere abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi baborogia kwete gosimeka emete yemenyere eserekari yechi kaunti yebinyoro yebokoreri.

English: DPP reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: DPP obaboririe abamenyi ba Samburu biechibarasa bieria gacha echibare nyami egerire gosiira mabare biechibare nyami biechibarasa.

English: HELB announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii.
Ekegusii: HELB ogosaba okogoria kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara kwao eskuli zechika Kiambu ebuagi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Murang'a County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia SHA (Social Health Authority) oboririe abamenyi ba Murang'a County konyora amang'ana ase oborwaire obo bwo typhoid obo bwakonyorekana, na goitaba ase abakonyi b'afya b'omochie.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Kisumu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia Kenya Red Cross yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire na Kisumu County koenekia amangana ebesa obokomokore, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia kubereko ebesa.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of poultry in Kiambu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo eretigite ogotambuka kwa chinkoko ase Kiambu County goetera oborwa bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Nairobi County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NDMA gacharia omomenyi o Nairobi gosemo na koraria koriba kwarwara gosiira gacha maene moke ni amanana.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera: DCI bokorwa obokurumi obwengencho ase omotuki omosiria omorobiria omoroboka bobwateranetie enibo ekaunti ya Siaya.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges goats farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa visa vya kimeta.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwe Erimo na Oboreri bwe Ebitugo baboririe ababoreri b'emburi ase Kakamega County koboria ase ofisi y'oboreri bwe ebitugo erio konyora oboate bwe ebitugo biabo biaremerwe n'oborwari bwa anthrax.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Migori County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross nigo egokaiyia abamama abamonyi ase Migori County ng'a okorua kw'ebirio bi'obokonyi ase abana abato nigo kire bosa ase chifasiri chi'eserikari chionsi.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in West Pokot County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Ekero ekeombe eke TVET ekorera abamenyi bo West Pokot County amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge bwabo.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Wajir County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'egetureti nigo egosaba omonto omonene oria okobwate oboremo bw'obochengereri ase Wajir County koba omokonyi ase omwaka oye oria okobwate oboremo erio asabe obokonyi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Busia County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board nigo korigiririe abaremi ba Busia County gochia ase ogotara chinchera chiogotindania chimboga na emegondo nigo konyora obuya bwobota bwomoto mbere yomwaka omotienyi 6 ogotara.

English: [Training Achievement] Over 91,000 teachers trained to deliver digital learning content as part of Digital Literacy Programme implementation
Ekegusii: [Ayaikereirwe ase okwegeria] Goetania abaarimu 91,000 baegerigwe buna bagochia gosomia chisemi chiegetekinorochia ase omoroberio bwokomanyia abana buna omoroberio ogikeranigwa

English: CDC urges residents of Samburu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: CDC egosaba abamenyi ba Samburu County korosia oborimbi bwa chindano chionse chigochanwa konyora konyuma y'ogokura kw'ebinyinyi bia HIV/AIDS.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Isiolo County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ekorwa ogosaba ogokora endorero yoborai amatindi ime yekaunti ya isiolo kwegoreria kwegoreria kwegora ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Kiambu County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) yabwirie abanto ba Kiambu County kwa abanto kwekwereria amang'ana nkobworire kwa emeremo eria eyio erigorie kwabu nkobworire kwa ekero ekwabu nkobworire.

English: Using a smartphone app, farmers can get a diagnosis of a crop disease and recommendations on what treatment to apply.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia programu ya smartphone, wakulima wanaweza kupata utambuzi wa ugonjwa wa mazao na mapendekezo juu ya matibabu gani ya kutumia.
Ekegusii: Kuokho okogesa kumwana, mifundi kumwana kuguva kusindika oboruaire na kurekodi gindigwa yake kuguva kuyagindigwa.

English: Latest publication A. ACAT 2025 has called on great investment in solutions of agriculture technology in Africa. A. Malawi farmers...
