Kiswahili: Mtihani wa elimu ya kiraia unavuja kwenye mtandao download version rasmi kutoka KNEC kabla ya bandia kuenea!
Ekegusii: Amatemwa yobogesaku nigo akoiberwa embeo igoro,  nyora amatemwa abeene goetera KNEC nyuma yamatemwa oborimo gosarera!

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Tana River County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Komunikesheni ya Kenya yachakire egonde a Tana River ase ekaunti yachabisa amakora aokogosia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia ase chikwani chokorera.

English: To lower cases of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, and enhance the vaccines and immunisation programme in the country, I have proposed Sh28.7bn for the Global Fund and Sh4.6bn for vaccines and immunisation programmes.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza visa vya VVU/UKIMWI, kifua kikuu na malaria, na kuongeza chanjo na programu ya kinga nchini, nimetoa pendekezo la Sh28.7bn kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Kimataifa na Sh4.6bn kwa programu za kinga na kinga.
Ekegusii: Gokeiyia oborwaire bwa Enyamoreo, Esese na Esosera na kogendereria emeroberio ye'chisindani chia ogotanga amarwaire aya, ase okorora kwane ndatebe, sh28.7 billion ase ekegancha gi'Ense na sh4.6bilion ase emeroberio ya chisindani chia ogotanga amarwaire.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya imetoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Ekegusii: Nyoche: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie ebirengererio bwa'ebinyoro bwa Tharaka-Nithi korwa egwokia omwera obokoreri ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for drought in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Chenya: DCI kera chingaki kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria omorakera ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay.

English: DPP warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: DPP yaboririe abamenyi okilifi gikombe giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kubonye obokoreri bwochinchera chiancheire kubonye kuokoria.

English: COMESA advises fish producers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: COMESA egokora abaremi b'ebisaba ase Siaya County gocha ase omosoko o'abaremi ogocha ogochaka mbere y'ekero giokogesa.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: DCI chera na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka kwa Homa Bay.

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Kisumu County that adult literacy classes registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ewizara y'Emasomo nigo egokomera abanyabanto ase Kisumu County buna okoregisita amasomo abakuru nigo kwarukire ase omotienyi 4.

English: KMTC encourages out-of-school children in Siaya County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KMTC nigo korigiria abana batari amasomoni ase Siaya County gochia gosega obonyakoni bwebursary mbere yebere ya ogochira ase obonyakoni obwo.

English: SHA warns public officers in Laikipia County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: SHA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: SHA ngosira kere chiofisi chia inse gotanga gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari aaria Laikipia kubera obokurumi.

English: To attain good markets: strengthening farmer groups from digital trainings and sales and reach good agricultural markets..
Kiswahili: Ili kupata masoko mazuri: kuimarisha vikundi vya wakulima kutoka kwa mafunzo ya dijiti na mauzo na kufikia masoko mazuri ya kilimo..
Ekegusii: Goikera echiro engiya: Gokong'ia obomo bwebiiombe bioboremi, korwa amasomo egechidigitari na oboonia, na goikerania echiro engiya nogo egokinia echiro yoboremi ...

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Oborimu: Enyonge chio obonyinge bwo'omwana ime yechisibitali chigenderere goika omotienyi 4 ase chichibitali chigendererete goika Narok.

English: EACC urges residents of Kirinyaga County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: EACC osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Kirinyaga kwerikia buna abanyene ekiama agasa kochichiri kochoria obisi.

English: For IFAD, this shows why digital agriculture needs to be at the very heart of its work. As the world's poorest people face spiralling food ...
Kiswahili: Kwa IFAD, hii inaonyesha kwa nini kilimo cha dijiti kinahitaji kuwa kiini cha kazi yake. Wakati watu maskini zaidi ulimwenguni wanakabiliwa na chakula kinachoongezeka ...
Ekegusii: Ase IFAD,eye nigo ekworokia egekogera obooremi bwegedicgitari boanetie kobekwa nkoro ase obokoreri bwaye. Buna abataka bense baonchokananire nenchara...

English: Notice: FAO will open a tea collection centre in Narok County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Narok Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: FAO egokora ekeombe kiokonyora chinchai ase Narok County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Ewizara y'amachio yaboririe amatariki okorendera abakure ase amasomo okosoma na okwandika ase amasukuru aaria Nyamira County.

English: Wash the utensils for feeding the child with soap to dirrhoea disease prevent
Kiswahili: Osha vyombo vya kumlisha mtoto kwa sabuni ili kuzuia ugonjwa wa dirrhoea
Ekegusii: Sibia ebinto imwana akoriera nesabuni gotanga oborwàire bwa ogosaa

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Ekegusii: Kwete: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) okoigora chideso cha gender chokorwania amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana ase ekaunti ya Busia.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Nandi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KEMSA eraririe oborwaire bwa typhoid ase Nandi County. Abanto baragirwe gokoresia chineti chie chinswa chiri na dawa ya chinswa kera gotuko.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Kirinyaga County to strengthen child protection in schools this January.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Januari hii.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS koriaga obiticha chinyeni a Kirinyaga gosegeta ting’igua igoro yokorenda abana obiticha chinyeni eng’atiato.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Meru County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Meru apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro, nere berekera esimi ya okonyora obokonyi ase abasubati bakogonkia GBV 1195 chinsa chinde chionsi, choria Meru.

English: CDC advises residents of Kakamega County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: CDC ogosia abanto ba Kakamega County koria sibia amaboko nesabuni na amache amarabu ogosia gotanga oborwaire bw'ebinto ebikorwa.

English: TVET advises applicants in Machakos County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET kigocha abasabi ase ekaunti ya Machakos kosaba gokwerika ase TVET korigereria KUCCPS ase okwerika okwo okwaisa.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Nyamira County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenywa abamenyi yekaunti ya nyamira ena eseregania chisela chechombe chomwishonjera chagachaga gacha gosiira ekombo ekirio.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IebC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) ngokichonire abaa abakuri omotienyi Tharaka-Nithi ngetarere chisekenderi IEBC chikurakia chokang'ombe awo abakuri omotienyi omochonire obweriki bwa abaaki chikura.

English: To prevent Fall Armyworm infestation, use high-quality, disease-free seed, avoid late or staggered planting, and increase plant diversity in your plots (for example intercropping) to make maize less attractive to armyworm moths.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia uvamizi wa minyoo ya Fall Armyworm, tumia mbegu za hali ya juu, zisizo na magonjwa, epuka kupanda kwa kuchelewa au kwa kuyumba, na uongeze utofauti wa mimea katika mashamba yako (kwa mfano kilimo kiingiliano) ili kufanya mahindi yasivutie nondo za jeshi.
Ekegusii: Kuokora oboruaire ya Fall Armyworm, kusia magoko mafua, magoko yeyote oboruaire, koka ogokomera magoko matatu au magoko makanyaga, na bucha mukorongo wa egetuma mu ekeraka yako (kwa mfano, kusia ogokomera magoko makundu) ili kumwesha egetuma kwa Fall Armyworm.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes agroforestry among farmers in Embu County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragete oboremi bwo ogotanda chinyamwaka ase abaremi ba Embu County buna ekerongo kio ogokonya oboremi konyora amagenderero ase omotienyi 6.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Homa Bay County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo ekoremereria abaremi ba Homa Bay County ase ogotoreka okwo gokwenderera kwokwigeria chinchera chinchia chiokogwita chindagera.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ebisarero bi'oboremi na oboreri bw'ebinyama biraburirie abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County goikera chinyomba chiogosangereria amache ase ebirima biabo erio gokonya ase ogotachana na ogotindoka kwa emvura.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NTSA kiyegese abamenyi Taita-Taveta koba maiso erio kwenekia obokoreri obwasioku.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi unaoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Ekegusii: AFA eribokire abanyamwaka ase Busia County igoro yomwaka ogokire ogokora amakande ase abanyamwaka abwo.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Makueni County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi aia Makueni koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) obokoreri bwa obokoreri bwa nyumba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kilifi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobori bwa obooremi na echiobi (AFA) nigo kigocha abaremi ase ekaunti ya Kilifi kobwata oborwaire bwa fall armyworm kare goetera emiti yoborwaire eye yemeretwe mbere yomwaka obooremi bwa omotienyi 2.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Turkana County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Turkana Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria oboitaai omosaria (DCI) giaansire okamanyia ayio gwaansire ase chisukuru Turkana esagati esagati.

English: Ministry of Health urges residents of Siaya County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Obosae bwe'ritongo nigo bogosaba abamenyi ba Siaya County goika gochia ase okomanya oborwa bwe'ndwari ya tuberculosis, bagende goika bagie gochira chindwara chionsi chio'gokonywa.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Kwale County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.

Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Nakuru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kakamega County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Septemba hii.

Kiswahili: Kanuni za Sekta ya Maziwa ya Kenya 2021 sasa ni sheria zinazoweka bei ya chini ya lango la shamba la Kshs 33 kwa kila kilo ya maziwa yanayowasilishwa Wakulima wanahimizwa kufahamu kanuni hizo.

English: OGP advises residents of Marsabit County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: OGP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Marsabit bogoria yonsi amasakara aogokora kogosomia buya gochia ogokora emeremo yao buna ogosomia buya gochia ID.

English: COMESA invites farmers in Kisumu County to a free training on greenhouse farming this February.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egokwenera abaremi ba Kisumu County ase amasomo abosa goetera oboremi bwogreenhouse omwaka omotienyi 2.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Kilifi County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Fundi giokorwa chibesa gonya endorero baria bare nokogania mu Kilifi County ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria ticha sasa.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) osabire abamenyi ba Uasin Gishu koegerera comiti eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio gose kana ekerieke nyachongo eusikaine.

English: FAO informs coffee farmers in Kajiado County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorera abaremi bwa kofi (FAO) nigo gikobatebria abaremi bwa kofi aaria ekaonti ya Kajiado buna erinde chinsoko chinsya chiokogurania chire gotanyorwa ase omotienyi 5.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Gorogo: Kenya Gazette itakorwa korwa aserikari yekaonti ase ebikaranso bia amaswari ase igoro yesisemi chirengete okobua kwomwana (CBC) mbikoreke chikaonti cha Embu.

English: Listeners win airtime by answering civic questions
Kiswahili: Wasikilizaji hushinda muda wa matangazo kwa kujibu maswali ya kiraia
Ekegusii: Abategereri eredio baranyare koiraneria amaborio igoro yobogesaku mbaegwe ribaga goaka chisimi chiabo bosa koiraneria amaborio.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Machakos County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi la kuanguka mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: FAO igosha abonge egetuma machakos amagoro gindigwa nyakorokoro gindigwa nyakorokoro oyera amagoro hii

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Isiolo County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this December.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba obosae bekaunti ya isiolo korekana amorokererigua ya okwegerigwa nobokwegerigwa noboosae esagati emo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure okobwatanigwa abamenyi Busia goeera eintaneti okobagera matumaini goeera eintaneti na abao abasani abo bembeo.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Lamu.
Ekegusii: Ngera: Bokoreri bweserikari TVET giatangasire programu yochisekenderi nchire ogosemia abana goetera abachisekenderi abachikorongoza Lamu.

English: TVET advises students in Siaya County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo.
Ekegusii: TVET yegindigwa endorero eSiaya County gindigwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma oigoirwe ase abana bechiyunifasiti.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Tana River County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Red Cross ya Kenya baborigwe ng'a abamenyi ase choria ase ekaunti ya Tana River b erekera namba ya GBV helpline 1195.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Chinga: NDMA kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoria korwa ebiateko omorero nareo ase egasi Bomet.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyeri County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) giaansire emeroberio ase obogaang a igoro yeserikari yechikaonti ase ekaunti ya Nyeri engoromomi.

English: Mothers should return for postnatal checkups within 48 hours, 7 days, and 6 weeks after delivery.
Kiswahili: Mama wanapaswa kurudi kwa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaliwa ndani ya masaa 48, siku 7, na wiki 6 baada ya kujifungua.
Ekegusii: Abangina goika bairane baringorigwa nyuma yokoibora ase chinsa emerongo enne na isato, amatuko atano na abere na emekubio etano noyomo

English: NTSA warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible drought this June.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Juni hii.
Ekegusii: NTSA ogokurerwa abamenyi bekaunti ya Makueni kwarwetwe gosorora omorakera omene ebuagi.

English: FAO urges farmers in Busia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo egosaba abaremi aaria Busia County gochia ase obotebia obwomwaka bwo gokonya ase oborimi bwo gokonya amagaka goikera oborimi bwa chitekinorochia ase okomanya goikera okonyora chimbura chitaragokwana.

English: Form One reporting starts January 6 – bring only admission letter and birth certificate.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti kidato cha kwanza kunaanza Januari 6 – leta barua ya udahili na cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee.
Ekegusii: Ogosoa esekenderi ase abana ba kerasi gia 1 nigo korachake chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotang'ani. Renta rirube riogokorangeria rioka nerisakara riria rikworokia omwaka omwana aiboretwe .

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a trauma counselling forum in Nyamira County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Ogochoka: Kenya Red Cross nigo egokora omoroberio bwokogokia abanto abakoreigwe nchera yobororo ase Nyamira County ime ya omotienyi 6. Abanto bonsi nigo bagokungwa.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Mandera County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri ya Kenya gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka ase, amwaga nindo abebele na abokeya abantochi Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago, na nindo abebele na abokeya abantochi omorero ogwateka.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Bomet County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobochari ikoibokia abanto ase Bomet County buna okobwate obwanchani bwa SHA nigo kwagenderera ase ebitari biria biatereirwe.

English: KRA advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Ekegusii: KRA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok gindigwa ase intaneti neserikari koba e-Citizen portal nesaba e-Citizen registration.

English: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Use a VPN if you must connect. Most free networks are not secure.
Kiswahili: Epuka kutumia Wi-Fi ya umma kwa ajili ya benki. Tumia VPN ikiwa ni lazima uunganishe. Mitandao mingi ya bure si salama.
Ekegusii: Erende korwa eWi-Fi yabanto bonsi kobeka chibesa ebengi. Tumia a VPN onye gokonyara gosoa ime. Chinetewaki chinyinge chia bosaare nchibwati borendi buya.

English: Support rural electrification 2023.
Kiswahili: Kuunga mkono usambazaji wa umeme vijijini 2023.
Ekegusii: Sira emeroberio yokobeka esitima omwaka 2023.

English: Coughing! High temperature! Sweating at night! Chest pains! Weight reduction! You can be infected with TB. Covid testing is done free at all government facilities! Get tested today
Ekegusii: Ogokorora! Riberera! Kogiramora botuko! Goatigwa egekuba! Gokea omobere! Nabo oratware Esese. Ogopimwa na oborwaria nigo bokoenanwa bosa ase chinyagitari chieserekali! Pimwa rero!

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMRI eribokire abakungu baria bari oborito ase Makueni County buna ogokonywa na abachumbe abanyabwate obwanchoni bwo gokonya abakungu korora abana nigo konyare gokorwa na bwerere ase chiofisi chiose chie eserekari.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nogo egosorora abaremi ba Kwale County ogokomera bisia okogesa korema amaroba riao keania omogoko bweriroba riao goika embura eyomo yogwekongia.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen okoraria oyera gochiera amachiko yokoraria na gokeani ogotakina goika ID gochindagera ekaunti ya Makueni.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Ekegusii: Enyorokero: KNEC nigo etangazete rituko ria okwenera abana bose bwo obosomi bwa sekondari obwomwene ase amasukuru ari Isiolo County.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kericho County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kericho Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere ogocha amo goetera emesangerekano yechisemi chia abarimu goetera enchera yamasomo igoro yogomia goetera enchera yechisemi chia ombudsmani ase Kericho riete.

English: Kenya has issued a warning on a bad mosquito that has come. Anopheles Stephensis causes bad malaria. All health workers have detected this mosquitoe at Mandera. Mosquitos transimit malaria among people and villages
Kiswahili: Kenya imetoa onyo kuhusu mbu mbaya ambaye amekuja. Anopheles Stephensis husababisha malaria mbaya. Wafanyakazi wote wa afya wamegundua mbu huyu huko Mandera.
Ekegusii: Kenya yakureire eumbu yachire embe. Anopheles Stephensi nigo ekoreta esosera embe. Abakori emeremo boborwaria banyorire eumbu eye aaria Mandera. Chiumbu nigo chikoenana esosera ase chinsemo ao ao ime y’emechi, n’ebinyoro.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Laikipia County this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio okorora n'okogokia amarwaire nigo korigokia abanto ng'a okororwa kwa amarwaire ya Rift Valley Fever nigo kware korwa bwere ase chinchokoro chi'oborwaria bwa eserikari chionsi ase Laikipia County ase omotienyi 9.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia okorora chindwa na ogotangigwa kwayo nigo kigoibokia abamenyi buna oboate bwo gotebigwa na goaka obogima bwo ogotiga oborogi nigo bori ase chichera chio obogima chio oboroberi ime ya Kiambu County.

English: Free plumbing and electrical courses offered in 50 TVET institutions.
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za mabomba na umeme zinazotolewa katika taasisi 50 za TVET.
Ekegusii: Chikoso chiamasomo igoro yokobwata amache goetera emetaro nesitima nkorwegwa chire ase chikolege 50 chiobobundi amo nechiosemi chiokwegendereria (TVET).

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a January awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egokora omwaka o omotienyi 1 ogokonyera abanto koba namanyora igoro ya oborwaire bwa chigukari ase ogosomwa ase Tana River County.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nyandarua County that school feeding programme registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria giechinsukuru chioboroso (Universities Fund) nigo gikwibuchia abasee ase Nyandarua County ng'a ogokwandika kwomoroberio bwokogaba endagera ase chinsukuru nigo gwatigwe ase omotienyi 3.

English: IPOA urges residents of Nandi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: IPOA osabire abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Nandi kwerikia buna abanyene IPOA kumuriria amakora igoro yomosiongoroko kwa abasikiria buna amid heightened attention to national peace-building.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Kwete: SHA okoigora ekeyia gia omoroberio bwechinyomba chierigori rianse bwechinyomba chienyia ya ID bkaunti ya Kakamega.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Nyandarua County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMRI egokoraria abanto bamenyete ase Nyandarua County korosia okonywa omunyu na esukari ase enchera eyemo yogotanga oborwari obo bware korwa ase okonywa binto ebi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Trans Nzoia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Ekegusii: Chama cha Habari za Kenya kumwambia wafanyabiashara wa ebesa wa simu mu Trans Nzoia kuwasiliana na wakawa wao kuhusu ujumbe wa kuharibu ili kujikwama kutokana na matendo ya kuharibu kwa ebesa wa simu.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto TSC ngokora kere omoroberio bwogosomia abanto igoro yamachiko yoboronge bwomonto o Kwale omonugunoobarema.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: Egeikaranso kiabagafana kiaigoreire amasomo yobogesaku komanyia buna chibesa chiechikanti chiabo chigokora emeremo Tharaka-Nithi.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kakamega County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Ekegusii: NPS nigo egosaba abanto bagotara na abanto bagotara namagoro Kakamega County ng'a babe goeta omorakera, tibatema gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Nakuru County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nakuru koegerera amakora a omosiongoroko kwa abakoriori bwa amakora amidia amakora a ekenyani.

English: AFA reminds residents of Lamu County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo ekobasibora abanto bwa Lamu County ng'a ogokonyora amabura nigo okonene buna oboremi obwogokura amabera amange.

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Garissa County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this September.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Fundi wa Chioya nere omorobaa esikole ase Garissa County okobaa ting’igua burukania abana baremaru nabana bande ase etureti ya kebaki.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Kirinyaga County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: TVET yaenekirie endorero bonsi abari Kirinyaga County ase omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase ticha omoroberio bwechisemi.

English: Mombasa County launched a text-based reporting line for victims to send secure complaints to oversight officials.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mombasa ilizindua laini ya kuripoti kwa njia ya maandishi kwa waathiriwa kutuma malalamiko salama kwa maafisa wa usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Ekaonti ya Mmobasa yaansete okomanyia gooetera rirube erieng'e riesimi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe gotoma ebirero biabo gochia abatenereri babasikari kobwatia amamocho ayio.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kericho County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Ekenene giokorenda obosombi yakenya yaboririe abamenyi yikeriho giasabire abanto koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire chokera obokoreri bwosombe yikeriho.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: IPOA yasemirie abamenyi ya Ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet gochakiri okobagera abao nabasani babo bembeo goeera eintaneti.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: IEBC igokora goika ase ebikaranso bia amasomo igoro yechikaonti chiomotienyi Kisii riete.

English: Kenyans have been warmed to stop consuming wild animals meat prevent monkey's disease transimission MPOX
Kiswahili: Wakenya wamehojiwa kuacha kula nyama ya wanyama wa mwituni ili kuzuia maambukizo ya magonjwa ya nyani MPOX
Ekegusii: Abakenya bakureirwe batige koria chingiti chia orosana erio gwetanga kwambokrigwa obirwaire bwa ebikondo(Mpox)

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this March.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Machi hii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nekoribokia abanto bonsi buna okorora amarwaire ya Rift Valley Fever nigo kware ase chinchokoro chiomonyansi chiomogongo chiensi ase Baringo County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Store sharp, toxic, or breakable items out of children's reach to prevent injuries.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi vitu vyenye ncha kali, sumu, au vinavyoweza kuvunjika mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha.
Ekegusii: Gacha ebinto ebioge, chisumu gose ebinto ebiororo kobunekana are korwa ase abana gotanga

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County on water harvesting this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya uvunaji wa maji Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: Kenya Dairy Board nigo egokwenda gotegeria abaremi aaria Elgeyo-Marakwet kaonti igoro y'okonyora amache chingaki chio omotienyi 9.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorora abamwalimu (TSC) nigo koretete chitariki chiokorendia abana ase amasomo amanyinge goetera oboremi bwekeombe keria kire Laikipia.

English: Learn the Heimlich maneuver to help someone who's choking.
Kiswahili: Jifunze mbinu ya Heimlich ili kumsaidia mtu anayekabwa koo.
Ekegusii: Soma na komanya igoro ya Heimlich maneuver erio omanye buna orkonye omonto ongentirwe nandagera gose amache.

English: Technology-facilitated abuse requires digital security training and documentation skills for affected individuals.
Kiswahili: Matumizi mabaya yanayowezeshwa na teknolojia yanahitaji mafunzo ya usalama wa kidijitali na ujuzi wa uandishi wa nyaraka kwa watu walioathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Ogokorerwa bobe goetra eintaneti neganetie oborendi bwegedichitari goetera ogosomia nenchera engiya yokorika na kogacha amang'ana ase bari bakoreire bobe.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Turkana County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: AFA nebangete abamenyi ba chinchogu Turkana agasa tigeria chinchogu chingaki abanto babwenerete korwa isiko kogenda chinka aaria agasa bwekibere ake oborendi bwabeire buya ake.

English: Home to costruct good and safe toilets to enciourage young children to use them to ensure health environment
Ekegusii: Chinka chirosie chichoo chiabo buya ase okoa abana oberemu gochitumia goikerania obochenu

English: NDMA urges the community in Nyamira County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Ekegusii: NDMA biebisa egonde e Nyamira egire komanyia amakora ase ababisi erio kobatumia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Lamu County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Lamu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Ekeorokererio: CDC nigo egwete ing'a erire yorwaria rwa Rift Valley Fever nigo eretire obwate ase Lamu County. Abanto nigo bagotebwa kwerinda goikana na amache ayo agokwanirwe na oborwaria obwo.

English: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.
Kiswahili: Sera na mafunzo mahali pa kazi huzuia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia kwa kuweka ufafanuzi ulio wazi, njia za kuripoti, uchunguzi, na huduma za usaidizi kulingana na mifumo ya kisheria ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Koba namachiko ase abanto bagokora emeremo na kobaegeria igor yoboronge bwa mwanyabanto ngokonya ere gokorerwa bobe kebwanchani egekogera kera omokori emeremo amanyete buya nga ogokora eke gose keria aya naria naro aramonyore, chinchera omonto akomanyeria abane igoro yayio, obotuki, amo nemeroberio yokomosira korengna nerichiko riense.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: DCI obotambe ase ewizara yobotugi obaboririe abagambi komanyia abanto bonsi amagenderero yeserekari naororo konyora okwanyoka kweriroba.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot.
Ekegusii: Nyora: DCI obaboririe omoroberio omuya bwokoyarora igoro yokoyarora yobwengencho abamenyi ase omogabana ya West Pokot.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Ngo: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) nkiarwete ngoro gokonya gisikanye gisikanye na ebesa egegurumire na abanto basirete na Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a depression awareness forum in Laikipia County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KEMRI egakora omotienyi ogokoraria abanto ase obongo omotienyi (depression) ase Laikipia County ase omotienyi 7. Abanto bonsi nigo bagetigwe.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Ekegusii: Tukono: Komisi ya Maalumia ya Walimu okoigora chia ekeyia cha kusoma na kuchuuma mashindano kwa sekondharia kwa chuma cha vokasionali kwa kaunti ya West Pokot.

English: NPS reminds the public in West Pokot County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NPS yarure okoboria ase abamenyi baborigwe West Pokot koba maiso erio gokinia obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces eye and dental camps for residents of Makueni County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Obochenu - Ekeombe gia Obochenu bwokwibarana nigo koroire amangana ase ekampeini ya eriso na meno ase abamenye ba Makueni County goetera omotienyi 6.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kwale County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorora oborwari na okogera (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo korigiririe abang'ina aaria Kwale County gochia ase chibitaro chia oborito chiri habe na abana babo nigo konyora obonyinkani bwa oborwari bwa abana babo.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: IEBC yachakire oyera korwania okonyeka okonene Kwa endwari eye chiechiumbu ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: The WFP is providing 1 050 modern beehives to 260 farmers in 11 counties to enhance beekeeping and boost honey production Farmers are encouraged to engage in this lucrative industry
Kiswahili: WFP inatoa mizinga 1,050 ya nyuki ya kisasa kwa wakulima 260 katika kaunti 11 ili kuimarisha ufugaji nyuki na kuongeza uzalishaji wa asali Wakulima wanahimizwa kujihusisha na sekta hii yenye faida kubwa.
Ekegusii: WFP ino chia 1050 kihive kya mbee moderni kwa 260 mifarmia ma 11 marua kwa kuhoma mbee na kuhoma neka ya honey Mifarmia yamuchukuliwa kwa kufanya kazi kwa hii soko ya chuma

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiogosiri abamenyi bo Elgeyo-Marakwet ekaunti na korwa kiogosiira gacha mikwa ekyekeri kogosiira ekyekeri kwa abamenyi

English: The Rockefeller Foundation is partnering with Kenya to enhance food security and promote agricultural innovation Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders should stay updated on new initiatives
Kiswahili: Rockefeller Foundation inashirikiana na Kenya kuimarisha usalama wa chakula na kukuza uvumbuzi wa kilimo Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanapaswa kusasishwa kuhusu mipango mipya.
Ekegusii: Amokeyia Rockefella amebera na Kenya kurema endagera na kuteka magumo ya kurema Farmers na wamagumo wamemali wendani wamebera na ekeyia magumo

English: NTSA reminds residents of Embu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NTSA gosokoria abamenyi ba Embu koborigwa gosoka ase obokoreri ao ao obwo bokoenanwa gacha gosiira kwebwabwera bwo'morai.

English: KICD endorses various online learning platforms to supplement classroom instruction for students.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) yarure okoboko gochia emeroberio ao ao yogosomera goetera emeroberio yeintaneti gosira amsomo ekarasi chisukuru.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Nabanto: Obokoreri bwekenya biaKenya okoigora ekeyia bokorosia esatifiketi yokoiborwa gose ekeyia Kitui chiekaonti.

English: NCPB informs avocado farmers in Kakamega County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokwenera abanyamwaka bamaavokado ase Kakamega County amariuko amayia ogokonyora chiro chia ogotunda amariuko aya ase omotienyi 9.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto amang'ana entongori eka Kisii County eka IEBC registration centre.

English: Be cautious of 'too good to be true' offers for rentals or purchases.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na ofa za 'nzuri sana kuwa kweli' za kukodisha au ununuzi.
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso nebinto bikororekana buya na buna ebiekeene bikorugwa ogore enyomba aase gete.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kwale County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross b erekera abamenyi ba Kwale kabwaterana korenda kubereka nchi ni mwereka omwano.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Ekeyia: IEBC okoigora genkio ekeyia kochiokorera okomanyia abanto erio komenta ba e-Citizen ba Embu koborigwa.

English: Notice: KTDA will open an avocado collection centre in Marsabit County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KTDA nigo egwanchoka ogotara ekiencho giokonyora amapera ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Turkana County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Turkana Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Enyarora: CDC egokora omoroberio bwokogokia abanto korwa ase obooro bwe chindawa ase Turkana County ase omotienyi 6. Abanto bonsi nigo babwate ogwancherwa gocha.

English: Government department, has commited to use solar power in food preservation in more secure manner
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwa eserekali, rwerure gosegeta obotumeki bwe chinguru chia omobaso ase okogacha chindagera bwango naende chibwate obuya obonge

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Kisii County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonyakerogo bwe' biama bia siasa orongo rwa Kisii, obooririe abamenyi kobwati okorita choria yebisi yomonyakerogo ni okara, nobwatekwa, na nobwatekwa kogo.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Meru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Aprili.
Ekegusii: KTDA egoteba abanyamwaka ba Meru County gosekeria chigero chiembori chiremererwe mbere yomura goika ase omotienyi bwa omotienyi 4 bwo gokuna.

English: Access relevant education and training. b. Have ... agriculture production. o Existing supportive agricultural facilities e.g., soil labs, physical market ...
Kiswahili: Pata elimu na mafunzo husika. b. Kuwa na ... uzalishaji wa kilimo. o Vifaa vya kilimo vilivyopo kwa mfano, maabara ya udongo, soko la mwili ...

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeorokererio: Ekeombe kio abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kigokora ekeombe giokorua obobwenia ase obwanto bwa Bungoma County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Farmers in Nakuru are invited to participate in the revival of the pyrethrum sector The county government has invested Kshs 70 million to provide clean planting material
Kiswahili: Wakulima mjini Nakuru waalikwa kushiriki katika ufufuaji wa sekta ya pareto Serikali ya kaunti imewekeza Kshs 70 milioni kutoa nyenzo safi za upanzi.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria Nakuru bana okuragia kuhoma kwenye kiserikali ya pyrethrum kiserikali ya kaunti ya Nakuru ame ogokomera malenga shillings 70 milioni kuhoma kwenye ogokomera malenga

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Tana River County to register their children at the nearest public school under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Ekegusii: HELB egokera abanto ba Tana River County gosekeria abana babo ase esukuru yechisereketi eri hakire ase oboremi bwe esukuru yechisikondari yechigari.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Registrar ya Biama bia Siasa yoborogwe abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi bwochwekwe na kogosa gokosa gokorwa ebirengererio bia siasa kwa webasaiti yebwochwekwe yoting’igua birengererio binyoro.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Tana River County on terracing this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya mashindano ya terracing Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Enyandiko: KTDA egokora ogotebia abanyamogondo ase Tana River County ase ogotera amaterasi ase omotienyi 9.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Nandi County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: IEBC baboririe abamenyi ba Nandi kaonti goetera omonto gose obomo bwebiombe, gosaba ogotingererwa kwa amangana are inse yobambi bwabo.

English: COMESA advises farmers in West Pokot County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: COMESA yasemirie abanyamwaka ase West Pokot County gochia namba yabo yegokwandika erio gochia ase ogotenywa kwomwaka okorua.

English: NTSA warns residents of Kilifi County to prepare for possible road accidents this May.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Mei hii.
Ekegusii: NTSA amabere abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kilifi amaumuntia kwa mabereka igoro yemebasekano yepara ama mesi amaumuntia.

English: Ministry of Health announces outpatient services for residents of Kiambu County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuanzia Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Eministiri yechisemi chioborigoro yakamanyia ng'a abamenyi ba Kiambu County barakua n'obwanchani bwo gochaka oborwari bwa abanto batararara ase esibitari korwa omotienyi 1.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Tharaka-Nithi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo ria abarai: CDC egokora ogosima oborwaire bwa sukari (diabetes) bwa bosa ase Tharaka-Nithi County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka, abamenyi korwa Murang'a.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Medical Association nigo gikobasema abamama abamemere ase Samburu County ng'a okonyora obotumi bwe chindagera chie chika (family planning) nigo keri bosa ase chifasiriti chiensi chieserikari.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
