Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Ekegusii: KALRO oboririe abaremi b'enguruwe ase ekaunti ya Isiolo kororia chinyamoche chiraire ase ofisi y'abaveterinari eria eri hakuhi konyora amang'ana y'oborwaire bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Marsabit County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama bia siasa obooririe abanto buna bategate obogambi bwabo korwa ebirengererio buna amachiko abwenerete korosigwa, korika baria ribaga riabo ria bene ase okoraagwa esagati.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of West Pokot County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeigo gia Kenya gia okorora obwate bwechimera (KEPHIS) nkoibwokia abanto ba West Pokot County ng'a ogotang'a obotaka nigo okong'onyora oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: Director SCM, Harley Mutisya urges suppliers and service providers to communicate with accuracy on any issues that may hinder their ability to deliver on time to IEBCKenya
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi SCM, Harley Mutisya anawasihi wasambazaji na watoa huduma kuwasiliana kwa usahihi kuhusu masuala yoyote ambayo yanaweza kuzuia uwezo wao wa kuwasilisha kwa wakati kwa IEBCKenya.
Ekegusii: Omorai omonene oyo SCM Harley Mutisya obooririe abaereri na obokreri goteba kengima gose bokongu bonde mborabeo boratange chinguru chiabo tibaikerani ase IEBC kenya

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene getenenerete goaka chikura giachikire ng'a chiunifasiti chionsi chibe chisenta chiokorika abaaki chikura giaansire abamenyi ba Laikipia ekaunti tebia emeroberio ase bera ogotiotereria go'kwerikia buna abaaki chikura.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: Ogokororia: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okoigora abanto mbasoka korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago na kobeka oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

English: SHA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya kirinyaga kwerikia buna abogwabogwa bwa wakabere bera tebia gosira magenderero gwekaunti yabo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) kurgwe abamenyi n'Kirinyaga County naikoria na ebirengererio korua isiko buna ekeene kia obotenereri ase obuy3 na kiagoirwe naikorwa kubwenerete November yio.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Bomet County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oborokeri bweching'ende (KEPHIS) nkogenda gokora omotito bwokobeka oboboremi bweching'ende ase abaremi ba Bomet County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Uasin Gishu County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigeikwara abantu ba Uasin Gishu binyoro boka kere nokomanyia abanto amang'ana igoro yechikaonti chiabo ase ebinyoro yechikaonti yegikwana.

English: Smallholder tea farmers are urged to stay informed about this year s bonus payments which have been affected by external market conditions
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kuwa na taarifa kuhusu malipo ya bonasi ya mwaka huu ambayo yameathiriwa na hali ya soko la nje
Ekegusii: Makundi makisio ya chaa amuragia ku tebia kuhusu malalo yale ya kumwela kuhusu mwaka wrui woye wali wametoboka na marigiti marua

English: We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.
Kiswahili: Tunawasihi Wakenya kuthibitisha ofa za kazi kutoka kwa mashirika ya ndege, hasa Emirates na Qatar Airways. Ulaghai mwingi unaoahidi ajira za viwanja vya ndege umeripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abakenya komanya buya amatangaso yechigasi korwa ase ebitii bienchindege, mono kobua buna keria Emirates na Qatar. Amatangaso amange yoborimo igoro yemeremo ase ebitii biechindege bwaansire.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Komisheni y'abasoma igokora ogosaba kwa endorero chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara ku mashuri ga Busia ebuagi.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kajiado County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekerechi ya Kenya Medical Association eragete omonto omonene orenge ase obororo bwobwongo ase Kajiado County goetera ekaunti eyio goetera namba ya simu ya obwongo etari yogocha chinsara.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Embu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorima na oboreri bwemichie giiburetire aboreri bemichie ase Embu County koba maiso gotara gochia na emichie yabo goeta chimbaka chie kaunti ende batari na echitibara kio goeta, nigo kigoita obogima bwemichie.

English: Bursary fraud alert: Only apply via official county portals – ignore WhatsApp scammers.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa igoro yechibesa chiogosomera: Toma ogosaba kwa goetera omoroberio bwekaonti yegetekinorochia obeene, ombia oborianania bwa abaibi ba Whatsapp.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS ekobasoka abanyamwaka banchera ase Narok County koripoti chinyamu chire oborwa ase ofisi yechivetinaryi eria eri hakoinya nigo konyora obochenu bwe chinyamu.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya gatonye omorero niTharaka-Nithi geyoni gatonye omorero n'obere ogegusa omorero.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Korwo: Eminisitiri yechisemi okoigora omoroberio bwechisemi gochia gosomera abana babwate ase Baringo County.

English: EACC advises residents of Wajir County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Ekegusii: EACC anamwonye nyamaboko yu Wajir yonsi bogoria amasakara yonsi yasiyogwika kubera nyamakasa wakati wa kumfumuza vurugho vya pasipoto.

English: DCI reminds residents of Machakos County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DCI osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya Machakos kojireka amagoro yebintu yebaboririe bonyamabere kwarorekanire aaria.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Isiolo County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokureiria abaturageti ba Isiolo County buna okobaka chitarasi konyora okongerera oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: The government is considering revising the Coffee Cherry Fund regulations to better benefit coffee farmers including potential access to farm inputs on credit
Kiswahili: Serikali inafikiria kurekebisha kanuni za Mfuko wa Coffee Cherry ili kuwanufaisha vyema wakulima wa kahawa ikiwa ni pamoja na kupata pembejeo za kilimo kwa mkopo.
Ekegusii: Serikali ina kusindana kuhusu kurevisha masharti ya Fondo ya Chikagwa ya Kirema ili kufanya zose zitakusaidia wafugaji wa chikagwa kama vile uwezo wa kupata vinywaji vya oboremi kwa kipato

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a maize collection centre in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Okobamanyia: KEPHIS egokora ekerio kiokogwata chibage ase Meru County omotienyi oyu o omotienyi 5.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: FAO egokora omotito ogw'okwiga emetara emayia y'okwomwera chinyama ase abaremi ba Kilifi County omotienyi ogwo omotienyi 6.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange reports that the recent auction sold 412 tonnes of coffee translating to a gross return of KES 129 per kilogram of cherry
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi linaripoti kwamba mnada wa hivi majuzi uliuza tani 412 za kahawa ikimaanisha kurudi kwa KES 129 kwa kila kilo ya cherry.
Ekegusii: Chikagwa cha 412 toni kati okoonia kwa Nairobi Coffee Exchange, kana kumwana kwa KES 129 ekiro kwa chikagwa cha cherry

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Mombasa County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ajili ya ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abachiri bwa Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nikigoibokia abanto bose ase Mombasa County igoro yobwenero bwo gochia na obochio bwa chinyomba chiao erio oborageria bwa chinyomba chiao.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs maize farmers in Embu County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi na chiri (AFA) nigo erekoboreria abaremi bwebituma ase Embu County igoro yechiro chinyia chio goikera echiro ase omotienyi 6.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kiambu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yobonyagitari eyio etari gochiara eya KEMRI erakorwa ase Kiambu County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free food safety outreach in Siaya County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Siaya Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio ogotebia abanto: Egesaku gia ogotebia na ogokora igoro yoborwari nigo kigocha gokora omoroberio ogotari gochara igoro yoborokeri bwe echio ase Siaya County ase omotienyi 5.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Machakos County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: ODPP baboririe abamenyi bekaonti ya Machakosyamanyirie ng'a ogkeania obosaria kwarorekanire aaria ensemo ya kaunti ting’igua obogambi bwekenyoro.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Kericho County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this February.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Oboremi na Enyamwamu (AFA) nigo korigia abaremi ba Kericho County ase ogotigwa obotegi obwomwanya igoro yemerobere yobokorogeri bwa amache bwa kare, ase omotienyi 2.

English: State Department for TVET reminds youth in Marsabit County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bya State Department for TVET bikoribua abamura na abanyaroka ase Marsabit County buna obonyamwamu bwa HELB bura bwo konyora amariuni ase ogotebwa gochia obokoreri bwa catering na hospitality.

English: Notice: TSC launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Ekegusii: Notice: TSC oboririe oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru kwenyara bwense abamenyi ase omoroberio bwokorenda abatari kwenyara bwense a West Pokot.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Kisii County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorosia endorero ase Kisii County rika amanyekane nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao kubokonya komanya buna amasomo egera ebirengo bioboikeranu.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC kiorangerete abarengeti babana ase Migori County gochia gokwandika amakadi abana nabang'ina ase omwaka omotienyi 10 nigo ekerio kioborigori bwobochenu bwabang'ina nabana.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Marsabit County this December.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI egokibukia abanto ing'a okororwa HIV/AIDS nigo kware ase chibitaro chiomwene biansi ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 12.

English: It's evident that farmers trained on digital information on quality standards, increase yields, income and sustainability.
Kiswahili: Ni dhahiri kwamba wakulima wamezoezwa juu ya habari ya digital juu ya viwango vya ubora, kuongeza mavuno, mapato na uendelevu.
Ekegusii: yarorekanire ng'a abaremi baegeriigwe goetera obomanyi bwegechiditari bagesire rigesa riabo, ebitoki na na ogwetenenera.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for passport services in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ofisi ya Auditor-General okoigora ekeyia gia servisi ya pasipoti aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu.

English: Announcement about SNV pledging continued support to Kenya's food systems transformation during Nairobi National Summit.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu SNV kuahidi kuendelea kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya mifumo ya chakula nchini Kenya wakati wa Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Okorari korwa SNV koria chiira kogenderera gokonya oboonchorerio ase chindagera orogongo rwa Kenya chingaki chia okoomerana okonene Nairobi

English: If the cord stump bleeds or oozes pus, seek medical attention immediately.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kipande cha kamba ya mshipi kinatokwa na damu au kutokwa na pus, tafuta matibabu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Onye ekenyogu gekorwa amanyinga gose amaira, rora omonyagitari bwango

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Korwa: Direktorat ya Omosaria Oboitaai (DCI) okoigora kia gendaa kia kiafia chierigori bwebina goika bwechindege goika bwango erio korwa obobogoria as abarwaire besosera aaria ase ekaunti ya Kakamega.

English: KICD advises students in Siaya County to collect materials from the county education office to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Ekegusii: KICD oboririe endorero ime ya Siaya ekaunti koagara ebibande konyora ebirengererio bia ofisi ya ekaunti ya ekoloni konyora kuboria ebirengererio bia.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on border security in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this April.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": DCI yamanyia egonde omosiongoroko a Elgeyo-Marakwet ekaunti go April.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Eripoti: Kenya Red Cross okoigora ekegendo eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio ekaonti ya Migori.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ewizara y'obochenu, ekitengo kia okorora na ogosubia oborwaire, nigo egokora abanto bose ba Kirinyaga County buna obokonyi bw'okonyora chibesa chia NHIF/SHA nigo bwakonyora ase ebiongo ebiaroreirwe.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Makueni County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Ekegusii: IPOA berekera abamenyi obo Makueni egonde kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kirendia egonde ekenene kirendia chingaki kirendia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Uasin Gishu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Chung'ongo: Ofisi ya Regera ya Viwanda vya Kisiasa okoigora vinywa vya kufundishia wabambo ma Uasin Gishu Mkaa Eng’atiato

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Kajiado County on progress of county development projects this November.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kajiado County kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Novemba.
Ekegusii: Ejudisiari ya Kenya yasegetire abamenyi ba Kajiado bwo'kaonti na kobasaba kwebwaterania amagenderero ase amabonyekei ase amagenderero ao ao na mwe November.

English: KMTC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Kiambu County this December.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC yararirie okobaga ebinto biogosomera egedichitari ebisagane kwa esagati ase emeroberio Kiambu County.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Uasin Gishu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this November.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chibesa korwa obosae bose Uasin Gishu County korika amorokererigua ya kubomba na kubokera chioboro chiini November.

English: Free voter education WhatsApp bot launched – save 0111222333 and type HI now!
Kiswahili: Boti ya elimu ya mpiga kura ya WhatsApp imezinduliwa – hifadhi 0111222333 na andika HI sasa!
Ekegusii: Amasomo abosa goetera omoroberio o'WhatsApp ogwetebereria bwoka oansire kobwate/kogache amag'ana goetera 0111222333 ase ogokwania HI bono!

English: FAO promotes organic farming among farmers in Siaya County as part of the September climate resilience drive.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange remains under the Coffee Directorate s oversight the Capital Markets Authority is advised to refrain from licensing it as an auction
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi limesalia chini ya usimamizi wa Kurugenzi ya Kahawa.
Ekegusii: Chikagwa ya Nairobi yikorongoa kweny Coffee Directorate Capital Markets Authority yikweme kuyatia nyakorongozo maro kama aukshon

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: DCI nigo yaechekirie omoroberio gwo okorwanika n'ebiateko bie dharura bia omorero ogochia gobochia ase Kaunti ya Laikipia.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a June awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Ekegusii: Egisera y'okorora na ogosubia chindwara nigo egwancha omwaka bwa omotienyi 6 bwo ogokonya abanto bamenye obuya bwo gokoroba chianja ase Kericho County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano homa ya dengue wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia okorora na okorwanirira oborwari nigo kaboririe abamama na ababa ase Uasin Gishu County gochia gosegeta abana baria bare ase emiaka etano gosegeta okororwa oborwari bwa dengue fever ase omotigo ogoetera omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Nya: EACC itegeka amaswari ase ebirengererio bia abanto chiomotienyi 2 abwo ase chinyoba chiebikaranso biekaonti ya Kilifi.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Ekegusii: COMESA egokana abaremi ase Ekaunti ya Nakuru gokora obochanchani bw'ebimeri nigo barete obonyinge bw'amataka mbere y'omwaka bwa omotienyi 1.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Bungoma County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bw'Oboremi na Obokuria bw'Etugo nigo bogoibuchia abanto ba Bungoma County ng'a oboremi bw'ebinyamwamu nigo bogoongera obonyamwamu bw'oboremi ase engaki ende.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 5.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Samburu County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekambani ya Pest Control Products Board nigo egosoka omwaka ogokorera chimbisi chioboria chiri Samburu County chibesa chio gotemwa oborwaire bwa anthrax chitariki chia omotienyi 10.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Ngera: Bokoreri bweserikari TVET giatangasire chisekenderi chinguru ase ogokonya abana goetera abachisekenderi goetera Kajiado.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Keombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenywa abanto bari Narok ekegokonya nagoita kwa ebiateko omorero ngo eng'atiato.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Turkana County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yemwitu yeku TVET yemwana omwana chisemi chire Turkana County ting’igua burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase eng’atiato.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Kisii County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: KNEC obabwateranirie abamenyi ba Kisii County kobatibia amagenderero gao nebirenga bera tebia ase amagenderero amo nebirenga biekaonti.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen child protection in schools this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Bieserikari igoro TVET mbaorogetie esikole e Nyandarua ting’igua igoro yokorenda abana esikole ebuagi.

English: DCI urges residents of Nyandarua County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: DCI osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nyandarua kwerikia buna omorai ekiama ya enyoro kiao omosiongoroko amid heightened attention to border security.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Turkana County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokonyia abaremi ase ekaunti ya Turkana gochiregista ase ebitongori biokogokonyana biabere biachirekeretwe nigo konyorekana amachiro amaya ase chinswi.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri yarure ogokurera ase okoigora ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto Communications Authority of Kenya nkorwa kere obokonyi bwa bosa chingaki chiemesangerekano emenene Kiambu.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Siaya County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen okabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Siaya gotokoria nyina ekaunti yabo ebobokororia enibo enyina yabo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwangeria abanto ng'a obokonyi bwogotanga okwiyita obo bwo bwerere nbo bwarete ase chifasiliti chie chiremo ase Kakamega County.

English: The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
Kiswahili: Mahakama imepokea malalamiko kuhusu wito bandia wa mahakama unaotumwa kupitia barua pepe. Wito haujawasilishwa kielektroniki au kupitia WhatsApp.
Ekegusii: EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of West Pokot County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kirengiere abamenyi ase omoroberio wopokot ya sugusu kachapin obaboririe ase omorero ase chingaki chinyinge omagoro ya chingaki chikonya.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Turkana County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ebiro y'Oboroche (Ministry of Health) - Ekeombe gie Ebiro y'Oboroche bwa Abangina nigo gokororia omonto omonde orenge na oborwa bwe chinsongo ase Turkana County goetera e namba ya simu ya bwerere ya oborwa bwe chinsongo.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kwale County to prepare for possible flooding this August.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororie abamenyi ba Kwale birengereka kubirengereka kwa riete.

English: KALRO urges sorghum growers in Lamu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo erure ogokurera abanyabireti bamasaka aaria Lamu County gosegeta chimbegu chiomwaka chire chire chigokora buya ase ogokora amakungu nigo gokong'ia ebiara ase omwaka oyu.

English: Government issues advisory on animal feed quality to prevent aflatoxin contamination.
Kiswahili: Serikali hutoa ushauri juu ya ubora wa malisho ya wanyama ili kuzuia uchafuzi wa aflatoxin.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nigo ekorwa ogosemia igoro yechindagera chingiya chietugo erio gotanga amarwaire akoretwa nesumu korwa nokobosa gwechinyeke.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Kericho County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gokora oboremi bwa chindagera (Pest Control Products Board) nigo gikobasoka abarimi ba Kericho County igoro yomoberio ogoendeerereria ogwegeria oboremi bwa kera na kera goetera okomwaga amache.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi oboroso emeremo abosae bo Narok County oko HELB emeremo rigiya riokorokereria amorokererigua okonye obokonye obokorwa.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonyene: KEMSA egakora ogosima oborwa bwa sukari ase obosa ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 11.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ramani ya barabara ya kitaifa kwa ajili ya uingiliaji katika lishe katika wilaya na kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Okoraria omoroberio ase orogongo igoro yechindagera ase ekaunti naboigo ense yonsi

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Egekoro: IPOA okoigora esimi ya GBV ogoaka kobamanyia buna abasikari bakomocha ase emeremo yabo egokora emeremo amatuko onsi chinsa chionsi ase abakungu aaria Narok.

English: Ministry of Health announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Nandi County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi'obochari bi'Eserikari y'Obonyang'anyi nigo ebitangazete ogotebwa kwa ebiara bi'okorwaria chimpio (dialysis) ase abanto b'omwaka Nandi goetera omotienyi 10.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Murang'a County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egosaba abarebi be abana aase Murang'a County gocha ase rituko ria klinik ria kera ririko ase ekampeini ya afya ya abamama ya omotienyi 6.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Ngochandeka: IEBC giaansire amachiko arengete gotanga, gokwanerana na gokeania okomocherwa gose gochaya abana bande arurwe ase chisuku chiesekenderi ya nse ya Migori.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie abanyasi ba Nairobi County korengana kwa forum y'amasomo maiborera kubera bera tebia kwa kwegara kwa kubora kwa voter registration.

English: CDC reminds the public in Homa Bay County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: CDC eribokire abanto ba Homa Bay County buna ogosaria ogw'okoregisita SHA nigo kwareo ase chiesitashoni chireo.

English: NCPB warns millet farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: NCPB neegochora abaremi b'obori ase Uasin Gishu County igoro y'ebinyamunyama ebiroreire na gosegeta omoroberio bwo gokora chingaki.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera egonde a Wajir County ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na kereka chisukuru chikorera chisukuru chikorera chisukuru.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Medical Association nigo egosaba abarendi babana ase Kisumu County konyandika amakadi abangina na abana ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 10 bwo ogokonyora obochenu bwabangina.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a fraud prevention campaign in Wajir County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Wajir Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Nabwete: Kenya Red Cross agokonya ekero kia gokorwa ritangani chingaki chimobasekano Wajir County egetamo March.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Nyamira County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Nyamira na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Omoreri bwobosemia bwobokoreri: CDC yabucha erio okorwania esosera ya enkoromba cyclosporiasis Nyamira County, yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia chineti chie'chiumbu chibekire eriogo koba koba.

English: Painted by civic clubs and local artists
Ekegusii: Abanyakenyoro bgokora emeremo yabo amo gokinia ekenyoro kiabo bang'ororirie chibicha igoro yebinyoro biabo nabanyagosori.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi a Busia County koerikia obokoreri bwa carjacking boborendi na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Eripoti ya oboruaire bw'ekiama berekera abasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia abana goetani motato kwerikia esese ase esagati ase obosemi.

English: EACC warns public officers in Nakuru County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: EACC aoriora abakuria ekaonti ya Nakuru kana kurendeleka kurendeleka.

English: NTSA warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: NTSA yasemirie abamenyi ya Elgeyo-Marakwet gose ebengi yao yobobisi ya PIN ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Ekegusii: TSC nigo egokora omwonyo abana batari amasukuru ase Kiambu County konyora obwate bwechisukuru mbere yechitariki yegokera ase ogotaba chibesa chiesukuru.

English: Kenya promotes livestock disease prevention programs.
Kiswahili: Kenya huendeleza mipango ya kuzuia magonjwa ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kenya negendererete gosegeta omoroberio bwogotanga amarwaire etugo.

English: KMTC invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Juni hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC nkoetia abasubati ime ya Kiambu County gochia gosoma obokoreri bwa welding na fabrication omotienyi 6 eyi.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Enyamwonyo: Eminisitiri yechisemi nigo agotangaza chitariki chiogochakia okorendika abana abasomi boprimari abatarari bogocha chinsomi chia Nyeri County.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kajiado County.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obchori (IEBC) giechimbebe oyera obweriki bwa oboriori bwa e-Citizen komenta Kajiado.

English: CDC encourages residents of Nyeri County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Nyeri County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: KALRO urges beans growers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KALRO) nkorwa kobaboria abaremi b'ebihingwa ase Garissa County kobwatesia ebitabi bi'ebihingwa biria birengete gochira obocha bwa riuba nigo bigokonya kong'erera ebitoki ase risesa eri.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe kia maunibasiti nigo koretia amagita okwenera amachiko amabere ase amasukuru aya sekondari ase amasukuru are ase Samburu County.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Isiolo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya baboririe abamenyi yekaunti ya Isiolo okoboria okuerikia erio goting’igua obokoreri gwekaunti yabo gosira eserekari.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Makueni County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Makueni County goika bakaregista kadi y'oborwaria bw'omomama n'omwana nigo bakonyare gotanga oborwaria bw'abana babo.

English: Promote coding clubs 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza vilabu vya uandishi wa misimbo 2024.
Ekegusii: Segeta ebiombe bia'masomo ekombiuta 2024.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir mwezi Februari huu.
Ekegusii: Chungu: KALRO ito tomonugunoobarema tomondeka chikagwa chikamwitu kwa mifarmu mi Wajir

English: NPS calls on the community in Siaya County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NPS b erekera egonde a Siaya gose gokorer abande ase esukuru na kereka ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru gochisukuru chikuru.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Laikipia County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Abarimu (TSC) nigo korigiria abasabi ase Laikipia County gochia ase ekitengo gia obokoreri bwa omwaka gose obokoreri bwa kera mbuya ase ogosaba okwaisa.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Siaya County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross ogosegeta egonde Siaya gose komanyia amakora ase ababisi gose goetera goaka esimi gose gokorikwa gosoa ebiombe biobosaria.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorora na gokorera endwari (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo gikoretera abangina ase Kitui County ng'a okonyorera obotumi bwa okobwata chindagera chia okorua chiana nigo keri obere ase chinsitashoni chionsi chia eserikari.

English: NTSA urges the public in Homa Bay County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: NTSA yateba obwana bwa Homa Bay County toka okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera abange baibeirwe ya SIM-swap.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Manyia: Chokoro chia Kenya chia Komunikesheni chakembea ase oranyanyare kominchoria korwa emechando  omwaka igoro yemebasekano yepara mu Vihiga County.

English: Train on leadership 2023.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu uongozi 2023.
Ekegusii: Somia igoro yoborai omwaka 2023.

English: Mark your calendar for Devolution Conference, a major gathering for stakeholders in the aquaculture sector to network and learn.
Kiswahili: Andika kalenda yako kwa ajili ya Kongamano la Devolution, ambalo ni mkusanyiko mkubwa kwa wadau katika sekta ya ukuzaji samaki ili wawasiliane na kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Beka ekeriorokererio ase ekarenda yao igoro yomiosangerekano bwokota obokoreri ang'e. oyio orarete baria bonsi amo baria bakobwaterna ase ensemo yoboremi buna bareranie na gosoma.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS nigo ekorenta abana batari amasukuru ase Lamu County goikara ime yechisemi chiabakuru goetera eprogramu yechindagera ase amasukuru.

English: KALRO invites farmers in West Pokot County to a free training on fertiliser application this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utumiaji wa mbolea Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo eretebie abaremi ba West Pokot County ase ogotenywa kwa bwerere igoro y'ogotebia oboboremi bwa mbolea omotienyi 9.

English: SHA invites residents of Baringo County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya baringo kwerikia buna abanyene ekiama ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese , erio kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari y'ekaunti.

English: CDC encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Tharaka-Nithi County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Egechera: Ebiombe bioboremi na chindagera (AFA) nigo bigokabera abaremi chimbeyo chie chibage chire nenchiketi ase Meru County ase omotienyi 7.
