Kiswahili: 100% mabadiliko: kila darasa la 6 lazima kuripoti kwa JSS hakuna kukaa nyumbani!
Ekegusii: Okonganya emia ase amia: Kera omwana bwegeredi gia 6 goika soe esukuru yesekenderi ya inse (JSS) kobera nka tikoiyo!

English: Vines should be killed by uprooting or cutting at least 10 to 14 days before harvesting potatoes, to ensure that the skin of the tubers hardens.
Kiswahili: Mizabibu inapaswa kuuawa kwa kung'oa au kukata angalau siku 10 hadi 14 kabla ya kuvuna viazi, ili kuhakikisha kuwa ngozi ya mizizi inakuwa ngumu.
Ekegusii: Matete aya amekorwa na ogotegora au okobutora matatu ma 10 hadi 14 amatuko kabla ya okogesa nyamihano, ili kuhakikisha ukoko wa nyamihano unamaliza kuhudhuli.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Nyeri County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri gindigwa intaneti via e-Citizen portal nende osabire ID ogosaba.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NTSA ngosemia abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Kericho koba osabire kochiokochia chinchogu kochiokochia gacha gotigara koba gosiira koegerera chinchogu.

English: The government will establish a milk price stabilizing fund through New KCC with Kshs 3 billion allocated to manage excess milk and stabilize prices
Kiswahili: Serikali itaanzisha hazina ya kuleta utulivu wa bei ya maziwa kupitia New KCC na Kshs 3 bilioni zitatengwa kudhibiti maziwa ya ziada na kuleta utulivu wa bei.
Ekegusii: Serikali itakayamba kuhusiana na kifedha cha kuhakikisha bei ya maziwa ni mara mara kwa KCC Mpya na amagori arobora arobora amalizwa ili kusaidia kudhibiti maziwa mengi na kuhakikisha bei yake ni mara mara

English: Always check depth before diving into water - neck injuries can be fatal.
Kiswahili: Daima angalia kina kabla ya kupiga mbizi ndani ya maji - majeraha ya shingo yanaweza kusababisha kifo.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki pima komanya obotambe bwamache otarasoa goaka ontimbu. - nabo oraumie bobe ebigoti.

English: Play is vital for a child's emotional, physical, and cognitive development.
Kiswahili: Kucheza ni muhimu kwa ukuaji wa kihisia, kimwili, na kiakili wa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Chigosori nechingiya ase ogokina kwa abana, kemobere nà gotingia obongo

English: AFA warns sorghum farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egokuria abanyamwaka bamasaka ase Kiambu County ase obwate bwebinyambare, na goboria gokora oboikari bwa chinguvu na chinguvu.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Tana River County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ewizara: KMTC yachakire abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Tana River amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges poultry farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Pest Control Products Board nigo korigia abaremi bechingoko ase Kakamega County komanyia ofisi y'abakong'i bechingoko eria eri habechi igoro y'amarwaire aya amabe ya rabies ayo ayarekeretwe.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Nairobi County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Obonchaki bwe Enyancha (Ministry of Health) nigo bogosaba abanyabanto baria barerete abana ase Nairobi County goika ase chikiriniki chie chinsa chigendererete buna emetuko yomokono yobochari bwa abakungu ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na usanifu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: KUCCPS nigo egwateire eprogramu empya yobokori bwebitambaa na okobuna ebitambaa ase ekigo kiabokori (vocational centre) ase Mombasa County.

English: KRA reminds the public in Isiolo County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: KRA orure okoboria ase abamenyi gosira ekaunti ya isiolo na omotimoko omuya ase chiafisi chia eserekari ni omotimoko omuya, omotimoko omuya, na omotimoko omuya.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Machakos County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: ODPP orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura bamenyete ime ya Machakos ka SMS kwa 70000 kochia ase kwarorekanire aaria ensemo ya baria.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Ekero ekeombe kwa Turkana giachakire abamenyi korwa oboronge bwabo bwamachiko.

English: KTDA warns wheat farmers in Kajiado County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kajiado County juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Ekegusii: KTDA enyamokirimbi ebiateko kwa mahindi kiaje Kajiado ekunyonyoreka na ekurekera namba yake kwa kufanya kufanyika kwa muda

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obosae bo Nyamira koenekia ayio goetera amakora yobokoreri bweserikari, gochera giasabire obokorwa bwobogwari bwokoginda.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: HELB nigo egokonya abana batari amasomoni ase Nakuru County goika gochora abana babo ase chisukuru chieserekari chiri habe ase ogotebigwa kw'emeri y'okoria ase chisukuru.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Nandi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mkondoni ili kupata yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa kiararirie endorero eri Nandi County kogindigwa kwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma egera digiri kwa kibundu kibundu.

English: Conduct safety audit using 2008 Manual by September 30.
Kiswahili: Fanya ukaguzi wa usalama kwa kutumia Mwongozo wa 2008 ifikapo Septemba 30.
Ekegusii: Kabe nomoroberio omuya bwoborendi goetera egatabu kiamaorokererio kia omwaka 2008 nyuma yechitariki 30 chiomotienyi 9.

English: HELB reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: HELB egokwaniria abase ba Kiambu County buna obokonyi bwa HELB bwo gochia ase ogotenywa chinguo na ogotara nigo bwochi.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Nyamira County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorwania obosae ime yense Nyamira koba kwegoreria ebirengeererio biabo goikerania esafari yamagenderero ekaonti giokorwania amakora agokorwania.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Mombasa County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: SHA (Social Health Authority) ekoba negetiro kiokonyora obomanyi bwa abasubati ase oborwa bwo obwongo ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 8. Abanto bonsi nigo baragwatwa amaboko.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Nyarire: KUCCPS yararirie chisemero chingongo chionsi cheboikeranu bwamaagacho bwebirasi bia abana bagomera bibwekaine Nyeri.

English: KNEC urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: KNEC naisia abaibori nabarimu ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi kuokera amasomo igoro yogokong'ia okoererania amang'ana gati ya abakoloi na barimu.

English: Do not apply substances to the cord. Keep it dry and clean until it falls off naturally.
Kiswahili: Usipake vitu kwenye kamba. Iweke kavu na safi hadi ianguke kiasili.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goaka ebinto binde bionsi ase omogoyo. Onyebeke ebe enkamoku naende endabu goika egwe yoka.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Garissa County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross eribokirie abanto ba Garissa County ng'a obonyamokoro bwebitaro biokobua na gochia (outpatient services) nigo bwobeire bwoigwete ase ebikaro ebi ebiting'wete.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Mandera County on agroforestry this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kilimo cha misitu Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Okari: Ebisareri bi'oborimi n'oboreri bw'etugo nibigo bikorere abarima ba Mandera County igoro y'oborimi bw'emiti ase omotienyi 6.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Ekegusii: KEMSA yasegetire abaturageti ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County gosekerera chineti chiokorwa n'emiti yokwita chinsu chiro chiro konyora oboremi bwa omurwaro ogwo dengue fever obwongererekete.

English: Farmers in mango producing counties are encouraged to adopt improved planting materials and enhance their skills to boost production and market access following the National Mango Conference
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kaunti zinazozalisha miembe wamehimizwa kutumia nyenzo bora za upanzi na kuongeza ujuzi wao ili kukuza uzalishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kufuatia Kongamano la Kitaifa la Mango.
Ekegusii: Abakor abakula matokoni maragiti na maragiti abakulegwa kusoroma madala y'ogokomera oyera na kuyera madala yao ya kusoma kwa kusinywa na marigiti maragiti kufuoga kusindana na Baraza ya Matokoni ya Mwaka

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Tana River County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiyakire endorero ase ekaunti ya Tana River okotoma ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara 2022 kuchakire ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yao onyore.

English: KICD encourages residents of Laikipia County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: KICD agasaba abamenyi ba Laikipia ekaunti koborigwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo, bera tebia ebirengeererio biabo.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": DCI giaansire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera Vihiga County esagati.

English: IEBC urges residents of Narok County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: IEBC osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya narok kogitegerera amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto na kogikera amang'ana igoro yosoma.

English: NPS alerts residents of Isiolo County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NPS yasemirie abamenyi a Isiolo County koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) nkworokereria ere igoro yasemerie obokoreri bwa nyama.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kilifi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiremire abamenyi e Kilifi kiobororie kubereka ebiateko ebochinkwana obokoreri ase amagoro yebiateko.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: NDMA yankiangete abamenyi bia Turkana goeera ekenyori kia abakorogo bia gosikiria gosikiria na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri okobagera matumaini bia gosikiria bia abakorogo bia gosikiria.

English: AFA advises farmers in Isiolo County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: AFA eragire abaremi aaria Isiolo County gochia na nomboro yabo y'okwerika ase oboremi erio gokwenera gokora ase amasomo amaya agokwiza.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egosaba abaremi ase Kwale County gochia ase ogoteka chingencho chiogotara amache ase amakonde ayo nigo bakonyeke na ogotindana na chimbura chire gochaka gose gosekerera.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Ekegusii: NDMA yarure abamenyi a Nyamira egonde koba maiso erio egonde obokoreri obwasioku.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Machakos County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi na echio chiriokonywa (AFA) nigo egokora omonyo bwoboremi bwechimera chitarerete amakemikali ase abaremi ba Machakos County buna egechencho yomwaka bwa omotienyi 11 bwoogokora amabera okomanya okogenderera ase obororo bwechiheo.

English: DCI urges the community in Mandera County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: DCI gotanga egonde bao Mandera buna okobagera amangana ao abobisi gose ayengencho na monto ende bwensi goetera chinkwana ase esimi na abao ababwera.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Trans Nzoia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DCI nigo egosaba abamotisiti na abachenu ase Trans Nzoia yekaonti tibatema goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache na komantia eserikari igoro ya mobasekano onde bwensi gochia amokoreri bweserikari ore ange nere gose goetera enamba ya morero yekaonti goetera eintaneti.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kisii County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nkiarobere: NTSA nkiaroberetie ogasanga egonde yao Kisii okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao esagati.

English: KALRO advises fish producers in Kiambu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo egokora abaremi b'ebisaba ase Kiambu County gochia ase omosoko bw'abaremi ogochaka, mbere y'omwaka bw'okogesa.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) ime yaikaranso egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti giachakirie obogaang a Wajir County omonugunoobarema.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Wajir County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya gochia abakoreri beserekari Wajir gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nandi County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC kigokora abanto ba Nandi County komanya obwenge bwo gwocha amaboko ase oborongo bwe chinyomba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiokorora ebiragiro biokorora ebisero (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoibokia abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County igoro yomogongo ogokorwa ogwogoteba buna barigese rigesa riabo.

English: DPP warns residents of Bungoma County to prepare for possible road accidents this November.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: DPP yamabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Bungoma yemebasekano yepara igoro yemebasekano yepara mu November yemebasekano yepara.

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Murang'a County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete obosae Murang'a County okogeria chisemi chiobogesaku igoro ya amakora achigakoro.

English: It is recommended that farmers cultivate improved tomato varieties with a longer shelf life.
Kiswahili: Inapendekezwa kuwa wakulima walime aina za nyanya zilizoboreshwa na maisha marefu ya rafu.
Ekegusii: Ere okere okotia maguzi a matunda a ngwete a oyera na kumwana kurekure

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Bomet County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborendi bwa oborwaro (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) eribokire abamwamu abari ase Bomet County inga okwenera obonyamwamu bwo okuria okomanya abana nigo bwo bwerere ase chifasiliti chiensi chiomwaka.

English: Ministry of Education distributes tablets equipped with preloaded curriculum content for youth in community learning centers.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkobaga ere ebikombiuta biakoboko bobekire amasomo onsi pi ase chinyomba chiogosomera chiebinyoro erio abasae basome.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Garissa County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kekere abantu abamanyia ase Garissa County ngoro choria yobokoreri bwechikaonti.

English: DCI calls on residents of Samburu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: DCI b erekera abamenyi kosamburu egonde kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kumwita egonde ekegurumia

English: KMTC advises applicants in Migori County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: KMTC egokora abasabi ase Migori County gochia ase ekigo kio ogotebwa obomanyi kio okwegera kire kure na boigo ase ogosaba okwo okoreng'ana na §MONTH0§ §YEAR0§.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC nigo gikoremereria abakungu baria bari n'emida ase Nyandarua County ng'a ogonyora obochunji bwa abana noboerere ase chifasiriti chiose chia geserikari.

English: Enhancing Agricultural Financing in Kayonza: SACCOs were introduced to the Agriculture Credit Assessment Tool through which cooperatives ...
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha Ufadhili wa Kilimo huko Kayonza: SACCOs zilianzishwa kwa Zana ya Tathmini ya Mikopo ya Kilimo ambayo vyama vya ushirika ...
Ekegusii: Kwangoyia omoroberion bwokorwa chibesa chioboremi ari Kayonza: Ebiombe bioboremi mbiaansetwe korigereria ogoikerania kwa ayio nebikoreri goetra ayio ebiombe bioboremi ...

English: NTSA urges residents of Homa Bay County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NTSA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya homa bay koegerera chinchogu omosiongoroko kurekia buna abanyene ekiama kia gokurerwa ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya.

English: Import export and transit of live animals and animal products in Uganda requires authorization from the Commissioner for Animal Health Ensure compliance with disease control guidelines
Kiswahili: Kuagiza nje na kusafirisha wanyama hai na bidhaa za wanyama nchini Uganda kunahitaji idhini kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Afya ya Wanyama Hakikisha uzingatiaji wa miongozo ya kudhibiti magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Rora nga noikeranetie amachiko boronge buna are ase egetabu kiamachiko cheng’iti na nyakwach cheng’iti boganda, oboruaire na nyakwach cheng’iti na nyakwach cheng’iti.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Enyarora: KICD yanchuire omoroberio omoyia bw'chisemi chia ICT ase ekorechi chiobobundi ime ya Siaya County.

English: Notice from CDC: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Omonyooro korwa CDC: chichiniki chio gokonya abamama gochiara chigakora chiroreire omotienyi 10 ase chichitue chio oboroche biareire ase Kakamega County.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Gorongo: Gikuru gokonya gokora emeremo gia Kenya gikonyire omosangerekano obonsi aaria Kakamega okonyire abanainchi komanyia abane gotyaertera monto na korika goikera amang'ana igoro yogosanga nagokwanerana.

English: The price of reaching out to farmers on a digital platform is under advisory level, and there's maximum benefit as well, there's more..
Kiswahili: Bei ya kufikia wakulima kwenye jukwaa la dijiti iko chini ya kiwango cha ushauri, na kuna faida kubwa pia, kuna zaidi..
Ekegusii: Rigori riogogoikera abaremi bande abange amo na dichitari nigo ore inse na obokoreri bwogotebereria boigo, na obuya obonge mboreo boigo. Igoro yayio, nareo amange...

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokaiyia abanto buna obokonyo bwokomanya igoro yoborwaro bwa depression bori bwerere ase chifasiliti chiachinchera chiao ase Kajiado County.

English: AFA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Lamu County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia AFA nikogendereria gokora obokirigani bwokogwata amache ase abanyamwaka ase Lamu County ase ogokora egechera kia omotienyi 9 kia ogokonyora abanyamwaka gokora obokirigani ase obororo bwobwong'aini.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Marsabit County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Universities Fund eragire abasabi ase Marsabit County gochia ase echituo chio gochia gosomia chichiri chire hakuhi ase okonyora omoroberio ogokwiza.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) kosemia ere abamenyi yekaonti ya Tharaka-Nithi goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese yekaonti yabo kwa portal yebirengerio yebiabo yebiinternet.

English: AFA warns coffee farmers in Nandi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: AFA egoteba abaremi b'ekahawa ase Nandi County igoro y'ebinyamwamu na kobatema gochia goikera obokonyi bwango.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire oyera yobokorei bweserikari yepasipoto igoro yKirinyaga.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Tharaka-Nithi County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Eritange: Egesaku gia okorora na ogokwanerera oborwaire nigo gokweneretie oborwaire bwa malaria ase Tharaka-Nithi County. Abaturageti nigo bagotebwa gokwanerera oborwaire obo ase abakonyi bwekerogoto.

English: Characteristics of bipolar, intruments top test and treat diseases
Kiswahili: Sifa za ugonjwa wa bipolar, upimaji wa juu wa vifaa na matibabu ya magonjwa
Ekegusii: Eng’encho ya bipolar, ebimanyererio, ebifaa biokorenga amo na obobwenia.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kiambu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobori bwa obooremi na echiobi (AFA) nigo kigocha abaremi ase ekaunti ya Kiambu kobwata oborwaire bwa fall armyworm kare goetera emiti yoborwaire eye yemeretwe mbere yomwaka obooremi bwa omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens the electoral calendar centres in Machakos County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ndege: Ofisi ya Rijistra ya Vipapari vya Siasa okoigora vikundi vya taarifa ya chache katika Kaunti ya Machakos etureti ya kebaki hii.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Narok County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwechikaonti Narok bono giasabire abanto koenekia goetera chinchera chindinge chia amasomo yobokoreri bwechikaonti.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egokaiyia abaremi ba Kitui County igoro yomorooberio ogochiaka ogokora oboremi bwa okwegia okomwaka ebitimbiri.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kiambu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Enyamoreo yesimi yeki Kenya Forest Service inao kwanera bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Kiambu County, inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe enyamoreo.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Ese: DPP kiarure ochokuru giyosoloka kwechokuru kiaintneti kwa amangana buna giyosoloka kichakirire ombia giyosoloka kwechokuru giyosoloka kera omotinyi ya Samburu.

English: Provide livestock supplementary feeds to cattle, sheep, and goats at risk in drought hotspots, and enhance livestock health through deworming and treatment.
Kiswahili: Toa malisho ya ziada ya mifugo kwa ng'ombe, kondoo, na mbuzi walio hatarini katika maeneo ya ukame, na kuimarisha afya ya mifugo kupitia dawa ya minyoo na matibabu.
Ekegusii: Nyinyi yoyera chokoro, ching’ondi, na embori e nyanjio omorakera, na kuyagwara nyinyi na mabira na matibiri.

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Bomet County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya yabooririe abasae entongori yogoaka chikura omotienyi oyo Bomet korikia abange buna tarere enyomba y'oboringoria IEBC.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Mandera County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: KEMRI egosaba abamenyi ba Mandera County gocha goetwa amachibu ase ebitaro biabere biokogacha bino bino, konyora obonge bwa amachibu a Rift Valley Fever ayo abere agosangirwa.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kericho County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egosaba abanto ba Kericho County gochia ase echiro chia Huduma chia habege ase obokonyi bwo gokwana oboremi bwa afya oboikereirwe.

English: KALRO urges millet growers in Kiambu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO airame abakunia imboga ya inyama mu Kaunti ya Kiambu korora obokanyirie bw’ebitungabi kuti barerie engicha yoigo kuremera omwaka uno.

English: Healthcare facilities must screen for violence and provide safe and comprehensive responses for survivors.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya huduma ya afya lazima vichunguze vurugu na kutoa majibu salama na ya kina kwa waathirika.
Ekegusii: Ase abanto bakobwenerigwa goikbapime ekerengo omonto okoreire bobe na korwa obobwenia boisaine naende obuya.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekeombe ekenene ki'amachiko na amangeire ase amasukuru amato (State Department for Basic Education) nigo kigoigora omoroberio omoyia o'goika chinyaya chi'amashini (electrical installation) ase ekigo ki'obomanyi bwa kera (vocational centre) ase ekaonti ya Nyandarua.

English: UK promotes bovine tuberculosis control through vaccination.
Kiswahili: Uingereza huendeleza udhibiti wa kifua kikuu cha ng'ombe kupitia chanjo.
Ekegusii: Ense ya UK negenderete kobeta chisindani etugo yechingondi buna omoroberio bwogotanga

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Turkana County to enroll for ICT skills training this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abasomesa (Teachers Service Commission) nigo koretete abasubati ase ekaonti ya Turkana gokwenera amasomo a ICT omotienyi 6.

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Vihiga County starting this May.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuanzia Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egwateire amang'ana ase oboremi bwa chimbere chio oborwachi bwa bwerere ase abanto bwa Vihiga County gochaka ase omotienyi 5.

English: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nematodes katika nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (mbegu ya kilo 2 kwa lima) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kukua nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali ambayo hufukuza nematodes. Ondoa au lima kwenye mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zao, kisha panda nyanya zako.
Ekegusii: Kuokora nematodes kwa tomatisi kubereko kumwana, kusanya Red Sunhemp (2kg mago per lima) kwa shamba 3-3.5 misi kabla ya kusanya tomatisi - mago yake yamuchoka chokera chenya inayokuchoka nematodes. Kukhota au kusanya Sunhemp mago yakayochoka, kusanya tomatisi.

English: KNEC calls on the community in Kilifi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KNEC b erekera egonde e Kilifi County gacha amagancha ase egera bionsi ase abana bagosomera.

English: Live KCSE 2025 prediction marathon starts 6PM daily – free on KICD channel!
Kiswahili: Marathon ya utabiri wa moja kwa moja ya KCSE 2025 inaanza saa 12 jioni kila siku bila malipo kwenye kituo cha KICD!
Ekegusii: Amasomo amaiso marore buna ekiorokererio kia ayagochi koba esekenderi KCSE 2025 kera rituko ngochaka ore chinsa 12 chiamogoroba kera rituko, abosa goetera emeroberio ya KICD!

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Ekemanyisyo kia CDC: chikiriniki chiogotera abana chigenderere gochakera omotienyi 4 ase chikiriniki chia oborwaro biari chiatangirwe ase Siaya County.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Narok County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya baborigwe abamenyi na Narok kaunti gosimeka erio gotingia obokoreri bwekenyoro kuburikia maburito yobokoreri yamanani kwekaunti.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) okoigora omoroberio bwogosegeta okorosia ayabwenerete gosomigwa yegedichitari ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso Nakuru.

English: Based on the seasonal rainfall forecast, adopt appropriate soil and water conservation measures: if rains are predicted above normal, focus on controlling erosion, protecting crops from flooding, and water harvesting; if below normal, focus on conserving soil moisture. If your land is sloping, add contour bunds to prevent soil erosion.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na utabiri wa msimu wa mvua, zingatia mbinu sahihi za kuhifadhi udongo na maji: ikiwa mvua zinatarajiwa kuwa nyingi kuliko kawaida, zingatia kudhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kulinda mazao dhidi ya mafuriko, na kuvuna maji; ikiwa mvua zitakuwa chini ya kawaida, zingatia kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo. Ikiwa ardhi yako iko mteremkoni, jenga matuta ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo.
Ekegusii: Kuokho chuma cha mvua yaliyotolewa, kuchereka nyumba za mvua na kuhifadhi nyota: ikiwa mvua yaliyotolewa ni zisizyo na mara nyingi, kusanyore kuhifadhi nyota kutoka kuharibika na mvua, kuhifadhi nyota ya kupanda, na kuhifadhi maji; ikiwa mvua yaliyotolewa ni zisizyo na mara kidogo, kusanyore kuhifadhi maji ya nyota. Ikiwa ganda lako linajaa kwa miguu, ongea kuhifadhi nyota kwa kuchangia miguu.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs tea farmers in Laikipia County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Boda ya Kenya Dairy tebia abaremi ba chai aaria Laikipia County amaumuntia marigiti ekeyia okobwatania ario.

English: A pioneer book that focuses on climate change, incorporate diverse knowledge & expertise concerns CSA to guide well policy makers.
Kiswahili: Kitabu kipainia kwamba inazingatia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, kujumuisha maarifa mbalimbali & utaalamu masuala CSA kuongoza vizuri watunga sera.
Ekegusii: Egetabu gekworokereria igoro yoboremi boria bokoremereria ogosareka kwerire nkebwate chinsemo chingare chiesisemi na ochusi ase ebirengererio bia CSA erio korwa oborai bwabeene ase abarosia amachiko.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Bungoma County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service kigoibokia abaremi ba Bungoma County igoro yomobero ogokong'ana ogokorwa ogosomia abaremi chinchera chinsya chiogotirira chindagera.

English: Literacy platform expands into Kenyan public schools.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la kusoma na kuandika lapanuka hadi shule za umma za Kenya.
Ekegusii: Amasomo gokonya gosoma ebitabu agareigwe goika chisukuru chionsi chieserikari.

English: REPORT CORRUPTION @EACCKenya urges Kenyans to report all forms of corruption for investigation. EACC treats all reports with the utmost confidentiality and subjects them to a meticulous analysis process. Below is the reporting process.
Kiswahili: RIPOTI RUSHWA @EACCKenya inawasihi Wakenya kuripoti aina zote za rushwa kwa ajili ya uchunguzi. EACC hushughulikia ripoti zote kwa usiri mkubwa na kuziweka chini ya mchakato wa uchambuzi wa kina. Hapa chini ni mchakato wa kuripoti.
Ekegusii: ENANA AMANG'ANA IGORO YOBOKURUMI@EACCkenya yababoririe abakenya koenana amang'ana igoro yobokurumi honde bwensi ase obotuki bene. EACC nigo ekeonekia ng'a amang'ana onsi okoenana abekirwe ase obobisi nakoringorigwa bene. Nabo okoenanana amang'ana ao goetera enchera eye.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Kericho County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Buna oratange amakonde ogosoma abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Kericho ko agasa tigeria chinyama ichora ichora ekaonti agasa ripoti, ko korenda rigesa tirisareka ochakire ekaonti.

English: DPP urges residents of Machakos County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya machakos koegerera chinchogu chwekia abakomiti bwekia amagenderero ase gosira eserekari naboigo kwerwa ase amagenderero ase gokina ekaunti yabo.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Kericho County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Kericho Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekenene: NTSA keria ekampeini ya kusia kuchokoria machina omochi omonene o' Kericho Ekura omochi omonene o' October.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi na echiobi (AFA) nigo kigoibokia abaremi ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County igoro yomokongori ogoendeire ogokorwa ogwogoteba oborwaria na ebisoro biokomanya ebiokoremi.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Nandi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiokorora ebiragiro biokorora ebisero (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoibokia abaremi ba Nandi County igoro yomogongo ogokorwa ogwogoteba buna barigese rigesa riabo.

English: Support refugee education 2021.
Kiswahili: Saidia elimu ya wakimbizi 2021.
Ekegusii: Sira chisemi chia baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo omwaka 2021.

English: ODPP urges residents of Nyamira County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nyamira kwerikia buna gosira eserekari naboigo kwerwa ase amagenderero amo nogokina gwekaunti yabo gosira eserekari ya kwerwa ase amagenderero amo nogokina gwekaunti yabo.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Murang'a County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS egera endorero baria bare nokogania Murang'a County ao ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria egera ticha ria.

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Nandi County on progress of ward-level service delivery this December.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gikorongo giKenya kiarure ogokurera abamenyi ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi kwa obokoreri obuya okorwa esagati.

English: NDMA urges the community in Homa Bay County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: NDMA kabe egonde a Homa Bay ekaonti koyomo bwaneraberio (Nyumba Kumi) nkworokereria ere igoro yamagenderero.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Meru County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Meru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Omosaria oboitaai okoboria ase baria batagete kogenda ase chingiya arria ase chngongo chire neminano okwateka omorero, Meru buekaunti.

English: Farmers in Nyakach are encouraged to participate in the Agoro East Aggregated Farm initiative to restore land and improve livelihoods Join the collective effort for better farming practices
Kiswahili: Wakulima huko Nyakach wamehimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa Agoro East Aggregated Farm ili kurejesha ardhi na kuboresha maisha Jiunge na juhudi za pamoja za kilimo bora.
Ekegusii: Aboremi a Nyakach ni okhuywa kuokha kuchama kwa Agoro East Aggregated Farm kuhu kurema gĩra na oyera gacha Kuchama kwa omokia kwa ebiya kwa oboremi

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches community-based development programmes in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: Abisi ya ekeombe yebwatoro yasegetire egonde goetera oborendi yebinyoro yebitambokero bioborendi ase Makueni Ekaunti.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Taita-Taveta County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Obururu: EACC agese gwekoboria okoboria obogaang a ase ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta ngo eng’atiato.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a suicide prevention forum in Nairobi County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KEMSA egokora omoroberio ogotanga obwiyite ase ekaonti ya Nairobi ase omotienyi 4. Bonsi nigo babwenerete gocha.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kericho County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kericho na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Okoraria kwobochenu bwabanto: Ebiombe biokorora na goikera oborwari nigo bigosomia igoro yegosekerera kwa Rift Valley Fever aaria Kericho County na goigwata abanto goikoresia ebitambira biokorara ebiarirwe dawa yechimbu ase obotuko bwoyonsi.

English: KEPHIS informs milk farmers in Nairobi County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo ekobamanyia abaremi bamate ase Nairobi County igoro yechingira chipeya chokorandia amate ase omotienyi 10.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria yaringana yobobisi ya ebesa ase ekaunti ya Kiambu tokoira okogaba gosanga enemba yao ya M-Pesa yobobisi ya PIN nonde bwensi ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio.

English: FAO warns rice farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Nyamira dhidi ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Ekegusii: FAO enyamokirimbi ebiateko kwa mifedha kia nyama Nyamira ekunyonyorera kuhara kuhara ekirengera ekirengera

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges cattle farmers in Samburu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigosaba abaremi b'eching'ombe ase Samburu County gotiga gochia na eching'ombe chiao korwa county ende goika ende batari na echibali, keria oborwaere bwa foot and mouth disease bwareteirwe.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nairobi County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC nkogoteba omonto omonene orenge na oboremo bwomobwongo ase Nairobi County goetera ase namba yomobere eyio etari na chibesa yomokonyo ase oboremo bwomobwongo.

English: This involves longer term and near-term predictions of traditional indices, such as temperature and precipitation, as well as new bioclimatic indicators that ...
Kiswahili: Hii inahusisha utabiri wa muda mrefu zaidi na wa muda mfupi wa viashiria vya jadi, kama vile joto na mvua, pamoja na vionyeshi vipya vya hali ya hewa ambayo ...
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abwatekaine nomoreroberio omotambe naboigo omoroberio omweng'e  buna obomanyi bori boitabire  igoro yerire neriberera bigochia koba, naboigo buna riberera rigochia boba ase ebimeri.

English: Health Ministry mandating provision of fruit-based snacks instead of sugary options in public primary schools by 2026.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya kuamuru utoaji wa vyakula vyenye matunda badala ya chaguzi za sukari katika shule za msingi za umma ifikapo mwaka 2026.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya obochenu yachikire okorwegwa chindagera chia amatunda ao ao ribaga rie chindagera chibwate esukari ase chisukuru chi'oboroso goika omwaka 2026

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: KALRO nkoribokia ababori babechara ase kaunti ya Nyandarua goanga ogotwara abechara babo gochia ase chikaunti chinde batari na echibali erio korinda obochari bwabechara.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges rice growers in Murang'a County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Egetengo gia Oboremi na Erio (AFA) nkogoteba abaremi b'omucheere aaria Murang'a County kobeka obwoyo obw'omubaro ogochiirwe mbere y'emvura gokwa nigo bagokonywa kong'era ebirio ase omwaka ogu.

English: Integrate AI education 2024.
Kiswahili: Unganisha elimu ya akili bandia (AI) 2024.
Ekegusii: Burukania ebikoreri biria biechisemi pandia ase ogosoma 2024.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Tana River County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service kigoika gocheria abaremi ba Tana River County igoro yoboremi bwokobeka amariogo ase omotienyi 11.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Ekegusii: Obwani: Communications Authority of Kenya okoigora kwa omokamwo arogegese magwara mokomeka omokorongo wa kumwochwa wokurigesa aria Tharaka-Nithi.

English: KEPHIS promotes organic farming among farmers in Uasin Gishu County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kama sehemu ya harakati za Julai za kustahimili hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS negenderete gotebia abaremi gokora oboremi bwo obwanchani ase ekaonti ya Uasin Gishu buna enchera eyemo yogoikera obomanyi bwa chindagera ase omotienyi 7.

English: KTDA warns millet farmers in Kajiado County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KTDA netenerete abaremi b'obori ase Kajiado County igoro y'ebinyamwamu ebirwaka na gosegeta ogokonywa ase obwango.

English: HELB reminds parents in Taita-Taveta County that adult literacy classes registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: HELB nigo egokumuria abamama na ababa ase ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta buna ogokwerikia ase amasomo y'abakure nigo ogwanchire ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Embu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekerario: KUCCPS ekororie amamenyi ba Embu koborigwa gosoka ase obonge ase okomoaregania omonene bw'ense.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: ODPP nigo kikoborokia abasiri ba Uasin Gishu County buna okobeka amang'ana yo ogotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari nigo kiri o bosa, amachunge, na siri.

English: TSC calls on the community in Kilifi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TSC berekera egonde ekaonti ya Kilifi nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura gacha chisukuru chikuru.

English: NTSA urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Egekoreri giokorwa chibesa gonya baria bigosoma oigoirwe bono as abana baria bare nokogania kwao Wajir ticha ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria.

English: COMESA urges maize growers in Wajir County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Wajir watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: COMESA baborigwe obotambe egetuma obotambe wajir ekaunti gindigwa amoyo achiangotwa chia embura oyera chingaki embura icho.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Biombe bieserikari igoro yochisemi berekera egonde ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet sira amagancha a bionsi ase gacha shikoli nchire noboremaru ao.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in West Pokot County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba obosae oko West Pokot County korekana amorokererigua oko kubeka na oko kubora etureti ya kebaki.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Laikipia County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo ekobasoka abanto bwa Laikipia County buna ogoteba amache nigo okong'ania oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
Kiswahili: "DCI inathibitisha kukamatwa kwa wawakilishi bandia wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaodai kushirikiana na Mpango wa Chakula Duniani Kaskazini mwa Kenya. Daima thibitisha kupitia usajili rasmi wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali."
Ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene enekirie okobwatwa kwa abatenereri be'NGO boborimo bakweroka abakobwaterana nekeombe kia Omoroberio Bwendagera Bwense (World Food Programme) aaria Kenya ya Irianyi. Botambe manya boronge korwa egetabu gia NGO."

English: "If you receive an email asking you to verify your bank account, dont click  it's phishing. Report to the DCI Cybercrime Unit."
Kiswahili: "Ikiwa utapokea barua pepe ikikuomba uthibitishe akaunti yako ya benki, usibonyeze ni udanganyifu. Ripoti kwa Kitengo cha Uhalifu wa Mtandao cha DCI".
Ekegusii: Korwa: If you receive an email boria gochandwa engegu yake, kose kochwa, ni phishing. Kogoswa gose koramwa goetera eintaneti, manyia omonene bwobotuki otari DCI Cybercrime Unit.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Ekegusii: Gorwana: Nofoisi yomotenereri amachiko omonene yaariganirie abanto bonsi korwa ebirengererio biabo ase richiko riria rigendererete korosigwa igor yokoroberekana chi Kisii.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to explore new export opportunities as CS Dr Andrew Karanja meets with AMCHAM Kenya to enhance U S Kenya agricultural collaboration
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutafuta fursa mpya za mauzo ya nje huku Waziri Dkt Andrew Karanja akikutana na AMCHAM Kenya ili kuimarisha ushirikiano wa kilimo nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria na abakolonyo b'agribizinesi basitiki kumwita ekeyia z'kutokana kwa mifumo y'kutoka wakati CS Dr Andrew Karanja akwemeza na AMCHAM Kenya kumwongeza ushujaa wa Amerika na Kenya kwa mifumo y'kufurahisha ardhi

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes water harvesting among farmers in Nakuru County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria giokorora chingencho chiogotanga ebichuni (Pest Control Products Board) nigo korigia abaremi aaria ekaonti ya Nakuru gokonya amache ase ogotang'ana nebiroba biokorua ase ekaunti eyio ime yomwaka, ase ogotebia ogotang'ana nenchera yoboremi bwa omotienyi 2.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Division of Disease Surveillance and Response kigoibokia abanto buna obokonyi bwo ogoteba amang'ana amayia gose ogotebwa igoro yoborwari bwa depression nigo bori ase obwateke ase chifasiliti chya afya chya kaunti ya Kwale.

English: TVET urges residents of Kakamega County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Ekegusii: TVET eragete abamenyi ba Kakamega County gochia goseera obosomi bwa bursary mbere yengaki eragete erinde banyore obonyamu bwo gochia esukuru yechisukuru chia day na chibesa chioboiti.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Tana River County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) egosaba omonto omonde orengete obororo bwobongo ase Tana River County gocha ase ogosomwa okwomogongo okwomwanya.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Turkana County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Turkana kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekechama kia Abadakitari ba Kenya nigo korigiririe kera omonto orenge na oboremo bwo oborweti bwo obongo ase ekaonti ya Turkana konyora obwate bwa gotumia omwaka ogochia konyora obosemi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Embu County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekoroberia oborimu (SHA) nikigoibokia abanto ba Embu County igoro yobwate bwa okonyora oboroberio bwokorengera oborimu bwa amariogo ase oboramu bweka.

English: DPP calls on residents of Kisii County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: DPP berekera egonde yao Kisii yoburendi erio korenda oburengererio kegima korora bwango ogcha kwamagena embura yao.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Homa Bay County to have children under five screened for measles during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano surua wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia abaringoria b'oborwaire bwa Kenya (KMA) nigo kigocha abamama na ababa ase Homa Bay County gochia abana abato barengete ase imyaka etano bagetwe okororwa oborwaire bwa measles goetera omwaka ogochia omotienyi 11.

English: DCI reminds the public in Baringo County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kubaki macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: DCI kisemirwe abamenyi baringo baborigwe koba maiso ase obokoreri obwasioku kweny obwokoruta chipomu.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bomet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya umakini wa kukabiliana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nkiarobere: IPOA nkiaroberetie egonde buna okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao nobomanyi bwabo erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu etureti ya kebaki Bomet.

English: AFA urges farmers in Kajiado County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egosaba abanyamwaka ase Kajiado County gochia ase obotebia bwa chigari bwe oborimi bwa ogwate amagega ase ogotanga chimbura chitaragoka buya.
