Ekegusii: Timonyegereria-nyegereria omwana omwana ekengwerere. Nabo omwana oyio arakwe. Motumie ng'oora

English: Gov't calls for wearing of masks as country battles 6th Covid-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa wito wa kuvaa vinyago wakati nchi zinapambana na wimbi la sita la Covid-19
Ekegusii: Eserekari yarure ogochika kobeka chimaski buna ense egendererete korwani omorindo o 6 o Covid-19

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Busia County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba usafirishaji wa mimea unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekehumo kia Kenya kia okorigereria oborongo bwechimera (KEPHIS) nigo gikwibuchia abaturageti ba Busia ng'a okorua amaterasi nigo gokonyora obokongu bwechimera ase omogondo ase oborende obonene.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Bungoma County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za ngano kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Ekegusii: Chungu: Kenya Dairy Board ino to

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Nyeri County this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoba ere okomanyia abanto erio komenta abaaki chikura chikaonti chionsi Nyeri egetamo.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Siaya County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nkoigwata abanto ba Siaya County gocha ase obochenu bwa bosa bwa abanto bensi gotanga amarwaire ayo atangigwa.

English: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15-29 year olds? Its time to raise awareness and support mental health.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kujiua ni sababu ya tatu inayoongoza ya kifo kati ya watu wenye umri wa miaka 15-29? Ni wakati wa kuongeza ufahamu na kusaidia afya ya akili.
Ekegusii: Nomanyete okoengete nakwo okwa gatato gotàngaine gokorenta amakweri egati ya abànto bare emiaka ikomi na etàno goika emerongo ebere na kianda? Chingaki chiabeire togosemia na gokonya obochenu bwobongo

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Erisire: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) nkitere esese ecybersecurity ekiria abarire bokorobereka ekitu chia baria amareba mokeo amowaa Vihiga County.

English: IPOA calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jamii katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: IPOA b erekera egonde a West Pokot gose gokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na manyia ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru goetera egonde yomonyaroka yeki bare chisukuru.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Marsabit County to a free training on fertiliser application this January.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nikorokora abaremi ba Marsabit County ase ogotenywa okobwate obwango ase chinchera chiokorenda ebirengo omwaka omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya okoigora ase okobwatanigwa abanto isiko gokwanerana aiga ekaonti yaito ya Nandi, okobwatanigwa abanto isiko gokwanerana chinginya chingiya.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana okoigora ekeyia yobokoreri bwechikaonti yosomwa yemakorosho yemabungo Siaya.

English: Build your future! Join TVET programs for technical skills.
Kiswahili: Jenga mustakabali wako! Jiunge na programu za TVET kwa ujuzi wa kiufundi.
Ekegusii: Agacha obogima bwamotwe bwao! Soa omoroberio bwobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria .

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.
Ekegusii: Kenya koenekia okomentekana Kwa abwarwaire 12 bande ba COVID-19, bonsi ase oboamo goika 246 . Omoteneneri Bwa obochenu agoteba buna batano ase ana,nawakori egasi ba omobogani/hoteli.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free food safety outreach in Mandera County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mandera Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyia yomwaka: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo eregocha gochia na ogoteba obuya bwechiokuria ase abanto aaria Mandera County ase omotienyi 1.

English: KRA advises residents of Nairobi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Ekegusii: KRA yamwita abakonito ya Nairobi goindigwa ntsa goitabwa neserikari koba Omoteneneri goetera egekoreri giaito gia e-Citizen.

English: Stay safe online! Teach students to avoid cyber threats.
Kiswahili: Kaa salama mtandaoni! Wafundishe wanafunzi kuepuka vitisho vya mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Kabe otari namochando ase eintaneti! Somia abana bande gwetanga kogosereria ase eintaneti.

English: IEBC updates residents of Murang'a County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi huu Julai.
Ekegusii: IEBC gokoraria abarai nebiombe a Murang'a egonde na obokongoria bwa egonde goetera emeroberio yebinyoro goetra okoreta abanto bonsi mbuya bare engoromomi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Vihiga County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Vihiga kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Ekegusii: Nofisi yomotenereri amachiko omonene yaariganirie abamenyi yeserikari y'Vihiga goikeranq ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto.

English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: HELB ekorera abanto ba Nyeri ekaunti baeria obogambi bwa' omosumbani.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Kiambu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egokang'a abaremi ase Kiambu County goika gochiregista ase ekeombe gia abaremi kiaremerwe na amagenderero gokonya kobonyora chibei chinchere chibesa ase chibage.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Makueni County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene keria ekenene kia Kenya Red Cross yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire Makueni County koenekia amangana ebesa obokomokori na goetera chinchera chireo chiokobamanyia, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Kwale County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Ekero eke Kwale County ekeombe keria abamenyi bwabo oboronge bwamachiko.

English: Farmers are urged to properly dispose of empty pesticide containers to prevent health hazards Participate in training sessions organized by aak GROW for safe disposal methods
Kiswahili: Wakulima wahimizwa kutupa ipasavyo vyombo tupu vya viuatilifu ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya Kushiriki katika vipindi vya mafunzo vinavyoandaliwa na aak GROW kwa njia salama za kutupa.
Ekegusii: Mabogotigara akeania ogotiringa mimintia ebogotigara korwa rigesa buna ebiemba gose amasaku koyaonchoreria boba obwoyo, bwaterana kegima ase amorokererigua aak GROW gokeania ogotiringa ebitoonchokanenete gose amasingira.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises avocado producers in West Pokot County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Serokire ya Ogorania Ebibago erie Kenya eriombekire abarimi babagura avocado bo West Pokot okogota oborte bwa birengo ebisibeta omwaki ogoo ogwabogewe oboremi.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kisumu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Korongo: IPOA batekereri obokoreri obuya ase okomanya abasaria ba kera engencho nagotoma abasikari gochia ase aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu ewiri riete.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: NDMA chera na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka Kisumu.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Bungoma County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Enyasera: KEMRI ekoreta omokutano bwobochenu bwobongo bwabana abato ase Bungoma County ase omotienyi 10. Abanto bonse nigo bagendererwe.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Kobororia: SHA okoigora ekeyia yao aase ogotemera chingaki chiomobasekano ya e-Citizen ime yekaunti ya Nyamira.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kitui County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kitui na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Ogotenywa kw'obong'aini bw'abanto: Ekeombe gia abachiri ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nkirorire ng'a oboremo bwa Rift Valley Fever nkubwongerekene ase Kitui County na nkiragire abanto barore ng'a barabure abachiri abakonyi ase ebitong'o bionsi baria barabone oborwari obo.

English: DPP reminds residents of Homa Bay County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DPP yateba abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Homa Bay koegerera amagoro ase okwera chinginya ase chingongo chire neminano na kochera chinginya ase okwera chinginya ase chingongo chire neminano.

English: Parents in slums: 50,000 full scholarships available – apply before Nov 30!
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika makazi duni: Ufadhili kamili 50,000 unapatikana – tuma maombi kabla ya Novemba 30!
Ekegusii: Abaiibori bamenyete chirandi: Chisiringi 50,000 chiamasomo amagima nchireo, chisabe nyuma yechitariki 30 omotienyi 11!

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia.
Ekegusii: Omorokori: IPOA koenana chikampeini cha koyarora kwa obamanyi igoro yokoyarora ase waburuburu ase ekaunti ya Busia.

English: DPP calls on residents of Narok County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP b erekera abamenyi ta Narok kobwaterana korenda abarendi boborendi chingaki korendana korenda esereko ekenene kisemera okwemurunganania kwabamenyi

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of pigs in Machakos County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: Ekomiti ya Kenya Dairy Board yaregire okogenda kwa chimburu ase Machakos County goetera oborwa bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: OGP urges residents of Nairobi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: OGP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Nairobi kwerikia buna egasi egokorwa yoborendi ase agasa chichiri chia choria chia ng'a.

English: Notice: HELB announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: HELB namanyetie chitariki chiokorika abana abakonywa na bursary ase amasukuru aya Bungoma County.

English: TSC calls on the community in Vihiga County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TSC b erekera egonde e Vihiga goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera gacha amagancha chisukuru.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Trans Nzoia County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: TSC eria abaibori nabarimu go Trans Nzoia goikerania amagancha a egera bionsi.

English: KNEC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this February.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Februari hii.
Ekegusii: KNEC ee ombe keria kere ogoikerania kwamasomo egedichitari erio gosira kwa makundi omosoma aria Tharaka-Nithi omonugunoobarema omonugunoobarema.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nkogokwaniria abanto buna ogosomwa kwa Esosera nigo kure ase chinchera chionsi chi'oborwaria bwa gavamenti ase Kilifi County ase omotienyi 6.

English: Notice: TVET announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Enyorokia: TVET yaenekirie chitariki chiokwiyandikira oboremi bwa amang'ana ase chisukuru chiri Makueni County.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Turkana County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Turkana Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Notice: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti Turkana igoro eng’atiato.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri y'Oborimi na Oboreri bwe'chinyama nigo eborigete aboreri bwe'chinyama ase Kajiado County kwanja chinyama chiabo ase chibango chi'echanjo ebiikeretwe erio korenda obochenu bwe'chinyama.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera ase bonsi: DCI okoigora esimi ya okonyora obokonyi ase GBV bwaye goetera amarieta ao ao aaria Bomet.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Uasin Gishu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia NCPB nikigokumbusia abanyamwaka ase Uasin Gishu County igoro yomobero ogokorwa ogwogoteba buna bakonyora ogotebwa ase ogokora emeremo yechingaki chiokomora chindagera.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: NCPB eragereria abaremi ba Taita-Taveta County gocha na kitambulisho kiao kia taifa erio gocha ase amasomo yoboremi arerete.

English: KEMSA announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this January.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Januari hii.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo yarengeire oboisi bwa dialysis ase abamenyi ba Uasin Gishu County gosekerera ase omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: TSC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Ngochandeka: TSC gokwanerana na gokeania amachiko arengete gotanga, gokorera abande bobe, na gose gochaya chisukuru nse Garissa.

English: KICD invites youth in Kilifi County to enroll for electrical installation training this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Februari hii.
Ekegusii: KICD eragete abasubati na abasomi ase Kilifi County gochia gokwenera obosomi bwe koinyora amagasi ase oboremi bwe amagetsi ase omotienyi 2.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Kisumu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Ekegusii: Abisi ya Kisumu yasegetire abamenyi kobwati amarago yokoroisia oboteneneri, omosikari omonene nomoke oye mbasoeretwe na gokumerwa choria gose komosuna omonto kare eseri ya porisi.

English: IPOA warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible landslides this August.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: IPOA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Turkana koegeriganie mapema gokonya omochando bwokwanyoka kweririe riete.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Wajir County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yachakirie abamenyi ba Wajir ekaunti kwa obokoreri obuya wakachuma amaumuntia.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens voter education centres in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Ekegusii: Nyeso: Egeikaranso kiabagafana okoigora chisemi yobogesaku komanyia Trans Nzoia etureti ya kebaki.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Laikipia County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo kigocha gokaba embeo chiengano chire na ebitibua ase abaremi ba Laikipia County ase omotienyi oyu omotienyi 1.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wa ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMRI eribokire abakungu baria bari oborito ase Nyandarua County buna ogokonywa na abachumbe abanyabwate obwanchoni bwo gokonya abakungu korora abana nigo konyare gokorwa na bwerere ase chiofisi chiose chie eserekari.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Narok County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: HELB ogokora endorero baria bare nokogania kwa Narok County kw'ogoticha egera digital chiria chirengete ticha soni.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Notice: KUCCPS yasomiya igoro yokorenda abana ase esukuru a Uasin Gishu.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kakamega County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross erangerie abanto ba Kakamega County igoro y'omwamo bw'ogochaba chiancha ase obuya bw'omochie.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in Trans Nzoia County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: KRA agasaba abamenyi omonto nare neribaga Trans Nzoia County korwa ebirengeererio biabo goikerania ekiarengete yechikura.

English: OGP reminds the public in Nyandarua County that input on development planning forums is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Ekegusii: OGP amaumuntia amaoni korwa abanainchi ase Nyandarua negenderere nechnkwana nabanainchi ase okorwa ebirengererio biamagenderero buna eserikari amaumuntia rero amaumuntia.

English: Government launched a nationwide campaign to raise awareness on the dangers of illegal arms trafficking through community outreach and media.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yachakire omoroberio omonene komanyia abanto goetera mesangerekano ao ao yebinyoro igoro yobobe bwebiasara biechibunduki chire ase amaboko amabe.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a maize collection centre in Isiolo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ogotebwa: KALRO egokwa ebitaro biokorokia chimbembe ase Isiolo County ase omotienyi 10.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Uasin Gishu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo gokomera abareeri babana ase Uasin Gishu County goika bagorejista ekarati yobochari bwomwana na nyina ase ogotebana na ogotebana kwa obochari bwa nyina bwa omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kirinyaga County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia obogaang a Kirinyaga County ebuagi.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu.
Ekegusii: OKOMANYIGWA: NTSA yaboririe okomanyigwa osekiyombe gochia amangana buna yebusia kwa abakonzi ase ekounti ya Lamu.

English: Notice: TVET announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: TVET nkoraria chitariki chiogosaba chigokora omoroberio bwogotera abana chiri ase chisukuru chire Taita-Taveta County.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Egekereka: NDMA egosomia erogwo ongekereka yekibweta nechiseguro ya SIM-swap yobamenyi yokaunti ya Mombasa.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe Bene kiobochori gia IEBC gochakiwa bene:Ekeombe bene kerachie kobachora abateneneri bene bekeombe kiobochori nechimbebe giachakigwe bene ase okobekwa ase obokoreri bene nyuma ebina ebinge ebio biabwateranetie ogochorwa geekeombe ekio egechore. omonachi ebina omonene Martha koome oboririe ekeombe ekio kwangoyia obochori obwo asengecho nigo babwate amatuko emerongo 30 goikerania obochori obwo.

English: Conduct fire drills in schools 2020.
Kiswahili: Fanya mazoezi ya zimamoto shuleni 2020.
Ekegusii: Kebe nomoroberio bwokomanya buna omorero gose esitima egotumeka gotanga ogwateka kwomorero esukuru 2020.

English: ODPP urges residents of Bomet County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya bomet kwerikia amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto na kogikera amang'ana igoro yosoma.

English: EACC urges residents of Nyeri County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: EACC obasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya nyeri kusoma chishei chechisemo chikuru kabu chenene kumiseme kuchikia mpamire mokoriti.

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Garissa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'Emasomo nkoraba abanto bose bwa Garissa County gochaka goisoma ase eprogramu y'abanto bakure erio gochaka gocha ase amasomo ayo.

English: Government has urged maize farmers to plant early maturity variety during short rains season.
Kiswahili: Serikali imewahimiza wakulima wa mahindi kupanda aina ya mahindi ya mapema wakati wa msimu wa mvua.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nogo egosorora abaremi ebimeri biebituma biria bikwama bwngo buna enchera eyomo yogwekongia ase embure enyeng'e.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Makueni County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorosia ere nakobeka endorero e Makueni County nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao okobwatia komanya buna amasomo yegedichitari birengere.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekobasoka abanto inga obokonyi bwogosira oboiboi bwa chindawa chiobochari nigo boriri ase chifasiliti chiobochari chia kaunti ase Baringo County.

English: Farmers are encouraged to engage in the production of palm oil sunflower and soya to reduce reliance on edible oil imports Your participation is vital for achieving self sufficiency in edible oils
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kujihusisha na uzalishaji wa alizeti na soya ili kupunguza utegemezi wa mafuta ya kula kutoka nje Ushiriki wako ni muhimu katika kufikia utoshelevu wa mafuta ya kula.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria amakendo, sunflower na soya ni amakoriria akiyegwa kwamba kumwita kufunza kuhuma kwenye mafuta omokera. Mwisho wenu ni muhimu kwa kufikisha kumwita kufunza kuhuma kwenye mafuta omokera.

English: KICD invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: KICD nigo egokwaneria abasae ase ekaunti ya Kiambu gochia goikara ase amachio okwiga okorungia emotokaa ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Nyaraka: Eminisitiri yechisemi yaansire omoroberio bwechisemi ase ogokonya abana goetera ogosemia abechisekenderi gokonya abana goetera Narok.

English: Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imezindua simu ya dharura kwa ajili ya kuripoti ulaghai wa uigaji unaohusisha watoa huduma bandia za simu. Piga 0800 222 777 ili kuripoti.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe getenenerete oboererania bwamang'ana giaansire enamba ya morero gokonya koyemanyia gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. Aka esimi 0800 222 777 koyemanyia amang'ana ayio.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) baboririe abamenyi echi kaunti ya Kakamega kogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu, ogotunya goetera abanto amang'ana na komanyia abanto amang'ana gochitangutangu SIM-swap.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Riaro ryi Oboremi na Kurema ryi Kurema ri nyanja Elgeyo-Marakwet ri kumwona ogokomera okogesa okokera kurema amaroba amakera amagoro ogokomera okotoke amagoro ya October.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo korwa ase ekeombe gekorora na gokorera chindwara (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response): chichiniki chiokororwa kwabana na babaibori bagocha gokorwa kera omotienyi 9 ase chinchera chiobusirika chire ase Baringo County.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: IPOA yaboririe abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kirinyaga kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kwenye magitasi abamenyo, kumwe kwenye kibero kibabirichu kwa nyumbani naboasioku.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Siaya County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: IEBC yaborire abamenyi yas Siaya County bono goikera obokoreri bwepasipoto yoboremi ngoro ngosira kegima goetera chinchera chiancheire.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: free antenatal care clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za bure za huduma ya ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo korwa ase Kenya Medical Association: chinkliniki chiokorora abanyamwaka chire bwere chigakora chirore omotienyi 2 ase chinchera chiabonyagitari chire Wajir County.

English: Women play a crucial role in dairy. Learn about specific programs, resources, and markets targeting women in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu muhimu katika maziwa. Jifunze kuhusu programu mahususi, rasilimali, na masoko yanayolenga wanawake katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abang'ina mbare nensemo enene ase oboremi bwetugo yamabere. Egera komanya emeroberio ereo, ebiganeirie, amo nechiro erengete abang'ina ase oboremi.

English: TSC reminds youth in Nairobi County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: TSC ekobasoka abasubati ase Nairobi County buna oboikoni bwa HELB bwoire ase okosomwa kwokorunga chinguo na okobora.

English: Beer and smocking increases blood warmth. When you are at home, reduce taking beer and smocking
Kiswahili: Pombe na pombe huongeza joto la damu.
Ekegusii: Amarwa n’esigara nigo bikomenta obokong’u bw’okonyora riberera riamanyinga. Ekero ore inka, keia konywa amaru gose konywa esigara.

English: SHA invites residents of Narok County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok kojikarana amaswari ase ebirengererio bia abanto konyora ebikaranso biechinkwana chia bonsi.

English: Ensure textbooks by January 6, 2025.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha vitabu vya kiada ifikapo Januari 6, 2025.
Ekegusii: Rora nga nore nebitabu biogosoma nyuma ya yechitariki 6 omotienyi omotangani, 2025.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria: KMTC okoigora egera ebitabu na bionsi biria abana ba Kiambu County.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Kirinyaga County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KTDA nigo egokabera abanyamwaka imbeu chie chibage chie chinchera chie chibere ase abanyamwaka aaria ekaonti ya Kirinyaga ase omotienyi 7.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Uasin Gishu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti kesi hiyo kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Chikorikia baboririe Kenya komanyia abanto basabirwe choria gose Uasin Gishu County bakarwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi, nchire negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna abana.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Kiambu County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo egokomanyia abaremi ba Kiambu County igoro yomwaka ogochire ogokora emechando yegokora amakande ase abaremi.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kitui County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette baborigwe abanto boni Kitui County koenana amang'ana obogaang a gose korarore bokurumi bonded bwonsi ase obokoreri aka EACC erio obeke amang'ana igoro y'obokurumi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Baringo County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekoroberia oborimu (SHA) nikigoibokia abanto ba Baringo County igoro yobwate bwa okonyora oboroberio bwokorengera oborimu bwa amariogo ase oboramu bweka.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Busia County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufikiaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwa Amagenderero nigo boborete abanto ba Busia County buna ogokonya kwa NHIF/SHA nigo kwarete ase ebikaro biria biachigirwe.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu Julai.
Ekegusii: Nabongo: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro obogaang a Nairobi County engoromomi.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Kurasa: IPOA okoigora ogoro oratenge amakonde na korenada rigesa tirisareka ochakire aaria ekaonti ya Nakuru.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Machakos County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen yaboria ase baria buekaunti Machakos batarere abisi ere ange na koerikia Huduma Centre yogoaka chikura.

English: DCI alerts residents of Bungoma County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: DCI yasemirie abamenyi bo Bungoma Gotanga komanyia eserikari bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu gosoa ebiombe biobosaria gose.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Laikipia County this June.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Juni hii.
Ekegusii: KICD ngokora kere omoroberio bwogosomia abanto igoro yamachiko yoboronge bwomonto mu Laikipia ebuagi.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Samburu County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ekerongo: IEBC ekororie abamenyi ba Samburu Abarwaire kwa rigoro kwa amagenderero yorogongo ya kubanga kwa bokora.

English: SHA updates residents of Nakuru County on progress of the county integrated development plan this June.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Juni.
Ekegusii: SHA yasegetire abamenyi gwekaonti ya Nakuru kwerwa amagenderero yekaonti yabo yasiyamagenderero ebuagi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Makueni County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha usajili wa IEBC.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonene yomwiti yasegetire abasae baikire emeika yogoaka chikura, batarere abisi Makueni yotarere chisekenderi IEBC yotokororire.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Kisii County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za maharagwe kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.
Ekegusii: AFA to tondoma miroo mukomo osingi kwa abakula Kisii omonugunoobarema

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Busia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe yomosaria yob erekera abamenyi yobusia kobwaterana komenta omosiongoroko korenda abamenyi

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kitui County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure abamenyi ime yekaunti ya Kitui okobwatanigwa abanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. okosimia amang'ana ayio gosiira gacha abasikari igoro yabanto bageirw.

English: UNDP feature on community policing, Nyumba Kumi and Youth liaison programs in Kenya
Kiswahili: Makala ya UNDP kuhusu polisi jamii, Nyumba Kumi na programu za uhusiano na vijana nchini Kenya
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse chikwegambera nemeroberio yamagenderero (UNDP) nkworokereria ere igoro yabarendi boborendi (Community Policing), Nyumba Kumi amo nemeroberio yogoikera abasae (Youth liaison programs) aiga Kenya

English: Chege Kirundi has been elected as the new Chairman of KTDA Holdings Board Tea farmers should stay informed of any upcoming changes in policies or operations
Kiswahili: Chege Kirundi amechaguliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti mpya wa Bodi ya Wakulima wa Chai ya KTDA wanapaswa kujulishwa kuhusu mabadiliko yoyote yajayo ya sera au uendeshaji.
Ekegusii: Chege Kirundi amecheleka kama ekeyia Mwaki wa KTDA Holdings Board Tea farmers kubera tebia kwa changanyiko zya chandiko au kufanya kwa mawasiliano

English: The government target 7.4 million children under 5 years with polio vaccination expected to be conducted strateing from Wednesday
Ekegusii: Eserekari yarengire koa echancho ya polio ase abana chimirioni 7 4 inse yemiaka etano chingaji chiekampeini yechancho eyio ekageire gochaka etichi gatano

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorora abamwalimu (TSC) nigo koretete chitariki chiokorendia abana ase amasomo amanyinge goetera oboremi bwekeombe keria kire Nyandarua.

English: Youth engagement took centre stage in Kisumu County this week as leaders threw down the gauntlet, urging young residents to swap spectator seats for the architect's table in governance.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa vijana ulichukua nafasi muhimu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wiki hii huku viongozi wakipuuza vikwazo, wakiwahimiza wakazi vijana kubadilishana viti vya watazamaji na meza ya mbunifu katika utawala.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana nabasae aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu ewiki eye nigo kwabete kwomonguso ase abant abange ekero abarai barwete ogosaba nga abasae babogorie egetambokero kioborendi. Gosegeta abasae batige koba magega na abarigereria korende korende kobwaterana korora ng'a ebirengererio biabo biasoire ase emeroberio yobogamb gose oborai.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: OGP oinyoria obokoreri bweyera gokonyora esatifiketi yokoiborwa gose gokorika chiekaonti ya Uasin Gishu.

English: EACC invites residents of Nandi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasilisha maadhimisho ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: EACC obokemera abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Nandi kushenge amaandoko ariego kwekechokanaine kwekogwana agwika kwevyo.

English: NPS warns residents of Nyeri County to prepare for possible flooding this November.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri okobereko oborwaire rwa' chingokero hii November.

English: UNODC highlights Kenya’s strategy development and shares regional best practices.
Kiswahili: UNODC inasisitiza maendeleo ya mkakati wa Kenya na inashiriki mazoea bora ya kikanda.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse chire chikwegambera gokinana namariogo oagotindia (UNODC) kiarokirie omoroberio buna Kenya yagendereire ase emeremo yaye na kererania ayakorirwe buya chingongo ao ao.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: SHA koaregania oyera obokurumi ime yense ID gosanga ase amagenderero yorogongo ime yekaunti ya nyamira.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kirinyaga County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi ya Kirinyaga County yao okogaba ebesa obokoreri nde ogwesi gose ebengi yao koboria yaringana erio, tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa PIN nonde bwensi.

English: KICD calls on the community in Nairobi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KICD b erekera egonde go Nairobi County sira amagancha ase gacha esukuru abwekaine.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: Ogokororia: DCI okoigora abachokoro bwekochera bwekochimbebe nobochori ekaonti ya Mandera.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Wajir County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiababoririe obosae Wajir Komenta kiababoririe kore kore koba koba ayechinse chia isiko erio gokonya amakora agokorera.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omwango: KEMRI eragabana obokoreri oboikeranu obwogosangia obuya bwe chinyomba chiokorara ase Baringo County ase omotienyi 10.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an August awareness campaign on food safety across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Agosti kuhusu usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Medical Association kigocha gosekeria omwaka ogochire omotienyi 8 ase ogokonya abanto bamenye igoro yoborugi bwe echio inse ya Kajiado County.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Machakos County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KTDA negenderete gosegeta abaremi ba Machakos County goikera chinyomba chiokogwata amache ase emegondo yabo nigo barakonye goikera obororo bwa chimbura chire gochinduka.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Ekegusii: Ogindigwa goitabwa neserikari koba Narok koegerera chinchogu nintaneti ntsa e-Citizen portal.

English: Youth Agenda simulates legislative sessions for youth learning.
Ekegusii: Achenda yabasae nkwegeria ere buna ebtengo bieserikari bikorosia amachiko ase ogosoma.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Nyamira County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekobasoka abanto ba Nyamira County ng'a oboikoni bwemeremo yechigagari nigo bwaikorete ase chinsagia chieretwe.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Nyandarua County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yabooririe abasae entongori yogoaka chikura korikia Nyandarua tarere enyomba y'oboringoria ere ange naye otari IEBC.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nigo eregoibokia abanto bonse buna oboate bwo gochanda obwoba nigo bori ase obosa ase chichibitaro chiachisemi chiao Tana River County.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Aprili.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nkoeboria abareeri abana ase Kilifi County gochia na abana babo ase ogokorwa ogokwanirwa ogokura ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 4 kw'obogwenia bw'abang'ina.

English: Government announces significant investment in upgrading and expanding school infrastructure nationwide.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yararirie gosira ammagacho a bono na kogarei chisukuru chingongo chionsi.

English: Thousands attend blue caravan tours Nyanza region. Tour aims at educating Kenyans on good nutrition. Roadshow is partnership between RMS and Blue Band
Ekegusii: Chirifu chia abanto gosanga ase omorobiri bw'orogendo erangi yerire oeogongo rwa Nyanza Orogendo oree ndorigetie gosemia abakenya igoro yokoragera okuya Amaorokererio apara nokobwaterana egati ya RMS amo na Blue Band

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale.

Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) kinyoria goika ase ebikaranso bia amaswari ase Kakamega chikaonti.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a stress management forum in Lamu County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Lamu Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Etebi: KEMRI erakore omwamo bwogosaria oborito bwomoyo ase Lamu County omotienyi o omotienyi 9. Abanto bonsi nigo baranyare gocha.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Garissa County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwa ere ababai na barimu a Garissa County akonyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English:
Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you.

Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua Jumuiya ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya inatoa huduma za ushauri wa bure 24/7? Tupigie simu 1199 na tutakuwa hapo kwa ajili yako. Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Msaada wa Saikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.
Ekegusii: Inee, nomanyete ing'a Kenya Red Cross Society mbabwate obosemia bwa bosa goetera esimi 24/7? Toakere esimi ase 1199 nao tore ase eng'encho yao. Koru Januari-Juni 2019, chitimu chiaito chia Afya y'obongo amo na Obokonyi bwa kisaikolojia nchiabwatire chisimi 513

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Migori County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo obasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia buna obokurumi na koria amaaki ase chokaonti, obokoreri bwabo bokwana bokwana na bokwana bokwana.

English: NPS calls on the community in Isiolo County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: NPS b erekera egonde ase Isiolo County ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: Eligible youth in Uganda can access opportunities under the new National Strategy for Youth Employment in Agriculture Engage with the Ministry of Agriculture for details on participation
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaostahiki nchini Uganda wanaweza kupata fursa chini ya Mkakati mpya wa Kitaifa wa Ajira kwa Vijana katika Kilimo Shirikiana na Wizara ya Kilimo kwa maelezo zaidi juu ya ushiriki.
Ekegusii: Obosae bokosha boganda binga kochera obosia korwa omoroberio bwense gokongia abanto gwetanga gosoa obokebago namasomo agosaria obongo oboremi. Nkorwa kere meministiri yamang'ana abasae oboremi korwa omoroberio bokosha.

English: Comic translated into 3 languages
Kiswahili: Katuni iliyotafsiriwa katika lugha 3
Ekegusii: Enkwana ase ebiorokererio yaonchoirwe ase emenwa yebisaku bitato

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cassava growers in Narok County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Narok kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitury yoboremi na oborabu gw'obokonyi gw'omogaso gw'okogacha ogosoroma ebimeri bikoremereria omorakera ebikonyi ebinyasi bya Narok County oyera amagoro ogw'okonyi.

English: OGP invites residents of Kwale County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: OGP obachikirie abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kwale gosia amaswari ya gosanga ya gosoma na korika goikera amang'ana igoro yosoma.

English: KRA advises residents of Nairobi County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: KRA gokonye gachiria omwami wa Nairobi County bogoria yonsi amasakara yagokorwa, ogokonye koira esatifiketi yokoiborwa yagokorwa.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Taita-Taveta County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen orure okoboria gochia ase eserekari eyuo kobeka ebango enene ase emerongi gose mogoka ase Taita-Taveta.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Busia County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa maombi ya wanafunzi wenye uhitaji utafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: KNEC riokorwa abana baria bare nokogania mo Busia County ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria ticha ria.

English: The Committee on World Food Security CFS continues to promote food security and nutrition for all All stakeholders are encouraged to participate in this multistakeholder platform
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Usalama wa Chakula Duniani CFS inaendelea kuhimiza usalama wa chakula na lishe kwa wote Wadau wote wanahimizwa kushiriki katika jukwaa hili la wadau wengi.
Ekegusii: Kamiti ya Usalama wa Endagera ya Dunia CFS inaendelea kusimamia usalama wa endagera na lishe kwa yonsi Wafanyikazi wote wanawekwa kuaminika kuhusika katika mfumo huu wa wafanyikazi wengi

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Nairobi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board nigo korigiririe abaremi ba Nairobi County gochia ase ogotara chinchera chiogotindania chimboga na emegondo nigo konyora obuya bwobota bwomoto mbere yomwaka omotienyi 6 ogotara.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free safe water storage outreach in Nandi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itakuwa mwenyeji wa ufikiaji wa bure wa uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nandi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonwa omonene: CDC egokora omokono bwokobatara amache amayera ase Nandi County ase omotienyi 1.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Siaya County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: SHA agasaba abamenyi omonto goetera goacka chikura chi Siaya kaonti korwa ebirengeererio biabo goikerania esafari yamagenderero eki arengete.

English: CS Machogu urges TVET principals to entrench dual training.
Ekegusii: Omomonisita bwechisemi Machogu osabire abarimu abanene bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ogarei amasomo ase baria bakwegera.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a January awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yaansire omwaka bwa omotienyi 1 bwa ogoteba abanto ase ogosima oborwaire bwa sukari ase Nandi County.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a tea collection centre in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: Ebisarori bi'oborimi n'ebirero (AFA) nigo bigocharia ebituo bi'ogosangia chicha ase Kitui County ase omotienyi 5.

English: NPS urges the community in Busia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Ekegusii: NPS egegusa egonde ase ekaunti ya Busia okobagera magwiko y'okobagera y'omwana omwana na abao abasani abo bembeo okorwania okobagera y'okobagera y'omwana omwana.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Mombasa County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe KICD nigo kigoikera abana batari amasomoni ase Mombasa County gochia kogwancha abana babo ase esukuru y'omomura erie ekeene ase amasomo abakuru.

English: KNEC announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: KNEC yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Nairobi Julai hii.
Ekegusii: KNEC ogosaba ogokora kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara kwao esikulu Nairobi County engoromomi.

English: NCPB urges beans growers in Kitui County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kitui kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia NCPB nigo kigochaera abanyabirage b'ebihingwa bia chimboco ase Kitui County gochia gokora okoruchia ebihingwa nigo bagochia gokonya obotambe bw'echiura nigo bagochia gokonya okonyora ebihingwa biange ase omwaka oyu.

English: TVET advises applicants in Laikipia County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET nigo kigoikania abasabi abari Laikipia County goika bagasajiri mbere yomwaka gokomera ase okorika okwo okwagochaka.

English: CDC encourages residents of Kirinyaga County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bera ase Kirinyaga County tibakaganya gochaka ase obororo, na bagende bagotebia omonyabwate orengeirwe gochia gobaria.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: IPOA yarure abamenyi ase Nyamira gieserekari kiaboririe koba maiso erio gokoboria obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Marsabit County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service kigoika gocheria abaremi ba Marsabit County igoro yoboremi bwokobeka amariogo ase omotienyi 11.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Ngo: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) nkiarwete ngoro gokonya gisikomokorere na komanyia abanto amang'ana bungoma Bungoma.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa kwa amariko amake yechisimi igoro yokoragera okuya kera omokubio ase abanyene ekeombe chimirioni ibere

English: State Dept. promoting millet and sorghum blends as pilot menu in adaptation to climate-resilient diets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo inakuza mchanganyiko wa mtama na mtama kama menyu ya majaribio katika kukabiliana na lishe zinazostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwa eserekali ngosegeta ere oboremi rwa obori na amaemba komentwa ase chindagera chia amatemwa korwana na ogoonchoka kwa erire

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Siaya County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekio okorora amabere n'ebinyamwamu (KEPHIS) nigo kigoibokia abaremi b'ebinyamwamu ase Siaya County kogecha gotwara ebinyamwamu biabo gochia ase chikaunti chinde batari na echitibika erio korigia obuya bw'ebinyamwamu.

English: KRA reminds voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere barigetie buna abaaki chikura mbuya ere getera SMS kwa 70000 kwa kinyo kwa nyoro yobochori.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Murang'a County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Biombe bieserikari igoro yamasomo oboroso b erekera egonde go Murang'a gacha amagancha ase gachia egera nchire nokogania okonene neribaga rigiya riemeremo.

English: KICD reminds youth in Mandera County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Ekegusii: KICD nigo egokora abasubati ase Mandera County buna obonyagwate bwa HELB bwo gochia ase amasomo y'okorua na okorora abageni nigo bori.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Wajir County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Gazeti ya Kenya okoboria ase baria buekaunti Wajir egokonye koira omogambi omonene obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: TSC increases intern salary to Ksh 45,000 effective January.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) nkogesa kere omosara bwabarimu baria kiarigete bwechisingi 45,000 gochakera omotienyi omotang'ani.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of sheep in Laikipia County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Ekegusii: Amachiko: KTDA nigo eganirie okogenda kwa chimburi ase Laikipia County goetera oborwa bwe'chirabi.

English: ODPP advises residents of Homa Bay County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Homa Bay bogoria yonsi amasakara yao buna ogosomia nyuma yechitariki ogokora emeremo yao buna ogosomia buya gochia (ID) nyuma yechitariki.

English: ODPP updates residents of Nyandarua County on progress of community-based development programmes this May.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Mei.
Ekegusii: ODPP yarure okoboria gochia ase egonde ya Nyandarua amaumuntia amaumuntia.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises horticultural produce producers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo korigiririe abaremi b'ebitoki na ebituma ase Nandi County kora ebitoki biabo goetera abaguri baria bare na ebisiteti (licensed) mbere y'omwaka ogw'ogugesa.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in West Pokot County this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie okoboria obokwana bw'amasomo kwa endorero ebisakane kwa esikulu z'omwaka West Pokot eng'atiato.

English: Young parent may be scared or fear. Dialogue with community assistance groups can be of great help to delink those fears
Ekegusii: Abasubati abageni ase oboibori nabo bakonyora omoichano gose obwoba. Gokwanerwa okuya n'ebiombe bie obokonyi nabo kogokonya.

English: TVET reminds youth in Nyeri County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET kigoibokia abasubati ase Nyeri County buna obonyinge bwa HELB bwarenge ase okorugwa amagenderero ase obumanyi bwa ICT.

English: Kenya is pushing forward with its international labour initiatives by sending 350 seasonal workers to the United Kingdom, despite the recent wave of violent protests that have rocked the former coloni...
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendeleza mipango yake ya kimataifa ya kazi kwa kutuma wafanyakazi 350 wa msimu nchini Uingereza, licha ya wimbi la hivi karibuni la maandamano yenye vurugu ambayo yamegonga koloni ya zamani...
Ekegusii: Kenya negenderete gosuka motwe nemeroberio yaye yobokoreri kimataifa ase ogotoma abakori emeremo 350 bechingaki  gochia United Kingdom, nonya chisegi na amaandamo ase ense eyio...

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: IPOA nigosaba abamotoli nobabanto bagotara Baringo County ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache, ng'abogendia obobe gochia igoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kisumu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia IEBC nigo kogoita abasubati ase Kisumu County gochia korigisibwa ase ogotemwa bwe ogokora chigari (motor vehicle mechanics) ase omotienyi 7.

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabekireebitambokero ekero ebinyinyi ebinyia bia Korona biamentekanete goika 15 ime ye'chinsa 72 chiaetire. Amachiko amayia nigo achete magega yabanto bande batano na batato gopimwa na konyorekana na COVID-19.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekoreibokia abanto aaria ekaonti ya Machakos igoro yobwenereti bw'ebirero ase obonyamu bw'echiika.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Meru County.
Ekegusii: Chinje: IPOA okoigora chitaa chokobaa oboraro nechinchera chiokobaonchoreria gochia obogime obuya buekaunti Meru.

English: Raise awareness about corruption effects to encourage ethical conduct among citizens
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa kuhusu athari za rushwa ili kuhimiza mwenendo wa kimaadili miongoni mwa raia
Ekegusii: Manya abanto obobe bwobokengeka erio koa abanto omoyo gokorera abande buya.

English: KTDA warns sweet potatoes farmers in Tana River County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KTDA nkoaburia abanyamwaka bwechingwaci ase Tana River County igoro yechinyamunyi chigokora obwate na gosegeta okorua ase obwate obo nchera eyemo.

English: NTSA urges residents of Narok County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NTSA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok kojweterane na bokwemurunganania bokwemuruganania omosiongoroko.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.

English: Farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to consider maize as fodder for dairy cows as it has advantages over napier grass for silage making
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wanahimizwa kuzingatia mahindi kama lishe ya ng'ombe wa maziwa kwani yana faida zaidi ya nyasi ya napier kwa kutengeneza silage.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kajiado County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Mandera County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this March.
